As shown by Hiruzen, this technique can be used in conjunction with Earth Release: Earth Dragon Bullet to ignite the projectiles fired by the latter technique, making it more devastating.
Fire Release: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet: After kneading chakra, the user breathes fire from their mouth. The flames are manipulated into the shape of a dragon and divided to strike the target from the left, right, and front all at once. Unlike the Great Fireball, which covers a wide area, the Fire Dragon Flame Bullet makes focused strikes, quickly reducing targets to ash upon contact. Alternately, the flames can coil around the target and form into a vortex, effectively keeping them trapped in place unless they can escape through the top. This technique is regarded as one of the most powerful Fire Release techniques, being several times more intense than the Great Fireball and greatly surpassing it in range. Even among the techniques mastered by the Third Hokage, this technique has outstanding power that he was proud of. Because of the power of this technique, as well as the amount of skill it takes to control the flames, there are very few shinobi who can perform it, the Third Hokage being one such user.
Fire Release: Fire Dragon Wall: The user forms a circular wall of fire around themselves and their opponent, preventing them from escaping during their fight.
Fire Release: Fire Wind Wild Blade: Madara shoots a fireball and attacks the opponent with both his sickle and gunbai in the expelled flames.
Fire Release: Fired Pottery Technique: The user creates powerful flames inside the giant oven created by the Lightning Release: Sixteen Pillar Bind, cooking the opponent until they are burned. It's used together with Earth Release: Sticky Earth Drop to harden the mud covering the enemy's body and subsequently immobilising them.
Fire Release: Flame Attack: The user imbues their fists with Fire Release. Upon striking the target, they will be consumed by flames. In the anime, this technique is capable of throwing flames in the direction of the attacks, which was powerful enough to incinerate kunai.
Fire Release: Flame Bullet: This technique is executed by the user gathering oil in their mouth which is created by chakra, spitting it out, and igniting it. This technique simply shoots a flame bullet at the enemy. If the amount of oil that is prepared is kept down, the time it takes to invoke the technique is reduced. This allows the enemy to be stricken unaware, allowing the oil-containing flame bullet to burn them up completely. It is also possible to shoot out a series of flame bullets by partitioning the oil, or a continuous flamethrower. If this technique is fired after covering the enemy with oil using the Toad Oil Bullet, it has the power to wound or kill. This also keeps down the consumption of chakra.
Fire Release: Flame Capture: The user creates a fire whip. It can knock an opponent a considerable distance, strong enough to damage rock.
Fire Release: Flame Murdering Boundary: After the chakra kneaded inside his body is converted into fire, Obito jumps a considerable amount of height and spews a large orb of flames straight to the opponent.
Fire Release: Flame Spear: The user creates a blade of fire, the flames of which spread horizontally ahead of them. The fire will go out if the user loses consciousness.
Fire Release: Flame Tiger Bombing: Jakō Ryūdōin summons a tiger made of flames from the scroll on his back, inflicting massive damage to the player's team, additionally having the ability to attach to the opponent and explode with much impact. This technique is similar to Fire Release: Great Dragon Fire Technique and Exploding Dragon Strike, except that it uses a tiger rather than a dragon. It is also somewhat similar to a explosive tag, but far stronger.
Fire Release: Flame Wave Technique: Hikari spews flames that split into three waves in three separate directions.
Fire Release: Flame Whirlwind: Fire erupts around the user's body in a spiralling manner which is then launched with his hands towards the target. Once the technique hits the target, the opponent is sent into the air in a spiralling manner and their body burns into ashes.
Fire Release: Flame Wrapping Sickle Danc: Madara covers his kama in flames and spins around, slashing any opponent in his reach, finally slamming down from above.
Fire Release: Flaming Hail: The user conjures a barrage of arrows made of fire. Any arrows that miss will spread fire around the surroundings.
Fire Release: Flint Yagura Technique: The user throws a lighter on the ground in front of his opponent and expands the flame into a wall of fire. It is noted to be a technique that "makes a small spark burst into a pillar of fire".
Fire Release: Flying Flame Bullet: While in his level two cursed seal form, Sasuke exhales a stronger short-range version of the Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique.
Fire Release: Fox Fire: The user manifests ten fire balls in a circle in front of them and launches them with their hand motions.
Fire Release: Great Blaze Ball: Itachi exhales a meteor-sized sphere of fire that carries the enemy away and causes a massive explosion on impact. The impact causes the ground around Itachi to break apart while he remains unfazed. This is much like Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique, but a larger and more destructive version.
Fire Release: Great Dragon Fire Techniqu: The user compresses a large amount of chakra built up inside their body and changes it into a dragon head-shaped fireball. The user then skilfully manipulates that great fire, and attacks their opponent. Even outside of the attack range, its power and reliability are stressed.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: The pinnacle of Uchiha Fire Release techniques, chakra kneaded inside the body is converted into fire, and then expelled from the mouth and shaped into a literal sea of flames, which covers a wide range as well. This makes the technique extremely difficult to either avoid or contain, with it requiring the combined efforts of several Water Release users in order to extinguish the flames.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: D: Madara attacks his opponent by creating trees that push them back, then throwing them up in the air. Madara jumps up as well, and sets his opponent and the trees he created on fire.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: E: Madara elbows his opponent, follows with a series of Susanoo sword slashes, strikes his opponent with his Susanoo's right arm, slamming its palm at the opponent. The palm attack lifts Madara in the air, where he finishes the opponent with a Fire Release.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: H: Madara elbows his opponent, follows with a series of Susanoo sword slashes, the last two of which throw the opponent up into the air, where Madara then blows a large amount of flames at the opponent.
Fire Release: Great Fire Destruction: A technique where chakra kneaded inside the user's body is converted into fire, and then expelled from the mouth in a massive stream of intense flames that can set a vast area ablaze, engulfing the target in a veritable sea of flames. If used upon a dense, combustible terrain, such as a forest, the confined area can greatly increase the possibility of the target's incineration.
Fire Release: Great Fire Heavenly Prison: A stronger version of the Fire Release: Heavenly Prison that can be used on larger targets. Unlike with the parent technique, when this is used the person's entire body is engulfed in flames as the cursed seal is branded on them.
Fire Release: Great Fire Wall Technique: The user expels a wall of flames to defend themselves and burn the opponent.
Fire Release: Great Fire Whirlwind: Madara swings his war fan and breathes fire into the swing, creating a wall of flaming whirlwinds.
Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique —: Tobi fans a gust of wind at the opponent with his gunbai and sets the whirlwind ablaze with Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique creating a big fire storm attack to burn his opponent.
Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique:: Sasuke elbows his opponent, followed by sword strikes and knee attacks, before jumping above and behind them and launching a fireball.
Obito lands a series of hits, finishing with an upwards double kick, sending his opponent up in the air. As they fall down, Obito shoots a burst of fire at them.

Itachi attacks his opponent with a series of mixed methods, including kicks, punches, and stabs with kunai. During the attack string, he creates a shadow clone, which attacks with a flurry of shuriken, and the real Itachi finishes with a fireball attack.
Fire Release: Great Flame Flower: Kneading his chakra and then converting it to fire, the user creates a multitude of fireballs at the same time which then rain down on the target causing severe, widespread damage around the field. These fireballs can easily destroy Earth Release-created shelters and even overpower Water Release attacks.
Fire Release: Great Flame Rasengan: Jiraiya creates a normal Rasengan, then spews fire onto it, causing it to turn black and be surrounded by a ring of flames. He then hits the opponent, causing a blazing maelstrom of fire, reducing the opponent to ashes.
Fire Release: Great Flame Technique: The Fire Release: Great Flame Technique is a hiden Fire Release technique utilised by the Sarutobi clan.
Fire Release: Heavenly Prison: The Fire Release: Heavenly Prison is an used by Mui's clan.
Fire Release: Hiding in Ash and Dust Tec: The user expels chakra-infused ash that blanket a wide area, burning anyone who comes in contact with it. The technique can also be used as a powerful deterrent from attacks as well as a highly effective smokescreen. This technique is a far more effective substitute for smoke bombs since the user doesn't need their hands to be free nor does this technique require hand seals.
Fire Release: Hiding in Fire Technique: Using this technique, a user can hide themselves inside a flame. Upon leaving concealment, flames burn, revealing the user. A member of the Nokizaru Group made use of this technique during a mission to retrieve a stolen scroll from Kumogakure shinobi.
Fire Release: Hurricane Oil Flame Bullet: The user creates two shadow clones that shoot oil while the original shoots fire, creating a flaming twister.
Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work: Kakuzu's fire-element mask fires a small fireball that erupts into a giant fire-storm after making contact with a surface, causing widespread destruction to the area. Since the flames travel along the ground, and cover such a wide area this is a difficult technique to evade. When combined with Wind Release: Pressure Damage, this technique is amplified to the point of being able to evaporate a large amount of water in an instant.
Fire Release: Mist Blaze Dance Technique: The user is able to create and blow a flammable gas from their lungs. Once it comes in contact with fire or spark, the gas ignites into a large fireball. Kagerō used this technique while disguised as Kabuto Yakushi.
Fire Release: Nail Crimson Crow Leap: Shisui delivers a series of swift strikes to his opponent, then proceeds to toss a volley of fire-infused kunai, from an aerial perspective, at the opponent, the flames of which spark a devastating explosion.
Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Techniqu: The user spits a volley of small fireballs into the air; at a glance, it can appear as though there was only one fireball that then burst into many. The many small flames move wildly through the area, potentially mesmerising targets as they're surrounded. The user controls each individual flame with their chakra, allowing them to guide each at the target and, consequently, making this technique difficult to evade. Shuriken can be hidden within the flames, not only making them more deadly upon impact but also, by controlling the flames' movements, giving users a means of controlling the shuriken as well.
Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Flower Nail C: The user unleashes a volley of shuriken with one hand, and at the same time, exhales fire-infused chakra onto them in order to increase the weapons' destructive potential by making them capable of inflicting severe burns upon direct contact with either the intended victim, or any other object caught within their trajectories.
Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Formation Tec: Multiple users spit several fireballs while surrounding their opponent from above, making it impossible to avoid them.
Fire Release: Prison Flame Mask: While in his long-range form, Kakuzu unleashes a torrent of fireballs at his opponent which explode on impact.
Fire Release: Roaring Flame Technique: Fugaku spews flames that envelop the opponent in a fiery sphere, bursting with them within it.
Fire Release: Running Fire: This technique creates a stream of fire that can be manipulated into several forms (so far, rings of fire that run on the ground or a circle of fire flying through the air) before striking the target. It can also be used in combination with Wind Release: Divine Wind to create a tornado of flames, or with Wind Release: Divine Mountain Wind to release a massive inferno, the latter which is made even more powerful when used in an enclosed space created by Earth Release: Earth Corridor.
Fire Release: Smokescreen Gale: The user spits out a flaming tornado from their mouth, which was noted to be powerful enough to incinerate everything it comes into contact with like paper. When in contact with large volumes of water, the technique creates a dense cloud of steam.
Fire Release: Soaring Flame Bullet Techn: The user gathers chakra from their stomach and spews a small ball of fire. The required hand seals needed for this technique have varied; Kawaki's first use required one hand seal (two in the anime) however, later in the anime, using four hand seals were used.
Fire Release: Toad Oil Flame Bullet: This is a cooperation ninjutsu performed by a toad and a fire user who have achieved mental and physical harmony with each other. The toad (specifically a large toad such as Gamabunta) uses its large lung capacity to spray toad oil from its mouth at a target. The fire user then ignites the oil, increasing the attack's range and power; Jiraiya uses Fire Release: Flame Bullet for this purpose. In the anime, Naruto Uzumaki instead sets flame to the oil with an exploding tag. The resulting cloud of fire is great enough that it forces Manda to shed its skin to escape.
Fire Release: Two-Headed Dragon Fire: He: Sasuke creates two shadow clones, who breathe dragon-shaped fireballs at his opponents while he throws a kunai above them. Sasuke switches places with the kunai, raining a circle of fire from above.
Fire Release: Uchiha Great Flame Sphere: Sasuke and Itachi both perform Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique which when combined form a giant fireball that explodes on the opponent.
Fire Release: Water Mist: Kakashi creates a bird of flames under his complete control that quickly flies into a designated water source, burning hot enough to cause the water to evaporate. The bird disappears as soon as the water is gone. Alternatively, the bird can release streams of fire from its mouth for offensive purposes.
Fire Release: Wind Release: Blazing Wind: While in his long-range form and in mid-air, Kakuzu sends a powerful torrent of wind and fire.
Fire Sealing Method: The user first readies a scroll that they've previously inscribed with a special sealing formula, which has a blank space left in its centre. They then activate this technique, quickly sucking any nearby Fire Release into the blank space and sealing it there, signified by the appearance of the kanji for . Regardless of any special properties that the flames may have, such as those of Amaterasu, they will remain sealed until the user chooses to unseal them. Because this technique is designed for Fire Release, performing it requires expertise in not only using seals but ninjutsu as well.
Fire Whirlwind Vortex Technique: First, the user uses Fire Release: Flint Yagura to create a wall of fire in front of the enemy and then uses Wind Release: Whirlwind Fist to blow the flames into the enemy, creating a blazing firestorm that leaves the surrounding area scorched.
First Axe Strike: The user, using Kabutowari, strikes an obstacle first with an axe, then strikes it from above with a hammer, destroying the obstacle, be it a wall or an opponent's sword.
Fission Technique: The Fission Technique is a highly advanced ninjutsu which allows Mū to literally split his own body into two identical — yet entirely independent — duplicates of himself.
Fist Slam: A covers himself with electricity and slams both his fists on the opponent.
Five Elements Seal: Orochimaru gathers "wicked" chakra to his five fingertips, which he forcefully applies over another seal. When this Five Elements Seal, being of an odd number, is applied over the Four Symbols Seal, being of an even number, the Four Symbols Seal is disrupted because of the odd—even imbalance. In Naruto Uzumaki's case, he loses access to the chakra of the Nine-Tails - which the Four Symbols Seal keeps stored in his body - and furthermore makes it difficult for him to use his own. When the Five Elements Seal is initially applied, Naruto is rendered unconscious. When Jiraiya is later shown removing the Five Elements Seal from Naruto, he is able to correctly guess that Orochimaru applied it in the first place, describing its use as "coarse".
Five Elements Unseal: This technique removes seals that are of similar power to itself. The user gathers chakra to their fingertips and hits the fingers against the seal that is to be removed, causing it to unravel and disappear. If the seal was applied to a person, the thrust of the hand that accompanies this technique will likely be painful. When Jiraiya uses this technique to remove a Five Elements Seal, it appears to be quite easy for him. In truth, this is a very advanced technique that even jōnin would find difficult to perform.
Five Release Great Combo Technique: The user creates four shadow clones and, alongside them, launch a different base-elemental attack at the target simultaneously.
Five-Mountain Jump: Using the enhanced strength granted by his Steam Armour, Han delves a powerful punch to his opponent, sending them flying into the air. He jumps up after them and transforms into Kokuō, headbutts them, and using its hoof, smashes the opponent into the ground, which ruptures the ground and generates a fiery shock wave.
Five-Seal Barrier: The user connects five tags to each other using their own chakra. One of the tags is applied to a central location that the user wishes to prevent access to, while the other four are applied to surfaces in the surrounding area. So long as at least one of the tags remains in place, a barrier will be created over the central location that prevents it from being opened or in any way physically damaged. Those wishing to remove the barrier are advised to break into two small teams for maximum efficiency: one team focuses on removing the four surrounding tags, while the second team removes the central tag and immediately afterwards storms the stronghold.
Five-Seal Barrier Pass Technique: In order to enter the boundary created by the Five-Seal Barrier without dispelling the technique, Deidara used a technique which raised the rock blocking the entry to Akatsuki's hideout. It granted him and Sasori passage into the hideout, while keeping the barrier intact.
Flame Circuit: Indra surrounds himself with flames, protecting himself and damaging any enemy that enters his surrounding area.
Flame Combo: Sasori shoots a barrage of fireballs from the flamethrowers on the palms of his puppet body.
Flaming Arrow Warhead: The Flaming Arrow Warhead is a technique used by Nagato through the Asura Path.
Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability: The Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability is a technique used by Nagato through the Asura Path.
Flaming Fang: Petrification Poison: Garaga spits venom that is able to petrify victims moments after contact, an ability which Aoda links to Garaga's reverse scale.
Flash: A swift ranged attack where the user swings their sword at a target after coating it in chakra, releasing a sharp crescent of chakra in the arc that the blade was swung.
Flash Cross Sever: Asuma delivers multiple punches to the opponent before he slashes the opponent with his chakra blades in a cross-style.
Flash Mode: Flash Mode is a recurring awakening mode used by Minato Namikaze throughout the Naruto Ultimate Ninja and Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Heroes series. It greatly increases Minato's dash, attack and jump speed in all of its depictions.
Flash Revolving Foot: The spiral flash kick is a series of punches and slashes finishing with a spinning kick, sending the opponent flying.
Flash Slice: From above the opponent, the user strikes the enemy with a kunai, stabbing them.
Flash Swallow Dance: Heaven Step: Minato kicks his opponent upwards, and throws several Flying Thunder God Kunai at them. He teleports between the kunai, striking his opponent, before finishing above them, where he stabs them with one.
Flashing Bell Beams: Shion's bell flashes and sends a ray of flashing pink light towards the enemy. It is powerful enough to cleanly slice through three of Mōryō's Ghost Army soldiers.
Flawless Three: Obito and Kakashi slash at their opponent, followed by Rin's back-flip kick. Rin cheers her teammates as they go forward. Emboldened by her support, Obito leapfrogs Kakashi, unleashing several small fireballs at the opponent. Kakashi slashes through the flames and the opponent, and Rin finishes by jumping and stomping at the opponent, before cheering her teammates again.
Flea Shuriken: The ninneko stretches its body and rolls the joint of its neck, launching its fleas at a target. The jutsu's effects after that vary depending on the target's tolerances: Kiba Inuzuka and Akamaru fall to the ground in painful itching; Shino Aburame finds it curious, but otherwise isn't bothered.
Flight: While fully transformed with the Cursed Seal of Heaven, Sasuke attacks his opponent with punches, kicks, and a rotating wing attack, before swinging an electrified sword at them.
Flight Mode: This is the mode in which Mecha-Naruto takes a plane-like form, allowing it to fly at high speeds, and its fingers into machine gun-like extensions.
Flight of the Obliterating Water: Haku gathers a larger amount of water from the air and surrounding environment into more than a thousand needles. He then directs the needles to a specific opponent, and leaps back to avoid damage to himself.
Floating Bugs: Shino fires a cloud like projectile of destruction bugs at the opponent.
Flower Dance: Kurenai creates a cherry blossom clone that spins around her, creating a barrier of cherry petals striking the opponent multiple times, and lifting them into the air.
Flower Ninja Art: is a subset of ninjutsu and genjutsu involving secret flower-oriented techniques used by a clan in the Land of Vegetables. The two known users of flower ninja art are Kikunojō and Yurinojō.
Flower Ninja Art: Many Blooming Flowers: After surrounding the opponent with flowers, the user will ignite the flowers. These flames will then shoot towards and explode on the target.
Flower Ninja Art: Many Releasing Flowers: This technique turns flowers into bombs that can be detonated like explosive tags.
Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water: The user casts an illusion which surrounds the target in flower petals and darkens the surroundings around them.
Flower Shuriken: Falling Blossoms and Sc: This technique will make flowers hover in the air before hardening and spinning at high speeds. The flowers will then be launched at the target. Their hardened state will allow them to cut targets as effectively as metal shuriken.
Flower–Fruit Mountain: The Flower-Fruit Mountain is a Lava Release technique utilised by Son Gokū and its jinchuriki Rōshi. While in his transformed state, Rōshi creates a volcano which then explodes violently, sending molten rock flying up in all directions the effects of which resemble a giant flower. The lava produced is said to be able to melt anything in its path.
Flowing Blade: Shizune gets in close and uses a spinning sweep kick before she spins back to her original position. She then slashes the opponent with a chakra scalpel.
Flowing Wall Sand: After hitting his opponent with a barrage of sand, Gaara flows three walls of sand to end it.
Fluttering Heaven: Utakata jumps up into the air, delivers a strike with his bubble blower, followed by two empty-handed swipes, and finishes it with a spinning kick which sends his opponent crashing down.
Flying Attack: Ōnoki creates a rock to hit and send the opponent up, then he flies up to attack the opponent and then slams the opponent down.
Flying Claw: Yugito lunges at an airborne opponent and delivers a powerful cross slash.
Flying Nail Mist Soaring: The user exhales a flying stream composed of hundreds of very small nails from their mouth.
Flying Revolving Sword: The wielder throws Kubikiribōchō at the opponent, dealing damage as it spins towards them. If the Kubikiribōchō gets lodged in something in its path, such as the trunk of a tree, a person can stand on it.
Flying Single Foot: After manifesting Chōmei's wings, Fū flies high up in the air and descends, landing a kick on her opponent.
Flying Swallow: This is an " that augments the killing power of a bladed weapon, such as a kunai or sword, by flowing chakra into it. The infused chakra materialises around the weapon in the form of a blade, increasing both its cutting power and effective reach. By adjusting the amount of chakra applied through Chakra Control, the user can freely alter the length and density/"hardness" of the chakra edge, making the attack range and timing difficult to anticipate.
Flying Swallow Barrage: Asuma uses his Flying Swallow and start a sequence of slashes finishing with a falling slash.
Flying Swallow: Cross Cut: Asuma punches the opponent a few times and finishes them with two final slashes.
Flying Thunder Formation Technique: This is a cooperation Space–Time Ninjutsu taught to the Hokage Guard Platoon by the Fourth Hokage to better aid in their duties of protecting the seated Hokage.
Flying Thunder God Mutually Instantaneou: The Flying Thunder God Mutually Instantaneous Revolving Technique is a technique which can be utilised when at least two Flying Thunder God Technique users are present.
Flying Thunder God Slash: A technique combining the use of a bladed weapon and space–time ninjutsu. The user teleports to a marked target, with weapon in hand, to instantaneously deliver a swift, devastating slash to his opponent. Because of the speed of the technique's execution, not even an individual wielding the Sharingan — a dōjutsu capable of predicting movement — has enough reaction time to defend themselves against this technique, especially if the user is already physically fast.
Flying Thunder God Technique: The Flying Thunder God Technique is a space–time ninjutsu originally developed by Tobirama Senju. It was later recreated by Boruto Uzumaki.
Flying Thunder God Technique (Boruto): The Flying Thunder God Technique is a space–time ninjutsu created by Boruto Uzumaki, inspired by the technique of the same name.
Flying Thunder God — Second Step: The Flying Thunder God — Second Step is a technique developed by Minato from the Flying Thunder God Technique. Minato first throws a Flying Thunder God Kunai, be it a direct attack at his opponent; once the kunai has reached close proximity to the target, or even past them, he would then teleport to the said kunai, immediately attacking his target from their blind-spot. The speed at which this technique is executed along with the unpredicted secondary attack is such that even an individual who possesses the Sharingan is unable to react in time.
Flying Thunder God: Guiding Thunder: The Flying Thunder God: Guiding Thunder is a technique.
Flying Thunder God: Sequential Steps: Minato places his formula mark on the opponent and kicks them in the air where he teleports behind the airborne opponent and hits the opponent with a Rasengan, knocking them down towards the ground, where he then teleports again to the falling opponent to use his charged Rasengan to slam them to the ground, creating an enormous explosion.
Flying Thunder God: Space–Time Hurricane: Minato throws several Flying Thunder God kunai at his opponent, teleports to one of them, and kicks the opponent, sending them flying back. While they are still in the air, he creates a shadow clone which teleports repeatedly to the Flying Thunder God kunai around the opponent, constantly slashing them. Minato then goes into Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, charging a Rasengan. The shadow clone catches the opponent and teleports them directly in front of Minato, who lands his Rasengan, sending the opponent a long way before the Rasengan expands.
Forbidden Individual Curse Tag: The Forbidden Individual Curse Tag is a juinjutsu utilised by Madara Uchiha.
Forbidden Summoning Technique: Fire Rats: Dōshin summons rats, immersed by fire, to burn any objects such as the forest or attack the opponents.
Forbidden Technique: Dead Soul Technique: Kabuto summons two corpses in his image to attack his opponent with their chakra scalpel forward and backward and then he slashes his opponent with his chakra scalpel.
Forbidden Technique: Gedō Seal: A kinjutsu developed by Orochimaru during the Second Shinobi World War. It combines the two powers of seal and confusion into one technique, giving them the names and when using them separately.
Forbidden Technique: Impure World Seal D: Orochimaru summons a coffin like the one used in the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation technique. Ghostly hands come out of the coffin, extending through the body of the opponent, damaging them, until a larger hand grasps them, crushes them, and pulls them into the ethereal dark void within the coffin. The lid closes on the coffin and begins to sink into the darkness surrounding it. Orochimaru laughs sinisterly, watching as it vanishes.
Forbidden Technique: Mud Golem: Dōshin can make duplicates of his opponents using his Earth Release. This technique, however, costs a significant amount of chakra and makes the user tired from using it.
Formation Ino–Shika–Chō: Formation Ino–Shika–Chō are formations used by the members of the Yamanaka, Nara, and Akimichi clan members/Team 10 designed as a result of their long history of working together.
Formation of Ten Thousand Snakes: With this technique, a countless number of summoned snakes crawl out of Orochimaru's mouth and hunt down the enemy. With such overwhelming numbers, a true "wall of snakes" is formed, making defence and evasion meaningless. The enemy can do nothing but become buried by the snakes. The snakes can bite the enemy with their poison fangs and open their mouths to extend Kusanagi-like blades, making them even more deadly. Furthermore, when the inexhaustibly crawling snakes gather together, they become a defensive wall, and can block any kind of attack.
Forward Trampling Jump: Transformed as Kokuō, Han tramples his opponent with his front legs three times, from his left, right, and centre.
Four Black Fogs Formation: The members of the Sound Four stand at four directions around their target as they, in unison, perform this technique. They create a dark, dense fog high in the air that descends on the target, engulfing them and creating a powerful barrier that seals them off from all outside forces, even death. The Sound Four use this technique to counter the effects of the Mind Awakening Pill, which kills those who ingest it in order to advance their cursed seal to its second level. The Dark Sealing Method can be used to contain the fog within a confined space, such as a coffin.
Four Black Snakes Formation: The four users stand in a square formation, erecting a large barrier between them. On command, it incinerates its contents.
Four Corner Seal Teleportation: The user places a sealing tag on the designated area. If anyone crosses it, whether it be an ally or an enemy, toads are summoned to stop them. This technique is useful to protect an object from falling into enemy hands, and it is said that only Jiraiya and Minato were able to remove it. Those wishing to release the seal must perform the required hand seals and then point at it, which will cause any summoned toad to depart.
Four Legs Technique: One of the , this technique allows the user to move in the same way as an animal. By surrounding their body with chakra and moving about on all fours, the user's speed and accuracy are significantly enhanced, which in turn makes their attacks more damaging. Hit-and-run tactics are the most effective form of attack while using this technique, as this ensures the user is constantly moving, thus making it difficult for opponents to follow their movements.
Four Red Yang Formation: A powerful barrier formation noted to only be usable by those of Kage calibre, whereby four shinobi, standing in a square formation, erect a large barrier that is red in colour. It was stated to be several times stronger than the Four Violet Flames Formation, and is highly malleable and elastic. When assaulted by a Tailed Beast Ball from the Ten-Tails, the barrier simply distorted its shape, forcing the brunt of the attack upwards while it was left completely intact and reformed to its original position. Its users can create openings within the barrier to allow passage.
Four Snakes Intimidating Thrust: Kabuto slashes his opponent with a chakra scalpel, and with three strikes from his navel snake. Three giant white snakes emerge from the ground in sequence, each biting his opponent, and in the end, four of those emerge behind Kabuto, raise themselves high, and lunge at his opponent.
Four Symbols Puppet Shinobi: Akatsuki members are given a special human-shaped seal created by Nagato that takes a physical form known as the Four Symbols Puppet Shinobi, to fight or stall the enemy. The Puppet Shinobi goes to a faraway location to create numerous copies of itself. The only way to break the technique is to stop the Puppet Shinobi source.
Four Symbols Seal: This technique requires a great deal of talent to perform. The user applies the seal's formula to an object or a human's body, sealing a large enemy or an evil spirit within them. If two Four Symbols Seal are used, a stronger seal is created; this is called the Eight Trigrams Sealing Style. If the Four Symbols Seals do not completely overlap with each other, this allows the enemy/spirit's chakra to merge with whoever they've been sealed into. This is how the Nine-Tails was sealed into the body of Naruto Uzumaki.
Four Violet Flames Formation: A team of four stands in a square formation and then performs this technique, erecting a solid barrier between them. The barrier is made of purple flames, which will instantly engulf those who come into contact with it, thus preventing anyone from entering or leaving the area. Because the barrier relies on all four users to maintain, attacking any one of them can bring down the barrier. To prevent this from happening, members of the Sound Four extend secondary barriers around themselves, making breaking out even more difficult. When used by members of the First Division, the users position themselves outside the barrier rather than inside, at least ensuring their captive cannot harm them.
Four-Corner Sealing Barrier: This technique was designed by Tsunade for the purpose of sealing a tailed beast. The technique is performed with four separate scrolls and a sample of blood similar to a Summoning Technique. Shizune mentioned that good chakra control and concentration are needed to perform the sealing technique. To use this technique, a scroll is needed to seal the numerous amounts of chakra. This technique was supposed to seal the Three-Tails in its own dimension, permanently. While sealing the users are vulnerable to enemy attacks. This technique has three stages:
Freight Bundle Bubble: Transformed into Saiken, Utakata forms a purple-coloured Tailed Beast Ball, mixed with his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu that he launches at the opponent.
Frog: While in the second state of his Cursed Seal of Earth, Kimimaro jumps in the air, hits his opponent with his tail with a vertical spin, throws behind himself, and spins sideways, creating several bone spikes from his body, hitting his opponent.
Frog Kata: The Frog Kata is a fighting style used exclusively by those who have mastered Sage Mode and trained with the toads of Mount Myōboku. The senjutsu chakra used during Sage Mode "activates" the body in various ways, enhancing the user's speed, reflexes, strength, stamina and durability. This allows a sage to achieve incredible feats which include leaping great distances, shattering sharp materials with their bare hands, as well as lifting massive objects. It is said to be a flawless taijutsu that has no openings in either attack or defence.
Frog Kata: Dual Gale: Jiraiya and Naruto, the latter who is in Sage Mode, use the Frog Kata to uppercut the opponent.
Frog Kata: Frog Throw: Naruto and two shadow clones punch and kick the opponent towards each other's direction, before kicking them up in the air, and punching them down to the ground, where Naruto grabs and throws them aside.
Frog Kata: Heaven Return: Naruto lands a series of punches and kicks using shadow clones, some of which extended with natural energy. One of these attacks sends his opponent up in the air, where the original Naruto follows and delivers an upwards spinning kick, sending his opponent even higher.
Frog Kata: Roaring Attack: Naruto lands a series of kicks and punches using a few shadow clones. The penultimate attack hits the opponent in the air, throwing them towards the ground, but the original Naruto intercepts the opponent half-way, extending the reach of his punch with natural energy, sending his opponent flying.
Frog Strike: While performing the Frog Kata, Naruto delivers a powerful open-handed strike, sending ripples of senjutsu chakra that emanate through the struck target from the initial point of contact, causing massive damage from the inside. This makes the technique extremely useful against the targets with strong defences.
Front Lotus: The user delivers an upward kick to their opponent, sending them high into the air. The user follows the opponent along their upward trajectory, taking tight hold of them so that they can't move or escape; Rock Lee wraps opponents with the bandages he wears to help in this regard. Once they've reached the peak of the initial kick's arc, the user begins a spinning motion and propels them headfirst towards the ground. The user releases the opponent right before impact and retreats to safety, leaving the opponent to collide with the ground alone. Because the Front Lotus requires at least one of the Eight Gates be opened, users are likely to be fatigued afterwards and thus vulnerable to attack. For this reason, Might Guy mandates that Lee only use the Front Lotus to protect something or someone important.
Front Lotus Guy Version: This technique is essentially the same as the Front Lotus, only more damaging. Might Guy ends it with a thumbs up.
Front Lotus of Love and Youth: Rock Lee kicks the enemy, and then Guy tackles the enemy to launch them into the air. They both grab the enemy and crash them into the ground with the use of Front Lotus at the same time on the same opponent.
Front Lotus: Eight Trigrams Palms Revolv: Neji jumps into the air while Lee wraps him in his bandages. At the same time Lee performs the Front Lotus, Neji releases chakra from his entire body. The spinning that occurs in the Front Lotus substitutes for the rotation involved in the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven technique.
Frying Pan Attack: The user rushes towards the opponent and hits them with a frying pan with enough force to knock them off their feet. The strength and power of this technique depends on the user.
Frying Pan Rapid Fire Strikes: Kosuke pulls out his massive frying pan and delivers swift, sweeping blows to his opponent, leaving behind trailing afterimages of the pan.
Frying Pan Shield: Kosuke puts a huge frying pan in front of him like a shield and, covering it with chakra, is able to repel opponents' attacks.
Furious Smelting: The user has the ability to manifest special red, glowing, malleable chakra, which, when on standby, float in a chakram-like formation behind their back. The user is able to manipulate it to form various makeshift tools and weapons, similar to Truth-Seeking Balls. The tools created were powerful enough to create craters when struck against the ground and, when used by Kinshiki, cleanly bisect his planet's God Tree. Not only can the user manifest multiple tools and weapons at once, but they can also manipulate the tools telekinetically.
Furious Smelting (game): Kinshiki manifests a club and slams his opponent up in the air, where he morphs his weapon into trench knives and slashes at them. He flashes past them, binding them in chains, and throwing them back to and through the ground. He pulls them back up, and throws a manifest trident at them, breaking the chains, and hammers them back down. Finally, he comes crashing that at them, hitting them with an axe, the power of the hit extending through the landscape, splitting mountains, the weather, and creating lightning strikes in the sky.
Furious Smelting: Scythe: Kinshiki creates a scythe which he swings upwards, hooking the opponent onto the blade and making a powerful sweeping motion, crushing them into the ground.
Furious Smelting: Whirlwind: Kinshiki simultaneously creates a machete and sickle, wielding them in both hands and spinning rapidly to create a whirlwind of blades that strikes all enemies it touches.
Furious Tail Strike: Releasing six tails, Kinkaku violently attacks with his tails, unleashing rapid, devastating strikes.
Fury: is a technique which could create a massive explosion, capable of wiping out an entire village. It was developed by En no Gyōja, and his granddaughter Hotaru had the kinjutsu implanted on her back. Tonbee stated that En no Gyōja gave him the scroll to unseal and destroy the deadly kinjutsu.
Future Telling: This dōjutsu is more of an involuntary ability. It allows Shion to predict when someone is going to die. While the predicting is in process, her eyes take on a sacred geometric pattern, shifting somewhat like a kaleidoscope.
Fūinjutsu Trap: Once the technique is activated, the target is sealed into a different dimensional space, within the location of the seal. Before noting that there existed few ways to escape the seal, Kakashi tried to break the seal with his Lightning Cutter, but to no avail. The only means of escape seemed to be by creating the appropriate blood seal.
Fūma Shuriken Shadow Clone: Hashirama throws a fūma shuriken and creates three clones of the shuriken at his opponent.
Gale Bullet: In his second Cursed Seal state, Sasuke flies swirling into the opponent.
Gamaken's Clumsy Shake-Down: After Jiraiya grabs and throws the opponent in the air, he summons Gamaken, who strikes them down with his sasumata.
Gedō Seal: Release: This technique was created by Hiruzen in the Second Shinobi World War to cure the shinobi from the Forbidden Technique: Gedō Seal. Tsunade uses this technique to heal Kakashi's Sharingan.
Gelel Rasengan: A technique that incorporates the Rasengan with energy from the Stone of Gelel. It has been used alongside the Demon Fox Rasengan as part of the Twin Rasengan. Its power is presumed equal in strength to a Demon Fox Rasengan, as it can burn part of an opponent's body. It is bluish-green in colour.
Genes of the First: Yamato has two giant wood branches emerge from the ground, which spiral upwards, striking the opponent higher into the air. He then ends the attack by causing the branches to come from both sides of the airborne opponent and crush them.
Genjutsu Ball Trap: A series of traps that placed in bridge dimension that bridged the Moon and Earth. It was created from a dangerous bubble-like substance that traps victims in a genjutsu dream, where they live out their memories.
Genjutsu Binding: As the name suggests, the user binds the opponent in a genjutsu, rendering them incapable of movement. As Tsunade demonstrates when facing the Legendary Stupid Brothers, this genjutsu can be used on more than one target at the same time. Once the target is bound, the user or an ally can rush up to the enemy and deliver a devastating killing blow.
Genjutsu Communication: This technique is a projection-type genjutsu used as a means of communication.
Genjutsu Cursed Seal: The user applies a spiral-shaped cursed seal that manifests a genjutsu on the victim's subconscious, allowing the user to alter selective memories from their mind and manipulate them under their subliminal control. The more powerful the genjutsu is applied to the victim, the further the seal spreads across their body.
Genjutsu Kiss: Gamariki kisses the opponent, placing them in an illusionary world. When the user's trapped in his genjutsu, everyone that the person sees in this illusory world will also have Gamakiri's face. When Naruto was trapped in the genjutsu he saw floating hearts and a mist of purple fog.
Genjutsu Protect: The user can use this technique to place a genjutsu protection in form of mental blocks in the target's mind that contains valuable information in case the one with the information is captured and interrogated. According to Inoichi Yamanaka, it is very effective against truth serums.
Genjutsu: Bell Sound Clone: The user utilises the ringing of bells to produce a sound wave that travels through the eardrum directly into the target's brain. This paralyses the victim while also causing them to hallucinate, seeing multiple images of the user, which makes it difficult for them to tell the real one from the illusions. The user can then take advantage of this to easily attack the victim.
Genjutsu: Flower Hill: The user summons up illusionary purple flowers from the ground in front of them, which damages enemies with a chance to paralyse them.
Genjutsu: Flower Petal Escape: When trapped inside of a genjutsu or wishing to appear trapped, Kurenai uses this technique to dissolve her body into lots of flower petals which then consume her enemy's body.
Genjutsu: Ghost Fire: Using their flames, the user manipulates the flames into an illusion of a dog-cat hybrid.
Genjutsu: Ketsuryūgan: By establishing direct skin or eye contact with a target, the user can lock them within a genjutsu for one of various purposes. They can brainwash them into mindless drones with a set order to follow, or trap them into a dream-like state. For more defensive means, this technique can create a powerful barrier against mind reading, protecting information from being acquired. In the novel, it also allows the user to place genjutsu guards upon their mind and see through the target's memories.
Genjutsu: Mirage: Kurenai stands up straight with her head bowed and her hands to her chest. As she stomps on the ground, pink leaves surround her, and the area is enveloped in a pink mist. The opponent is confused as to where Kurenai went. Suddenly, the opponent is punched back and as the opponent is spinning backwards Kurenai appears in front of them and attacks the opponent in mid-air.
Genjutsu: Sharingan: Genjutsu: Sharingan broadly refers to a range of genjutsu performed with the Sharingan. It has also been shown to be performed through the Sharingan's higher evolutions: the Mangekyō Sharingan and the Rinnegan.
Genjutsu: Unknown Fire: This genjutsu is cast by pointing at the opponent and a faded purple wave is released from the finger that when it reaches the target, causes them to see a ring of blue fire around them and then see themselves ablaze with blue flames.
Genjutsu: Yaksha Shark and Birds: Itachi casts a crow genjutsu while Kisame creates numerous water sharks that jump over and onto the opponent.
Gentle Fist: The is a form of hand-to-hand combat used by members of the Hyūga clan. Considered a peerless martial art, It inflicts internal damage through attacking the body's Chakra Pathway System, subsequently injuring organs which are closely intertwined with the area of the network which has been struck. To do this, the user surgically injects a certain amount of their own chakra into the opponent's chakra pathway system, causing damage to surrounding organs due to their proximity to the chakra circulatory system. Even the slightest tap can cause severe internal damage, hence the name "gentle" fist.
Gentle Fist Art One Blow Body: A technique born from their innate ability to expel chakra from every tenketsu on their body, a member of the Hyūga clan can hit their opponent with a blast of chakra that will send them flying away from the user. It was also shown that this technique can be used with pin-point accuracy to target the weak point of a technique exemplified when Neji Hyūga was trapped by Kisame Hoshigaki's Water Prison Technique, and was able to dispel it.
Gentle Fist Art: Exorcism: Hinata delivers a two-handed palm strike, jumps toward her opponent, delivering another two-handed palm strike to their chest, and finally pushes herself backward with her feet from her opponent's chest, knocking them back.
Gentle Fist Instruction: Hanabi strikes her opponent with several Gentle Fist moves, causing them to fall to the ground. Hanabi then goes to her father, Hiashi, and asks him how she did. Hiashi notices the opponent starts to get up, and with incredible speed finishes off the opponent.
Gentle Fist: Tenketsu Needle: Targeting a single chakra point, the user delivers a two-fingered strike at the opponent, in an attempt to plug the chakra that's being used and halt its flow.
Gentle Phoenix Spiralling Twin Lion Fist: Naruto, while in his Tailed Beast Mode, transfers his chakra to Hinata, who launches an Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm at the opponent to knock them off balance before grabbing Naruto's hand. He transfers his chakra to her again and they take off in the form of a bird, where Hinata creates a Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists and Naruto creates a Rasengan within its jaws before smashing it into the opponent. The opponent then detonates in a giant dome explosion as Naruto retreats away from the blast with Hinata.
Gentle Step Tailed Beast Twin Lion Fists: Naruto and Hinata create a cooperative Rasengan, implementing both of their chakra, with which they hit the opponent. Afterwards, Naruto transforms into his Tailed Beast Mode and, with Hinata's help, launches a Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists-enhanced Tailed Beast Ball at the opponent, creating a huge explosion.
Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists: The Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists is a high-level secret Gentle Fist technique taught only to the main branch of the Hyūga clan.
Gentle Step Twin Palms: Hinata dashes towards her opponent and hits them with two chakra-enhanced palm strikes, damaging them and knocking them back.
Gentle Wind Spiralling Twin Lion Fists:: The users combine their chakra and create a gigantic lion head where their hands meet, within it a Rasengan, empowered by both users' chakra is formed. This technique is strong enough to completely destroy the Tenseigan.
Giant Insect Fang: Sixty-Four Palms: After Shino releases a swarm of kidaichū, Kiba transforms into the three-headed wolf and rapidly spins towards the enemy along with Shino's bugs. Hinata then jumps into the spinning vortex and uses her Byakugan to lodge the bugs onto the opponent's tenketsu. As the opponent is thrown back, Shino's kidaichū grow rapidly, eating them from the inside out.
Giant Sphere: Satori forms a large sphere of red energy from its mouth or feet to fire at its foe. A single hit forced Gamabunta to retreat, and the resulting explosion is larger than the Hōzuki Castle itself.
Giant Spider Drop: Kidōmaru summons Kyodaigumo above his opponent, who then falls down and crushes them.
Giant Spinning Axe: Sitting astride Ponta, Sabu throws his massive axe at his opponent, which spins wildly, cutting through its target before returning to Sabu's hands.
Giant Stick Rampage: Kotetsu summons his Conch Shell Mace and begins to spin wildly, beating the opponent, and at the end makes a powerful swing with the mace from the bottom up and sends the opponent flying with a powerful blow.
Giant Swing: A grabs his opponent by the legs, spins around, and throws them.
Giant Tree Strong Drop: Yamato creates a large pillar of wood and Sakura punches the wooden pillar which falls on top of the opponent.
God of Tides: The users gathers red chakra into their fist and slams down into the ground, sending numerous waves of the red chakra all around them.
God: Nativity of a World of Trees: God: Nativity of a World of Trees is a technique used to manipulate the roots of the God Tree, spreading them around the entire world to encase those caught within the Infinite Tsukuyomi in the roots' bark. By ensnaring all living beings and connecting them to the tree, similar to cocoons, this will keep their now-slumbering bodies alive so long as they remain attached, while sapping their chakra. At the same time, this assimilates every victim to the God Tree, regathering the chakra into one location, in order to sprout a new fruit. It is one of the Jutsu with the greatest expansive power, spreading throughout the planet.
Goemon Hellfire: Jiraiya and Naruto, with their respective toad summons, work together to create a large flaming wave of toad oil.
Gold Dust Cloud Spear: Thrust Away: Rasa goes to the air using Desert Suspension and delivers a series of strikes with his Gold Dust. Then, he forms several bullets and uses them to attack the opponent in rapid succession.
Gold Dust Drizzle: Rasa gathers gold dust into the air that strikes downward on the opponent.
Gold Dust Imperial Funeral: Rasa uses his Gold Dust to trap the opponent and then creates a shock wave, crushing the opponent beneath the dust.
Gold Dust Press: Rasa deals several blows with his Gold Dust, with a couple slashes, rising spikes, a downward projectile, before finally crushing his target with a block of Gold Dust.
Gold Dust Strong Spear: Rasa attacks with his Gold Dust, delivering two slashes, followed by rising spikes, two waves, and finishes with a drill-like spear.
Gold Dust Twin Spear: Rasa deals several blows with his Gold Dust, slashing his target twice, followed by a wave of rising spikes, and a blast that sends them up in the air. While in the air, two spears rising from the ground, piercing the target.
Gold Dust World Method Ball: The Fourth Kazekage sends a mass of gold dust toward his opponent, and causes spikes to emerge from it, hitting them within reach.
Gold and Silver Training: Treasured Tool: Kinkaku uses Bashōsen: Coil of Lightning, attacking the enemy with lightning bolts and paralyzing them, while Ginkaku spins around with Shichiseiken in his hands, cutting through the paralyzed enemies.
Golden Wheel Reincarnation Explosion: The Golden Wheel Reincarnation Explosion is a powerful technique utilised by Toneri Ōtsutsuki.
Gospel of the Angel: The user creates a spear out of pieces of paper and throws it at the opponent.
Gozu Tennō: The Gozu Tennō is a fūinjutsu developed by Root's Tanuki Shigaraki under orders from Danzō Shimura. Sasuke Uchiha remarked that it came close to replicating Kaguya Ōtsutsuki's secret techniques.
Grass Shadow-Style Emit Destroy Palm: A pure taijutsu attack in which the user delivers a set of open-handed as well as closed-fist hits along with kicks to the opponent. This series of attacks is so fast that it can barely be followed by the naked eye.
Great Barrage Strike: The user hits the opponent with a series of punches followed with an uppercut, lifting the opponent into the air and then appearing behind them as they fall near to the ground and finish with a barrage of quick short punches.
Great Burial Bullet: Kawaki pins the opponent down with stakes, following with him bringing down large stone columns down on top of them, and then finishing with a blast of red chakra gather from his Kāma.
Great Cat Claw Attack: Matatabi, or Yugito in her Tailed Beast Mode, delivers a solid hit with their right paw.
Great Dance Slash: Kisame jumps high up into the air and spins around cutting the opponent with Samehada.
Great Entrance of Burning Spirit: Guy first unlocks seven chakra gates, then kicks his opponent high into the air. He then quickly jumps after his opponent and uses a chakra-powered punch to send them back down.
Great Fire Lightning Flash: The user expels a fireball from their mouth, and then proceeds to use Chidori to strike the opponent while they are engulfed in flames.
Great Gunpowder Attack: The user utilises their gunpowder mist to combust with every punch they strike at the opponent. They finish the opponent a large slam, causing a large explosion.
Great Harem Technique: Konohamaru clones himself and holds his opponent in place. He then transform himself and his clones into bikini-clad girls who swarm his opponent. While the opponent is distracted, Konohamaru and a clone ram them with a Rasengan.
Great Roar: A tailed beast uses its massive chakra reserve to turn a roar into a powerful force of pressure and destruction. When Naruto was in control of Kurama's power, he too could produce these shockwaves by roaring. Initially, these shockwaves could deflect projectiles, fracture infrastructure and destroy some ninjutsu, but their raw force in Version 2 is such that they can rebound even Pain's Shinra Tensei back upon himself.
Great Rotating Pushing Kick (Failed…): Tobi punches his opponent three times, strikes again with an eye-poking motion, jumps up in the air to kick his opponent with both feet, before failing to properly land a spinning kick, ending laid on the ground.
Great Sand Downpour: Gaara, whilst riding on the floating sand, manipulates his sand to create a small amount of sand in the air which he controls to fall down towards the opponent. Before reaching the opponent the sand splits into multiple shots increasing the spread of its attack range.
Great Sand Eater: While in her sand dimension, Kaguya sends a flowing wave of sand at the opponent.
Great Sandstorm Technique: This is a cooperation ninjutsu between a Wind Release user and an Earth Release user, where they create a sand tornado.
Great Sickle Weasel Technique: Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari causes many currents of wind to collide with each other, creating vacuum pockets. As the wind moves outward from her, it cuts up whatever it comes into contact with and deflects any attacks coming towards her, even sound-based genjutsu. Because of how far the winds travel, this technique is especially useful against opponents that attack from long ranges.
Great Snake Binding: Kabuto grabs his opponent with his navel snake, pulling them towards him, and then delivers a cross cut with two chakra scalpels.
Great Snake Charmer Technique: Orochimaru transforms into a giant snake that grabs the opponent with its mouth and slams them down on the ground with the giant snake bursting into many smaller snakes. He then reforms out of the snakes.
Great Snake Thrust: In Sage Mode, the user thrusts their chakra snakes at the opponent.
Great Spiralling Ring: The user creates an exceptionally powerful Spiralling Ring that can cause massive destruction on impact. Menma used this technique to destroy most of Konoha, similarly to Pain's assault on the village.
Great Strike Outburst: Transformed as Son Gokū, Rōshi jumps into the air and comes down punching the opponent.
Great Trample Circle: Transformed as Kokuō, Han reels back, lifting his front legs, and comes back down crushing his opponent.
Great Tree Spear: With his wood human, Hashirama uses it to create a large wooden spear to throw at the opponent. The landing of the wooden spear can also sprout branching trees that can damage the opponent.
Great Tree World Method: After placing his palm on the ground, Danzō creates a giant tree that knocks back anyone caught in its vicinity.
Great Twin Circles: Obito delivers a series of strikes with a combo of Kamui, a shuriken and the Wood Release: Cutting Technique. He then kicks the opponent in the air and summons two giant shuriken from Kamui's Dimension, and sends them at the opponent.
Great Vacuum Cannon: This technique utilises the Takumi Village's special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords. The user shoots small, powerful and near-invisible blasts of wind from the blades.
Great Wild Snake: The user rapidly slithers in a circle-like fashion, brushing off any incoming targets. The strength and speed of this technique is great enough to leave sparks on the surrounding terrain.
Great Wind Violent Wall: Temari swings her Giant Folding Fan and a giant vortex swirls around and lifts the opponent into the sky. They are zapped by lightning three times before falling to the ground, giving off black smoke.
Green Egg Bombs: The Animal Path's Giant Drill-Beaked Bird lays eggs that explode at its command.
Green Impact: Naruto performs Leaf Whirlwind to disable the opponent then sweep them off their feet using Leaf Gale. After that, he launches the opponent into the sky using Rasengan. Naruto can only use this technique as "Might Suit" Naruto.
Green Rain Ground Levelling: Sarada jumps high and throws a bunch of kunai with healing seals on them in a large circle, healing all allies within the radius of the healing field.
Green Roar: The user grabs the opponent and then gets behind them and flips using both feet to kick them away.
Ground Splitting: With Sage Mode activated, Naruto kicks his opponents around, before heel-kicking the ground, causing it to crack, sending his opponents up in the air.
Ground Splitting Technique: After forming the necessary hand seals, the user slams their hands into the ground which causes the earth to erupt below their target's feet. This technique can also effectively create barricades that would take quite some time for a regular person to surmount.
Grudge Rain: This technique requires a considerable amount of users. The users create a large storm cloud to produce rain. The large amount of rain can turn into a large wave of water and sweeps the enemy off their feet. As long as the targets are trapped by the water, their chakra will be continuously drained.
Grudge Sand Cloud Rend: Gaara thrusts his arm into a cloud of sand, transforming his arm into Shukaku's which strikes the opponent.
Grudge Sand Cloud Tear: Gaara uppercuts a cloud of sand, transforming his arm into Shukaku's which strikes the opponent into the air.
Guillotine Drop: After covering himself in his Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A jumps into the air above his opponent and performs a downwards kick, using the momentum of the fall to increase the power behind the attack. This technique is preferably done right after knocking an opponent down to reduce their reaction time as the user cannot use the Body Flicker Technique to increase their speed in mid-air nor can they use it to dodge counter-attacks in mid-air.
Gunbai Fanned Wind: The user waves their gunbai as a fan to create powerful gusts of wind, strong enough to blow away several enemies in one swing.
Gunpowder Fist: Ultilising the gunpowder mixed in his black mist, Boro covers his fists with mist and ignites it with each punch he delivers to the opponent.
Guts Rasengan: Remembering Jiraiya's words about never abandoning his ninja way, Naruto creates a fully charged Rasengan, but increases its mass and raw force. It has shown enough power to blast away an entire wall of a fortress and even decimate it in a matter of minutes. Unlike a normal Rasengan, which fades away after striking its target, this version does not disappear until Naruto was finished destroying the entire fortress. This technique can be compared with the Big Ball Rasengan having many similarities, except being much smaller.
Hair Binding Technique: Using their chakra, the user is able to stimulate their hair, granting them the ability to freely manipulate it. Because of the malleability of the hair, the user can use it to entangle their opponents, cutting off their movements or even use it to grab their target and send them hurtling some distance away. Because this technique depends solely on the user's hair, the more volume there is, the more effective this technique can be used.
Hair Camouflage: Using this technique, Kurenai's hair will lengthen and completely cover her whole body. Exactly what this technique serves for is unknown.
Hair Needle Senbon: This technique hardens the hair on user's head and shoots a multitude of hair senbon at the enemy. The sharpened points of the hair can turn the target's entire body into a pincushion.
Hanabi Style: Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four: Hanabi uses the Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms technique to hit and shut down sixty-four of the opponent's tenketsu, with the final hit making the opponent spin in a vortex-like fashion. Then, Hanabi, after fussing about her hair, launches a vacuum of chakra at the opponent, stopping their spinning and sending them head-in into the ground.
Hanabi Style: Revolving Heaven: After releasing chakra from the tenketsu in her palms, Hanabi spins rapidly, creating a undefined vortex of chakra around herself, which is capable of blocking an attack and harming any nearby opponent.
Hands of Bonds: After amassing a large amount of chakra, Asura can use it to manifest up to four large arms. These chakra arms are capable of repelling Indra Ōtsutsuki's Susanoo.
Hands of Flame: Using the ignited flames from his jinchūriki transformation, Obito shapes them into hands to attack with.
Harem Technique: After using the Shadow Clone Technique to create many copies of the user, the user and their shadow clones each perform the Sexy Technique to change their appearances into beautiful naked women. The naked forms swarm their target and hang upon them, the intention being to overpower targets with lustful thoughts. Ebisu, against whom the Sexy Technique was ineffective, is defeated by the Harem Technique, losing consciousness due to a bloody nose. The Third Hokage, who previously fell prey to the Sexy Technique, suspects the Harem Technique would also work against him. Killer B is unmoved by it.
Haze Clone Technique: The user creates hundreds of copies of themselves, each of which, like the standard Clone Technique, has no physical substance and thus cannot be attacked. While opponents attack the clones trying to locate the user, the user secretly moves underground so that opponents will preoccupy themselves looking for someone who isn't there. Once the opponent is too distracted to defend themselves, the user will emerge from the ground in order to attack.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Aft: The user summons a gateway that can be used to presumably send anyone to anywhere that the user desires. It can be used to bypass impenetrable barrier ninjutsu. The cost of the technique ages the user greatly to the point of their death.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Eph: The user sacrifices their life to summon an otherworldly spectre. As they begin the hand seals, green seals spread across their body, and the user prays to the spectre. The jutsu turns the user into a red gemstone that then fuses with the spectre, turning it into a golem and creating an enormous barrier around its targets. The golem is highly resilient, able to resist chakra-enhanced strikes, and much faster than its size would imply, able to cover distances very quickly. It generally drains chakra indiscriminately from whatever living creature it can reach inside the barrier, which it can use to regenerate any damaged anatomy. If it detects damage to the barrier, it will ignore closer targets to prevent further damage. Its weak spot is the red gemstone, destroying it will both defeat the golem and break the barrier.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Hel: The user summons tar-like sludge in the area around them and those caught in the sludge will sink to their deaths. If the targets try to get close to the user, they will sink faster. The user can also form tendrils of the sludge to hold down the victims' limbs or defend themselves.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Red: The user grabs the intended target with the intention of incinerating both themselves and the target in a burst of powerful red energy. If the opponent has a strong enough defence, they can survive the technique unscathed.
Hazy Genjutsu: This technique casts an illusion on the enemy that blurs the target's vision of the entire area. In addition, it causes the victim to react as though they're sinking in quicksand, effectively immobilising the target.
Hazy Moon: Kakashi summons all eight of his ninken to cross-slash the opponent, followed by him delivering a deadly, swift sword slash.
Hazy Moon Night: Yūgao swings her sword in a circular motion, leaving a trace of afterimages behind, which befitting the technique's name, mirrors that of a moon. Yugaō will then rush at them to deliver a blow, taking advantage of the difficulty in following her movement.
Headbutt: After entering his four-tailed transformation, Killer B uses the two chakra horns that protrude out of his chakra cloak to headbutt the opponent. According to Sabu, this attack is strong enough to decapitate someone.
Headbutt (game): Gengetsu grabs the opponent and headbutts them.
Heal Bite: Through biting and consuming the user's chakra, they can heal the injuries of others, as well as themselves.
Healing Resuscitation Regeneration Techn: This is a medical ninjutsu that is used to heal severe, life-threatening injuries. To perform, it requires a full intensive care unit, staffed by medics with refined chakra control. The procedure lasts many hours, requiring the constant attention of the medics on staff and, inevitably, requiring backup shifts to replace medics who have tired out. Because of how difficult the procedure is, there is a very low chance of actually saving the patient.
Healing Technique: The user gathers healing chakra into a white orb and moves it over injured areas. Sakura used this trying to heal Kakeru Tsuki. But, because too much time had passed since Ishidate's Petrification Gauntlet inflicted the wound, she was unable to heal the injuries or ultimately save the king.
Heart Acceleration Technique: Murasame changes the way his chakra flows, allowing him to release more of his chakra for techniques and greatly increases his speed. This technique makes the user run out of chakra much faster than usual.
Heaven Collapse: The user first punches the opponent four times, sending them crashing into a large boulder. The user then jumps onto the boulder, and uses the 1000 Metre Punch on the opponent, sending them flying far away, and the boulder crumbling to pieces.
Heaven Cutter: Zabuza kicks his opponent, and delivers a series of slashes with his Kubikiribōchō, finishing with an upwards slash that sends his opponent up in midair.
Heaven Gold: Fukurokumaru lifts a gold bar into the air, causing huge gold bars to rain down on his opponents from the sky, injuring them.
Heaven Twin Fang: Kiba and Akamaru jump into the air and uses the Fang Passing Fang technique. The two then merge creating a giant Passing Fang. They then tunnel far into the ground creating a large, deep hole.
Heaven and Earth Exploding Funeral: Tobi rushes forwards through the opponent while intangible, leaving a trail of explosive tags behind him, which detonate after he stops.
Heaven and Earth Lightning Roar: With the swipe of a hand, the user brings down four bolts of thunder on the opponent.
Heaven's Blessing: Sakura summons a giant Inner Sakura to throw four giant kunai which then fall upon the enemy.
Heaven's Needle Barrage: Komachi moves forward and delivers a quick slashing attack with her sword, pushing the opponent away from her. She then leaps high into the air above the opponent and removes the ornamental needles in her hair before throwing them downward in a fast-moving barrage. This technique lands a fairly large number of hits upon the opponent and also inflicts severe damage.
Heaven-Bending Bomb Assault: Tobi warps backwards and then quickly returns, throwing five explosive tags at the opponent's feet.
Heavenly Advent: In his avatar, Asura slams down the opponent with a palm strike, causing golden chakra to rise beneath them.
Heavenly Chidori: Cherry Blossom: Sasuke strikes the opponent with Chidori, switches places with Sakura, who punches them down, and switches back again, channelling Chidori into the ground.
Heavenly Defending Foot: Much like the Heavenly Foot of Pain, the user concentrates their chakra onto their foot, causing a purple clash of light when the user kicks the opponent with this technique. This does immense damage to the opponent, and the result of this technique is a very large crater into the ground.
Heavenly Foot of Pain: Tsunade leaps into the air and concentrates all her strength into her heel. She then rapidly swings her heel down, not only doing severe damage to anyone she hits, but also cratering the ground and decimating the surrounding structures. As with all Tsunade's extreme feats of strength, this technique is possible because of her excellent chakra control.
Heavenly Foot of Pain: Kirin: Sakura charges towards the opponent using taijutsu, while Sasuke in his Susanoo prepares imbuing Sakura in Kirin, coming down on the opponent with an lightning-empowered kick.
Heavenly Ice Chamber: While in her ice dimension, Kaguya causes ice to condense and freeze around her opponents, holding them in place, the intense cold injuring them.
Heavenly Insertion Hammering Star: Obito throws the opponent up in the air while using his Wood Release: Cutting Technique. The opponent lands and Obito wraps them in a wooden ball. Madara then summons his Tengai Shinsei, while Obito uses Kamui to escape from the blast, which crashes down on the opponent.
Heavenly Kick Wild Dance: The user kicks the opponent once on their knee, and then kicks them twice on their face in rapid succession, sending them spiralling upwards.
Heavenly Lightning: The user brings down a bolt of thunder on the opponent.
Heavenly Palm Wild Dance: Neji grabs the opponent, flips them around and then strikes them thrice in the back, sending them flying away.
Heavenly Prison Fire Sword: The user brings up a large flame in his right hand, which soon after takes the form of a sword. If someone is hit by the sword, they will be engulfed in flames. The sword can also easily pierce flesh.
Heavenly Punishment: This is a suicidal technique which is done when the user covers their torso with explosive tags and detonates themselves while in range of the enemy.
Heavenly Spear Foot: Tsunade leaps to great heights and comes down crashing into her opponent with a massive amount of force, powerful enough to crack the ribcage of Madara Uchiha's Susanoo.
Heavenly Transfer Technique: With this technique, Mabui is able to transport objects anywhere at the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speed_of_light speed of light]. When being transferred, the object is engulfed in light and moves to any desired destination through a narrow beam, reminiscent of a bolt of lightning.
Heavenly Weeping: The Heavenly Weeping is a ninjutsu used by Tobirama Senju.
Heavy Hammer Spark: When Mecha-Naruto is in vehicle form, and the opponent is in a position near the wheels (for example, Chōji Akimichi tried to attack by rolling towards Mecha-Naruto), he extends a huge hammer from the bottom and hits the opponent, sending them flying.
Heel Falling Attack: While in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Naruto jumps up in the air, kicks his opponents from multiple directions, and finishes by heel-kicking them into the ground.
Hell Dark Formation: The Sound Four activate their second stage Cursed Seals and create a four-way barrier formation that pulses out dark energy. The four shinobi seal the opponent inside the barrier formation, creating an erupting explosion of dark energy and leaving no trace of their target.
Hell Drop: A grabs the opponent and uses his palm to push the opponent in the air, where A then smashes his elbow onto the opponent's head, smashing them into the ground.
Hell Stab: The Hell Stab is the strongest technique of the Third Raikage, whereby he concentrates a considerable amount of lightning chakra into just the fingertips of a single hand and then performs a thrusting motion, which allows him to pierce a target in a somewhat similar manner to the Chidori and Lightning Cutter.
Hell Stab Four-Finger Spear Hand: Sky Dr: A delivers a series of hits to the opponent, sending the opponent into the air. Then A cloaks himself in lightning and uses his Hell Stab to deliver a strike to the opponent, sending them crashing into the ground.
Hell Stab One-Finger Nukite: Ultimate: A uses his Hell Stab and smashes his hand into the ground, creating several pillars of earth from the impact. Then, the Raikage uses one finger to create a spear covered in lightning and enters the Lightning Release Chakra Mode. Using his finger, he strikes the opponent, creating a gigantic shock of lightning and dealing great damage to the opponent.
Hell Stab Three-Finger Spear Hand: Side: A uses his Hell Stab and swings with a horizontal chop at his opponent, unleashing a wave of electricity that sends them flying back.
Hellfire Gale: Kakuzu, after using the Wind Release: Pressure Damage to create a whirlwind in the centre of the battlefield, releases through his fire-mask a large fireball into the whirlwind, causing the fireball to split into several smaller ones that are sent in all directions in a fixed pattern.
Hero of the Hidden Sand: Pakura covers herself with fire, amplifying the effect of her Scorch Release attacks.
Hero of the Sharingan: Obito performs the Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique and after the opponent gets burned by the flames, he appears behind the opponent and stabs them with a kunai.
Hidden Doorway Technique: The user extends their palm out towards a wall, causing a hole that ripples and shapes into a doorway. Additionally, a seal can be placed on the wall to secure the contents behind it.
Hidden Rock Trap: This trap was amongst the many ones that protected Mount Katsuragi. After crossing the spot where it's placed, a rock cylinder pops out and pushes the enemy off the mountain track.
Hidden Shadow Snake Burial: The user burrows underground and extends their limbs to grab their opponent by their ankles, and drags them into the ground, burying them.
Hidden Shadow Snake Hands: The user summons several snakes from under their sleeve, deploying them against a target as a surprise. The snakes do as their summoner commands, attacking or capturing targets by biting or constricting them. The snakes can also help the user latch to the surroundings, pulling the summoner towards a destination to help them get around faster. Because of the snakes' length, they can be used from a fair distance away.
Hidden Shadow Wild Snake Hands: The user summons a large amounts of snakes that emerge from underground to attack a target.
Hiden: Hiding in Scale Powder Technique: The user exhales a large quantity of fine powder from their mouth, which due to its luminous quality, shines so brightly that it can temporarily blind multiple targets within its area of effect. This momentary handicap can be utilised either by the user or their allies to attack the opposition whilst their vision is still impaired.
