Hiden: Scale Powder Enfolding Attack Tec: Fū transformed as Chōmei flaps its wings to release a perculiar powder. While in this state Fū can also use this generated powder to shoot several small spheres at the opponent.
Hiden: Scale Powder Technique: Fū manifests Chōmei's wings and flaps them at her opponent, sending a wave of scale powder.
Hideout Destruction Trap: A timed trapping technique created by Orochimaru to destroy any evidence of the location it is placed on. Once activated, the entirety of the area is completely erased, by what appears to be a mud water vortex, destroying everything within the predefined vicinity. The technique activates regardless of who or what caught up within it.
Hiding in Black Fog Technique: The user emits a black fog from their body to conceal themselves.
Hiding in Cloth Technique: The user covers themselves and the surrounding area with a giant roll of cloth which conceals the user as they escape, allowing them to leave the battlefield unnoticed.
Hiding in Frost Technique: The Hiding in Frost Technique produces visually clouding frost by causing the temperature of air to fall below the freezing point, effectively freezing any ambient water vapour in the vicinity. The frost allows the user to become transparent within it. Upon being struck with an attack, the user becomes visible. The mist is visible to the naked eye, but since the user is transparent it voids that sense. An effective way of finding the user is tracking them through sound.
Hiding in Mist Technique: This technique is a specialty of Kirigakure ninja. Users fill the air with mist and control its thickness with their chakra. Once the mists are thick enough that opponents cannot see, that in turn means they cannot manage much defence against the user. Zabuza Momochi famously used this technique to perform assassinations; although he also could not see within the mists, he was able to locate his targets based only on the sounds they made. The mists can be created using water from the surroundings, or users can create the mists themselves, which they exhale from their mouths. If the mists are made thick enough, they can cancel out the enhanced vision of the Sharingan and Rinnegan. In the anime, Byakugan users are able to see through the mists. Sensors also can still find targets despite the lost visibility.
Hiding in Shadow Technique: A technique in which the user is capable of concealing themselves in a shadow.
Hiding in Surface Technique: With this technique, the user can phase through their surroundings, allowing them to quickly avoid an incoming attack and can travel undetected as well. Using this method of approach, the user can execute a surprise attack on their enemy.
Hiding in a Toad Technique: The user summons a special from Mount Myōboku and hides inside its stomach.
Hiding with Camouflage Technique: The user controls the reflection of light around their body using chakra, causing their form, shadow, and even breathing to become invisible to the unaided eye. Because they perfectly blend in with their surroundings, the user can sneak up behind an enemy without being noticed. Since both their appearance and scent are camouflaged, their presence can only be revealed by the sounds they make. Dōjutsu such as the Sharingan or Byakugan can also see through it.
Hinokagutsuchi: Hinokagutsuchi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu unique to Indra Ōtsutsuki's left eye. It strongly resembles Amaterasu in both form and function, allowing him to produce black flames at the focal point of his vision. Little else is known about the technique, though the flames faltered before Asura Ōtsutsuki's Amenomihashira.
Hog Release: Crazed Fireworks: Shizune surrounds the opponent with the poison mist, then jumps up and throws senbon at the opponent. Tonton then finishes the opponent by tossing eight large bombs at the opponent in the poisonous mist. After throwing eight of them, an explosion appears.
Hog Release: Tonton: Tonton is thrown to the opponent by Shizune, who then constantly attacks the opponent in various directions. Tonton then spins fiercely upward under their opponent, leaving them in the air, which then causes a crash once the opponent knock into the ground.
Hokage-Style Sixty-Year-Old Technique —: The Hokage-Style Sixty-Year-Old Technique — Kakuan Entering Society with Bliss-Bringing Hands technique utilises the power of the Wood Release to forcibly suppress a tailed beast's chakra.
Holly: Kimimaro dives at the opponent with his bone sword spinning rapidly like a drill and strikes them rapidly in different places.
Honey Spit Trap: After being summoned, the Giant Bee spits massive amounts of honey on its opponent which encases and immobilises them.
Horizon Meteor: The user launches a series of Truth-Seeking Balls at the opponent, forcing them straight into the ground. Then, several platforms, alongside the opponent, are lifted into the air, with the user creating an invisible clone to strike the opponent hard enough to blow them onto another floating platform. After that, four more invisible clones are created, which punch the opponent with force enough to send them straight into the ground. Finally, the user uses Chibaku Tensei to create multiple satellites and drop them on the opponent.
Horn Breaking: Kokuō drives its horns directly into the opponent using a powerful charge. The force of this attack was so great that it sent Gyūki flying a considerable distance away.
Horror of Akatsuki: Hidan slashes the opponent with his Triple-Bladed Scythe, creating an opening for Kakuzu, who grabs them and throws them at the ground. Zetsu emerges from the ground with his flytrap extensions "chewing" the opponent as he spins upwards. Deidara and Sasori attack from a distance with C1 birds and a flamethrower, causing an explosion. Orochimaru shapes the explosion into a fiery whirlwind, which Itachi further incinerates with Amaterasu. After it explodes, Kisame slashes the opponent through the remains of the explosion with Samehada, clearing the path for Konan, who flies above and pins them with numerous paper spears. At the end, Pain finishes with Shinra Tensei.
Host Transformation: Host Transformation is a ninjutsu exclusive to the player avatars in Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker. The player momentarily takes the form of one of the following Tailed Beasts:
Hot Sand Waterfall Funeral: Gaara while in Shukaku form grabs the opponent, jumps into the air with them, and throws them back down to the ground while crushing them with sand.
Hot-Blooded Dynamic Entry: Guy and Lee combine their Dynamic Entries and kick the opponent together as one.
Howling Hair Sound Wave: By whipping around locks of their hair, the user generates high-frequency sound waves that are capable of simultaneously disorienting the foe by overwhelming their hearing and likewise able to slice at the target.
Human Beast Combination Transformation:: This technique is a specialty of the Inuzuka clan. The Inuzuka and their ninken companion perform the Combination Transformation to take the shared form of a two-headed wolf. Because of the transformation's size, its strong claws, and its two sets of fangs, its standard attacks are quite powerful. This is especially true of any other jutsu performed while using this form, which are far more destructive than what the Inuzuka or the ninken are ordinarily capable of. These attacks and jutsu are most often performed against targets that have been cornered, fitting their wolf form.
Human Beast Mixture Transformation — Thr: This technique is a speciality of Konohagakure's Inuzuka clan.
Human Bullet Big Tank: Chōji performs his Human Bullet Tank in unison with Multi-Size Technique, and slams into his opponent, leaving a gaping hole in the ground.
Human Bullet Heavy Tank: Chōji performs Human Bullet Tank and begins bouncing until brutally bouncing on the opponent two times while driving them into the ground on the third.
Human Bullet Tank: This is a "showy" taijutsu unique to members of the Akimichi clan. The user tucks themselves into a ball and rolls towards a target. Due to force of their rotation, most obstacles are pulverised upon contact. Users can take advantage of the surrounding environment to launch themselves into the air, increasing the damage when they fall back to the ground. The speed at which they spin has the added benefit of rendering most attacks ineffective against them. But the ball's speed also makes it difficult to turn, forcing users to stop spinning entirely if they want to make significant changes in direction and thus leaving them vulnerable while they do.
Human Bullet Yo-Yo: The Human Bullet Yo-Yo is the technique derived from used by the 16th generation of the Ino–Shika–Chō trio.
Human Cocoon Technique: The user creates a cocoon around themselves to use it as a waterproof "sleeping bag". It can also be used to hide from enemies or to spy on them.
Human Path: The grants a Rinnegan user the ability to read the mind of any target by placing their hand on the target's head or chest, thus obtaining even the most well-guarded secrets. This process kills the target, with their souls being physically removed from their body once users pull their hand away. This makes the ability quite deadly in close combat, as in most cases, there is little that targets can do to stop the removal of their soul short of attacking the user, which the other Six Paths Techniques make very difficult. Though it can be somewhat physically resisted temporarily if the target has enough power to do so.
Human Shadow Simulation Technique: Shikamaru materialises and personifies his shadow into two different Shikamaru shaped shadows. Each shadow punches the opponent once and then both shadows coil around the opponent and crushes them.
Hundred Blooming Flowers Technique: While having the target under the effects of the Odourless Poison Mist, Karenbana releases flower petals, before casting the illusion that she had turned into a multitude of flower petals herself, which flow through the air and circle the target. With the target hindered, she can freely move through the flower petals and attack the target without being seen.
Hundred Furious Palms: After activating her Byakugan, Hinata then hits the opponent ninety-nine times. After the last, hundredth hit, they are sent flying.
Hundred Puppet Soul Binding: After having their target destroy ninety-nine of their puppets with each puppet driving a "bolt" into the target, the destruction of the hundredth puppet allows the user to effectively take full control of a person's body in a similar manner to the Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body technique without the person's cooperation. This technique may cause pain to the victim as seen when Shizuka was yelling in pain.
Hungry Shark Drop: Kisame jumps into the air and then points Samehada down towards the opponent and then enveloping it in water. He then manipulates its shape moulding it into a shark and drilling the opponent into the ground.
Hunt: The user stretches out their Truth-Seeking Balls into a rope-like form that pierce the opponent.
Hurricane Head Butt: Mecha-Naruto uses its jet boosts to rush into the opponent and headbutt them before spinning rapidly as it lifts them up into the air.
Hurricane Thunderclap: Akaboshi and his group surround and entrap their opponent in a pyramidal, pink-glowing barrier, then cause the barrier to explode, injuring or, ideally, killing the person within it.
Hurricane Thunderclap — Majestic Attire: Naruto and Sasuke deliver a series of physical attacks on their opponent. Naruto fully manifests Kurama, and Sasuke armours it with Susanoo, also manifesting its sword, cutting the opponent down.
Husband and Wife Rasengan: Kushina delivers a barrage of punches, following with Minato teleporting above the opponent to slash down on them, finished with the couple forming together a Rasengan that is charged towards the opponent.
Hydrification Technique: This jutsu, a hallmark of the Hōzuki clan, allows the user to liquefy any part of their body at will, from the hair on their head to the muscles in their arms. Gengetsu Hōzuki liquefies into a mixture of oil and water, but it's not clear if this same mixture is used by other members. When the user is struck by a physical attack, the impacted area becomes liquid, causing the attack to pass through them and leave them unharmed. The user then solidifies back into their original form. This technique is generally autonomous, allowing for members to liquefy without conscious thought.
Hypnotic Genjutsu: Wild Beast Communicat: By exhaling the Kotarō that their bodies are able to produce, members of the Kodon clan hypnotise Rōen, putting it under their control. Most forms of attack that might be directed against Rōen won't disrupt the hypnotism, but large quantities of blue fire powder will. The jutsu can also be used on those that Rōen has been sealed into, dulling its influence over them and altering their memories if desired. If anyone else inhales the purple smoke, they will simply lose consciousness.
Hyūga Great Combo Palm: Neji, Hinata and Hanabi use Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm to distance themselves from the opponent, after which Hiashi arrives and uses Eight Trigrams Vacuum Wall Palm. Afterwards, the four Hyūga use a cooperative Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms, during which Hinata and Hanabi deliver close-ranged Gentle Fist strikes and Hiashi and Neji use Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven. Lastly, the four use a cooperative Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm at a close range, sending their opponent flying.
Hyūga Main Family's Juinjutsu: This cursed seal is used by the Hyūga clan in order to protect their kekkei genkai, the Byakugan. Members of the clan's main house brand members of the clan's branch houses with the cursed seal so that, when they die, their Byakugan will be sealed away, preventing its secrets from being learned by enemies. The cursed seal can also be used by the main house to torture branch house members: if a main house member uses a special hand seal, the branch house member will experience intense pain, discouraging them from disobeying the main house again. If the pain is great enough, it can even kill the branch house member, destroying their brain cells.
Hyūga: Great Revolving Heaven: A collaboration technique performed by two Hyūga clan members. One performs the Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms technique and the other uses the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven around it. This creates a huge sphere with both offensive and defensive power, causing great damage to the opponent.
I Won't Let You Go!: Kushina hits her opponent with a frying pan a bunch of times. Then, she becomes enraged and punches the target, sending them a considerable distance away.
IQ200: Shikamaru throws a myriad of kunai, all but one of which have wire strings attached to them, with a single one having explosive grenades instead, at the opponent. He then pulls on the strings, creating a friction that cuts down a bunch of tree branches, creating a debris that triggers the grenades, causing an explosion.
Iai Beheading: Adhering to the principles of Iaidō, the user performs a quick and powerful slash with their sword in order to cut the intended target, before immediately re-sheathing the blade afterwards.
Iaidō: The term refers to a specific style of kenjutsu that is concerned with the smooth, controlled movements of drawing the sword from its scabbard, striking or cutting an opponent, removing blood from the blade, and then replacing the sword in the scabbard. The linear motion and force applied to draw the sword from the scabbard results in slashes that are faster and stronger than ones executed with the sword already drawn.
Ibuse's Poison Mist: Hanzō summons Ibuse from the ground, who launches a poison cloud, which travels in a straight line and poisons his opponent by enveloping them.
Ice Disk Technique: This technique turns the moisture particles in the air into ice disks of multiple uses. They can be hurled with tremendous force at a target, and are hard to dodge because of their transparency. They can create highly durable shields against enemy attacks. They can be stand on as platforms for hovering in the air. They can also be used to spy with, stringing together multiple disks to reflect images from great distances. By forming the ice into a large lens, the user can hover it high into the sky to focus the rays of the sun into a powerful beam capable of melting and exploding the pinpointed area, allegedly able to burn down an entire mountainous terrain, but when used in this manner, the beam can be reflected onto the user or anyone else, using a reflective surface.
Ice Prison Technique: This technique allows the user to infuse their chakra with ice on the ground and bring it to the surface. The user can then trap their opponent within the ice by controlling its movements and completely surrounding them in the ice. It is strong enough to withstand basic Fire Release techniques, because the ice has already been infused with the user's chakra. The user can also surround themselves with the ice prison to act as a shield.
Ice Release: Black Dragon Blizzard: An Ice Release technique formed from already existing ice. After forming the needed hand seal Dotō will thrust his arm to send out a black ether-like dragon to strike his opponent. As it flies through the air it will begin to turn. When it hits the target it will use its motion to launch the opponent high into the air.
Ice Release: Crystal Wall: The user creates walls out of ice crystals to detain their opponents. The reflective surfaces of ice can serve as mirrors for certain genjutsu that requires mirrors to work.
Ice Release: Earthen Consecutive Chains: The user, either through physical contact or remotely, causes ice particles to form on a target. If used on a living creature, the target will freeze to death unless they are able to mould chakra. By coating themselves with chakra and dedicating all their energy to keeping themselves warm, they can avoid death; if they use their chakra to perform a technique, they will start to rapidly freeze again. Its usefulness in neutralising shinobi is on par with Fire Release: Heavenly Prison.
Ice Release: Frozen Capturing Field: Upon making a one-handed hand seal, the user freezes the ground underneath a target to immobilise and freeze their feet, rendering them motionless for a period of time.
Ice Release: Ice Peak Crumbling: Haku creates thin spikes of ice that protrude from the ground underneath the opponent, sending them flying high into the air.
Ice Release: Ice Rock Dome of Magnificen: Haku can quickly freeze the surrounding air and create an icy, transparent igloo-like dome around himself and/or allies to act as a defence. It is strong enough to withstand the air assault of many explosive tags at once, remaining almost undamaged.
Ice Release: Ice-Breaking Sledgehammer: The user surrounds their fists with ice, increasing their striking power or, alternatively, allowing them to use their fists to block attacks stronger than they would be able to otherwise.
Ice Release: Icicle Combo: Haku delivers a series of slashes with senbon, followed by some kicks, before resuming to slash at the opponent. He then kicks the opponent away, generating multiple large needles of ice in the air to fly at the opponent.
Ice Release: Icicle Swallow: After backflipping in the air, Haku quickly launches several ice needles at the opponent.
Ice Release: One Horned White Whale: This technique allows the user to create a humongous whale with a long narwhal horn out of preexisting ice to attack their opponent. The user needs a source of ice in order to use this technique. The large bulk of this technique is capable of creating great destruction upon landing. However, due to it's size and lack of speed, this technique is used more as a distraction, or to block an opponent's movements rather than attack.
Ice Release: Swallow Snow Storm: This technique creates a cluster of ice needles in the shape of miniature swallows out of preexisting ice, which the user then launches at the opponent. These needles can change direction in midair and will maim the opponent with their sharp wings. This technique can be countered by Fire Release techniques, which in turn melts the ice.
Ice Release: Tearing Dragon Fierce Tiger: The user manipulates pre-existing ice and forms it into a giant tiger. It is cold enough to freeze any Water Release technique that it comes into contact with.
Ice Release: Ten Thousand Ice Petals: The user unleashes a barrage of ice darts. The intensity of the cold is so great, that should a person attempt to block them, it will cause severe damage to the afflicted limb. The user can also use this defensively by creating a wall of ice to create distance between the user and their combatant.
Ice Release: Twin Dragon Blizzard: An advanced version of Ice Release: Black Dragon Blizzard in which Dotō releases two dragons of black snow that merge into a massive tornado. This technique manipulates existing ice instead of creating ice.
Ice Release: Whirlwind: Aiming their hand at a target, the user shoots shards of ice rapidly around the target which entraps them in a whirlwind, leading to the target becoming partially encased in ice.
Ice Release: Wolf Fang Avalanche Techniq: This technique allows Nadare to cause an avalanche when near a mountain and transform the falling snow into a pack of wolves to attack the opponent. This technique has a weakness to lightning-based techniques, as seen when the wolves completely dissolve when attacked by Kakashi Hatake's Lightning Cutter.
Ice Sword Technique: The user condenses the moisture in the atmosphere into swords of ice that can then be used for close-range combat or shot at a target. The swords can be formed from great distances away.
Ice-Breaking Fist: The user surrounds their fist with ice to block incoming taijutsu attacks. With this technique, Rahyō was able to successfully stop Might Guy's Leaf Whirlwind.
Illusionary Mist: The Three-Tails releases a mist created by its chakra to put intruders under an illusion. The illusion torments the target with events from their past. The illusion will vanish if the victim can break the illusion, either by themselves or with the assistance of another.
Immortal Body: Hidan's immortal body releases a wave of energy, damaging his opponents, briefly cursing them while enhancing his own attributes.
Impaling Spear Tree: The user grows trees with sharp pointed branches, impaling any that are beneath them.
Impermanence of Worldly Things: The Magaki Group creates a shard that breaks up into multiple shards and impales the opponent. According to Yamato, it is said to be quite a formidable technique.
Improvised Secret Technique: Lightning B: A cooperation ninjutsu developed by Boruto that has Sarada create a series of Lightning Balls that are then infused with Lightning Release-charged shuriken by Boruto and are launched at the opponent.
Incursion of Clarity: Kabuto uppercuts his opponent and then spins around slicing their throat with a chakra scalpel.
Indra's Arrow: Indra's Arrow is Sasuke Uchiha's strongest offensive technique.
Infinite Embrace: A special barrier of bright purple chakra that subdues the enemy by pushing down on them and rapidly draining their chakra. It's quite difficult to resist it, but Naruto Uzumaki managed to do it using the Nine-Tails' chakra. In order to maintain the strength of the barrier, a group of individuals must perform it simultaneously.
Infinite Tsukuyomi: The Infinite Tsukuyomi is an extremely powerful genjutsu that traps the entire world in an illusion, enslaving the human and animal populations in a dream so that their chakra may be drawn upon by the God Tree.
Infinite Wild Dance: After opening seven chakra gates, Lee punches the ground, creating an earthquake that launches his opponent into the air. He then attacks his foe many times at the speed of light, moving so fast that it seems as if there are three Lees attacking at once. To finish, Lee punches the enemy from the sky three times, slamming them back to the ground.
Ink Clone Technique: A technique that infuses chakra into ink to form clones of the user. If struck, the ink clones revert back to plain ink.
Ink Creation: This is a unique ability of Gyūki that allows it to produce ink. Though Gyūki is the sole inheritor of the ability, it can be passed on to its jinchūriki.
Ink Flush: By directly pouring out his ink instead of using it to draw, Sai can create a large amount of creatures such as a nest of snakes to attack the target.
Ink Lariat: Killer B rushes back and forth on the opponent using Lariat with ink on his arm.
Ink Mist Technique: The user wraps their body in chakra-infused ink to hide themselves creating an effective smokescreen. When used in combination with the Body Flicker Technique, the user can quickly leave the battlefield without being noticed.
Inner Sakura: broadly refers to a range of techniques performed by Sakura Haruno with her inner self that sleeps in her heart in the Naruto video games.
Insect Clone Technique: An Aburame has thousands of their kikaichū gather together until they've taken on the size and appearance of the Aburame, to be used either as a decoy or a diversion. The insect clone can be created anywhere that the kikaichū are positioned or sent to, making it more useful for certain tasks than a shadow clone. When the insect clone is struck, it disperses back into a swarm of kikaichū. In the anime, the insect clones take a solid enough form to coordinate with the user for joint attacks.
Insect Deception Technique: Shibi sends his insects underneath the opponent before springing them upon the enemy, feeding on their chakra. The technique isn't as effective if the opponent has chakra reserves which surpass the kikaichū's capacity to feed on said chakra.
Insect Jamming Technique: The user has a large amount of their kikaichū spread out over a wide area around themselves, having them emit a small amount of the chakra they usually feed on to confuse sensor-type shinobi. As the insects' irregular distribution and grouping together result in the creation of numerous chakra signals, it makes it more difficult to distinguish the user's actual location.
Insect Jar Technique: A technique capable of protecting against attacks by using kikaichū to fly in a dome shape at high speed, similar to the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven. While proving defensive, a sufficient amount of explosive force can break through it.
Insect Pillar: Shino disappears and seemingly transforms into a pillar of kikaichū that attacks the opponent. This attack can be used on multiple opponents at once as extra pillar appears per target.
Insect Pillar Technique: Shino summons many kikaichū to form pillars the attack the opponent form below in various ways, either as a row of advancing pillars, or a spike from the ground which multiplies per target.
Insect Rope Technique: The user releases a large number of kikaichū that form a rope that can easily support the target's weight.
Insect Spying Technique: By linking themselves to an insect, they are able to see and hear what it experiences, providing a long-range and relatively safe and inconspicuous way to gather intel. The user is also able to tell when the bug had been killed.
Insect Webbing: The user is able to create excrete webbing from the palms of their hands, extending their reach mainly for restraining and trapping their target.
Instant: Sasuke appears in front of his opponent and unsheaths his sword. He then slashes many times and reappears behind his opponent. The opponent collapses after he sheathes his sword back in the hilt.
Instant Earth Burial: Isshiki flies towards the opponent and grabs them by the throat, dragging them into the ground and tossing them.
Instant Ice Encasing Technique: The user fires ice at the target, causing them to become completely frozen.
Instant Lightning Blade: Minato dashes towards his opponent with such high speed that he looks like a blur and hits them as he passes them. He then stops behind them and slashes them with a kunai.
Instant Lightning: Combination Tag: Sasuke and Naruto blitz the opponent at incredible speed from both sides, making it difficult for them to make a move against the pair.
Instant Path: The user instantaneously teleports in front of the opponent and hits them with their shakujō coated in lightning.
Instant Water: Employing their mastery of Water Release, the user releases a wave of water below their feet to act as jets to increase their speed which allows them to dash towards the opponent and attack with a full-body blow.
Intelligence Transmission: With this ability, Motoi can mentally transmit commands to Fukuemon, and he attacks the enemy with wings on the fly, and lifting shinobi into the air and dropping into a pre-prepared trap.
Intense Passion: Ferocious Tiger Lotus P: Guy and Lee both activate the Eight Gates, Guy entering the Seventh Gate and Lee the Sixth. After a streak of hits throwing the opponent up in the air, Lee uses the Reverse Lotus sending them down. Before they can reach the ground, Guy performs the Morning Peacock and the Daytime Tiger, causing the tiger to consume the peacock's flames. Lee and Guy both rush through the combined jutsu, punching through their opponent, before the tiger explodes, spreading the peacock's flames.
Internal Weapon: The Deva Path begins with a kick, followed by two slashes with chakra disruption blades and a Shinra Tensei. Then, the Asura Path performs a jumping attack with Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability and finishes off with the Asura Attack.
Interrogation Genjutsu: Kakkō uses this genjutsu to break the will of his captured target, to make them give as much information as possible. However, if the target has a strong will, the technique will be useless.
Intersection Method: With this technique, the user is able to intercept and counter an oncoming taijutsu technique by raising the knee, and driving the elbow downwards at the same time. This catches the attacking limb between their two limbs, and drives the elbow down with great force, effectively shattering the bone. Genshō used this technique while disguised as Yagura to "break" Rock Lee's Leaf Whirlwind by intercepting his attacking leg. Even though Lee's ankle was not broken due to protection from his ankle weights, he was forced to completely halt his training until the injury was fully healed.
Inukaitakerunomikoto: A technique where the user creates ferocious canine chakra avatars from the land itself. They will pursue their targets relentlessly in order to clamp down on them with their jaws, restraining and crushing them, and their tracking speed is so great that they were even able to catch Sasuke Uchiha.
Inuzuka Clan Glory: First, the Three Haimaru Brothers attack the enemy from different sides, moving very quickly, attacking with claws and teeth, after which Hana Inuzuka finishes him off with her sharp fingernails, enhanced with chakra, which is accompanied by bright red flashes.
Invariant Connection: Naruto jumps into the air where he creates many shadow clones that form a chain whip for Sakura to wield. She then spins the chain like a tornado and drops it down on their opponent with intense force.
Iron Armour Seal: Iron Armour Seal is the fūinjutsu used by Kumogakure to seal Gyūki into its respective hosts.
Iron Ball Trap: The user summons a huge steel ball with spikes from the scroll, and crushes the enemy with it, dropping it from a height on their head.
Iron Claw: This move simply entails A squeezing the target's face with his hand. He uses this technique on Killer B whenever he get irritated with B's behaviour. Gyūki has seen A do this to B several times to the point it even mentions he would give B the Iron Claw for helping Naruto escape from Genbu.
Iron Hammer of Kirigakure (game): Jinin smashes the hammer portion of Kabutowari down at the ground, the heavy impact of which breaks it and stuns his opponent. He follows it with a slash from the axe portion, before placing it on his opponent to hammer it inwards with the other portion.
Iron Mountain Leaning: After creating an insect clone, Shino and the clone run towards the opponent and simply tackle them. The force of this attack is strong enough to send the target flying away from them.
Iron Pan Furious Attack: Kosuke holds the frying pan he usually carries on his back in front of him and attacks the opponent like a projectile, spinning wildly as he does so.
Iron Sand Body: Ryū instantly dissolves into a body of iron sand. In this form, he is able to freely move about in the air, while being invulnerable to damage, and retains control of his sand.
Iron Sand Chain World: Sasori uses the Third Kazekage human puppet to release a series long spike of Iron Sand surrounding him to stab the opponent.
Iron Sand Clone: The user creates a clone out of Iron Sand that can be used for diversionary tactics.
Iron Sand Drizzle: It is a gunshot-like attack which uses Iron Sand hardened into minuscule grains to attack simultaneously across a vast range. The bullets are so fast that they are difficult to see. The moment the user has finished preparing the attack, evading it becomes extremely difficult. Using the repellent force of magnetism, the speed of the bullets is rapidly increased after they are shot. Furthermore, the user can also use an attack pattern where the Iron Sand bullets are shaped into sharp needles, increasing their ability to wound or kill the opponent.
Iron Sand Funeral: While using the Third Kazekage puppet, Sasori makes it grab the opponent and lift them into the air. Then he controls the puppet to make small spikes of Iron Sand fly towards and stab the limp opponent before exploding, knocking the opponent backwards.
Iron Sand Gathering Assault: The Iron Sand Gathering Assault is a technique which gathers a great volume of Iron Sand and compresses it into a high-density shape.
Iron Sand Gathering Assault: Drop: Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to create a Giant Hammer made of Iron Sand and drops it on the opponent.
Iron Sand Gathering Assault: Giant Hamme: Sasori jumps up into the air, and then he manipulates the Third Kazekage human puppet to smash a great mass of Iron Sand against his opponent.
Iron Sand Gathering Assault: Wedge: Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to manipulate a large quantity of Iron Sand into a pyramid-shaped figure that lengthens towards his opponent while spinning from left to right.
Iron Sand Marking: The user tags their opponent with a special marking, ensuring that all Iron Sand-based attacks are magnetically drawn to their target.
Iron Sand Mountain Range: Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to create a wall of Iron Sand in front of him, which he then causes several variable sized spikes to protrude and strikes the opponent.
Iron Sand Scattered Showers: Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to create a series of large Iron Sand senbon in mid air that fall down upon the opponent piercing them.
Iron Sand Sky Wings: The Third Kazekage manipulates countless Iron Sand particles to cover the ground. He takes flight, causing the sand and iron on the ground to transform into numerous sharp spikes to attack the enemy. Finally, the Third controls the Iron Sand scattered in the air to condense into a giant spear, which is drilled towards the ground to attack the enemy.
Iron Sand Wall: Shinki uses his Iron Sand to create a cloak around himself as a means of protection from incoming attacks.
Iron Sand Wave: Shinki launches a wave of Iron Sand to descend upon his target. It is similar to Gaara's Quicksand Waterfall Flow, but on a much smaller scale. He can also use this technique to bind a target and crush them.
Iron Sand Weaponry: Using Iron Sand, the user can create weapons charged with magnetism, such as spikes, spears, and swords, that can be used offensively against the opponent. In addition, the user can place special markings on their opponents to ensure that the weapons hit their target.
Iron Sand World Method: This technique uses Iron Sand to create a gigantic sphere of branching spikes. The user first creates two masses of Iron Sand of opposing magnetic fields and then merges them together. This causes the magnetic forces to instantly increase and the repellent force created by the two opposing magnetic fields scatters the Iron Sand across a vast area.
Iron Sand World Method: Earth Break: Using the Third Kazekage puppet, Sasori shapes the iron sand into four large cubes around his target, which grow spikes.
Iron Sand: Black Iron Wings: The user creates wings out of Iron Sand that can be used for flight. Using these wings, the user can also generate feathers in the form of homing missiles, as well as can combine the wings to form a giant spear.
Iwagakure Kinjutsu: This is an unnamed kinjutsu which was passed down through generations in Iwagakure.
Izanagi: Izanagi is a genjutsu performed with the Sharingan.
Izanami: The Izanami is one of the Uchiha clan's ultimate dōjutsu.
Jade Crystal Clone Technique: By using the Crystal Release: Jade Crystal Mirror as a medium, Guren creates six clones of herself that emerge from the mirror. Due to them being made of crystal, those said clones can endure further damage than that of a shadow clone can. These clones are also able to deceive Byakugan users due to their reflective nature, but by focusing their sight, this can be circumvented.
Jar of Poison Technique: Using his rinkaichū, Torune gathers multiple infected corpses and contains them within a barrier where the decaying flesh will release a gas that in time will ignite an explosion and release the venomous insects in a huge swarm that could cover the surrounding landscape. According to Shino, the barrier accelerates the insect's multiplication.
Jawbreaker: Sakura lands a series of punches, before sending her opponent up in the air with a backwards cartwheel kick and jumping to kick them even higher.
Jet Booster Jump: Jūgo, while in his transformed state, creates many jet-like appendages on his back to create very powerful blasts. He then jumps, giving him enough power to rapidly manoeuvre through the air, as well as tremendously enhance his speed on the ground.
Jibakugan: This genjutsu brings out the victim's subconscious negative or hateful emotions. The caster can take advantage of these feelings and control the victim's actions. This technique can be cancelled by smelling the New Moon Flower Perfume, using the Sharingan, or killing the caster. Those who are being controlled by the Jibakugan gains several strange markings under their eyes and on their foreheads. For this technique to be effective, direct eye contact is needed, unless the user's power is sufficient enough to use it without the need of direct eye contact.
Jōgan: The is a unique dōjutsu that is known only by the Ōtsutsuki Clan, whose members claim that it is troublesome and a power strongly inherited from their clan. In the manga, the dōjutsu is featureless in appearance with a barely visible pupil. When depicted in the anime, the dōjutsu is light blue in colour with a darkened sclera and visible pupil.
Kagura Shuriken: Tenten throws a barrage of shuriken which automatically target the opponent and break through their guard.
Kagura Square Formation: Karin surrounds herself in an orb of pink light to immobilise the opponent before throwing multiple senbon at the opponent.
Kagutsuchi Rasengan: Sasuke and Naruto prepare a Scorch Release: Halo Hurricane Jet Black Arrow Style Zero, which Naruto throws at their opponent. When the opponent is pushed back by it, Sasuke teleports behind them, kicking them back, positioning them between Naruto and himself. Sasuke manifests a Susanoo arm through which he channels Chidori and Kagutsuchi, Naruto focuses Kurama's chakra on his fist, and the two strike their opponent, which results in a massive explosion visible even from space.
Kaima Form: This technique, developed by Amachi due to Orochimaru's initial interest in creating the ultimate underwater shinobi, drastically changes the user's appearance, giving them green scale-like skin, fins, and gills.
Kamui: Kamui is a space–time ninjutsu that can be used with Obito Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan.
Kamui Lightning Cutter: After receiving Obito's Six Paths Power, Kakashi forms a Lightning Cutter imbued with the power of Kamui. Anything pierced by this technique is instantly warped to Kamui's dimension. Combined with Kamui's intangibility, this technique allows for Kakashi to avoid an enemy's counter.
Kamui Running: Obito charges forward to his destination, using Kamui to make his body completely intangible, avoiding damage from any incoming attacks.
Kamui Running: Brutal: Obito dashes to the opponent while using Kamui, to impale them with branches grown from his arm.
Kamui Shuriken: Kamui Shuriken is a technique utilised by Kakashi Hatake through his Susanoo.
Kanzeon Lotus King: While using Yamato as a medium, Tobi creates a massive statue, similar to Hashirama Senju's Sage Art Wood Release: True Several Thousand Hands technique. Unlike Hashirama's much larger variant however, this creation does not utilise senjutsu chakra. The wielder of this avatar is capable of using a multitude of hands to assault their opponents.
Kara Savagery: Jigen brings the members of Kara through portals to attack the opponent. Delta rushes flying at them, modifying her leg to stab them from above. Boro follows with a gunpowder-laced punch, both it and the explosion tossing the target aside towards Koji as he summons flames. The target is caught between the flames erupting below them and Jigen dropping a cube above them.
Katsuyu: Immense Network Healing: Katsuyu: Immense Network Healing is a cooperation ninjutsu used by Katsuyu and its summoner using the link shared via the Strength of a Hundred Seal.
Ketsuryūgan: The , is a dōjutsu, which appears in certain individuals of the Chinoike clan. The Ketsuryūgan is recognised by its reddish colour, giving a special appearance for the users of this dōjutsu, characterised as holders of "eyes as red as blood". Its power earned it comparison to the Three Great Dōjutsu.
Kick Attack Crash: Obito attacks with his kunai and gunbai, kicking his opponent up in the air, teleporting above them and kicking them back down.
Kido's Juinjutsu: The user places a cursed seal on a target as a way to protect secrets, the target is aware involving the user, from leaking. The seal is designed to cause its wearer to explode if they divulge sensitive information.
Killing Cursed Seal: The user leaves a seal on the victim's body in the form of black patterns, allowing them to be kept under control, killing at any convenient moment.
Kirin: Kirin is an extremely powerful Lightning Release technique created by Sasuke Uchiha.
Kokugan: The Kokugan is a dōjutsu used by Isshiki Ōtsutsuki and later Kawaki through his Kāma. It features a black pupil which glows gold when jutsu are used, and a black wheel-like pattern with eight spokes coming out of the centre. The iris area between adjacent spokes is gold.
Kongukan: Three of Kakuzu's masks combine their Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work, Lightning Release: False Darkness, and Wind Release: Pressure Damage to create a massive explosion reminiscent of an atomic blast.
Konoha Jōseki Formation: Izumo uses Water Release: Starch Syrup Capturing Field to create a big pool of water, after which, he, alongside Asuma and Kotetsu, moulds with the water in order to get close to their opponent. The three then jump out of the water and strike the opponent behind their back, with Izumo and Kotetsu delivering an attack with a long kunai and a mace simultaneously, followed with Asuma striking the opponent with his Flying Swallow-enhanced Chakra Blade. After that, Shikamaru uses his Shadow Gathering Technique to pull his teammates in, allowing Kotetsu and Izumo to attack the opponent once more, creating a pillar of water, which hardens after the blow, followed with Asuma slashing through the pillar and the opponent.
Konoha: True Thousand Hokage Hands: In Sage Mode, Hashirama creates a gigantic wooden statue. The other five Hokage all channel their chakra through it, causing it to glow with power. Hashirama detaches the statue from its countless hands, and lands a sequence of six chakra-enhanced punches with it, swiftly moving the statue in front of the opponent after each hit to land the next. The last punch is an uppercut, throwing the opponent into the sky, and creating a fire in the shape of the kanji for fire.
Konohamaru Army Corps! Reach the Goal!: First, Moegi attacks the opponent with water projectiles, after which Udon creates a tree from snot, which pierces them with sharp branches, and in the end Konohamaru summons Gamagorō, who smashes the tree and the opponent.
Kotoamatsukami: Kotoamatsukami is the signature dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha's two Mangekyō Sharingan, which casts a powerful yet subtle mind-controlling genjutsu on a target.
Kotoamatsukami: Afterglow: Shisui casts Kotoamatsukami on all his opponents, confusing their movements and obscuring their vision.
Kotoamatsukami: Beam of Light: Shisui places the opponent under a genjutsu using Kotoamatsukami, which shows a large Mangekyō Sharingan that shines down rays of light to blast the opponent.
Kumogakure Taijutsu: Wolf Ring: Yurui performs a full body horizontal spin with his swords, attacking in quick succession.
Kunoichi Rumble: Sakura throws some shuriken at the opponent, followed by Ino using her Mind Body Switch Technique, and finally Sakura finishes with a powerful punch.
Kurama Arm Attack: Naruto concentrates Kurama's chakra into his arm, greatly enhancing his punching capabilities. With it, Naruto is also able to remove Toneri's Puppet-Cursing Sphere from others, freeing them from his control.
Kurama Claw Slice: Kurama slices either the ground or the air with great force, creating slashing waves.
Kurama Great Crumbling: Naruto, in his full Tailed Beast transformation, gathers chakra in his right fist, leaps into the air, and comes crashing down, delivering a chakra-enhanced punch to his opponent.
Kurama Great Rotating Attack: In Tailed Beast Mode, Naruto coils himself with his tails to perform a spinning attack around the surrounding enemies.
Kurama Twin Palms Attack: Naruto slams a Super Mini-Tailed Beast Ball into the ground with a chakra arm.
Kurama's Shroud: Naruto briefly enters a tailless Version 1 state to swipe at the opponent with his shroud's claw.
Kuramitsuha: Kaguya shapes out Black Zetsu into a black wave, which traps the opponent while she forms huge blocks of ice to crash down on them.
Kāma: is a seal that serves as a compressed backup of an Ōtsutsuki clan member's biological data that they can embed in the body of a compatible recipient known as a . Over time, the Kāma will gradually overwrite the vessel's genetic profile until they transform into a perfect Ōtsutsuki. Should the Ōtsutsuki be slain, their soul will migrate to one of their vessels and become anchored to the world of the living, and when the Kāma completes, will through their body, completely replacing them.
Kāma Rasengan: Boruto creates three shadow clones, one flings another downward on the opponent to perform a taijutsu combo with the third continuing the combo, then Boruto gathers an enormous supply of chakra stored in his Kāma to create a massive Rasengan to finish them off.
Kāma: Great Burial Wave: The user impales the opponent with their modified limb and disintegrates them with a large blast of chakra gathered from their Kāma.
Kāma: Spiral: Boruto and Kawaki charge together at the opponent, combining the gathered red chakra from Kawaki's Kāma and Boruto's Rasengan, creating a large explosion.
Labyrinth Barrier: Suien can create a maze by blowing up a mountain and hammering stakes into the ground, with each carrying a special technique.
Labyrinth Genjutsu: This is a genjutsu used by Ōga, placing her victims in labyrinth like simulations with puzzles to solve for her experiments, with the assistance of the technology provided by Kara.
Lacquer Bloom: The user places shrunken black rods beneath the opponent and brings them to their original size to impale them and keep them immobilised.
Landmine Field Technique: Tobi burrows underground and places a few mines underneath the opponent.
Landmine Great Plain Technique: Tobi burrows underground and circles the opponent with many mines. While burrowing out, he is stuck and struck by the blast, resulting in him being knocked over with fire on his cloak. Though Tobi is caught in the explosion, no damage is inflicted on him as a result of this attack.
Landmine Lance-ification Technique: A cooperation ninjutsu performed by Earth Release and Lightning Release users. The Earth Release user uses their chakra to create a spear made of earth, which is thrown to the ground. The Lightning Release user then electrifies the spear, causing severe damage to the opponent.
Landslide Assault: Sakon swirls in front of the opponent, attacking them.
Last Resort: Eight Gates Crumbling Attac: An extremely high level tenketsu attack, this technique involves attacking and closing the Eight Gates. Neji Hyūga activates his Byakugan and attacks the Eight Gates.
Lava Release Chakra Mode: The Lava Release Chakra Mode is a heightened state utilised by Rōshi after manifesting one of Son Gokū's tails.
Lava Release: Ash Stone Seal Technique: The user spews out a thick cloud of ash from their mouth, which wraps around their opponent to restrain them. By focusing their chakra, the user can maintain, as well as, enhance the binding properties of the technique.
Lava Release: Dissolving Exploding Acid: Mei surrounds her opponent with her acid mist, immobilising them, and then blows a kiss at the opponent, sending out a large lava sphere which creates a powerful explosion on contact.
Lava Release: Expanding Flame Rings: The user expands a ring of melting flames, which can be sealed inside a projectile to melt it and change it into a spiral shape. The sealed flames then cause a high-pressure shock wave that melts the projectile and explodes in a storm of flames.
Lava Release: Fiery Rock Bullet: The user expels a single lava boulder at the opponent.
Lava Release: Melting Apparition Techniq: The Lava Release: Melting Apparition Technique, utilised by Mei Terumī through her unique Lava Release, manipulates a strong acidic mud flow, even capable of corroding flesh. Mei changes chakra inside her body into a powerful acidic fluid that will melt anything and spits out the viscous fluid from her mouth. Both the shape and the amount are determined by her. By spitting it out at short-range the technique's speed increases. By distributing the liquid across a vast range, she creates an acid wall. Anything that touches it will crumble and lose its shape. Should her initial attack miss, a great deal of smoke is created by the effects of the acid, so a follow-up attack can be conducted while the enemy's vision remains obscured. It can even melt chakra-based defences such as the Susanoo.
Attacking the opponent with torrents of water initially, Mei finishes them off using Lava Release, spitting a small high force shot of lava from her mouth at a high speed.
Lava Release: Planet-Branding Blast: Using Lava Release, the user can either expel acid from their mouth as a projectile, or create the substance from beneath the ground to erupt as a large explosion. The liquid is capable of melting objects.
Lava Release: Quicklime Congealing Techn: This technique makes use of the Lava Release kekkei genkai where the user expels a large quantity of quicklime from their mouth, capable of inflicting damage to an opponent. This ability can also be manipulated in order to restrict the intended target's movements, as after the initial blast the remnants of the substance can act in a similar manner to quick-drying cement. However, the technique requires the addition of water to set off the necessary reaction to make the substance harden. This can be easily achieved through the use of a Water Release technique, which can also serve to increase the area covered by the substance, thus further increasing the potential range of the technique.
Lava Release: Rubber Ball: The user expels a large glob of lava from their mouth, which quickly solidifies into a hollow ball that can be used to protect an object by surrounding it with the durable rubber-like material. The properties of this substance mean that it can both absorb and dissipate the force behind a blow when struck, resulting in it either deforming or bouncing upon impact.
Lava Release: Rubber Defence: The user creates a short tube with lava converted into a rubber-like material which can be used to guard against enemy's attacks.
Lava Release: Rubber Rope: The user creates a rope with lava converted into a rubber-like material. It can be used to quickly withdraw an ally from the attack line, being more efficient when combined with a distraction.
Lava Release: Rubber Wall: The user creates an enormous torrent of lava from the ground directly in front of them, which then forms into a wall possessing immense durability due to its rubbery consistency that allows the material to deform when attacked, meaning it can both absorb and dissipate the force behind a blow rather than just simply obstruct it. This technique can also be used to provide reinforcement to a pre-existing barrier.
Lava Release: Scorching Armoured Fist: Rōshi coats himself in lava and punches the opponent. Even if the punch fails to connect, the intense heat from the lava can still burn his opponent if they're close enough.
Lava Release: Scorching Flow Fist: Rōshi jumps up in the air, covers his fist in lava, and delivers a punch, sending his opponent crashing down.
Lava Release: Scorching Flow Peak Rock: Rōshi creates circles of lava that erupt molten rock towards the opponent, sending them into the air.
Lava Release: Scorching Flower Great Cru: Rōshi coats one arm in molten rock to stop the opponent in their tracks, then coats the other arm with molten rock and punches them, which bursts upon contact, and sends the opponent flying back.
Lava Release: Scorching Kick: Rōshi covers his foot in lava and delivers an upwards kick to his opponent.
Lava Release: Scorching Stream Rock Tech: The user expels a large amount of lava from their mouth, which quickly solidifies into multiple boulders of molten rock that are fired towards the target with tremendous force. Due to their composition, the boulders can melt through most objects with ease, and because a considerable number are dispersed over a wide range in quick succession, they are also difficult to avoid.
Leaf Broadminded: Guy kicks his opponent twice — one overhead and one under, before slamming them into the ground.
Leaf Coiling Whirlwind: A variant of the Leaf Whirlwind where Guy and Lee attack a single target with a roundhouse kick.
Leaf Coiling Wind: Guy spins while making a handstand with his legs outstretched. It creates enough wind to clear a small area of thick mist.
Leaf Dragon God: This is the ultimate taijutsu technique created by the legendary taijutsu master Chen. It appears to be initiated by an upward spin kick at which point it quickly becomes a tornado. Forming into a dragon with long whiskers, it attacks the target aiming to swallow them, at which point they are cut by the razor sharp winds inside the attack. After initiating the attack, the user appears to remain shielded within the base of the tornado as the outward surface of the dragon seems to be solid enough for a person to impact and rebound off of, making the only way to enter the technique once it has been initiated is by being swallowed.
Leaf Drop: The user delivers a falling kick, strong enough to bring the environment crumbling down.
Leaf Flash Kick: Rock Lee performs a technique similar to the Heavenly Foot of Pain, but without any chakra enhancement, to deliver a heel drop to the opponent using only sheer physical strength that causes small alteration to the ground on impact.
Leaf Gale: The user delivers a spinning low kick from behind, throwing the target off balance. Because of the kick's speed and how it's delivered, targets are unlikely to be able to defend against it. When performed by someone as strong as Rock Lee, this relatively simple kick has the added ability to propel targets away as they're knocked over.
Leaf Great Combo Attack: The user strikes the opponent rapidly with Leaf Gale, Leaf Whirlwind, and Leaf Rising Wind.
Leaf Great Flash: The user charges at their opponent and unleashes a powerful lateral kick aiming at the head that will send his opponent flying away.
Leaf Great Violent Sky: Rock Lee attacks the opponent and punches them into the sky. Upon leaping off the ground, Lee performs a spinning attack headfirst and kicks his opponent into the ground. Finally, he poses by raising his arms and bringing his legs together.
Leaf Great Whirlwind: While spinning, the user delivers a series of kicks. As they spin faster, they are lifted from the ground, allowing them to kick different areas of their target: first a low kick, then a middle kick, then a high kick. These are finished off with a heel drop. As a result of the spinning, targets cannot see the incoming kicks until just before they're struck.
Leaf Gust: Using simple, yet effective strikes, the user begins to spin rapidly and with a strong rotative high kick to hit the opponent.
Leaf Hot Wind: After opening five of the Eight Gates, Lee swiftly kicks his opponent high into the air. He then jumps up and does a kick so powerful that his opponent is set on fire.
Leaf Hurricane Bullet: The user being airborne, delivers a powerful drop kick that sends the opponent flying.
Leaf Revolving Light: Lee knocks his opponent off their feet, launching them into the air, after which he delivers a series of revolving kicks to their stomach and face, leading to a finishing kick that sends the opponent straight into the ground. This technique is very similar to Youth Full Power.
Leaf Rising Wind: This technique uses the entire body as a spring, by amassing power through taking a posture where the back of the body falls down. With this powerful taijutsu, the user kicks just above the head. Because the power of the kick from the ground is instantly converted into a blow, the enemy hit with this attack will be launched high into the sky. This technique can also be initiated while mid-air.
Leaf Roaring Flame Hurricane: Rock Lee unlocks five of the Eight Gates and begins a kick so fast that his leg catches fire. Lee spins around into the air, creating a spiral of flame before bringing his leg down through the centre and into the ground. The fire bursts outwards, blasting any enemy within close proximity.
Leaf Rock-Destroying Rise: A taijutsu technique where the user smashes their elbow into their opponent using the other arm as support. It deals a powerful blow to the target and as the name suggests, it was even strong enough to destroy Yagura's coral.
Leaf Shuriken: Metal attacks the enemy, sending him flying with a strong kick, and then finishes him off in the air using Fūma Shuriken.
Leaf Springtime of Life Lotus: After opening the First Gate, Guy punches the opponent into the air and grabs their arms, fracturing them and pile-drives the opponent into the ground.
Leaf Strong Whirlwind: Might Guy, using his great talent with taijutsu, concentrates all his skill into a spinning backwards kick. The kick is so fast that it cannot be seen, much less dodged, and it is delivered with such power that targets are unlikely to get up once they're struck, much less block. In the anime, this technique generates a powerful whirlwind around the user, which can be used to attack multiple opponents at once.
Leaf Style: Swift Sword: Hayate draws his sword and, with swift, abrupt movements, like a dance, attacks the enemy, slicing them open. In some cases, he can place an explosive tag on the ground, causing the enemy to fall after the sword attack and be blown up.
Leaf Sweet Riot Car: Anko kicks her opponent into the air then kicks again higher and jumps on their shoulders and spins them into the ground through rapid somersaults before getting off of them upon landing.
Leaf Taijutsu: Whirlwind Furious Feet: Guy dashes a considerable distance and performs a powerful kick, sending the opponent flying.
Leaf Whirlwind: The user delivers a series of high and low kicks, each of which is fast enough that even the Sharingan can't react to them. When Rock Lee performs it against Sasuke Uchiha, he starts with a backwards high kick using his left foot, the motion of which then helps him deliver a low kick with his right. Although the first kick is damaging on its own, it's primarily intended as a distraction, forcing Sasuke to block it and thus rendering him vulnerable to the second kick.
Leaf Windstorm: Lee focuses for a moment, and launches a spinning kick. He covers a short distance while spinning on the ground, and then jumps while still spinning, hitting several opponents.
Leaf-Style Willow: The user waves their sword back and forth, which when seen by the target locks them in a genjutsu which causes them to hallucinate multiple waving arms out to slash them. The movement resembles that of a willow tree blowing in the wind. With the enemy off guard, the user is free to cut them down.
Leaf-Style: Empty Cicada: After waving his hand seals, Rō disappears into thin air. Shortly afterwards, he reappears behind the opponent, and uses a kunai to strike their back.
Leaping Bullet Shell Tower: Transformed as Isobu, Yagura curls himself into a ball and bounces, allowing himself to either crash down at an opponent, or to quickly move around.
Leaping Flame Blowing Step: Transformed as Matatabi, Yugito leaps above in the air, spews fire on her opponents, and finally lands on top of them.
Leech Gap: While in his transformed state, Utakata can ooze an extremely alkaline liquid, which burns upon contact. Killer B while in his full Eight-Tails form commented that the substance was strong enough to burn through his skin. In the anime, when he used this technique in his Version 2 form, Utakata's chakra cloak turned blue.
Legend of the White Fang: Kakashi strikes down the opponent with the White Light Chakra Sabre and then attacks them with Chidori, causing a lightning explosion.
Legend's Portion: Tsunade punches the opponent towards Jiraiya, who summons a warrior toad to strike the opponent to the ground. The toad then crushes the opponent by falling on them.
Liger Bomb: The Liger Bomb is a certain-kill technique used by the Fourth Raikage.
Liger Two Platoons Bomb: A and Bee start their combo by using Cross Lariat to launch the opponent. Bee grabs ahold of the opponent's arms and waist, while Ay takes the legs; the team then link arms from a back-to-back position and drive their foe into the ground stomach-first.
Lightning (jutsu): A smaller version of the Tailed Beast Ball that has been infused with lightning chakra which Killer B or the Eight-Tails can use to bring down a target's defences and inflict major damage.
Lightning Ball: The user creates spheres of electrical energy and launches them at the enemy. When they make contact with the enemy, the spheres electrocute them and throw them back. This technique can also be used in rapid succession or fire multiple balls at once.
Lightning Beast Running Technique: Twin: Kakashi sends out two lightning hounds at his opponent, which run and attack his target from their sides.
Lightning Blade Kunai Cutter: Lightning Blade Kunai Cutter is a technique developed by Kakashi Hatake. Kakashi channels his lightning chakra into a kunai, increasing its piercing power. Then he strikes his opponent several times.
Lightning Bolt: Killer B jumps into the air with his seven swords and tackles the opponent whilst coated in lightning chakra.
Lightning Burial: Banquet of Lightning: The user creates several thunderbolts that cut through the ground or air until they hit the enemy.
Lightning Cutter: The Lightning Cutter is the special name for Kakashi Hatake's Chidori.
Lightning Cutter Combo: This combo attack has the user elbowing the opponent, then punching them in the face, sweeping their feet, double kicking the enemy twice and sending them high into the air, then using Lightning Cutter on the falling victim as they land on it with their back. This can only be performed with Kakashi's Sharingan active.
Lightning Cutter One Flash: Kakashi uses Lightning Cutter and runs extremely fast towards his opponent, he then grabs them, dragging their body on the ground for a long time and finally ejecting them.
Lightning Cutter Seal: Wielding his lightning-infused sword, the user swiftly delivers a slash to his opponent, temporarily sealing their ability to use chakra to perform jutsu.
Lightning Cutter Two Sequential Crashes: This is a technique used by Kakashi Hatake. He first creates a slightly larger Lightning Cutter than usual with both hands, but then quickly grasps the lightning and pulls it apart into two hands. He then charges at the enemy with one Lightning Cutter, uppercutting the enemy into the air. Then Kakashi appears above the enemy and releases all the lightning into the enemy, charging down with them in a giant cyclone of lightning.
Lightning Cutter: Double Lightning Quake: Kakashi submerges into the earth or water, comes up and punches the jaw of his opponent, jumps back away from the opponent to form a Lightning Cutter in-between his two hands. He splits it in two and charges his opponent, leaving two streams of light, and then strikes them with one Lightning Cutter, sending them into the air. He then repeatedly hits them with that one Lightning Cutter in a zig-zag formation into the air, back and forth, before coming above his opponent and finally slamming his second Lightning Cutter into his opponent, driving them into the ground.
Lightning Cutter: One Apex: Kakashi appears underneath his opponent and launches them into the air. He gets above them, before slamming them into the ground with his Lightning Cutter.
Lightning Cutter: Swift: Kakashi uses Lightning Release: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang to impale the opponent, then throws multiple chakra kunai. He activates his Kamui to teleport some kunai to the hound, which turns into a shadow clone, where he throws the rest. The two waves of kunai clash while Kakashi charges the Lightning Cutter and attacks from the air.
Lightning Cutter: Twin Drilling Lights: Kakashi forms two Lightning Cutters instead of just one. He runs towards the opponent and plunges one into the target, followed by the other.
Lightning Dragon Tornado: Raiga will draw lightning down upon his body. The current will be contained within and around Raiga's form. He will then begin to spin in place forming a whirling vortex of wind and electricity. The vortex will take on the form of a dragon's head and will cover the area in front of him. It will then strike out against his opponent and painfully trap them in the vortex. Even if the attack doesn't directly connect with his foe, the lightning can jump from the vortex to hit a nearby target.
Lightning Fish: The user produces a large shark-like structure of lightning that travels independently under water, striking at the target it is locked on to.
Lightning Flash: The user launches a lightning-infused fūma shuriken at their opponent, knocking them back. The lightning trail it leaves behind is also capable of temporarily stunning their opponents. This attack can also be used mid-air, albeit at a shorter range.
Lightning Flash Attack: Flight: Kakashi attacks with three shadow clones in a forward arc, each channelling Lightning Release through their White Light Chakra Sabre. Enemies' movements are impaired, and hidden traps are revealed.
Lightning Flash Lion Combo: Sasuke slashes the opponent into the air with his sword and jumps after them. He then proceeds to kick, backfist and slash them while still in midair as he tumbles around, ending in a heel drop akin to the original Lion Combo. However, Sasuke quickly lands on the floor, holds up a formed-Chidori on his left hand to have the falling victim land on it.
Lightning Flash Palm: The user gathers lightning chakra on their hand to strike the target.
Lightning Flash Sword: Kakashi channels Lightning Release through a sword to deliver a series of strikes before jumping up in the air and finishing it with a downward slash.
Lightning Kunai: The user throws lightning infused kunai at their opponent.
Lightning Oppression Horizontal: After covering himself in his Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A performs a simple backhanded horizontal chop against his opponent, which is powerful enough to snap even the bones of Sasuke Uchiha's Susanoo's ribcage.
Lightning Oppression Horizontal Chop: Covered in the Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A leaps from a high vantage point and performs a simple yet powerful horizontal chop on his opponent from above, seemingly using the momentum gained in the previous fall to increase the force behind his strike. In the event the attack isn't powerful enough to penetrate an opponent's defence, the attack can be used to push an opponent well into the ground to prevent them from escaping from another incoming attack.
Lightning Rat Violent Quake: The user releases a discharge of electricity that fires several destructive disks of electricity which home in on the targets.
Lightning Release Bullet: Powerful Breat: The user creates a condensed surge of lightning in their fist. Upon doing so, the user thrusts it forward, unleashing a powerful lightning bolt. It can also be conducted by a water source to hit multiple targets.
Lightning Release Chakra Mode: The user wraps their body in a layer of lightning chakra to increase their physical parameters and , with more lightning causing greater increases. As users coat more lightning chakra around themselves, the more their hair sticks up. The lightning augments the strength of the user's taijutsu, creating what is called nintaijutsu. The lightning also defends the user from most attacks, deflecting them away on contact; the Fourth Raikage is impressed when Chidori pierces through to him, however slightly.
Lightning Release Co-Operation: Thunder: This is a cooperation ninjutsu where the users unite the extremities of their weapons, discharging a strong voltage across the blades, targeting multiple opponents simultaneously.
Lightning Release Wall: This technique is deployed by the bandits and shinobi from Yumegakure by creating a wall of lightning bolts that repels anyone who touches it and causes damage to them. The technique is used to block off advancement to the next area and the only way to dispel the technique is by defeating the users or by stepping on certain switches on the ground near the wall.
Lightning Release: Black Panther: After generating black lightning from their body, Darui releases it in the form of a panther to shock anyone that comes into contact with it. Its quick movement allows it to be used to take out multiple opponents. By using this in a battle on water, it can be spread out to cover a wide range.
Lightning Release: Black Thunder: Darui extends his arms from both sides and channels the Black Lightning from his fists, shocking anybody nearby.
Lightning Release: Depth Charge: After enveloping themselves with lightning chakra, the user can inflict damage to the opponent by either touching or emanating a powerful bolt of electricity from any part of their body.
Lightning Release: Double Lariat: The Lightning Release: Double Lariat is a stronger version of the Lightning Release: Lariat, whereby two users perform the technique from both behind and in front of the opponent, creating a scissor effect, up to close to light-speed. Both users must use the exact same amount of opposing strength or the target will merely bend. When successfully done, the force of the technique will decapitate the target and send their head flying several metres into the air.
Lightning Release: Electric Shock Needle: The user surrounds themselves with countless tiny lights. After the lights are shaped into needles, they are quickly fired at a target and pierce the skin. Because of how small the needles are, they do little to no actual damage on their own. As such, this jutsu is more useful for hiding other fast-moving projectiles, such as bees.
Lightning Release: Electromagnetic Murde: A Lightning Release technique that allows the user to create a wave of electricity from their hands. The user can vary its power from a small surge to shock an opponent to a powerful stream of lightning capable of ripping through solid rock.
Lightning Release: Elekiter: The user concentrates lightning-natured chakra directly into the palm of their hand, the user then channels this gathered electricity to shock and electrocute an opponent at close range.
Lightning Release: False Darkness: The user emits lightning in the shape of a spear from its mouth, which then pierces the enemy. Its destructive power is great enough to even pierce through rock, meaning it has a high killing potential. The user can increase the number of spears to attack multiple enemies. This, coupled with the sheer speed of the lightning, makes it a difficult technique to evade. This technique is capable of being focused into a straight beam, similar to a laser. Kakuzu is able to use this through his lightning-element mask.
Lightning Release: Four Pillar Bind: Four giant rock pillars are summoned around the enemy, which then shoot bolts of lightning between them, immobilising the target and possibly doing great damage to them.
Lightning Release: Heavenly Formation Li: The user strikes with lightning bolts. The bolts can be produced either from storm clouds or the user themselves. Additionally, the bolts can be channelled through structures so as to strike at targets from multiple sources.
Lightning Release: Lariat: The Lightning Release: Lariat is a powerful taijutsu technique whereby the user charges at their opponent with quickness-like light speed, striking them with a Lariat move, which can be coated in chakra. A successful strike can blow away a target's entire chest with a direct hit, which may not kill them right away, but will ultimately kill them if they are not treated. The attack is rather straightforward, but very quick, powerful and is easily capable of knocking down an opponent.
Lightning Release: Lighting Flash: With his Susanoo, Kakashi gathers electricity in his hand and showers down lightning bolts on the opponent.
Lightning Release: Lightning Beast Track: Kakashi forms a Lightning Cutter in his hand and launches it at the opponent in the form a hound. The hound is highly fast and its movements are unpredictable, making it is very difficult to avoid. As Kakashi's hand remains connected to the hound by a cord of lightning, adjusting the amount of chakra used for the technique allows him to freely manipulate its speed and range.
Lightning Release: Lightning Bind: The user sends a thin stream of electricity through the ground, which briefly paralyzes an opponent upon contact.
Lightning Release: Lightning Bullet: First, C blinds his opponent, then bombards them with multiple kunai infused with lightning chakra, and finally finishes them off with a Fūma Shuriken that spins wildly, cutting through the opponent's flesh.
Lightning Release: Lightning Eel: While standing in water, the user generates a burst of electricity, shocking anyone also in the water with them.
Lightning Release: Lightning Fang: Using Kiba, the user sends bolts of lightning to electrocute their enemies.
Lightning Release: Lightning Flash: Karui thrusts her sword into the ground and lightning strikes it, striking and paralyzing her opponent, after which Karui pulls out her sword and finishes him off.
Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Fl: The Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar is a genjutsu that utilises lightning-natured chakra.
Lightning Release: Lightning Net Techniq: The user fires a beam of Lightning Release chakra from their hand at a target, which stops them in their tracks for a short time.
Lightning Release: Lightning Quake Flash: The user releases a current of purplish lightning from their hands forward, damaging and knocking away opponents. This technique is similar to Chidori Current as they both have the effect of shooting lightning currents at their opponent. Its range, unlike that of Chidori Current, is much smaller. Unlike Lightning Cutter it has a smaller current of lightning so it will not completely kill them.
Lightning Release: Lightning Rod: After coming into physical contact with the opponent, the user raises their arm into the air, generating a powerful bolt of electricity which travels through their body transferring the electricity to the body of the opponent.
Lightning Release: Lightning Signal Fire: After forming the necessary hand seals, the user points their hands towards a certain direction and triggers an electrical discharge, which then explodes in a specific form. When the hands are raised to the sky, this technique can be used as a signal flare.
Lightning Release: Lightning Slash: Denki releases an X-shaped wave of Lightning Release chakra that is capable of temporarily stunning his target.
Lightning Release: Lightning Violent Soa: Darui channels lightning chakra through his cleaver sword and stabs the ground, which hits the nearby opponent, paralysing them. Darui then attacks with a side sweep with his sword, knocking them away.
Lightning Release: Overdrive: By utilising Lightning Release, the user can speed up the signals that are sent from the brain to the muscles to increase the user's striking speed. The technique also gives the user cutting capabilities from barehanded attacks.
Lightning Release: Pulverising Lightning: The user channels their lightning chakra around their club, enhancing the force of the strikes launched.
Lightning Release: Purple Electricity: The user shoots a bolt of electricity from their hand to strike a target. It was invented by Kakashi Hatake as a replacement for the Lightning Cutter, which he could no longer safely use after the loss of his Sharingan. In Kakashi Hiden, Kakashi typically uses Purple Electricity to strike targets from a distance, though he does sometimes use it through direct contact, as when he places his hand on spilled alcohol in order to transmit Purple Electricity throughout the surrounding area. He can modulate the intensity of the Purple Electricity, creating a blast strong enough to remove a target's explosive vest but without setting off the explosive or otherwise affecting the target. Conversely, he is later shown using all his chakra to perform a Purple Electricity powerful enough to induce the rain clouds he's falling through to start producing rain.
Lightning Release: Reverse Lift: Darui lands a series of hits with his cleaver sword, followed by a lightning infused stab, which pushes his opponent back, and finishes it by sending a burst of lightning chakra through the ground with his sword, throwing his opponent up in the air.
Lightning Release: Shadow Clone Techniqu: This technique allows the user to make a shadow clone infused with lightning. Because it is a shadow clone, it is able to perform techniques and interact with the environment. If the clone is injured, it will revert to its natural lightning-state, at the same time electrocuting whatever makes contact with it. Unlike a regular shadow clone, however, it does not send chakra back to the user upon reverting to lightning.
