Lightning Release: Sixteen Pillar Bind: A more powerful version of Lightning Release: Four Pillar Bind, the user creates sixteen giant pillars, which then form a giant oven-like structure to trap the target. It is used after Earth Release: Sticky Earth Drop to cover them in mud and then followed by Fire Release: Fired Pottery Technique, creating flames inside the oven to roast and harden the mud, immobilising them.
Lightning Release: Snake Lightning: The Lightning Release: Snake Lightning technique allows the user to generate a discharge of yellow electricity from their hand, which can electrocute a target by either emitting it around the user's body while they're submerged in water, thrusting it into a target, or manifesting a snake from the concentrated chakra to attack from a distance.
Lightning Release: Spider Web: After kneading chakra in the body and converting it to lightning, the user places their hand on the ground, releasing a surge of electricity around them in the form of a web, which electrocutes anyone caught in its vicinity.
Lightning Release: Thunder: With the flick of their wrist the user is capable of firing countless small sparks of lightning towards a target.
Lightning Release: Thunder Binding: This technique lets the user create a three-sided wall of electricity to bind their opponent. The user must have three conductors to stick in the ground to create the points. Furthermore, once the enemy is inside, if they come into contact with the wall they will be electrocuted. The only way the technique can be broken is if an outside party were to strike one of the walls with a strong enough attack, which will then deactivate the other walls.
Lightning Release: Thunder Gate: The user first buries Kiba’s blades into the ground and then sends out an electrical charge towards the sky, which in turn, causes lightning to fall from the sky decimating the immediate area around the user, burning everything to a crisp.
Lightning Release: Thunder Wedge: By wrapping chains around their arms, the user channels lightning to their kunai attached to the chains.
Lightning Release: Thunderbolt: The user extends one or both arms, releasing a high electrical discharge through said palms, targeting multiple opponents simultaneously. It is possible to increase the power using this technique in combination with a water source.
Lightning Release: Thunderclap Arrow: The user moulds, then shapes lightning-natured chakra. They can then throw the lightning as a projectile-based attack, or combine it with a Water Release technique to electrocute a target.
Lightning Release: Thunderclap Wave: Boruto expels a large wave of water from his mouth and throws lightning at the wave, electrifying anything that is caught in it.
Lightning Release: Thunderstorm: Several users gather around a scroll with the kanji for lightning in it, and gather their chakra. The kanji begins glowing, and the chakra is sent to the sky, gathering storm clouds, which then unleash lightning.
Lightning Release: Tiger Scissors: Similar to a bear trap, this technique being much larger and brimming with lightning. The technique is capable of materialising from the ground and locking down onto the target with its blade surging with lightning.
Lightning Release: Wave of Inspiration: This is a , which employs Water and Lightning Release. After releasing a large water wave from his mouth, Darui mixes lightning into it, instantly electrocuting the target caught in it.
Lightning Release: Whip Dance of Fools: After the user ensnares their target with their barbed metallic whip, they will channel lightning into it, shocking the target. The technique is apparently self-sustaining as the user can keep it up without paying attention to the target, and the barbs make it harder for the target to free themselves if they struggle against it.
Lightning Speed (Kakashi): Kakashi uses Lightning Cutter and zig-zags around his enemies, attacking them.
Lightning Straight: While in their Lightning Release Chakra Mode, the user runs towards the opponent and punches them at maximum speed.
Lightning Strike: The user creates an electric current that can hit multiple individuals at the same time. Furthermore, it can extend incredible distances and avoid obstacles.
Lightning Strike Armour: By using Lightning Release, the user surrounds themselves with electricity in the form of armour. The intense electric field enhances the user's speed, and protects them by electrocuting anyone who makes contact with it. The armour appears very strong, as it's capable of withstanding Rock Lee's Drunken Fist.
Lightning Surge: Indra releases a current of electricity, damaging any opponent that is near his vicinity.
Lightning Sword: Kakashi hits the opponent into the air where Yūgao kicks them and then attacks with her sword and Kakashi strikes them with Lightning Cutter.
Lightning Tackle: In his insect form, Taisa covers himself in electricity and tackles the opponent.
Lightning Thrust: Sasuke charges his Chidori and Kakashi charges his Lightning Cutter together. They strike the opponent at the same time either killing or causing major damage to them.
Lightning Transmission: Kakashi and a shadow clone both perform the Lightning Cutter on opposite hands, which they connect together with a sharp cord of lightning between themselves. It was powerful enough to slice through several tailed beast chakra arms with relative ease. The technique can also be used to wrap around a target and restrain it.
Lightning Water Dragon Bullet: This Lightning Water Dragon Bullet is a cooperation ninjutsu used by Mei Terumī and A.
Lightning Wood Flow Palm: Yamato attacks the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and then Kakashi strikes the wood with Lightning Cutter that hits the opponent.
Like a Whirlwind: Asura creates four whirlwinds that circle around the opponent and converge on them, combining into a large wind dragon that rises underneath them.
Limbo: Border Jail: Limbo: Border Jail is a unique dōjutsu awakened by Madara Uchiha's Rinnegan.
Limbo: Tengai Shinsei: Madara uses his shadows to bind his opponent in lightning while he brings down a meteor on them.
Limelight: Limelight is a lightning-based technique that is used when all four users take place in the cardinal directions. They will then join their lightning-chakra in the form of four connecting streams that shoot high into the sky above the target area. It will then create a massive ball of lightning powerful enough to incinerate everything within the area of the four users. It is considered to be the most powerful and destructive Lightning Release technique. While walking towards their designated positions, the users will generate fluctuating pillars of electricity from their bodies. This technique is proven destructive enough to wipe out an entire ninja clan along with their entire village at once, and Furido intended to use it to wipe out the even bigger Konohagakure village.
Lion Combo: This technique is unique to Sasuke Uchiha, relying on his advanced physical condition and his "knack" for rapid combo attacks. Sasuke kicks a target into the air and follows close behind them. While in the air, Sasuke provokes the target into attacking him, giving him the chance to counter them and, in turn, kick them higher into the air at increasingly greater speeds and/or to flank their sides with another kick. The higher up they get and the faster they move, the more damage that will be caused to the target when, as his finishing blow after punching them down, Sasuke inevitably kicks them back to the ground with a heel drop.
Lion Flame Bullet: Sasuke stuns his opponent with his electrified sword, sending them up in the air, where he slashes them with it, lands physical attacks, and ultimately delivers a fireball.
Little Toe Attack: After opening the Eight Gates, Guy attacks the opponent with a very powerful downwards kick. Guy used this attack against the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path to literally attack its little toe, the force of which helped topple the statue over.
Living Corpse Reincarnation: The Living Corpse Reincarnation is a technique that was developed by Orochimaru that allows him to transfer his soul to someone else's body. It is also referred to as the "Eternal Youth and Immortality Technique". It was developed in order to fuel his dream of acquiring all the knowledge in existence, a feat that cannot be achieved in a single lifetime.
Localised Reincarnation Explosion: The Localised Reincarnation Explosion is one of the powerful techniques utilised by Toneri Ōtsutsuki.
Long Range Mind's Eye of the Kagura: Karin uses her Mind's Eye of the Kagura to sense her opponent at a long range, alerting her whenever her opponent uses projectile attacks. This prevents her from being hit by their projectile attacks.
Long-Distance Bombing: Tobi reveals two bombs and throws them at his opponent, the first one knocking them far back.
Longsword Ninja Art — Earth Spider Sewin: Using the Nuibari, the user buries the sword's attached razor sharp wire string underground. Once a person stumbles into the area, they pull the string to trap their feet in a formation of wire, cutting them off. The power and force behind the wires can be controlled by the user by applying additional strength.
Longsword Ninja Art: Massacre Method For: Using Nuibari and wire strings, the user strings their opponents in a way that leaves their bodies looking as though they were crucified. The final blow is given by piercing them with Nuibari, leaving the opponents to die a slow, painful death.
Lorentz Gun: The user erects a field of lightning to connect two points. Any metallic object (such as a kunai) that enters the field will rapidly accelerate from one point to the other, quickly surpassing the speed of sound. This makes the metallic object incredibly destructive as it moves towards its destination, such that a single kunai will topple trees that get in its way and decimate a cliffside that it impacts. Once mastered, users can strike targets from far greater distances than they could if simply throwing a kunai. Any metallic object can be fired in this way assuming the current of lightning is large enough: a ship's anchor caught in such a field will shoot into the sky, the rest of the ship being dragged through the air behind it.
Love Roar: Iruka yells at the opponent producing a sound wave that knocks the back and then teleports himself near the opponent. Then he slams his fist onto their head, creating a shockwave and leaving a large bump on the opponent's head.
Mach Boomerang: Mecha-Kurama pulls a large boomerang from its back and throws it at the opponent.
Magatsuhi no Kami: Kaguya sends Black Zetsu out of her sleeve to cover the enemy, contracting and then exploding in the process.
Magic Lantern Body Technique: The Akatsuki members sit down and send out , converted into chakra. These thought waves are then picked up by Pain, acting as a kind of control tower. This technique amplifies the thought waves and broadcasts them to a specific location through illusionary bodies. The illusionary bodies differ from being mere reflections. While Pain is relaying the members' thoughts, they can have conversation and use varying techniques.
Magnet Iron Grain Seal Palm: Shinki uses his Iron Sand to seal an individual in a sphere. As long as the user is alive, the seal will remain active and the individual will be in stasis. Only the user can release the seal. The seal also keeps the victim alive, even if they have what would otherwise be fatal injuries, buying time for a medic ninja to heal them,
Magnet Ninja Art: This technique enables Jiga to magnetise anything he touches, thus fully manipulating objects at his discretion and allowing him a variety of attacks against his enemies, in areas with large quantities of iron ore, Jiga was even able to change direction in mid-air aswell as float momentarily. Jiga claims to be able to do this because of the great amount of iron he ingests. He can activate or deactivate his own body's magnetism, ensuring that he is not affected by his technique. The potential risk of his technique is exploited when Hinata Hyūga introduces an interfering electric current into his chakra, causing he himself to become a powerful magnet. In this state, he attracts a large quantity of iron sand to himself, and is forced into a vortex of sand and killed.
Magnet Ninja Art: Electromagnetic Vision: This technique unleashes a wave of iron sand that stops the brainwaves of anyone who is caught in its vicinity. By disrupting the electrical waves in the brain, the opponent is rendered unable to think or move.
Magnet Ninja Art: Infinite Meteors: Jiga uses this technique, after magnetising the rock walls of a deep pit, to give him the ability to attack a target with many rocks. Once magnetised, Jiga can completely manipulate the rocks' shape and form at his discretion. He also made use of this technique in order to bury his brother Ruiga alive.
Magnet Release: Body Control: By coating a person's body with enough Iron Sand, the user can effectively control all physical actions of the target. Akin to puppetry, the user cannot force the target to use any chakra-based techniques, only the skills that come from their physical conditioning.
Magnet Release: Conserving Bee Twin Blad: Through the Magnet Release kekkei genkai, the user is able to magnetise anything they touch, and then subsequently anything that touches something they have already magnetised, and so on. However, the magnetic force weakens from object to object. Once a person has been magnetised, the user can manipulate the magnetic field in such a manner as to make any subsequent attack using a metallic weapon impossible to evade.
Magnet Release: Gold Dust Imperial Funer: Rasa causes a considerable quantity of Gold Dust to erupt from beneath the surface, by placing both of his palms onto the ground directly in front of him, before manipulating the resulting substance into a wave of tidal proportions. The amount of dust produced by this ability is comparable to that of the sand used during Gaara's Quicksand Waterfall Flow technique, but as gold is the heavier of the two, the former was capable of nullifying the latter when they clashed.
Rasa traps his opponent in a mount of gold dust, and causes it to crash upon itself, crushing those inside.
Magnet Release: Lightning God Self: The user uses electromagnetic powers to absorb the iron sand in a swirling vortex around themselves and expand their body's size to that of a 20-meter tall giant. Due to their size, their footsteps then crush the graphite in the earth and cause electric discharge. The thunderclap of these discharges were powerful enough to cause Suna shinobi to lose their footing. Kankurō described it as an technique, noting its incredible speed. Additionally, the electromagnetic field used to maintain the form caused anyone who came into direct contact with the body to be scattered into bits the instance they touch it.
Magnet Release: Spiral Jet Black: Naruto forms a Magnet Release Rasengan while Sasuke uses an enhanced Chidori to strike the opponent from both sides, sealing their movements from the Rasengan's cursed seal markings.
Magnetic Iron Sand Sealing Blade: With Shinki's chakra coating Araya's blade, he can manipulate the latter's Iron Sand through the use of Wind Release. Because Ryū is modeled from Shinki, Araya was able to use the jutsu to free others manipulated by the same material.
Mail Manipulation Technique: A technique which employs the use of mail to be manipulated to the user's will. Using it, the user can cut objects and create barriers that are capable of withstanding shurikens.
Majestic Attire: Susanoo: The user shapes their Susanoo into an armour for Kurama, enhancing its defence and preventing its chakra from being suppressed. Kurama can wield Susanoo's bladed weaponry as well as combine it with its own Tailed Beast Balls to give the latter cutting power, making them impossible to catch.
Mangekyō Sharingan: The is an advanced form of the Sharingan that has only been activated by a handful of Uchiha when enduring a traumatic enough experience. They are noted to be the .
Mangekyō Sharingan (jutsu): The user activates their Mangekyō Sharingan when in the Sharingan Mode and traps their target in an illusion that confuses them for a short period of time as they drop to their knees.
Mangekyō Shark Sword: Itachi uses his Mangekyō Sharingan on the opponent to trap them inside the Tsukuyomi, then comes walking up behind the opponent and stabs them in the back. Left open to attack, Kisame comes up from the water below to finish the foe with a slash from his Samehada.
Manipulated Shuriken Technique: With this technique a translucent string, both elastic and highly durable, is attached to a shuriken, making it possible to alter its path after having thrown it. An expert will have the ability to freely glide the shuriken in any direction with just a single movement of their fingertip. The first attack, challenging the enemy, is avoided and after a time-lag of several seconds, it will come from behind. Depending on the performance, the possible tactics can be infinite. In the anime, this has also been applied to various other weapons, as Tenten manipulated a myriad of projectiles simultaneously.
Manipulated Shuriken Wire Binding: By using shuriken with wire strings attached to them, the user can set a trap for their target. Using the shuriken to spread and set the wires around, they can position them as to bind their target, requiring only to trigger a change of position of the set wires, such as cutting one of them, causing the others to rearrange. If a shinobi is highly perceptive, such as a Sharingan user, it is possible to use one's own projectiles to change the course of the wired shuriken as the trap is set, making it so the one setting the trap is immobilised instead.
Manipulated Tools: Binding Meteor: Tenten summons a manriki-gusari from one of her scrolls and uses it to restrain her opponent. When her opponent is restrained, she uses the scroll to launch a barrage of weapons at them and then finally slams them into the ground with the manriki-gusari.
Manipulated Tools: Blade Kick: Tenten summons several weapons connected together by strings and jumps into the air, reeling them together to stack on top of each other. She then stands on the top weapon on one foot, and twirls backwards, rapidly shooting the ninja tools at the opponent like a machine gun.
Manipulated Tools: Deadly Spheres Strike: Tenten pulls out a scroll and rotates it around herself. Many spiked metal balls burst forth from the scroll to strike any nearby opponents or discourage them from using close ranged attacks.
Manipulated Tools: Exploding Sphere: Tenten sends out multiple Exploding Spheres from her scroll, which explode upon contact.
Manipulated Tools: Floating Blade Wall: Tenten unrolls two scrolls under her opponent and summons a barrage of different weapons from them, launching the opponent into the air. She then wraps their legs with a chain and pulls them down, sending them crashing into the ground.
Manipulated Tools: Gigantic Iron Ball: Tenten throws five spiked iron balls at her opponent, then she unrolls her giant scroll and summons a giant spiked iron ball connected by wire strings to her hand, which she slams onto her opponent.
Manipulated Tools: Great Iron Lump: Tenten takes out a big scroll and waves it in a circle. It turns into a giant chain hammer with a huge metal ball at the end that she then crushes the opponent with. After crushing her opponent, the metal ball turns back into a scroll.
Manipulated Tools: Heavenly Chain Disast: The Manipulated Tools: Heavenly Chain Disaster is a stronger version of Tenten's Twin Rising Dragons technique.
Manipulated Tools: Heavenly Steel Disast: Tenten tosses and unrolls her large scroll over the opponent, summoning countless kunai from the scroll to rain down on the opponent. She then summons four large chains that collapse on the opponent, forcing them down to the ground.
Manipulated Tools: One Thousand Blades A: This technique is very similar to Twin Rising Dragons. But in this version, Tenten only summons countless kunai from her two scrolls, which are connected by strings on her fingers. She then throws all the kunai at the same time on the opponent.
Manipulated Tools: Spinning Swallow Show: Tenten repeatedly hits her opponent with a pair of tonfa, then tosses a scroll in the air to summon a bō and continues hitting them with it, ultimately knocking them to the ground. When the opponent is lying on the ground, she then summons a huge spiked club and crushes them with it.
Manipulated Tools: Steel Needles Wild Fl: Using one of her smaller scrolls, Tenten summons several Exploding Spheres, which are scattered over the battlefield and then explode after a time firing out projectiles at the same time.
Manipulated Tools: Ten Thousand Wild Hea: Tenten summons multiple weapons connected with wire strings to her fingertips from one of her scrolls, directing them towards her opponent in a stream formation. After the final weapon hits the opponent, Tenten uses the strings to make the weapons fly above her opponent. Moving her fingers to make the weapons spin, she then directs the weapons downwards to hit the opponent down into the ground again.
Manipulated Tools: Thousand Blades Attac: Tenten performs a back-flip and opens a scroll in the air, releasing a variety of bladed weapons that are then directed at her opponent.
Manipulating Attack Blades: This technique allows the user to control multiple kunai - or a similar weapon - at once. By releasing chakra from the hand over an area, the user can freely manipulate any kunai within that area. This allows the user to either attack opponents from their blindside or surround them with kunai, preventing them from escaping. If the Puppet Technique's chakra threads are attached to the manipulated kunai, the chakra threads can then be transferred to the kunai's target upon contact, giving users an easy (and potentially unnoticed) way of manipulating opponents outside their range.
Manipulating Attack Blades Explosion: An identical technique to the Manipulating Attack Blades technique, but instead, the kunai thrown have explosive tags attached to them and as a result, the attack is more lethal, causing an explosion on contact.
Manipulating Windmill Triple Blades: The user attaches one end of a wire string to a shuriken and the other end to a kunai. The user throws the shuriken at a target, expecting that the target will dodge it. The user then loops the kunai around a tree (or something similar) and throws the kunai, which the target will also dodge. When the kunai reaches the end of the string's length, it pulls the shuriken back towards the target, striking them from behind; Rin no Sho compares the action to a yo-yo. Because the manoeuvre's effectiveness relies on anticipating the target's movements, having the Sharingan is invaluable to its success.
Many Hidden Shadow Snake Hands: By increasing the amount of snakes summoned with the Hidden Shadow Snake Hands, the diversity of this ninjutsu is increased. The swarm of big snakes appear in an instant, each snake individually doing something like intimidating, diverting, or capturing the enemy in a cooperative attack. Without giving them the time to react, the enemy is entangled.
Married Couple Combination: Adamantine I: Sasuke uses Banshō Ten'in to pull in any nearby opponents, with Sakura finishing with a strong punch.
Master and Student's Move: Sasuke throws his sword at the opponent, which is actually a transformed shadow clone of Boruto, who attacks them with a Rasengan.
Maximum Entry: The user attacks his opponent at high speed and then finishes them off with a powerful version of Dynamic Entry.
May Rain Blood River: Shura uses his umbrella to shoot senbon from the bottom of it, similar to the Senbon Shower technique. Also, while gliding in the air, he can spin the umbrella to help further disperse the senbon, shooting it at targets underneath him.
Mayfly: The Mayfly is an infiltration technique, which is a signature characteristic of White Zetsu and its clone siblings, due to being infused with the cells of Hashirama Senju.
Mayfly: Antlion: Zetsu digs underground, then emerges, with his flytrap extensions "chewing" the opponent as he spins upwards.
Mecha-Naruto Taijutsu Combo: Mecha-Naruto pulls out chakra blades from his head, using which he aggressively attacks his opponent with a barrage of blows.
Mechanical Eight Trigrams Formation: A technique used by Konohagakure to trap the enemy in a maze of tall walls. The user bangs a giant Taiko drum which causes countless walls to appear around the village, cornering the enemy. Additionally, if one tries to escape by scaling the walls, net traps will make short work of said escape.
Mechanical Light Shield Block: This technique is a chakra-based shield that is used to defend against attacks. This form of defence is usually installed into puppets, where the user opens their segmented arms and radiates chakra through to form a light blue, thin shield. While it is powerful enough to block iron sand constructs, the sand will still seep into the joints of the puppets, which will restrict their movements, and thereby, stop the technique from functioning.
Mechanical Wings: While in vehicle mode, Mecha-Naruto releases blades from his arms and head, which rotate at high speeds, cutting through anything in their path. The blades are powerful enough to easily slice through thick trees and the snakes summoned by Orochimaru. If necessary, the blades can be thrown at an escaping opponent, and they will pursue them, continuing to rotate at high speeds.
Medical Empress Gambler: Tsunade and Sakura concentrate on performing the Cherry Blossom Impact, crushing the ground, which damages everything surrounding the two users in a very long distance.
Medical Mode: This mode envelops the user in a flowing blue chakra and allows them to constantly heal themselves in the middle of the battle while at the same time, boost their strength and speed. Over time, this mode consumes the user's chakra until it finally wears off by itself, though the user or, more specifically, Sakura and Ino, can cancel it whenever they wish. Shizune and Karin, however, cannot.
Medical Ninjutsu: Strong Flash: Sakura uses the chakra scalpel to deliver a double palm strike on the opponent, sending them flying back.
Medical Technique: Triple Unity of Death: Using two dark chakra scalpels, Kabuto sends cuts inside his opponent's body three times and strikes them to death the final time.
Medical Water Release: Jellyfish: By applying jellyfish to a person's form in advance, the jellyfish can store up and spread chakra throughout its host to allow for quick recovery from a recent injury. This technique appears to drain the jellyfish completely as it can only be used once.
Medical Water Release: Water Mosquito: The user creates water mosquitoes, that can be used to nullify poison in a target's body. The full extent of this technique was not seen, but it is apparently very painful when applied.
Medical Water Release: Water Scorpion: The user can form giant insect-like claws on their arms made of water, extending the range of attack. One can also apply chakra flow through the claws akin to the chakra scalpel, increasing the attack's sharpness and thus penetrative force.
Medullary Cut: Kurenai kicks the opponent in the side, hooking them with their foot before spinning around with their other foot and sending them flying in a spinning-like way.
Melting Lightning Burst: Dodai spits out a large amount of rubber lava, which sticks the opponent to a stone object, and then the Fourth Raikage falls from above, crushing his victim along with the object they are stuck to.
Memory Blocking Technique: A secret technique passed down through the Shiin Clan that erases another's memory. Menma uses this by playing his ocarina. This technique is claimed to cause permanent amnesia, but when Menma performed the technique it lasted only a few hours.
Memory Erasing Seal: This technique erases certain memories of all those who are in the range of the seal, including the caster, with the command . However, it is possible that the target may once again remember what was erased as a vague dream.
Memory Erasing Technique: Yota can erase anyone's memory by touching them. By doing so, the targets are knocked out and once awakened, they have no recollection of targeted memories. However, Yota can restore the target's memories by flicking them on the forehead.
Memory-Concealing Manipulative Sand Tech: The user seals away the target's memories by burying an extremely small needle into the brain's memory centre. The memories can be restored by cancelling the technique, thereby destroying the needle. If a subordinate had this operation performed on their brains and has infiltrated in enemy camp, they can safely perform spy activity over a long period of time with no memory of being a sleeper agent. This could help enhance them in their act as they will fully believe their loyalty lies with the ones they are spying upon. If the user cancels the technique, the target will once again remember their mission as sleeper agent.
Menacing Shark: Kisame uses Exploding Water Colliding Wave and slashes the opponent underwater with Samehada.
Mental Replacement Device: Mecha-Naruto gets within range and forms a hand seal which then makes an unknown type of chakra rush out of his hands and into his opponent; in turn switching their minds. The user of this technique is able to sound exactly like and use any technique that the original could. The user is also able to use this technique even when inside the opponents body.
Mental Resistance Technique: A highly advanced technique primarily used by Konoha's Anbu that prevents the user from being interrogated or having their mind taken over by an enemy. When the invader enters the user's mind, this technique generates a horrific illusion to repel them. It is noted to be a dangerous technique to master, as it risks damaging the user's mind if not properly employed.
Meteorite Rasengan: While controlling the body of Boruto Uzumaki, Momoshiki cloaks himself in an aura of deep blue chakra and flies high into the sky, momentarily vanishing from view. He then arcs back down and dives toward his opponent at high speed while forming a Rasengan in his right palm, striking them with it at the moment of impact. His glittering blue chakra causes the attack to resemble a falling star.
Miasma Stroke: In his Version 1 chakra shroud, Naruto swipes at the opponent with an extended chakra arm from the left, right, upwards, and then from below.
Middle-Aged Attack: After channelling chakra into one's hand, the user grabs the target. The effects of the technique are unknown, but it seems to pose a serious threat as Minato Namikaze stopped Might Guy from performing the technique against the toads from Mount Myōboku.
Mifune-Style First Tachi: Blaze: The user grips their sword with both hands, focusing their chakra into the blade. Once the chakra has been sufficiently concentrated, the user unleashes a powerful downward slash, releasing a tremendous force capable of dispersing even a massive fireball.
Might Cyclone: Guy jumps up in the air, delivers three kicks to his opponent, and finishes with a drill-like kick with both feet, sending his opponent crashing to the ground.
Mimetic Insects: Crawl: Shino calls forth kikaichū from all around him to engulf the opponent in a small barrier that implodes.
Mind Body Confusion Technique: This technique causes damage to all foes on the battlefield as well as confuses the main target. It also leaves the opponent at a wide range to attack without being in defence to protect themselves.
Mind Body Disturbance Technique: The user sends their chakra into a target's nervous system, giving them full control over the target's body. Unlike the Mind Body Switch Technique, the user's consciousness remains within their own body while they use this technique, meaning that it can safely be used even when the user is outnumbered. It is when outnumbered that this technique is most useful, as the user's opponents can be made to kill each other. Because only their bodies are being controlled, targets remain aware of what their body is doing, though they won't understand why. Users can control targets even from a distance, allowing the user to sow confusion among the target and their allies.
Mind Body Switch Technique: The Mind Body Switch Technique is the signature technique of the Yamanaka clan.
Mind Body Transmission Formation: The Mind Body Transmission Formation is a technique created by Inojin Yamanaka to combat the Human God Trees and their ability to suppress their chakra signatures.
Mind Body Transmission Technique: The Mind Body Transmission Technique is a hijutsu utilised by members of the Yamanaka clan to telepathically communicate with people. With focus the user can communicate with multiple people at once and the targets can also communicate with one another while the technique is in effect.
Mind Clone Switch Technique: This technique allows the user to transfer their consciousness into more than one target by cloning their consciousness, giving them complete control of the bodies for a short period of time. Like the Mind Body Switch Technique, the user's body is left defenceless while the technique is in use. Unlike the Mind Body Switch, this technique can travel in a curved line.
Mind Disturbance Dance Performance Techn: This is simply a large-scale version of the Mind Body Disturbance Technique, where the sheer volume of people affected in a given area is much greater. Like its parent technique, it causes the user to gain complete control of the target's body, often forcing allies to attack each other.
Mind Mystical Palm Transmission Techniqu: The user continuously heals themselves and all people telepathically linked to them by Mind Body Transmission Technique. The user is unable to move while the technique is active.
Mind Puppet Switch Cursed Seal Technique: The user of this technique firstly transfers their mind into a puppet laid somewhere in advance, near the vicinity of an enemy's predicted path, before manipulating it to attack an intended opponent. When the opponent counters and inflicts damage upon the puppet or the puppet inflicts damage on the enemy, the cursed seal will take effect, causing the kanji to disappear from the puppet's forehead and the two consciousness (that of the user's inside the puppet and that of the victim who countered) to switch. Consequently, the user will gain full control of the opponent's body, while the victim's mind remains trapped within the immobile puppet.
Mind's Eye of the Kagura: The Mind's Eye of the Kagura is a technique that allows one to sense chakra from exceptional distances in great detail. These sensory capabilities bless Karin with abilities that even surpass dōjutsu with comparable powers.
Mingling Arm Flying Thrust: Fū delivers a sequence of punches and kicks, manifests Chōmei's wings to flap a quick burst of wind, and flies towards her opponent, ramming them with her arms crossed in front of her.
Mini-Rasenshuriken: This is a miniature, yet powerful version of the Rasenshuriken.
Miniature Tailed Beast Ball Sniper Shot: Jura charges a small Tailed Beast Ball from one of his eyes as a projectile or beam to pierce through his target from a far distance. Whether the Ball explodes on contact or not is up to the user.
Mirrored Sudden Attacker Technique: A secondary trap is laid under the Five-Seal Barrier. This technique is automatically started when the "forbidden" tags are removed. An exact copy of the person who removed the tag appears with their appearance, weapons, battle skills, and so on. Because the double has a fixed amount of stamina and doesn't feel exhaustion, it has an advantage in a drawn-out battle. In order to cancel this technique and defeat their copy, the one who removed the tag has no choice but to somehow push past the previous limits that they had at the time they removed the tag.
Missile: Mecha-Naruto launches either a single or a multitude of missiles from its mechanised chest cavity. When Mecha-Naruto does this, its forehead protector changes to read .
Mist Servant Technique: This technique creates several ghost-like figures clad in black that emerge from the surrounding environment. When Mubi uses this technique, the figures are somewhat similar in appearance to him, but are not his exact lookalikes in the same that other clone techniques resemble their users. The black figures move slowly towards their target, provoking the target into attacking. Each time the figures are struck, the attacks pass through them, only briefly disfiguring their form. With each attack they receive, the figures multiply.
Molten Earth Wild Eruption Technique: A cooperation ninjutsu performed by an Earth Release user and a Fire Release user, where one erupts chunks of earth from the ground, while the other burns the earth chunks, it then explodes on the opponent.
Molten Wave: From her dimension, Kaguya brings forth a large wave of lava to crash down on the opponent, leaving a small pool of lava.
Monkey Flame Arson: Son Gokū or Rōshi in Tailed Beast Mode spews green flames at the opponent.
Monkey Rock: This technique creates a giant stone monkey by accumulating surrounding ground and shaping it into the animal, which is then reinforced with fire. It's powerful enough to keep up with a fully manifested Kurama and even put it down, requiring a Susanoo support to defeat it. Although, it should be noted Kurama had half of its chakra drained by Momoshiki before Naruto was rescued.
Monstrous Sand Arm: After gathering a large amount of sand, Gaara forms it into a replica of Shukaku's arm to grab and/or crush an opponent.
Monstrous Sand Arm: Breakthrough: Gaara jumps up in the air and sends two twisting sand arms straight at his opponent.
Monstrous Sand Arm: Gripping Crush: After trapping the opponent in a giant sphere of sand, Gaara creates two enormous sand arms to press the subdued opponent between them.
Moon Shadow Technique: Under the moonlight, the user can manifest multiple target's shadows as tangible clones. While mute and void of personality or specific characteristics, they are exact physical copies of the target, able to use all the same raw might, techniques and abilities. At the same time, they can manipulate their form into other shapes, including morphing their arms into spears. Uniquely, they do not have a separate source of chakra, but rather draw their chakra from the target they were spawned from, effectively making the target tire twice as fast.
Moonlight: Sasuke attacks with his sword, stabs it into the ground, balances himself on it and kicks his opponent away. His kick is usually aimed at the upper abdomen or the neck area.
Morning Moon: Obito attacks the opponent while also planting a Truth-Seeking Ball on them, where it expands and creates a large explosion around the target.
Morning Peacock: The Morning Peacock is a certain-kill taijutsu born from the philosophy of Might Guy. The principle of this taijutsu is to rapidly increase the body's abilities by opening up to and including the sixth of the Eight Gates, and then to strike the enemy down with countless punches.
Mortality of All Creation: Obito slashes the opponent with the Sword of Nunoboko, following with a scythe shaped from the Truth-Seeking Balls, and then shapes them into two large arms that forms a sphere of chakra at the palms.
Moulded Beauty: Deidara hits the opponent and then jumps on a giant clay bird. After that, he releases six clay spiders that detonate around the opponent.
Mountain Face: Jirōbō strikes the opponent with a combo of two punches before lowering his stance, and then raises his head up to headbutt the opponent into the air.
Mouse Hairball: The user transforms their spit into a flaming ball of hair that assumes the shape of a mouse engulfed in flames, which then continually splits into individual and similarly ablaze balls of hair. These flaming projectiles pursue the intended targets before exploding, once they come into contact with an object.
Mud Release: Bottomless Mud Hole: The user turns the ground beneath their target into a deep, muddy pit that the target will slowly sink into. To prevent targets from escaping, the walls of the pit are lined with hands made out of mud that pull the target deeper. These pits can only be created on earthen surfaces, so if a target is able to find something to stand on that is not made from dirt, they are safe from this technique.
Mud Release: Landslide: After performing a long sequence of hand seals, the user converts much of a mountainside into mud, creating a landslide that crushes everything in its path. Ameyuki used this technique to destroy Shangri-la.
Mud Release: Mud Doll: The user creates one or more humanoid shapes out of mud that carry out their bidding. Like sand clones, the mud dolls can recover from most damage they receive. When a mud doll captures an opponent, it can force its hand down their throat, drowning them with mud.
Mud Release: Muddy Water Wall: By putting both hands on the ground, the user turns it into mud that erupts like a wall and swoops down on the enemy in a wave of muddy water. The mud clings to the target's body and, as it hardens, slows their movements.
Mudshot Technique: The user fires mud straight from their mouth at an enemy; the chakra-enhanced mud is able to trap and slow an opponent down.
Multi-Size Technique: This is the trademark ability passed down through the Akimichi clan. When performed, the Akimichi grows in size, proportionately increasing their weight and strength and thus making their physical attacks more powerful. Clothes they're wearing will change in size to accomodate them, as will certain weaponry, such as the bo. Such a significant change in size places a great burden on the user's body. In keeping with this, users typically are not seen maintaining the Multi-Size Technique for long periods of time, instead reverting back to their normal form after they've concluded their series of attacks. During the Fourth Shinobi World War, Chōza and Chōji Akimichi at one point seem to use the Multi-Size Technique for several hours.
Multiple Connected Feet: While occupying Sakon's body, Ukon adds his feet to Sakon's kicks; when Sakon is about to kick something, both of Ukon's legs sprout from Sakon's leg. Ukon's kicks can be performed simultaneously with Sakon's, increasing their combined power to the point of sending targets flying, or they can be performed in intervals, spacing out the damage to their target.
Multiple Connected Fists: While occupying Sakon's body, Ukon adds his hands to Sakon's punches; when Sakon is about to punch something, both of Ukon's arms sprout from Sakon's arm. Ukon's punches can be performed simultaneously with Sakon's, increasing their combined power to the point of punching through rock, or Ukon can grab opponents to give Sakon's punch an easy target.
Multiple Connected Fists: Rakshasa: Sakon and Ukon create some distance between themselves and their opponent with a kick. They split, and summon a Rashōmon behind their opponent, before merging and activating their cursed seal. They pummel their opponent with their fists against the Rashōmon until it breaks.
Multiple Connected Whirlwinds: Sakon and Ukon use their legs to spin with strong force to generate a whirlwind capable of deflecting any incoming attacks.
Multiple Infinite Embraces: This technique has exactly the same effect as Infinite Embrace, but this version is much larger and stronger as it could completely subdue and incapacitate Naruto Uzumaki, despite him using the Nine-Tails' chakra. The Magaki Group puts their opponent in a barrier that pushes down on them, preventing them from escaping and draining their chakra. The more effort place into the technique enhances its ability to subdue and drain chakra from the target.
Multiple Lotus Nonself Connected Cannons: While in the second state of their Sage Transformation, the user grows more of their jet booster-like appendages, extends them, and then uses them to gather natural energy before releasing it as a powerful chakra blast, covering a wide range. The rate at which the chakra is gathered and released is so fast that escaping the technique is impossible through normal means.
Multiple Phantom Shuriken: This technique is very similar in both execution and result to the Shuriken Shadow Clone Technique. It is a cooperation ninjutsu where three users, after throwing shuriken at their target and forming the necessary hand seals, can create corporeal replicas of the shuriken — turning a small amount of shuriken to a large amount in an instant with which to bombard the enemy. Unlike the Shuriken Shadow Clone Technique, however, this technique makes no use of the Shadow Clone Technique.
Multiple Shadow Clone Technique: This technique is a larger-scale version of the standard Shadow Clone Technique; there is no real difference between them beyond the number of shadow clones being created. Creating even a single shadow clone will require half of a user's chakra, for which reason the normal Shadow Clone Technique is generally only safe to use for jōnin. Because of how many clones are created with the Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, the chakra cost is far greater, rendering it unsafe to use for most people other than the Hokage. For this reason, the First Hokage declared it forbidden and hid it away in the Scroll of Seals. Naruto Uzumaki is among the few exceptions to this rule because of the sheer amount of chakra he has access to.
Multiple Shadow Clone Technique: Lightni: Kakashi creates multiple shadow clones, each of which attacks the enemy using Lightning Cutter, after which Kakashi himself, using an enhanced version of Lightning Cutter, finishes off the enemy.
Multiple Shadows Attack Combo: Naruto punches the enemy and jumps from their shoulders into the air where performs Multiple Shadow Clone Technique to create countless clones that throws each other at the enemy. Naruto proceeds with entering his one-tailed form.
Multiple Smoke Clone: After creating a smoke clone, should it be sufficiently struck, it will disperse into smoke and then form into multiple smoke clones.
Multiple String Light Formation: By having more than one person using the String Light Formation, the effects of the jutsu are amplified, making it so even weaker users can successfully entrap a stronger opponent if they have enough users.
Multiple Wood Release Clone Technique: This technique is essentially a large-scale version of the Wood Clone Technique where the user uses pre-existing vegetation in their immediate vicinity as a medium to create a large number of wood clones.
Murderous Grasp: This technique uses a metal string strengthened with chakra to make a thread capable of constricting a target and cutting through steel with little difficulty. The user can also use the wire to form complex string figure design with his hands, and launch the figure from the string as a powerful cutting attack.
Mutability: Killing Spiders: Fuen summons a number of stone columns that trap the opponent in a vise-like grip, after which massive, venomous spiders descend along these columns to attack, tearing their victim to pieces.
Mutually Multiplying Explosive Tags: The Mutually Multiplying Explosive Tags is a technique which forms part of a fighting style purposely designed for those who have been reincarnated, and employs the use of special explosive tags to create a near infinite series of explosions. By using their own body as a medium for the paper, the reincarnated individual creates several exploding tags formed from large sheets that each bear five seals on them. These special tags then attach themselves to the intended target, but just as they detonate, additional tags are created as these previous ones explode. This process is continuously repeated, leading to a near infinite chain reaction of consecutive explosions. By sacrificing themselves, this technique can also be employed by a live individual.
Mysterious Peacock Method: The Mysterious Peacock Method is a trademark technique of Hoshigakure and utilises chakra-enriching radiation produced by a meteorite that fell 200 years prior to the start of the series.
Mysterious Storm Technique: While under the influence of dark chakra, Setsuna and Shizuku combine their elemental ninjutsu ability to create a thunderstorm that could disperse bolts of lightning in order to demolish areas. Doing so quickly drained both dark chakra and regular chakra reserves.
Mystic Safety Bell Seal: Release: This technique is used by Shion. She releases power through her bell, and completely transforms. This allows her to send a huge ray of light which can penetrate Mōryō's darkness. In this form, she has the ability to, and attempted to, completely destroy Mōryō along with herself. She was pulled out by Naruto before she could do so.
Mystical Palm Technique: The user applies their hand to a wounded part of the body and sends chakra into it, accelerating the body's natural healing abilities. Although its most obvious use is as a way of treating external injuries, it can also be used for internal illnesses. Users must be careful to only use as much chakra as is needed for the specific injury. If too much chakra is sent into the body, this can disrupt the body's circulation, putting it into a comatose state.
Nadeshiko-Style Deep Crimson Dance Perfo: The user throws a continuous barrage of kunai with deadly accuracy. This technique is seemingly difficult to evade, as Naruto was praised for doing so.
Nadeshiko-Style Hardliner Gale Fist: By covering one's own hand with wind-natured chakra, the user attacks the enemy with it. The force of the strike is great enough to produce a powerful shockwave that can cause noticeable fissures without direct contact.
Nadeshiko-Style Hardliner Revolving Cut: The user covers one leg with wind chakra and delivers a powerful falling kick to her opponent. This kick was powerful enough to slice through a mechanical puppet.
Nagi Snake Tail: This ability consists of the snake swinging its tail and striking its opponent. The tail also serves to defend against projectiles launched at the user.
Naka Shrine Pass Technique: In order to enter the Uchiha's secret meeting place under the Naka Shrine, one must perform a specific technique, akin to a password. Performing the technique moves a slab of rock which has the Sharingan wrapped in sealing formulae in the centre, revealing stairs to the meeting place. Despite the destruction of the Naka Shrine, the rock still guards the secret entrance.
Naraka Path: The grants the user two main abilities: interrogation and restoration, by using the King of Hell. Pain channelled the power of the Naraka Path through the body of a priest.
Narutimate Blaster: In his Mecha-Kurama form, Mecha-Naruto fires a purple beam of electricity.
Narutimate Tornado: In his Mecha-Kurama form, Mecha-Naruto generates black whirlwinds around each arm and unleashes them as powerful projectiles directed at the opponent.
Naruto Beam: Mecha-Naruto locks onto its target and fires an laser beam from its eyes. It is capable of destroying several buildings in one fell swoop.
Naruto Cannon: Naruto creates a shadow clone that grabs and flings him to a distant point of the player's choosing. This technique is not meant for combat purposes, being only a method used in Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm to get around the Konoha hub faster. As players progress in the game, Naruto's chakra reserves become larger and he can be thrown further.
Naruto Punch: Mecha-Naruto strikes the opponent with a jet powered punch.
Naruto Region Combo: The Naruto Region Combo is a taijutsu attack used by Naruto Uzumaki while having Six Paths Sage Mode and Nine-Tails Chakra Mode active at the same time. The attack, enhanced by Six Paths Senjutsu, is the strongest taijutsu in his arsenal. After using his Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, Naruto creates an army of clones to assault his opponent, overwhelming them by attacking on all sides while yelling "U-ZU-MA-KI". The rest of the clones then follow up with a direct attack to finish the combo.
Naruto Uzumaki Combo: Naruto creates four shadow clones to assist him for this technique. The clones kick or punch the target into the air, each yelling "U-ZU-MA-KI" ("NA-RU-TO" in some English translations) as they do so as the real Naruto himself leaps off a clone to chase after the target.
Naruto Uzumaki Combo Attack: Naruto creates two clones that punch the enemy, then Naruto comes from the left, punching them again, after which a clone kicks the enemy in the air. All three Naruto jump in the air and grab the enemy throwing them on the ground.
Naruto Uzumaki Five Thousand Combo: The user creates several shadow clones, which kick the opponent in succession, launching them into the air. Then, the user creates five thousand shadow clones, which, taking the form similar to that of the Fang Passing Fang, strike the opponent from both sides. Finally, using their Nine-Tails' chakra, the user, alongside their shadow clones, focus the chakra into their one hand and, with it, they strike the opponent together, creating an eruption of orange-coloured chakra, which can even be seen from space.
Naruto Uzumaki Spiralling Combo: Naruto uses his Naruto Uzumaki Combo, kicking the enemy while creating several airborne clones that kick the enemy to the ground. Naruto jumps onto a clone that charges a Rasengan that Naruto uses on the enemy while falling.
Naruto Uzumaki Two Thousand Combo: Naruto uses the Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, creating a total of one thousand Narutos. Some of the Narutos then kick the target high into the air while yelling "U-ZU-MA-KI", just as is done with the original Naruto Uzumaki Combo. Once the target is airborne, the one thousand Narutos punch them from every direction with their, combined, two thousand fists, hence the name; the punches are so numerous that targets have no chance to escape. Two Narutos then join to deliver a final blow: a simultaneous punch from the left and right.
Naruto Uzumaki's Shinobi Handbook: could refer to one of two techniques used by Naruto Uzumaki:
Naruto Uzumaki's Shinobi Handbook (Ultim: Naruto creates a huge amount of shadow clones with the clones piling on the opponent where Naruto grabs one of the clones that grabs on to each another to form a chain whip and slams the opponent down onto the ground.
Naruto and Shion's Super Chakra Rasengan: An enormous purple and blue Rasengan created with the combined chakra and emotions of Naruto and Shion. It was powerful enough to completely destroy Mōryō.
Needle Hell: After using Needle Jizō to extend their hair around their body, the user shoots a barrage of hardened hair needles towards their opponent. The hairs themselves are strong enough to pierce through and destroy boulders.
Needle Jizō: Jiraiya uses chakra to harden his hair and shape it into spikes, which are as sharp as metallic weapons. His hair also grows long enough to wrap around him, serving as armour. Jiraiya can use this technique to discourage opponents from attacking him, or activate it in response to physical attacks they've already started, causing them to impale themselves on the spikes. In the anime, the hair is resilient enough to defend Jiraiya from arrows. Though useful, Needle Jizō does not fully cover Jiraiya, leaving areas of his body vulnerable to attack.
Negative Emotions Sensing: This technique enables the user to sense hostility, hatred and other evil emotions within others.
Net Shadow Paralysis Technique: The user projects their shadow into multiple blobs that latch to a surface. From there, they will crawl about the surface, seeking its targets. When latching on to the target, it will meld with its shadow, paralysing them on the spot. They can then force those caught in the shadows to move to their will with a single gesture.
Net-Shaped Prison: The user manipulates the webs. When used by the spiders, the emitted web hardens into spikes. The user can also emit web from their mouth or hands and use it in the form of a net to trap opponents.
New Naruto Uzumaki Combo: Naruto strings together a series of kicks and punches, constantly having two shadow clones to make the hits land. A shadow clone kicks his opponent up in the air, another lands an uppercut, and finally the original uses the last shadow clone to land a kick, throwing the opponent further up in the air.
New Sexy Technique: During his two-and-a-half years of training with Jiraiya, Naruto Uzumaki on one occasion uses the Sexy Technique against Jiraiya; Naruto transforms into a woman wearing a revealing devil outfit and short shorts. After seeing it, Jiraiya encourages Naruto to take a form that is wearing a thong, which he believes will give him inspiration. Confusing a thong for a mawashi, Naruto transforms into a sumo wrestler. Jiraiya is first startled, then disturbed, then angry to see it, having expected another scantily-clad woman. He complains bitterly until Naruto, irritated, uses the form to knock Jiraiya out.
New: Summoning Three-Way Deadlock: Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura summon Gamakichi, Aoda, and Katsuyu, respectively. Katsuyu jumps into the air and slams down on the opponent, Aoda then attacks from underground and pushes the opponent up in the air where Gamakichi slashes the opponent with his sword. Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura then jump from their respective summon's head, and land a punch on their opponent, Naruto with a tailed beast chakra arm, Sasuke with a partially manifested Susanoo, and Sakura with her chakra enhanced strength.
Newly Invented: Lightning Swift Rasengan: Boruto lands a few hits on the opponent between Sarada's shuriken being thrown and hitting her target. With the opponent stunned, Sarada lands an uppercut, sending the opponent into the air, while she and Boruto jump backwards, putting distance between themselves and their opponent. Boruto throws a vanishing Rasengan, and Sarada sends lightning chakra-charged kunai, resulting in an explosion.
Night Guy: The Night Guy is a forbidden taijutsu of the highest level and can only be performed after opening all Eight Gates.
Night Phoenix: Guy is covered by flames, in a specific shape as though resembling a phoenix. When the move hits, the opponent goes ablaze.
Nine Masked Beasts: The are entities created by Menma through the use of the Black Nine-Tails' chakra. Five of these beasts are described as , while the other four are referred to as .
Nine-Tailed Fox Barrage: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto slashes the opponent and then strikes downward upon them.
Nine-Tailed Fox Rapid Combo: While in his one-tailed form, Naruto knocks the opponent to the ground then throws them into the air and follows up by jumping into the air and slashing them. He then lands and repeats the process several times before finally slashing through them.
Nine-Tailed Naruto Wild Attack: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto first rushes forward with a shoulder charge. Once he connects, he then unleashes a brutal series of claw slashes until he rise-slashes ending with a downward slash, then in an instant releases all built-up chakra in a powerful Nine-Tails Burst which blasts away the victim.
Nine-Tails Beam: The Nine-Tails can fire a powerful beam of chakra, capable of piercing through rock.
Nine-Tails Chakra Bomb: Mecha-Naruto transforms part of its body into a cannon and fires a powerful laser, made from the chakra of Kurama, at its opponent.
Nine-Tails Chakra Mode: The Nine-Tails Chakra Mode is a unique form of transformation that is granted to the jinchūriki of the Nine-Tails.
Nine-Tails Surge: In his one-tailed form, Naruto brushes his claws past each other, releasing a powerful horizontal crescent wave that rips though the opponent and causes them to crumple to the ground in pain.
Nine-Tails Swirling Orbs: The Nine-Tails creates orbs of black-red chakra that swirl around its body and damage anyone who touches them. The orbs then spread out while continuing to swirl even faster until they disappear. This has only been shown used by a false Nine-Tails.
Nine-Tails Twister: With a swipe of its claws, Kurama can create a miniature tornado.
Nine-Tails' Claw: Fission: In his four-tailed Version 2 cloak, Naruto swipes at his opponent while in the air, "drills" them with his tails, and briefly manifests a second upper body that throws his opponent back down.
Nine-Tails' Claw: Great Rampage: In his four-tails form, Naruto swipes downwards at his opponent with his right claws, makes a half spin, this time hitting with his claws, followed by a second chakra body emerging from his to strike with his right claw. Naruto continues with a backwards spin that again hits the opponent with the tails, throwing them up in the air, and then jumps spinning forward, hitting with the tails many times before finishing with a downward swipe with both arms.
Nine-Tails' Power: When in his one-tailed form, Naruto roars and causes a fire-like orb made of chakra, if it connects he slashes the opponent with his claws downward, then upward, then downward again, then leftward, then upward again to launch the opponent into the air. He then jumps into the air to slash the opponent away from himself. Using his chakra, he forms a hand to grab his opponent, then pulls them back and finishes with a bone-shattering punch.
Ninja Art Creation Rebirth — Strength of: The Ninja Art Creation Rebirth — Strength of a Hundred Technique is a forbidden technique that is only accessible to those who have mastered the Creation Rebirth technique.
Ninja Art: Bare-Handed Blade Block: This taijutsu allows its user to avoid being slashed with blade weapons. The user has to stop the weapon literally with their bare hands, clamping the blade between palms.
Ninja Art: Dance of the Snowy Cherry Blo: Sakura proceeds to throw four small white bags at them filled with exploding tags, which are disguised as cherry blossom petals in the opponent's eyes. She shatters them by throwing kunai at them and the exploding tags begin to fall gently towards the target. Lastly, Sakura aims a kunai with a final exploding tag attached to it at her opponent's feet and it detonates, followed by the explosion of the other falling "tags". There is a huge blast and the opponent is either killed or severely damaged.
Ninja Art: Fierce Dragon Palm: Rokkaku Ryūdōin summons a dragon made from chakra to attack the enemy, inflicting major damage to the opponent. This attack may also lower the target's defence.
Ninja Art: Hollow Deception Projection: After waving his hand seals, Rō creates a projection in mist-like fashion.
Ninja Art: Hurricane: Temari jumps and swings her Giant Folding Fan to create two powerful hurricane-level torrents of wind that travel towards the opponent, severely damaging them upon making contact.
Ninja Art: Infinite Sea Watchtower: The user produces a fog by forcibly extracting all water within the grass, trees, earth and all other living beings throughout the entire area, trapping all within the area in a powerful illusion of themselves. In addition, because of the nature of this technique, it will quickly dehydrate its victims, eventually killing them. The technique can also be condensed to target a single person. If the user is rendered unconscious, the technique will end.
Ninja Art: Moonlight Beauty: Ino jumps into the air and manipulates countless flower petals to surround, confuse and blind her opponent. She then stomps them into the ground with a powerful kick.
Ninja Art: New Moon Flower Wheel: Ino twirls a bundle of moon flowers into the air which transforms into a circular blade, somewhat resembling a chakram. She then throws the blade at the opponent, slashing anything in its way. Once it gets to the opponent, it slashes through them and explodes into moon flower petals.
Ninja Art: Profusion of Flowers: Ino casts an illusion that tricks the enemy, causing them to see a storm of flowers. This technique has different variations ranging from a field of flowing petals to an overflow of petals surrounding the enemy. With a clear shot, she throws the poisonous wolfsbane flower at the enemy hitting them in the head.
Ninja Art: Shuriken Giant Body Technique: The user throws a fūma shuriken towards the opponent and uses their chakra to massively enlarge it, brutally striking the opponent and sending them flying.
Ninja Art: Ten Thousand Flowers Profusio: After Ino kicks the opponent in the face and throws a wolfbane, she twirls elegantly around in the air and throws a barrage of poisonous purple flowers at the opponent. The flowers explode upon impact, releasing a shower of poisonous mist and purple petals.
Ninja Tools Barrier: Reverse Fish Scales: This is a technique used by the Four Celestial Symbols Men. Devised to counter Gaara's sand, the formation draws upon their weapons (Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, Garian Sword and Hōki's unnamed fire-shooting sword), arranged in a triangle with Gaara at the centre. The three members will use three underground waterways to connect their formation, which will converge under their target. With their weapons charged with their chakra, they will then activate the technique, sending a surge of power through the waterways to the central target. This will cause a water dragon to rise from the ground and envelop Gaara, soaking his sand and making it become much heavier. This causes it to clump and makes it near impossible to utilise.
Ninja Wolfsbane: Ino throws poisonous wolfsbane flowers which amount varies depending on how much she charged. This poisons the victim, decreasing their health.
Ninken Ninja Art: Dance of the Dust Clou: Using their strong front limbs, the ninken dig into the ground. This creates a cloud of dust which they can use to conceal their movements. It can also be used to create large holes in a short period of time.
Ninken Ninja Art: Hound Clone: Using the hair he sheds, Pakkun creates dozens of clones of himself. These clones are able to float in the air, in a similar manner that hair is able to stay airborne.
Ninshū Flame: Indra concentrates his chakra and attacks the enemy with a massive stream of fire.
Noisy Riot: Super Beast Imitating Drawin: Naruto and Sai unleash a series of alternating physical attacks at their opponent. Naruto performs a drop kick, and Sai finishes it off with three ink lions.
Nose Water Tree: Using nasal fluid, the user creates a water source. They can manipulate the liquid at will to expand into multiple tendrils, able to ensnare or pierce a target. The water can also solidify to maintain its shape and integrity to act as a support structure.
Nosedive: Jūgo jumps at his opponent and slams them at the ground with an engorged left hand.
Nuibari: Fall: Kushimaru throws Nuibari high into the air and, using the wire strings attached to the sword, pulls it down with all his might towards his desired opponent, inflicting considerable damage, knocking them down and even cracking the ground around where it hit, depending on the maximum height reached.
Nunchaku Combo: Using nunchakus, Might Guy lands a series of blows on the opponent and finishes with his Dynamic Entry, kicking them far away.
Object Extraction Technique: This is a technique used by Koharu to extract a concealed explosive tag from its hiding place that could be a wall or a stud. The user must first detect the hidden object, as the technique forcibly pulls the object into their hand. The affected object will also phase through other objects in its way.
Object Manipulation Technique: This Mangekyō Sharingan technique allows the user to telekinetically control objects and after marking them with a seal on their hand. Using this technique, Shin Uchiha was able to freely manipulate his medical equipment to perform surgery, create makeshift prosthetic limbs and weaponry out of multiple scalpels, as well as manipulate his clone's body to shield himself.
Oblique Shadow Slash: Darui repeatedly slashes his opponent with his cleaver sword, finishing it with a powerful spinning attack that knocks them far back.
Octopus Hug: B manifests two of Gyūki's tails to hold down his opponent, pulls himself towards his opponent, and lands a punch, his hand also transformed into Gyūki's. As he's about to land the hit, B releases his opponent, allowing to hit to knock them back.
Octopus Leg Clone Technique: By using a small portion of Gyūki's chakra and sacrificing one of its tentacles, Killer B can create a flawless clone of himself that neither the Sharingan, nor the Akatsuki, could distinguish. This clone is apparently long-lasting and can sustain considerable damage, only reverting back into the tentacle when completely drained of chakra.
Odour-Concealing Bubbles: The user first smells the scent of their allies and produces sweat with movements. After sucking up sweat, it is then mixed with saliva to create a bubble from their mouth that lets them conceal natural body odour of their allies and themselves.
Offering Flowers Funeral: Ino lies about having feelings for her opponent after throwing a bouquet of flowers with a hidden exploding tag attached at them. While Ino runs away from the explosion, the confused opponent is caught in the blast.
Offsetting Sound: A genjutsu that relies on the sound of the ocarina. While playing the melody, the user is able to release his allies from powerful genjutsu, such as the ones used by Shiin and his clansmen.
One Thousand Years of Death: The user tightly clasps their hands together and extends their middle and index fingers, resembling the Tiger hand seal. Using the full weight of their body, the user thrusts these four fingers between the target's buttocks. Despite the technique's dramatic name, it is not actually harmful. The pain is fairly extreme, however, so much so that, when Kakashi Hatake uses it on Naruto Uzumaki, Naruto comically leaps into the air, travelling a fair distance. Sakura Haruno blushes to see it used and Sasuke Uchiha declares both Kakashi and Naruto "buffoons". The anime shows those who are familiar with One Thousand Years of Death are very unwilling to be subjected to it. It has no effect on unconscious targets.
One's Own Life Reincarnation: The One's Own Life Reincarnation is a technique that was developed in Sunagakure's Puppet Brigade.
One-Man Front Lotus: A singular version of its parent technique, Lee instead starts spinning by himself creating strong winds around him, and dives down on the opponent rather than with them.
Oneself's Rule: Guy pins the opponent down and does a hundred push-ups on top of them in five seconds. After this, he spins around so fast that his legs catch fire and then he kicks the opponent into the air.
Onikuma Clan's Hijutsu: A unique Hiden jutsu that is passed down to members of the Onikuma clan. Described as a "possession-type" Summoning Technique, the technique mutates the users arms into a beast-like form granting them enhanced strength and allowing them to stretch similarly to the Soft Physique Modification. Similar to Jūgo's Clan's Kekkei Genkai, this technique can prove mentally unstable at times as it can cause the user to assume a more bestial form when they become emotionally vulnerable resulting in them losing complete control over the technique. Enko Onikuma was prone to fits of rage which were triggered by feelings of loneliness caused by other's fear of her due to the jutsu's appearance. Until she understood what brought these fits, it required her team-mates to tranquillise her when she lost control.
Opening and Closing of the Universe: Obito sends the opponent into his pocket dimension and uses the block formations to crush them.
Orbs of Light: This is a technique that creates a numerous amount of small balls of light to attack the target. Just a single hit from one can result in the target feeling a burning sensation.
Order of Glamour: Using his signature genjutsu, Gengo suppresses the will of his followers and forces them to attack his opponent with taijutsu.
Origami Replacement Technique: Prior to being struck by an attack, Urashiki activates his tomoe-less Rinnegan and causes it to glow blue. His body then disappears without warning, leaving behind ten glowing red orizuru, which slowly float to the ground before fading away. Afterwards, Urashiki's chakra signature is completely untraceable, allowing him to escape elsewhere unnoticed. The exact nature of this technique is unclear, but upon observing it, Sasuke Uchiha believed that it does not involve slipping into another dimension.
Origami Skewer: Konan morphs her right hand into paper and hits her opponent before spinning and doing the same with her left hand. She then sends two flurries of paper butterflies, separated by a spin, hovers toward her opponent covered in swirling paper that hits her opponent, and with a last attack, knocks her opponent far back.
Origin of Ninshū: Hagoromo is joined by Asura and Indra, both in their avatars, as they charge their long distance ninjutsu while Hagoromo combines his Truth-Seeking Balls into a large single ball that are all thrown at the opponent.
Orochimaru's Juinjutsu: Orochimaru's Juinjutsu is a transformation-based cursed seal that Orochimaru can apply to others for various purposes.
Orochimaru-Style Body Replacement Techni: The Orochimaru-Style Body Replacement Technique is a unique form of substitution that was created by Orochimaru.
Ostrich Aerial: Condor delivers a powerful aerial kick to the opponent.
Ostrich Meteor Blast: Condor jumps high in the air to slam his opponent down with both his feet. A powerful shock wave is released from the impact point.
Ostrich Rising Dragon Bullet: Condor gives a rising kick to the opponent's stomach.
Ostrich Whirlwind Attack: Condor uses his leg to jab the opponent hard in the stomach.
Outcry of Earth: Sakura summons a giant Inner Sakura to deliver a series of punches.
Outer Path: The is one of the seven abilities of the Six Paths Technique granted to the wielder of the Rinnegan, standing out from the other six Paths. It grants the user the power to control and transcend life and death. With this power, the user is able to revive the dead, transmit their chakra into black receivers, and manifest chakra chains.
Outer Path — Samsara of Heavenly Life Te: The Outer Path — Samsara of Heavenly Life Technique is a reincarnation ninjutsu used through the Outer Path, which can infuse new life into the bodies of the dead in exchange for the user's own life by reuniting the separated soul to the body using .
Overwhelm: Rasengan: Naruto delivers a string of punches and kicks using shadow clones. The penultimate of these attacks are enhanced with natural energy, which stuns his opponent. Naruto then jumps at his opponent and kicks them down, bouncing off them, going up high, and comes crashing down with a Rasengan.
Overwind Raid: Using his Kote, Boruto sends a Wind Release-infused shuriken at his opponent, pushing them back. Boruto then uses a Kote Water Release technique to flood the place, holding the opponent in place, and while surfing on the waves, sends a Vanishing Rasengan through the water, pushing the opponent up when it hits.
Owl Drop: Obito jumps up in the air, attacks his opponent with three kunai slashes and kicks them down.
Owl Guardian Pursuit: Motoi summons Fukuemon and gives him commands mentally, and owl attacks the enemy with rapid strikes from his wings and beak.
Pachinko Technique: By using the Chakra Liquid that bound their hands together, Naruto and Sasuke stretch the sticky substance, and launch a golden statue at the target like a slingshot with enough force to knock them out.
Pacification of the Grounds: Jūgo hits the enemy at extreme speeds while part of his body is transformed.
Pair of Maidens: Kankurō summons Kuroari to sneak up behind the opponent, pinning their arms. Kankurō then uses a mouth-bomb wielding Karasu that rushes toward the opponent, causing the bomb to explode.
Pair's Kamui: Kakashi and Obito use Kamui to transport the opponent inside their pocket dimension, where they strike their target with a series of cooperative taijutsu attacks. After gaining enough distance, Obito creates a Black Receiver, through which Kakashi channels his Lightning Cutter. Obito launches the receiver, electrocuting and piercing them, both with the thrown receiver and the new ones which branch from it upon impact.
Palm Bottom: This attack consists of a quick, precise thrust of the user's palm to the opponent's body. The attack sends chakra into the area of the foe where struck to either stun them, or if a more sufficient amount of chakra is used, cause severe internal damage.
Palm Wave: Shizune attacks her opponent a few times, then spins around with her arm outstretched to hit them with a chakra scalpel. She finishes by hitting her opponent high into the air with another chakra scalpel.
Pampas: Kimimaro uses his bone sword to strike the opponent with amazing speed at different vital areas of their body. This attack can be used repeatedly in succession to not give the opponent a chance to attack back.
Paper Chakram: Konan gathers a large quantity of paper sheets into a single chakram-like shape, which she then throws at the intended target. While in flight, the disc spins with tremendous speed, with its trajectory and inclination being freely manipulated by her. This presents opportunities to attack an enemy from all angles, even if the disc is initially avoided. The discs spins so fast that a collision between the two result in a considerable impact.
Paper Clone: A technique which employs the use of Konan's ability to manipulate the shape and colour of her paper by forming it into one or more replicas of herself. When a clone is hit, it will merely turn back into sheets of paper. If need be, Konan can conceal explosive tags within her paper clones to allow for a deadly surprise attack.
Paper Drizzle: After creating wings out of her paper, Konan uses them to launch a multitude of paper in rapid succession at the target. In the anime, this attack was strong enough to overpower Jiraiya's Fire Release: Flame Bullet technique.
Paper Person of God Technique: Konan disguises six hundred billion explosive tags as the surrounding scenery, be it earth or water, with enough sophistication that even the Sharingan cannot see through it. When the target is in position, Konan causes the scenery to split in half, resulting in the rapid creation of a huge abyss beneath the target. Due to the sudden lack of any available foothold, the target inevitably descends ever deeper into the depths of the chasm. As the target falls, Konan guides the explosive tags to stick to their body and detonate, with six hundred billion being enough for ten minutes of consecutive explosions — more than enough to counter the five minute time limit on Obito Uchiha's intangibility.
Paper Shuriken: A technique that consists of using chakra to harden and shape paper into shuriken. The user can increase the power of the shuriken by further altering its final shape. Konan could fold the paper shuriken into different shapes, including the normal four-pointed star shape and a more kunai-like shape. By combining it with Nagato's Wind Release: Gale Palm, the duo were able to increase their lethality.
Parachute: Naruto punches his opponent into the air, creates two to four shadow clones that jump in the air as well, before jumping himself. The clones hold his opponent down as they fall, with Naruto landing on them knee-first.
