Paralysing Flute Genjutsu: An illusion that relies on the sound of the flute. After the user plays a melody though the flute, whoever hears it will become paralysed as if their bodies became heavier.
Paralyzing Chakra Field: The user strikes the ground with his fist and releases a large amount of chakra, creating a pulsating field that paralyzes anyone it hits.
Parasite Clone: The Parasite Clone technique is one utilised by Akatsuki's White Zetsu.
Parasite Demon Demolition Technique: Ukon can only perform this technique after activating his cursed seal's second level. Using his chakra, he disassembles his body on a cellular and proteinic level so that he can enter a target's body. He then starts reforming himself, taking over certain parts of their body and gradually corroding the parts he hasn't entered yet. Ultimately, the target dies, achieving this technique's primary purpose: assassination. Ukon had previously been very successful in this regard, as the only way that victims could stop him would be by attacking their own bodies, something that none were willing to do. Kiba Inuzuka, however, experiences no such unwillingness; he badly injures himself, doing the same damage to Ukon, and in trying to kill himself drives Ukon from his body so that Ukon will not suffer the same fate.
Parasite Technique: The user spits out parasites at a target, which will burrow inside them. This allows the user to kill the target, inflict great pain, or take control over their movements. It is possible to resist it, though quite painful, and is preferable to remove the parasite before it burrows completely.
Parasitic Bugs: Shino manipulates his kikaichū to swarm around the opponent and absorb their chakra and then providing the stolen chakra to Shino, allowing him to replenish his own.
Parasitic Destruction Insect Fang: Kiba uses his Passing Fang to send the opponent flying, then Shino uses his Insect Pillar to send the opponent flying and Akamaru uses the Beast Human Clone to become Kiba and finish with the Fang Passing Fang.
Parasitic Destruction Insect Technique: Shortly after a member of the Aburame clan is born, thousands of insects are allowed to colonise his or her body. In exchange for getting to feed off of their host's chakra, the insects follow the host's every command: from attack to defence to reconnaissance, and everything in between. The insects inevitably become the core ability of the Aburame's entire fighting style, upon which all of their other jutsu rely.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Arrowhead: Shino reveals several kikaichū behind his opponent, which begin to wrap around them. At the same time, Shino sends more insects in a spiralling pattern. All the insects swarm at the opponent, damaging them, and then dispersing.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Bind: Shino creates a cloud of kikaichū that lifts the opponent into the air. Then, many spheres of them repeatedly strike the opponent before sending them crashing to the ground.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Eclipse: Shino manipulates his kikaichū to form a giant pillar that collapses into a wave that engulfs the opponent. The bugs then turn into a whirlpool that drag the opponent below ground before spouting out as a pillar that implodes.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Hail: Shino releases hundreds of thousands of kikaichū from his body into the air. On his command, the insects attack the opponent in five waves. They then coalesce into a large cloud and rain down on the opponent, and then the insects form a giant meteor-like insect sphere crashing down on the opponent.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Hollow: Shino manipulates the kikaichū to form a large airborne cloud that descends on the opponent. After the insects are on the ground surrounding the opponent, the insects swarm upon them, and quickly erupt into an explosion of insects.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Pupa: Shino uses his kikaichū to form a tornado that traps the opponent. He then walks into the tornado and sends another cluster to crush the opponent.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Round Mas: This technique is a larger and more powerful version of the Floating Bugs technique.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Spear: Shino's kikaichū combine into two spear-like forms that spiral towards the enemy and carries them into the air, where they brutally feast upon their chakra.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Whirl: Shino uses his kikaichū to form a funnel that traps the opponent, spins them around violently, and then throws them away.
Parasitic Giant Insect — Bug Bite: Following an Aburame clan member placing a number of kidaichū onto the skin of an enemy, these insects immediately burrow into the victim's body and begin to devour its flesh and chakra. This process causes the insects to grow rapidly in size, until the host body is completely eaten away from the inside out.
Parent and Child Rasengan: The Parent and Child Rasengan is cooperation ninjutsu where two shinobi — a parent and a child as the name suggests — combine their Rasengan to create a massive one.
Partial Multi-Size Leg Technique: The user expands their leg and sends the opponent flying with a kick.
Partial Multi-Size Technique: This is a more practical application of the Multi-Size Technique. Rather than increase the size of their entire body, the user increases the size of only specific body parts, typically the arms and legs. Because of the larger size, physical attacks made with the expanded limbs do greater damage than normal. The limbs' growth is very fast, giving users a way of taking opponents by surprise. In the anime, the expanded mass can also be used a powerful defense from blunt-force assaults, cushioning the impact to negate it.
Partial Super Multi-Size Technique: Chōji uses the Super Multi-Size Technique only in one part of his body, similar to the Partial Multi-Size Technique.
Passing Fang: The user moves at a target at high speeds and delivers a body slam. Because of how quickly they move, the user travels in a fairly straight line, necessitating that they anticipate the target's movements in order to ensure a successful strike. As they move at the target, the user spins rapidly in order to pierce targets, drilling even through stone. Unlike the Fang Passing Fang, this technique is performed alone; users therefore require additional training to raise its attack power enough to compensate for this.
Past Vision Sharing: This technique allows the user to share their past and experiences with a Byakugan user. The user will expel a glowing bubble from their mouth that releases blinding violet rays, which reacts to the person's Byakugan to project images into their mind. However, only those who are worthy are capable of seeing the vision while those from outside the determined targeted area are incapable of doing so. After the vision is transferred, the sphere can be retracted to the user.
Peacock Whirlwind: Utilising the Takumi Village special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, the user swings one of the blades to create a powerful whirling gust of wind.
Peacock Whirlwind Formation: This is a technique utilising the Takumi Village special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, to create a vortex to push away materials covering the user's body. Seimei used it to free himself of Gaara's sand.
Peacock Wisdom Queen: After forming the neccessary hand seals and reciting an incantation, On Mayura Girante Sowaka, Mukade absorbs the seal placed by the Fourth Hokage, allowing him to time travel. Those caught in the blast are also sent through time.
Peerless Great Flame Bullet: Sasuke headbutts his opponent, and jumps over them, kicking them in the head. He then kicks them up in the air, punches them back on the ground, and finishes with a Fire Release technique.
Peerless Great Wind Formation: While in his Level 2 Cursed Seal form, Sasuke kicks upward to launch the opponent into the air. He then glides after them and performs another flipping kick to slam the opponent into the ground, then finishes up with a Chidori.
Peerless Hurricane Formation: Sasuke kicks the opponent. He then dashes behind and punches the opponent from behind. He then jumps into the air and performs an axe kick. He then rushes behind the opponent again and sweeps off their feet, upward flip kicking the opponent as he does. He then jumps once more, this time behind the opponent, and punches them into the ground face-first. Finally, falls with a heel drop on his foe akin to the Lion Combo.
Peony Snow: Kurenai attacks her opponent first by lowering her stance and then spinning into the opponent to deal a knee strike, followed with a kick that pushes the opponent backwards, where she then grabs the opponent, lifting them into the air. She finally delivers a barrage of several kicks to their stomache, kicking them into the ground.
Peregrine Falcon Drop: The user grabs a falling opponent by their waist, wraps their legs around their upper body, and drives them head first into the ground, similar to the Front Lotus.
Perfume Spray: Karin sprays a massive amount of pink perfume that does low to medium damage while poisoning the opponent in the process. Besides poisoning the opponent, it can also lower her opponent's speed and defence. While in Awakening Mode, it also acts as a guard breaker.
Petal Diversion: Chakra Rope: Ino rushes forward to the opponent and disappears in a curtain of purple petals. She appears behind the opponent and concentrates her chakra into a rope of petals, then hits the opponent with a powerful punch.
Petal Diversion: Flower Fireworks: Ino runs forward to the opponent and then disappears in a curtain of purple petals. She appears behind the opponent and concentrates chakra into a rope of petals, then kicks the opponent and throws a kunai attached to an explosive tag at them.
Petal-Dancing Flower Garden: Ino skates towards her opponent with chakra on her feet and purple flowers surrounding her. She then knees them into the air, jumps after them, and twirls gracefully before delivering a powerful, chakra-enhanced kick.
Pheasant Hunter: The user creates a giant flamed pheasant that they direct at a target. In Boruto: Naruto the Movie, the pheasant merely grapples with Naruto Uzumaki's Tailed Beast Mode until it is torn apart by Naruto. In the Boruto anime, it explodes on impact with its target, doing extensive damage to the surroundings.
Piercing Burning Emotions: Lee unlocks several chakra gates, and then charges into the opponent, lifting them upwards into the sky like a rocket. After reaching a certain distance, Lee crashes back into the ground.
Piercing Cloud Spear: Chiriku powers up the spear with golden chakra, similar to that emitted by Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder, and then delivers a slash, first from top to bottom, then from bottom to top, and finally leaps into the air, where she throws the spear with great force, impaling the opponent.
Piercing Funeral Foot: Isshiki uses his immense strength to deliver a fast and powerful dropkick to the opponent, strong enough to knock a Susanoo user out of their avatar.
Piercing Separation Spring: Transformed as Isobu, Yagura pounds the ground, causing water to spring up at his opponent, throwing them up in the air.
Piercing Showers: Komachi throws multitudinous needles at the opponent, causing major damage.
Piercing Stab: Mifune slashes at his opponent a few times, kicks them away, and them stabs them down with a reverse grip of his sword.
Pinching Rage: Rasengan: Naruto charges at his opponent, swiftly generating two shadow clones. The clones efficiently craft Rasengan, and with precision timing, the original Naruto propels his opponent towards the clones. This sets the stage for a simultaneous Rasengan assault from both directions, culminating in a decisive finish as the opponent gets caught between Naruto and his clone's Rasengan.
Pink Lightning: The user creates high-impact lightning with a pink hue from their hands. Tsukiyo was able to launch bolts of this pink lightning from his fingertips, powerful enough to shatter rock. A single precise blast to the head apparently will cause instant death. It can also be channelled through other techniques, allowing for even greater versatility.
Piston Fist: While using his Sage Transformation ability, Jūgo can alter his arm into a piston to increase his attack power. To increase it even more, Jūgo can form jets on his hands or elbows.
Piston Fist: Style One: The user uses their transformation to grow jet booster-like arms that increases his attacking and throwing power. This is a more powerful version of Piston Fist, with the combination of the Jet Booster Jump.
Piston Fist: Style Zero: Jūgo punches the opponent and then rushes up to them to deliver a more powerful punch.
Planetary Rasengan: Naruto Uzumaki — while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode — creates a Big Ball Rasengan in one of his hands, which is then surrounded by three regular-sized Rasengan, in a similar manner to moons around a planet. When coming into contact with a target, the disordered rotations of the individual Rasengan, created by the central and smaller ones spinning in different directions, interact with each other to form a massive and turbulent wave-like vortex.
Poison Cloud: Sasori while inside Hiruko swirls around spraying a green poison cloud around himself affecting nearby opponents.
Poison Cloud Technique: Torune puts his hands together to form a small poisonous smokescreen sphere from his rinkaichū between his hands, Torune can then blow the smokescreen across the area in front of him, the poisonous smokescreen when spread gets bigger. If touched or inhaled, it is a guaranteed fatality.
Poison Missile: Hiruko slams the opponent with his tail and fires a poison missile at them. If the missile itself does not kill the opponent then the poison most likely will.
Poison Mist: This technique combines ninjutsu, chemistry, and medical knowledge, thus requiring fine chakra control and advanced ability in medical ninjutsu. The user converts chakra in their body into a special chemical that they then exhale from their mouth. When the chemical comes into contact with the air, it becomes a cloud of poison. Breathing in even a small amount of the poison will cause immediate death.
Poison Mist Hell: Hundred Continuous Fir: Using his Puppet Technique, Kankurō spins Karasu and Kuroari around his target at high speed. Karasu launches poison gas bombs at the opponent, surrounding them with a gas cloud. Then both puppets fire a barrage of senbon from their arms at the now blinded victim.
Poison Mist Needle Shot: Shizune first uses her Poison Mist on her opponent and then attacks with her chakra scalpels a few times. Finally, she jumps in the air and throws senbon at her opponent.
Poison Moth Genjutsu: Fuen first uses poison that is thin and tiny enough to be taken in the air. Her target will inhale the poison and start to see the things that Fuen chooses, like caves, moths, or allies of the target trying to kill the target. When her target is imprisoned in her genjutsu, Fuen charges and kills her target.
Poison Senbon: The user jumps up and throws the some amount poisoned senbon into the opponent with a swing.
Poisonous Claw: User rushes at the enemy and attacks with poison-lubricated Metal Gauntlets, leaving a trail of poisonous claws.
Polarised Sand Formation: Hot Sand Camou: The user infuses chakra by placing both hands on the ground, making sand particles polarise which is able to bend light, they erupt in the direction of the users comrades, covering them and rendering them invisible and much harder to detect, save by a sensor. This technique appears to require ample time to perform for the build-up of chakra.
Possession: Possession is a unique ability possessed by Black Zetsu allows it to take advantage of its malleable body to coat itself over a target. This technique is mainly used to restrict the movement of the target by coating a target's body, and forcibly make them do its bidding by directly channelling its will through them. In possession of the target's body, Black Zetsu is also able to use target's techniques, kekkei genkai, as well as any other ability they may possess. By using this technique, Black Zetsu can perform various feats including controlling the target, and even stabilising their life force allowing them to live following a mortally-taxing event.
Power Bomb: The user jumps up into the air, lands a couple powerful physical attacks, grabs there opponent, and powerbombs them.
Power of the Hokage: Tsunade enters Sannin Mode and punches her enemy's abdomen (warning them to brace themselves) with such might that in slow motion it appears as though he or she will be snapped in two. They're pushed backwards at tremendous speed, however, razing through a field of trees until they're finally stopped by a large boulder, which causes Tsunade's opponent to take even more damage. Shortly afterwards, a volcano erupts in the background as a result of the punch's power, dyeing the battlefield crimson. Tsunade, straightening herself up, is left wondering whether she perhaps went too far.
Power of the Sage: Jiraiya uses his Wild Lion's Mane Technique to extend his hair, then swings it 360 degrees to slam the opponent and send them flying into the air. He then uses the Fire Release: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet on the opponent and slams his Rasengan onto them, absorbing the fire chakra and forms into the Fire Release: Great Flame Rasengan with a white orb inside instead of black. The Rasengan is released from Jiraiya's hand, and instead of an explosion of fire, when the opponent hits the ground like the Great Flame Rasengan, a small cyclone composed of flame appears and after disappearing for a few seconds, rain made of fire falls to the ground at a dramatic speed.
Prepared Needle Shot: Shizune wears a device on her forearm that's loaded with five senbon. While contained within the device, the senbon are immersed in a poison potent enough to leave victims near-death from a mere scratch. The device is fired by pulling an attached string, which quickly shoots the five senbon at any target Shizune aims at. Because of how the device is configured, the senbon cannot be fired individually. However, by channeling her chakra into the string, Shizune can alter the trajectory of the senbon, either to concentrate them on one point, spread them over a larger area, or even change the direction of the senbon from what the device is aimed at. Shizune generally uses this as a surprise attack, as the device is hidden by her sleeve, is not bulky enough to be noticed, and furthermore she does not give the impression of being able to fight, thus lowering an opponent's guard.
Prepared Puppet: Eight Waves of Needles: Sasori, while inside of his puppet Hiruko, makes the puppet spit a rapid stream of countless senbon from its mouth, in a fashion similar to a machine gun. These senbon can be poisoned for increased lethality.
Pressure Points of Harm and Death: Guren releases two tenketsu points to greatly increase her chakra and physical capabilities for a short time by changing her life force into chakra. This allows the use of taxing techniques such as Crystal Release: String of Glory. The amount of chakra released is so much that it becomes visible and causes water to form a vortex around her, similar to the one caused by opening the "Sixth Gate of Joy" from the Eight Gates. Her eyes also turn completely white momentarily.
Pressurisation: Jūgo grows his hand to great proportions and swats at his opponent.
Preta Path: The grants the user the ability to absorb chakra in any form. Pain channelled the Preta Path through the corpse of a Kusagakure shinobi.
Prison Flame Funeral: Sasuke slashes his opponent with both an electrified sword and a black flame sword, before using Amaterasu.
Prison Gate Palm Bottom: A delivers a series of palm strikes to the opponent, with the last one sending the opponent into the air.
Prison Sand Burial: Using his chakra, Gaara breaks open the earth and uses his sand to pull a target up to two hundred metres underground; targets are dragged down so quickly that they cannot escape it. Because of the depth that they're buried at, targets are rendered unable to move even a finger. Gaara then applies additional pressure to them with the sand, crushing them to death. Tō no Sho likens this technique to the larva pits of antlions.
Prisoner Cursed Seal: The user applies a red seal on the prisoner's neck, should they be granted limited movement outside prison. The user can instantly activate the seal to kill the prisoner should they disobey orders. Also, if they are a certain distance away from the user or the user is killed, the seal will automatically kill the branded. If close enough and facing it, the user can remove it with a Seal of Confrontation.
Problem Children of the Academy: Naruto, Konohamaru, and Iruka throw their fūma shuriken at the opponent. Then Naruto and Konohamaru perform their Sexy Technique, sending Iruka flying towards the opponent, knocking them out of the sky. Afterwards, Iruka hits both Naruto and Konohamaru in the head.
Projection Technique: This technique enables the user to make a hologram of themselves in order to send a message.
Protecting Eight Trigrams One Hundred Tw: This is the upgraded version of the Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms. This technique sends out an outward burst of the chakra dome created.
Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Pal: Created by Hinata, this is a highly versatile technique which affords both offensive and defensive capabilities whereby she emits a constant stream of chakra from her palms, which are formed into extremely thin, sharp, blades.
Protective Cloth Dome: Maki uses her cloth for defensive means by wrapping it around her and any nearby allies, she can form a protective barrier. The cloth can be made around a nearby object such as a rock, to better hold down the fortification. If the cloth is made wet by a Water Release technique, it allows the dome to defend against powerful heat-based attacks.
Protective Sphere of Light: This is a technique in which Shion's bell illuminates and negates any negative occurence. It was powerful enough to protect Shion from Mōryō's darkness.
Psycho Mind Transmission: The user enters the target's subconscious by placing a hand on the target's head and extracts any information needed, even if the target has forgotten it or has had it blocked. A special device can be used to decrease the time it takes to read the target's mind and allows other ninja to assist. Memories that have mental blocks on them will require longer periods of time to probe through and obtain however.
Pulverisation: Jūgo grows many jet-like appendages to propel himself towards his opponent, and lands a series of punches and swipes.
Puppet Curse: Hiruko uses this technique to take control of people. It can be activated long after the technique is first applied. The appearance is a red eye with another circle in it resembling the pupil, with four lines stemming from the upper line of the eye and two big thick lines stemming from the side of the eye. This power seems to control the minds of others as it appeared on Kakashi Hatake's forehead, vanished, then took control over his body. The eyes of the person who get caught by this technique turn red while they are being controlled.
Puppet Imitation Technique: After taking a sample of the target's hair with the use of a puppet, the user forms a specific hand seal, and takes control of the target.
Puppet Performance: One in Body and Soul: Chiyo uses the Mother and Father puppets to attack the opponent with a flurry of attacks.
Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement: A puppet performance technique where chakra threads are attached to various spots on a person's body; the head, torso, both arms, and both legs. The person being manipulated gains the ability to not only use their own techniques, but the skills of the puppeteer as well.
Puppet Reincarnation: As a last resort, Toneri summons countless Byakugan from the disintegrated Energy Vessel and infuses them into himself. The Byakugan seemingly grants him immense power, which he claimed to be capable of bringing about the end of the world. However, the true power of this technique is never shown as he was exposed to sunlight, affecting the chakra in the Byakugan and surpassing his chakra capacity limit, making the technique highly unstable and impossible to control. The sunlight also caused the technique to go berserk and mutate the user into an unstable white mass with a large mouth protruding from the back, which would lead to Toneri either melting or exploding.
Puppet Scatter Shot: Kankurō uses Karasu to shoot multiple poison covered kunai from its body at his opponent.
Puppet Smoke Bombs: Kankurō jumps and then makes his puppet Karasu shoot smoke bombs at an angle the poison smoke will spread and damage them nearby.
Puppet Technique: The Puppet Technique is the core skill of a fighting style, whereby they control a puppet.
Puppet Technique: Bishamon: While inside his puppet Hiruko, Sasori sends the puppet's iron tail towards the opponent, hitting them repeatedly and causing them to fall to the ground. Finally he stabs them in the torso with a powerful thrust of the tail.
Puppet Technique: Combo Attack: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long sword (or spear) from different sides, after which he himself jumps into the air with a sword, and together with the puppet they fall on the enemy, piercing him.
Puppet Technique: Heavy Blade Warehouse: While inside his puppet Hiruko, Sasori summons two large torpedo-shaped containers. When opened, the two containers release thousands of kunai that pierce into the target's body. Then, another set of kunai are loaded into the wooden cylinders attached to the containers. When opened, a full load of kunai with multiple explosive tags attached to each are shot to the ground near the target. They then detonate, causing a large explosion.
Puppet Technique: Prosthetic Arm Senbon: While inside of his puppet Hiruko, Sasori fires the puppet's torpedo-shaped left arm towards the enemy. The arm rotates at high speed, launching the wooden cylinders attached to it. The cylinders then open, each one releasing a large amount of senbon, creating a quick rain of poisoned needles in all directions.
Puppet Technique: Spear: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long spear, easily inflicting injuries even on an opponent with the Sharingan.
Puppet Technique: Sword: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long sword.
Puppet Water Release: Dance of Mystic Ra: The puppeteer wraps the enemy with chakra strings in an effort to bind and restrict their movements, and then has their puppets spew water onto the opponent. This technique was especially effective on Gaara as it prevented him from manipulating his sand which was soaked in water.
Puppet White Attack: While under the control of Kaguya, Hamura kicks his opponent into the air then activates his Byakugan and leaps after them, unleashing a rapid barrage of punches and then a single powerful strike with his right hand, knocking them back to the ground.
Puppet-Cursing Sphere: Toneri moulds his chakra into the form of a green-coloured sphere. The sphere can be used for various purposes such as controlling targets by entering their body, rendering a target unconscious, absorbing chakra from a distance, and detonating if needed.
Puppet: Burning Blade: After using Karasu and Kuroari to strike the opponent, Kankurō then proceeds to use his Sanshōuo puppet to launch a burning attack towards the opponent causing massive damage.
Puppet: Corpse Crow: Kankurō has Karasu tackle the opponent, breaking its own body apart in the process. Kankurō then uses the puppet parts to deliver a series of swift strikes to the opponent, after which Karasu picks the target's body up and carries them through the air, with the finishing blow being a strong slam into the ground.
Puppet: Dance of the Cherry Blossom: Chiyo uses chakra threads to control Sakura and dozens of kunai at the same time. Sakura runs at the opponent and Chiyo launches the kunai behind her, using Sakura to hide them from the opponent's view. At the last second, Sakura is pulled back by the threads, the opponent taking the shower of kunai. Then, Sakura jumps up high and comes down at the opponent preparing a chakra-enhanced punch, Chiyo adding extra momentum by pulling her down with the strings. Finally, Sakura punches the opponent creating a gigantic crater.
Puppet: Degeneration: Kankurō sends his puppet, Crow, rapidly dashing toward the opponent. Crow's six hands then project spikes and stab the opponent, sending them crashing to the ground. Crow then slams them with the spikes when they are on the ground.
Puppet: Demon Castle Mask: Kankurō has Karasu deliver a few swift slashes to the opponent, after which Kuroari opens itself up, dropping a bunch of explosives onto the opponent. Kankurō proceeds to take cover within Sanshōuo as the grenades detonate.
Puppet: Early Summer Rain: Kankurō uses Karasu and Kuroari to shower the opponent with bombs.
Puppet: Father and Mother: The Mother and Father puppets join hands, extending a razor wire that Chiyo uses to initiate a flurry of deadly attacks. The wire is strong enough to slice cleanly through the Third Kazekage puppet's Thousand Hands technique.
Puppet: Inexhaustible Explosive Blades: Karasu's four arms open and shoot a barrage of kunai with explosive tags attached, which home in on the opponent and explode on impact.
Puppet: Iron Sand Prison Mass: Sasori uses the Third Kazekage puppet to release a spike of Iron Sand at the opponent that then drills them into some rocks. He then makes a huge cube of iron sand to fall on the opponent, crushing them.
Puppet: Revolving Blade Heavenly Drill: Kankurō has Karasu sprout many poison-covered blades on his arms and mouth and sends them spinning towards the opponent like a tornado, slashing them several times. After launching the opponent into the air, Karasu explodes near them. Karasu is unharmed by this explosion.
Puppet: Rotation Attack: This is a technique used by Mukade while in his Ultimate Form. By taking advantage of his puppet body, Mukade extends additional blades and spikes on his centipede-segmented body. He then spins his own body at every joint, creating powerful gusts of wind and inflicting massive area damage to his vicinity.
Puppet: Shadow Actor: Kankurō attacks his opponent using close-range taijutsu, then, as his face begins to crack, Kankurō is revealed to be Kuroari in disguise, and the real Kankurō is controlling the puppet from within the cloth on his back. Kankurō then uses Kuroari to capture the opponent.
Puppet: Spewing Bullet: Kankurō detaches the head of his puppet, Karasu, just as the opponent is approaching. Its head then projects a spike from its mouth, stabbing the opponent.
Puppet: Spring Punishing Strike: Using her Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body, Chiyo launches Sakura high into the air to deliver a chakra-enhanced punch. It was powerful enough to destroy Sasori's ultimate defence, Hiruko.
Pure Land of Paradise: Tsunade punches the ground, creating a shockwave that launches her opponent in mid-air. Then using her chakra enhanced strength, she punches the falling opponent in the gut with such force that it sends them flying up into the sky.
Quaking Leg: Sakura concentrates chakra into her foot and then stomps down on the opponent with tremendous force. A follow-up kick can be used directly after the stomp.
Quarantine Wall: Using his shield as a medium, Renga creates a massive chakra barrier. It is strong enough to withstand a bomb detonation.
Quicksand Waterfall Flow: Using his personal sand, Gaara grinds up rocks and minerals underground into a huge volume of sand that he brings above ground. The earth shakes as the sand surfaces, which Gaara then manipulates like a tsunami that he crashes against his targets. Targets are battered multiple times by the waves of sand as it spreads throughout the area. When the sand settles, the landscape is dramatically altered, taking on the appearance of a barren desert. Gaara can then use this sand to perform additional attacks, such as Sand Waterfall Imperial Funeral.
Quicksand Waterfall Flow: Poison: Gaara performs Quicksand Waterfall Flow with Kankurō coating the sand wave with poison.
Rabbit Hair Needle: The Rabbit Hair Needle is a Kekkei Mōra taijutsu used by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki.
Raging Pounce: Hana attacks her opponent with rapid strikes, slicing them with her sharp claws. A more powerful version of this technique allows Hana to summon the Three Haimaru Brothers, who fall upon the opponent from above, pinning them to the ground before tearing them with their fangs.
Raging Snakes: Orochimaru, in his true form, attacks the opponent with a multitude of white snakes from his own body and finishes the opponent with a slash from his Sword of Kusanagi that came out of his mouth.
Raging Thunder: is a sword technique utilised by Temujin by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel.
Rain Tiger at Will Technique: The Rain Tiger at Will Technique is a contact-type perception ninjutsu, allowing one to freely manipulate rain infused with the user's own chakra.
Rain of Spiders: Kidōmaru summons Kyodaigumo high above his target. Kyodaigumo then produces a sac of baby spiders, which Kidōmaru cuts open to release them. The many baby spiders rain down on the target, spinning out strings of chakra as they fall. Because the baby spiders are so numerous, targets cannot avoid all of them, inevitably leading them to be wrapped in the chakra strings. Once caught by the strings, it is extremely difficult to escape; upon falling prey to this technique, Neji Hyūga was unable to spin for his Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven.
Rampaging Barrage: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto delivers a series of punches to the opponent and finishes with a kick.
Rapid Fire: Kusune uses Tsurukame to fire massive amounts of thick senbon.
Rasengan: The Rasengan is a jutsu that takes form as a spinning ball of chakra, invented by Minato Namikaze.
Rasengan Connection: Naruto creates a shadow clone that charges chakra in his palm while kicking the enemy before disappearing, leaving the real Naruto to use the fully charged Rasengan.
Rasengan: \"Ensemble\": Naruto, in his Six Paths Sage Mode and Kawaki utilising his Scientific Ninja Tool alterations, attack the opponent and finish them by attacking from both sides with a Rasengan and a chakra blast from Kawaki's Kāma.
Rasengan: \"Unison\": While activating their respective Kāma, one person channels their energy into the other, greatly increasing the size and explosive power of the Rasengan.
Rasengan: \"Uzuhiko\": Rasengan: "Uzuhiko" is a unique Rasengan variant developed by Boruto Uzumaki that harnesses the user's own chakra along with what Boruto calls planetary chakra—energy generated by the centrifugal force that works alongside the planet’s rotation and
Rasengan: Aerial Attack: Naruto and a couple shadow clones string together a series of physical attacks, and jump in the air to finish with a triple strike, consisting in a kunai slash, a kick, and a Rasengan.
Rasengan: Crown of the Head: Naruto attacks his opponent along aside a couple of shadow clones, stringing a few hits, throws a shadow clone at the opponent, and finishes it with a Rasengan to their head, created with a third shadow clone.
Rasengan: Flash: After infusing Kurama's chakra into Naruto's Wind Release: Rasengan, he fires it as a beam, which has enough power to clear an explosion, or uses it to propel himself into the air.
Rasengan: Hail: Naruto uses shadow clones to land a few hits on his opponent, briefly stunning them. He and two shadow clones use the stunned opponent as a stepping stone to jump back up in the air, Naruto sends a volley of shadow clones crashing at the opponent, and finally lands a Rasengan.
Rasengan: Nosedive: Naruto punches his opponent up in the air, sends in two shadow clones to hold them down as they fall, and then lands two Rasengan right on the opponent.
Rasengan: Parachute: Naruto punches his opponent into the air, creates two shadow clones that jump in the air as well, and creates a third to help him form a Rasengan. The two clones hold his opponent down as they fall, with Naruto jumping towards the opponent and landing the Rasengan.
Rasenshuriken: Orange: Pursuit Attack: Naruto forms three orange coloured Rasenshuriken by himself and throws one after the other at the opponent.
Ravaging Chakra Knives: Kagura will sink several knives attached to strings of chakra underground and shoot up from the ground under the opponent, launching them into the air. While the enemy is in the air, Kagura will release chakra strings and restrict the opponent, pulling them to her, while throwing several chakra strings with knives directly at them. She finishes the opponent off by slamming them into the ground.
Red Chakra: After entering his jinchūriki form, Naruto is consumed in red chakra and throws a strong punch to the opponent's face. He then grabs their face, flips them around, and smacks the opponent into the ground. Ending it, Naruto gathers his chakra and runs toward the opponent to deliver a devastating uppercut.
Red Flash: Minato throws a Flying Thunder God Kunai in front of the opponent and Kushina appears where it lands, hitting the target with a frying pan. Minato goes above the opponent and uses Rasengan, and Kushina finishes with a powerful punch that breaks the ground.
Red Secret Technique: Machinery Triangle: Using the Sasori puppet, Kankurō detaches its head and launches several triangular blades with explosive balls attached to them from the neck and palms of the puppet.
Red Secret Technique: Performance of a H: To begin this technique, Sasori removes one summoning scroll from his back. He then opens his right chest compartment to emit more than a hundred chakra strings, which reach into the scroll. From the scroll, more than a hundred puppets wearing red cloaks emerge.
Red Secret Technique: Red Sea: Using the flamethrowers attached to the puppet Sasori, the user fires a spreading wave of flames at the opponent.
Red-Banded Snake: Orochimaru releases several snakes from his sleeves that attack the opponent and then lift them into the air, where the snakes then detach from him and spin around the opponent whilst attacking them multiple times before dispersing.
Redaku Reincarnation Ninjutsu: This reincarnation ninjutsu is one of the many subjects documented at the centuries-old Astronomy Research Institute, an archive of knowledge for the Land of Redaku. A few years prior to the events of Sasuke Retsuden, Zansūru, an archaeologist, deciphered enough of the relevant research to learn how to use this technique. However, because he was not a ninja, he recruited Jiji to perform it on his behalf. A few decades prior to this, Orochimaru visited the Institute to research this technique, ultimately stealing a few of the more valuable documents for his own purposes and using what he learned to improve upon Tobirama Senju's Impure World Reincarnation.
Regeneration Ability: The Regeneration Ability is a power lying inside the cells of Hashirama Senju, which is able to heal the injuries of anyone imbued with them in mere moments.
Repent!: Kushina hits her opponent with a frying pan several times and delivers a series of kicks. Then, she uses her pan to send the opponent flying into the air.
Repulsion Technique: By expelling a significant amount of chakra from their palm, the user can generate a powerful repulsive force capable of pushing targets at a considerable distance. This technique can also be employed defensively, allowing the user to unleash it from any point on their body to negate the force of an enemy attack.
Resonance Blast: Obito grows a large tree from beneath the ground with four flowers that forms four large Tailed Beast Balls. To ensure the balls would not miss, Obito had used Six Red Yang Formation to contain the blast, although the Allied Shinobi Forces had teleported outside the barrier to avoid it. The resultant explosion was strong enough to completely distort the shape of the unbreakable barrier.
Resonating Echo Drill: Dosu Kinuta uses the Resonating Echo Speaker worn on his arm to generate powerful sound waves. The Speaker amplifies sounds from the arm's mere movements, but can make even louder sounds if the Speaker is physically struck. Dosu can direct the sound waves based on how he moves his arm, or he can guide them at a specific target using his chakra; because the attack uses sound, it can't be blocked. The sound damages his target's semicircular canals, throwing them off balance so that they can't stand, move, or fight. Additional side-effects include bleeding ears, distorted vision, and vomiting.
Retreating Tear Sever: Mifune jumps back and draws his sword. His drawing is so fast it creates a shockwave that damages his opponent.
Return of the Devil: Suigetsu first uses his Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique on the opponent, damaging them and leaving them in the air. He then strikes them down, crashing the opponent onto the ground with his Kubikiribōchō sword.
Reverse Four Symbols Sealing: The Reverse Four Symbols Sealing is a powerful fūinjutsu activated upon the user's death. The user must, beforehand, place the seal across their chest. Upon activation, it releases four symbols from the user's own blood that then forms a large, black sphere around them. Anything caught inside the sphere's area is then drawn in and sealed within the user's corpse.
Reverse Lotus: The user first opens at least three of the Eight Gates, removing their body's limitations on their maximum speed. Once this is done, the user - who is so fast that it's difficult to follow their movements - continually strikes the target from multiple directions, pummelling them into the air. When Rock Lee uses Reverse Lotus on Gaara, Gaara's Shield of Sand is unable to react fast enough to protect him. As Lee attacks Gaara, he gradually wraps Gaara with the bandages he wears, allowing him to better manoeuvre Gaara to deliver a finishing blow that sends him crashing back to the ground.
Reverse Mist Beheading: After creating several shadow clones which surround the enemy and attack them simultaneously forcing them to jump into the air, the real user will then attack them from above.
Reverse Summoning Technique: Like the standard Summoning Technique, this technique allows the user to transport a target to a location. But whereas the regular Summoning Technique functions identically from one use to the next, the Reverse Summoning Technique has had two distinct uses seen in the series:
Reverse White Secret Technique: The Uema: After taking control of ten bodies, the user lets them attack a single spot from all sides at once, leaving little to no time to react.
Reversible Technique: Ordering one of his giant snakes to completely swallow a target, Orochimaru has the snake shed its skin. Orochimaru then commands the snake to immediately digest the target.
Revival Fist: By gathering dark chakra into both hands, the user can unleash a powerful and focused shock wave that, when it hits a person at close range, will cause tremendous internal damage.
Revolt of the Demon World: Tayuya plays a melody - her "finale" - with the Demonic Flute, causing many-mouthed, worm-like spirits made of chakra to emerge from the mouths of the Doki. The chakra of the spirits is almost entirely spiritual energy, causing them to ravenously seek out physical energy in order to achieve balance. Tayuya's melody directs the spirits at her targets, who they pursue in so complicated a pattern as to resemble dancing. When the spirits pass through the targets, they take bites of physical energy. Because of their immaterial form, the spirits are impervious to direct attack. As such, the target's only chance of stopping the spirits is to either prevent Tayuya from playing her flute or to neutralise the Doki.
Revolving Throw: Yagura strikes his opponent with a few water attacks using his staff, and finishes by hooking them with it and throwing them far back.
Right Pinching Melody: While the opponent's attention is on Sakon, Ukon jumps behind them to slam his fists down on their head.
Righteous Fist Thrust: The user strikes their opponent with a chakra enhanced punch, sending them flying. When reinforced, the user dashes forward and delivers the punch.
Rinne Sharingan: The is a dōjutsu kekkei mōra and the predecessor to the Rinnegan and Sharingan. It is characterised by red sclerae and irides, with a ripple pattern spreading over the eyeball and nine tomoe.
Rinne Six Paths: The Six Paths of Pain simultaneously punch the opponent, then Asura Path throws them in the air and the other Paths impale them with their black receivers.
Rinnegan: The is reputed as the most exalted eye amongst the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Sharingan and the Byakugan, and the strongest dōjutsu. It is said that in times of disorder, one who wields the Rinnegan is sent down from the heavens to become either a "God of Creation" who will calm the world or a "God of Destruction" who will reduce everything to nothingness. The Rinnegan is characterised by concentric circles covering the eyeball.
Rising Bomber: Killer B charges lightning-natured chakra through his arm, and runs towards his opponent in a similar manner to the Lightning Release: Lariat.
Rising Sun: Itachi ignites Amaterasu on a rock behind the opponent, then he ignites Amaterasu again buring a hole behind the opponent to scare him. Itachi then ignites a final Amaterasu that burns the opponent and creates a huge crater.
Rivalling Wills: Madara instructs Hashirama to follow his lead and uses Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation on Hashirama's wood dragon to make the dragon so hot it glows red and attacks their opponent. Once the opponent is pinned down, Hashirama uses Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity of a World of Trees to restrain the opponent while Madara uses Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation to burn the forest. Hashirama then taunts Madara if that's all he's got by creating a deeper forest and Madara responds by creating an even bigger and stronger fire, resulting in a massive explosion.
Roaring Run: Great Strength Ice Strike: A powerful technique used by Mizore Fuyukuma in which he surfs on his snowboard towards the opponent, after which he attacks the opponent with his Retractable Cable Arm, slamming them into a large chunk of ice.
Rock Armour: The user flows earth-chakra through their body, absorbing the properties of earth around them to form a skin-deep armour that is transparent and is only visible when light reflects off it. The armour is shown to be able to defend from all forms of blunt-force trauma. At the same time, it enhances the user's strength, allowing them to deliver powerful strikes and break free of restraints. Because this technique works by constantly absorbed earth properties, it requires no extra chakra after initiating it, yet still needs a sufficient amount of stone to be performed.
Rock Avalanche: The user causes a rockslide by sending a wave of electric energy into a cliff. However, this technique is extremely location-based and needs to be done uphill of a mountain for it to be effective.
Rock Avalanche Formation: Several shinobi enter a formation in which they are standing on one another's shoulders, and then proceed towards the enemy, walling the opponent so they can't escape.
Rock Clone Technique: The user expels earth from their mouth to form it into one or several identical clones. Unlike other clones, ones generated by this method do not disappear when struck with sufficient force, but rather break apart.
Rock Hive: The user creates a bee hive made of rock. This hive houses the giant bee larva which consumes chakra.
Rocket Rasengan: Mecha-Naruto uses his Rasengan which is a light purple colour after propelling itself towards the opponent. As the Rasengan hits the opponent, Mecha-Naruto "shoots" his hand along with the Rasengan, further damaging the opponent.
Rockslide Genjutsu: This technique casts an illusion on multiple targets, making them perceive multiple large explosions going off. From this, the victims will see the ground around them collapsing, disorienting them and leave them confused and panicked. This technique does not appear to be very powerful as an individual can negate it themselves and all others around them without direct contact on the fellow victims.
Rolling Pin Shuriken: The user throws a rolling pin at the opponent like a shuriken, dealing physical damage.
Roof Tile Shuriken: This technique allows Hiruzen to remotely control, levitate and hurl spinning tiles in the nearby area. In addition to being able to control the tiles remotely, he was able to pressurise them with chakra to make them far stronger than normal.
Root Explosive Entombment: Danzō sprouts large roots from his arm and digs them into the ground rise beneath the opponent.
Rope Escape Technique: A tenet of shinobi is that they must escape any situation, no matter how difficult things may seem. Accordingly, this is the first jutsu taught in Konohagakure's Ninja Academy. When the user is bound, they do what they can to escape, such as by finding a way to untie the knot or dislocating their joints in order to get free of the bindings. Although this is the most basic of the escape-based jutsu, it is still fairly complicated to perform. At first, Naruto appeared not to know how to use the technique.
Rotating Destruction Slash: Darui jumps in the air, deliver a series of attacks with his swords, and finishes the string with a powerful, downwards spin, sending his opponent crashing into the ground.
Rotating Ferocious Wind: This is a technique used with the Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, which creates a large gust of wind. When Seimei united the swords with the other three special weapons from Takumi Village, the gust of wind transformed into a very strong whirlwind.
Rotating Funeral: Obito absorbs his opponent and releases them in the middle of multiple detonating explosive tags.
Rough Rampage: Jirōbō elbows the opponent, slams them, drags them through the stage and then throws them.
Rough Sea Barrier: The Rough Sea Barrier is a Space–Time Ninjutsu that allows Isobu to materalise a bubble-like entrance to a separate dimension in which it could hide its presence until it is ready to return to wherever it chooses.
Rough Sea Splash: Yagura knocks the opponent underwater, before transforming into Isobu. While transformed as Isobu, he rams the opponent out of the water, and finishes them off by spitting a stream of water directly at them.
Round Moon: Sasuke jumps up in the air, lands a few fast spinning hits with his sword, and crashes down at his opponent with Chidori.
Ruining Sand Waterfall Burial: Gaara creates a zigzag fissure of sand under the opponent. The zigzag fissure then erupts into the face of Shukaku which devours and seals the opponent away in 200 metres of sand. Gaara will then place his hand on the ground and have the sand compacts itself with such a force that only a giant crater, 200 metres deep is left crushing the enemy into nothingness.
Rumoured Endeavour Star: Might Guy opens several chakra gates, jumps high into the sky shaped like a star and crashes down onto the opponent, creating an explosion.
Runt Ball Rasengan: The user creates a miniature-sized Rasengan through limited supplies of chakra. The full effect of the technique is unknown as Naruto collapsed before using it.
Rupture: The user violently swings their chakra-enhanced sword with the intention of striking an approaching opponent, releasing a wave of chakra to cut a target.
Ryūmyaku Chakra Control: By controlling the vast chakra flowing from the , the user is able to convert the chakra and use it in various ways including to power up an entire city and control a large number of puppets. If not stopped, the user would have an unlimited source of energy to feed off of.
Ryūmyaku: Great Dragon Fire: Mukade shoots purple flames from his puppet body's mouth using the Ryūmyaku chakra. The attack leaves a residue of purple flame around the area.
Ryūmyaku: Super Great Dragon Fire Techni: Using more of the Ryūmyaku chakra, Mukade shoots a larger, more powerful version of the Ryūmyaku: Great Dragon Fire from his puppet body's stomach. He states that this is his greatest technique. Unlike its lesser version, this technique doesn't simply burn targets but instead causes a massive explosion that can create a crater in the ground, and it does not leave any residual purple flames.
Sadistic Combination: Kakuzu delivers multiple punches to the opponent and then finishes them with wind and fire techniques.
Sage Art Wood Release: True Several Thou: The Sage Art Wood Release: True Several Thousand Hands is a technique which creates a titanic, many-handed wooden statue that can be freely controlled by the user.
Sage Art: Amphibian Technique: This technique is used by Shima and Fukasaku to fuse with Jiraiya. It maximises the sage chakra for the person they are fused to and allows them to access Sage Mode. This also allows Fukasaku and Shima to continuously gather natural energy for Jiraiya, as he cannot do so himself while on the move, thus eliminating the weakness of exhausting all of his natural energy in battle. Fukasaku and Shima were not able to fuse with Naruto Uzumaki because Kurama rejected them.
Sage Art: Big Ball Spiralling Drop: Inst: Using both Kurama and Sage Modes, Naruto forms a Giant Rasengan and Tobirama teleports him above the opponent to strike them down.
Sage Art: Five Fire Gods' Fan of Flames: While in Sage Mode, the user is able to summon a massive wall of flames, scorching everything around them. The technique can also be used as a smokescreen to conceal their escape.
Sage Art: Five Fire Gods' Fan of Flames:: Koji traps the opponent in the terrain altered swamp, sets them ablaze with a flame bullet, summons a pillar of flames beneath them, then finishes them by surrounding himself in a large expanding sphere of fire.
Sage Art: Frog Call: After focusing Senjutsu chakra to their throats, both Fukasaku and Shima croak together in unison, releasing large, loud and immensely powerful sound waves that effectively annoy, distract and temporarily paralyse any afflicted targets completely.
Sage Art: Frog Call Spiral: Jiraiya and Naruto both enter Sage Mode, following with Fukasaku and Shima stunning the opponent with their croaking sound waves as Naruto throws a Rasenshuriken.
Sage Art: Gate of the Great God: Sage Art: Gate of the Great God is a sealing technique utilised by Hashirama Senju while in Sage Mode.
Sage Art: Goemon: Sage Art: Goemon is a cooperation technique used by Jiraiya with Shima and Fukasaku.
Sage Art: Great Snake Lightning: A senjutsu enhanced version of the original, the user shoots cyan lightning shaped like snakes.
Sage Art: Great Snake Lightning: White S: The user dashes towards the opponent in Sage Mode, attacks them with their snakes and finishes them with the lightning chakra snakes.
Sage Art: Ink-Splatter Rasenshuriken: After accessing the power of Gyūki, Naruto forms a Rasenshuriken in ink.
Sage Art: Inorganic Reincarnation: The Sage Art: Inorganic Reincarnation allows the user to breathe life into inorganic substances by filling the atmosphere with natural energy.
Sage Art: Lava Release Rasenshuriken: A powerful technique whereby Naruto, after accessing Son Gokū's power, creates a Rasenshuriken with a lava-infused nucleus, the heat of which causes the blades themselves to emit steam. The technique is strong enough to destroy a target's legs, and when expanded, it was powerful enough to bisect the Ten-Tails' tree form completely.
Sage Art: Lightning Cage Border Jail: Madara has his shadows take on a square formation and create a beam of lightning, going from shadow to shadow, which close onto the opponent in the middle of the formation.
Sage Art: Magnet Release Rasengan: A technique that's available to Naruto after inheriting the Sage of the Six Paths' powers. By combining his Rasengan with Shukaku's Magnet Release to reinforce its suction power, he creates a Rasengan with the beast's cursed seal markings. He then smashes the sphere into his opponent in the same manner as a normal Rasengan. Upon being struck with this technique, the markings quickly spread across the target's body and immobilises them.
Sage Art: Many Ultra-Big Ball Spiralling: The Sage Art: Many Ultra-Big Ball Spiralling Serial Spheres is a technique utilised by Naruto Uzumaki which enhances his Rasengan with natural energy.
Sage Art: Scattering Rage Technique: Kabuto expels numerous white dragons to attack the opponent.
Sage Art: Storm Release Light Fang: The user infuses Storm Release with senjutsu chakra to fire a sharp, thin stream of light from their mouth. It is powerful enough to cut clean through a Truth-Seeking Ball. As it travels at the speed of light, it is described as being impossible to dodge.
Sage Art: Super Tailed Beast Rasenshurik: This is an "ultimate technique" created by Naruto Uzumaki using the power given to him by the Sage of Six Paths. Naruto and eight of his shadow clones each form a Rasenshuriken that's been imbued with the unique chakra of a different tailed beast; Naruto's reason for using such a varied attack is because he doesn't know which type of chakra Kaguya Ōtsutsuki would be weak to. When the nine thrown Rasenshuriken strike Kaguya, multiple large explosions are created. Although Kaguya herself is not noticeably hurt by the attack, the tailed beasts' chakra contained within the Rasenshuriken resonates with the tailed beasts' chakra within Kaguya, preventing her from maintaining her humanoid form. Jin no Sho describes this as, "the most marvellous ninjutsu of all time."
Sage Art: White Rage Technique: The Sage Art: White Rage Technique is a senjutsu used by those who studied in the Ryūchi Cave and mastered the Sage Transformation. After forming the necessary hand seals, the user expels a dragon-like entity from their mouth that carries an orb in its left front claw. As the dragon tightly coils itself around the orb, it releases both blinding light and deafening sound by making the air oscillate. This alone greatly hinders those in the vicinity but, due to the intensity of the resulting vibrations, paralysing pain is also induced. Thus, the technique both briefly inhibits the opponent's senses, as well as techniques that require their active concentration.
Sage Art: Wind Release Dust Cloud: Shima exhales a massive cloud of dust from her mouth, which is thick enough that it is capable of blocking the target's vision completely. The dust cloud is also large enough to hide a summon as large as Gamabunta.
Sage Art: Wood Release: Ground Pulse: Hashirama's giant wood statue pokes a finger on the ground, causing wood to erupt from the ground, hitting his opponent.
Sage Art: Wood Release: Wood Dragon Danc: Hashirama's gigantic wood statue causes a wood dragon to erupt from the ground and strike his opponent.
Sage Art: Yin Release Lightning Dispatch: The Sage Art: Yin Release Lightning Dispatch is a ninjutsu used by Madara Uchiha.
Sage Combo: While in Sage Mode, Naruto creates four shadow clones, two that attack the opponent and two that help Naruto create Rasenshuriken, the attacking clones kick the opponent up and down and then Naruto throws Rasenshuriken at the opponent.
Sage Transformation: is a way of attaining Sage Mode, using a bodily reaction exhibited by members of Jūgo's clan. By exposing their special body fluids to natural energy, they gain increased physical capabilities and the ability to perform various shape-shifting feats.
Sakura Blizzard Technique: Sakura throws a barrage of kunai attached with bags of small explosive tags and cherry blossom petals to help camouflage the tags. Sakura simply has to throw an additional kunai with an explosive tag to ignite the tags and catch the target in a large explosion.
Sakura Special Shuriken Throwing Techniq: Sakura throws five shuriken, which are connected to wires of chakra, chasing her opponent.
Samehada Colliding Explosion: Kisame delivers several slashes to his opponent with Samehada whilst releasing water blasting his opponent and finishing with a downward slash that results in a pillar of water rising up.
Samehada Wild Dance: Kisame slashes downward in a reap, then drags his Samehada along the enemy's shoulder then slashes them with a turn, draining their chakra before stabbing the enemy and slams them into the ground behind him.
Samehada's Gonna Shank Ya!: B begins with a a couple kicks, before standing on one hand and spinning, kicking his opponent with both legs as he does so, and also striking them with one of his swords in his other hand. Using the momentum of the spin, B gets back up and attacks the opponent three times with Samehada.
Samurai Sabre Technique: Unique to Samurai, this technique employs the concept of chakra flow in a similar manner to the Flying Swallow and Sword of Kusanagi: Chidori Katana techniques. Through the use of chakra flow, the user channels their chakra through their swords, extending both the reach and cutting ability of the blade, while allowing the user to fire crescents of chakra whenever the blade is swung. This released chakra is capable of great destruction, as shown from how these projectiles completely penetrated a considerable stone pillar, before continuing to damage the immediate surroundings.
Sand Binding Coffin: Using the sand he keeps stored in his Sand Gourd, Gaara immobilises his targets and captures them. Because the sand is naturally malleable, most of the target's usual methods for defence or escape become ineffective once they've been encased by it. They can only wait until Gaara releases or kills them. When killing his targets, Gaara tends to either let them suffocate or use Sand Waterfall Funeral.
Sand Binding Prison: A capturing ninjutsu that is characteristic to Gaara. Using ordinary sand, a perfectly airtight space is created, in which the enemy is captured. An enormous quantity of sand completely envelops the target from every direction and captures them. The speed, hardness, and scope of the sand depend on the amount of chakra poured into it. Gaara can fine-tune the sand's properties to the target's size and characteristics. No matter if the target is on the ground or flying in the air, it is almost impossible to escape from this technique. However, even if someone successfully escapes from it, Gaara can easily use one of his offensive techniques, like the Sand Binding Coffin, to immediately attack the target.
Sand Blade Double Attack: Gaara sends two streams of sand towards the opponent, one stream rises into the sky while the other slides through the ground. The sand stream on the ground hits the opponent and carries him up into the air. Once in midair both streams collide with each other, making the opponent the epicentre of the collision.
Sand Body: Firstly deconstructing the sand from his gourd, Gaara's body also changes into sand. In this form, Gaara is invulnerable to damage and can travel over long distances as a rushing sandstorm, as well as maintain control over sand. It can also be applied in battle, transforming parts of the body to increase manoeuvrability on the battlefield.
Sand Bullet: Gaara forms a small sphere made of sand and compresses it to increase its hardness. The sphere can strike opponents with such speed and force that it knocks them unconscious. He can also change its trajectory, to strike down multiple targets. By using this one small bullet, Gaara was able to defeat the Suna Assassin Captain along with all his subordinates.
Sand Castle Wolf Horn: The user surrounds their target in a vortex of swirling sand, which can be used as a medium for other sand techniques, like creating several Third Eyes, for information-gathering purposes.
Sand Characters: Sand Characters is a technique that utilises sand as a method of communication.
Sand Cloak Technique: The user cloaks the body of an ally with sand, acting like armour, which is strong enough to withstand a strong sandstorm without making the person flinch.
Sand Clone: The user shapes their sand into a lookalike of themselves that fights for them. Unlike other clone techniques, the sand clone's composition is usually obvious at all times, only taking user's shape and not their exact appearance. Because of this, the clone can be reverted to sand at any time, most often when being attacked; as it's punched or kicked, the user can use the clone's sand to immediately capture the opponent's limbs. Alternatively, the user can use the clone as a decoy, drawing opponents to it and once they're close enough, manipulating the clone's sand against them. Whereas other clones can only take so much damage before being destroyed, the user can reform the sand clone regardless of what happens to it.
Sand Cloud: Gaara gathers sand in the air that strikes down on the opponent.
Sand Cloud Circle: Gaara manipulates his sand to create a spinning pillar of sand and dust to rise up from beneath the opponent lifting them into the air.
Sand Cloud Dancing Rasengan: Gaara uses Sand Drizzle to knock out the opponent while Naruto finishes the combo with a well-placed Rasengan, stomping the enemy into the ground.
Sand Cloud Dark Coffin: Many Shukaku sand arms come out of the ground near the opponent and form a sphere around the opponent. After it is lifted into the air, a vortex of sand surrounds it and it detonates.
Sand Cruel Pursuit Interment: Gaara manipulates his sand to create multiple arms of Shukaku rise from the ground and converge on the opponent crushing them into the ground.
Sand Drizzle: Gaara forms small lumps of sand high in the air, which he has fall on a target like rain. Gaara can control the sand lumps with his chakra, allowing him to ensure they strike their target and even guide them towards the target's blind-spots. Because this control allows Gaara to strike the target from multiple directions at once, the target's attention will be focused upwards as they attempt to avoid it. As such, the technique is an effective distraction, allowing Gaara to use another source of sand to attack the target from underfoot. This ground-level sand, in addition to being useful for followup attacks, can also be used to immobilise the target, preventing them from escaping the Sand Drizzle.
Sand Encampment Wall: Gaara summons a series of solid pillars of sand that come out from the ground and rise up beneath the opponent damaging them.
Sand Exploding Sand Cluster: After using Sand Binding Coffin, Gaara creates a large boulder made of sand above himself. He then hurls the sand boulder at the opponent, crushing them.
Sand Formation Combo: First, Shishio turns his teammates invisible with his Hot Sand Camouflage so they can attack the enemy undetected, after which the invisible Kōji quickly moves behind the enemy several times, punching them with his sand fist, and finally, Ameno finishes the attack by slicing the enemy with the mantis's enormous aquatic mandibles.
Sand Formation: Shisa: The user generates one or multiple lion-like sand creatures to attack or subdue a target. They appear to be easily dispersed if struck hard enough.
Sand Hail: Sand Hail is a larger scale version of Gaara's Sand Drizzle.
Sand Hell: Gaara creates a sand arm beneath his opponent, throwing them up in the air. Then he grabs them with two sand arms, and slams them to the ground.
Sand Lightning Needles: This technique is very similar to Sand Drizzle. Gaara launches a large amount of sand in the sky to rain down on the opponent. The sand then forms into needles which stick into the ground and create an electrical charge that drains or otherwise neutralises electricity. Gaara uses this to disable Ranke's Plasma Ball.
Sand Mesh: Gaara uses his sand to create an expanding mesh, providing support and footing for his allies going after retreating enemies.
Sand Pillar: Gaara can form a sand pillar using the sand from the ground or by warping the lower half of his body into sand. Gaara manipulates the sand to suspend and manoeuvres himself in mid-air at high speeds. The sand maintains contact with the ground, thus creating a pillar-like formation.
Sand Prison Spear Attack: Gaara first encases his opponent with sand, immobilising them, and then creates a large drill-like sand spear which he uses to impale them.
Sand Restraining Technique: The user immobilises and restrain the target's movements with sand. It's apparently almost impossible for the target to escape from the technique unless the user exhausts their chakra.
Sand Shuriken: Gaara, while preparing to enter Tailed Beast Mode, shapes the sand coating his arms into multiple shuriken. By swinging his arms - which are more powerful than normal because of his transformation - the shuriken are launched rapidly, with additional volleys being possible with each additional swing. The Sand Shuriken, made to be stronger than steel, easily cut through whatever they come into contact with. This technique is a useful way to fend off approaching attackers, as well as a good way to stop opponents from fleeing.
Sand Stream: Gaara uses his sand to drag his opponents away in a stream to keep them from moving forward.
Sand Swift Spear Attack: Gaara creates a drill-like sand spear which he hurls at his opponent.
Sand Sword: The user creates a giant blade out of sand to slice through the opponent's body with, which can stretch and slip through shields like a giant snake.
Sand Taijutsu Tsunami: Gaara sends the opponent into the air where Lee kicks the opponent. Gaara then uses Quicksand Waterfall Flow and Lee appears from inside the tsunami of sand, and kicks the opponent into it. As the opponent slowly descends, the sand proceeds, and they drown in it.
Sand Waterfall Funeral: After encasing a target with sand, such as by using the Sand Binding Coffin, Gaara clenches his fist to cause the sand to contract. The sand presses in on the target from all directions until they're pulverised, killing them. Although some of the target's remains burst through the sand, scattering around the area similar to rain, most of their blood is absorbed by the sand itself.
Sand Waterfall Imperial Funeral: After a target has been engulfed by Quicksand Waterfall Flow, Gaara slams his hands onto the sand and activates this technique. As with the regular Sand Waterfall Funeral, the sand compresses upon and grinds down the target, though on a far greater scale than the regular version. The large volume of sand used in the Quicksand Waterfall Flow is flattened out and the target is repeatedly squeezed, preventing them from moving and ultimately crushing them to death. Kimimaro is able to survive this technique only because of fortification to his bones.
Sand Waterfall Mass Attack: Gaara strikes the opponent with a ball of sand, then pours sand down on them before raising the sand upwards to knock them into the air.
Sand Waterfall Mass Defence: Gaara manipulates his sand to swirl around himself, acting as a shield against projectiles.
Sand Whip: Gaara raises himself on a sand platform, striking all around himself with a sand whip for any target within reach.
Sandstone Fist: The user gathers sand and rock into their fist to form stone-made weapons, like a mallet or a shield. Its hardness is so great, that it can withstand the might of Chōji Akimichi's enhanced fist.
Sandstorm Barrier: With the help of pre-existing sand, the user creates a sandstorm barrier that is capable of overpowering other active barriers, like the Sensing Barrier. The technique also disturbs sensing abilities of the opponents. The barrier can be used offensively to surround opponents and limit their sense of vision.
Sandstorm Technique: With the help of pre-existing sand, the user creates a localised sandstorm, surrounding opponents and limiting their sense of vision.
Sannin Mode: After using their Ultimate Jutsu, the user goes into this mode. It increases the range, power, and speed of the user's attacks. Whilst in this mode, the user gains access to their Awakening techniques.
Sasuke Uchiha's Space–Time Dōjutsu: With his Rinnegan, Sasuke can use an unspecified Space–Time Ninjutsu to travel to different dimensions.
Scale Powder: The user releases a large amount of fine powder from their mouth or body, which, due to its luminous quality, shines so brightly that it can temporarily blind multiple targets within its area of effect.
Scale Powder Blasting: Using Chōmei's wings, Fū strikes her opponent and flies into the air while releasing scales, then fully transforms into Chōmei and delivers a drill-like attack on her opponent. Just before impact, Fū snaps Chōmei's mouthparts, creating a spark which ignites the scale-filled tornado her rotation created, resulting in a massive explosion.
Scale Senbon: Amachi spreads his arms and launches his scales at high velocity at the target. This technique had enough power to burst a shadow clone and throw Naruto back quite some distance. In addition, it had a wide enough range to wipe out six shadow clones at once.
Scale Wrapping Rotating Flight: Fū lands a series of kicks and punches, blinds her opponent with scales, and then flies into it, landing more hits with Chōmei's wings as she rotates.
Scarlet Invitation: Kurenai strikes the opponent with a combination of an elbow strike and two kicks before creating multiple cherry blossom petals which burst up from the ground lifting them into the air.
Scattering Tailed Beast Balls: In his full Tailed Beast transformation, Naruto discharges multiple uncompressed Tailed Beast Balls at once. They can be shot in a widespread manner, and can converge on multiple targets.
Scattering Thousand Crows Technique: This technique summons a flock of countless crows, dazzling the enemy. The user can freely manipulate the crows by emitting chakra from his fingertips and altering it into high frequency waves. Since the crows continuously clone themselves, the target becomes completely surrounded, obscuring their field of vision, a useful distraction aiding in assassination combinations. When no longer needed, the crows will simply disappear in a puff of smoke.
Scent Blossom Colouring: Kurenai creates a cherry blossom clone which attacks the opponent with several kunai slashes while creating a stream of cherry blossom petals behind it, before spinning around, and delivering a final slash that sends the opponent flying away.
Scent of Illusionary Flowers Technique: This genjutsu uses a species of white flower that grows near the Valley of Lies as a medium. When victims smell the flowers' scent, they remember things from their lives that will cause them to lose their will to fight. The flowers' scent is strong enough to, with enough time, seep into victims' other belongings, keeping them entranced even if the flowers are discarded. If victims also discard the scented belongings and move out of range of the smell, they will be free of the genjutsu.
Scientific Ninja Tool: Ever-Changing: With their Scientific Ninja Tools, the user can use three different stored ninjutsu:
Scientific Ninja Tool: Orca and Powerful: Boruto utilises his Shinobi Gauntlet to release a surge water pooling the area and electrify it with a bolt of electricity, electrocuting anyone that is in the water.
Scientific Ninja Tool: Purple Electricit: Using his shadow clones, Boruto is launched by their boosted wind, and uses Purple Electricity through the use of the Shinobi Gauntlet.
Scorch Release: Extremely Steaming Murde: The user creates several flaming orbs that resemble small suns. These orbs rotate around the user and can be freely controlled to attack enemies. When an orb touches an opponent, it instantly evaporates all the water inside their body, leaving them in a mummified state. When this happens, steam can be seen emitting from the opponent's body. However, this technique is vulnerable to Water Release, which can be used to dissipate the heat, becoming steam.
Scorch Release: Fireball Barrage: Pakura creates two flaming spheres that she uses to hover low above the ground, and from this position she fires flaming spheres at her opponent, replacing each thrown sphere with a new one.
Scorch Release: Fireball Dance: Pakura creates two flaming spheres, which she uses to hover low above the ground, and from this position she fires one large sphere at the enemy, connecting two small ones, immediately replacing them with new ones.
Scorch Release: Great Steaming Explosive: Pakura combines several of her flaming orbs to create a single massive one, which then violently explodes with enough force and power to incinerate a large area around it. When this happens, steam can be seen emitting from the area.
Scorch Release: Halo Hurricane Jet Black: This technique combines Naruto Uzumaki's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken with Sasuke Uchiha's Blaze Release: Kagutsuchi along with their variants. Because the wind to flame ratio is perfectly balanced, the flames are greatly enhanced, causing whatever is struck by this technique to be enveloped in a swirling mass of black flames.
Scorching Heat Sand Binding Coffin: As Gaara traps his opponent within an enormous sphere of sand, he also manoeuvres his siblings around it in sand platforms. Kankurō uses the Sasori puppet to set the sphere on fire, while Temari fans the flames. Gaara finishes covering the opponent in sand, and crushes them, causing the flaming sand prison to explode.
Scorching River Great Eruption: Rōshi grabs his opponent and makes a great leap, transforming into Son Gokū. He then puts his opponent between his lava-coated fists, slamming them into the ground. As he raises his arms, the ground beneath him erupts.
Scroll Communication Technique: The user communicates to another by using a scroll, on which writing appears and disappears.
Sea of Trees Erosion: Using the Wood Release, a user can manipulate the terrain, bringing out underground roots of varying sizes to fit various offensive situations, such as using the roots for trickery, misdirection and restriction. One can also use a large scale version, bringing out massive roots over a larger area that tangle around each other with such force that anyone caught in-between is violently crushed to death.
Sealed Iron Wall: A seal placed on the Fire Temple's gate to protect against intruders from the outside world. The two statues placed on either side of the gate form a barrier. Only ninja monks of the temple have access to enter due to the special chakra gifted from the Gift of the Hermit Group. However, a powerful enough physical strike can break through the defences, as demonstrated with Kakuzu's Earth Release: Earth Spear.
Sealing Release Technique: After throwing prayer beads on the sealed victim, Chūkaku begins to mumble words while performing ritual hand movements, leading the seal formula to slowly disappear. This technique seems to take concentration and strength since Chūkaku looked troubled while performing it.
Sealing Tag Barrier: A barrier ninjutsu that involves the usage of several sealing tags being concealed beneath the surface. Once anybody steps onto the area, the tag will activate, releasing several thin threads that wrap around the target and restrain them. Due to the fact that the tag contains sealing formulas on its surface, it proved to be very useful when dealing with reincarnated shinobi.
