Sealing Technique: Black Aura: Kuroma unleashes a dark and ominous aura capable of serving multiple purposes. The aura is able to subdue and restrain the opponent. The aura is also able to serve as an attack and defence, deflecting another attack or forcing the opponent into the defensive by blowing them away.
Sealing Technique: Crimson Seal: After executing the necessary hand seals, user creates a seal based on the Fire Release: Heavenly Prison, capable of immobilising and burning the target.
Sealing Technique: Five Elements: Kuroma uses his sealing tags to use the five element natures.
Sealing Technique: Four Limbs Weighting: This technique is performed by placing prayer beads around the wrists and ankles of the target and then pressing the palm against the target's chest. This increases the weight of the beads exponentially, weighing down the target's limbs.
Sealing Technique: Frog Suppression: The user erects four pillars from the ground around their target. The pillars create a field that paralyses anyone caught inside. The paralysing effect can be countered through the use of another seal.
Sealing Technique: Lion Closing Roar: This sealing technique completely blocks the target's chakra with a drawn on the ground or a wall. This is done by closing all the tenketsu of the person caught in the middle. When the target is sealed, a stylised kanji for appears in the middle of the sealing formula.
Sealing Technique: Octopus Hold: The Sealing Technique: Octopus Hold is a fūinjutsu unique to Killer B, using his ability to generate clones made of ink.
Sealing Technique: Phantom Dragons Nine: The Sealing Technique: Phantom Dragons Nine Consuming Seals is a technique that was used by Pain and the other members of Akatsuki to forcibly seal a tailed beast or to extract a still-living jinchūriki's tailed beast chakra into the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path. The technique took three full days to complete if nine of the Akatsuki members were present. Zetsu stated that if there are fewer people to perform the technique, it would take a while longer.
Sealing Technique: Release: This technique is a counter-measure that can be used to undo fūinjutsu that may be binding the user. By placing their hand atop the seal, it activates, nullifying the effects of the fūinjutsu casted on them.
Sealing Technique: Rōen Kodon: A sealing technique that is passed down within the Kodon clan, allowing its members to seal Rōen, a wolf-like monster that has terrorised them since ancient times. The seal must be placed at Rōen's weak point, on the back of its head. If successfully applied, Rōen's body gradually turns to smoke, which then travels to and is contained within the Kodon clan's shrine. Rōen will only remain imprisoned there for seven years, at which time the sealing must be performed anew. Kodon can release the seal before then if they choose.
Sealing Technique: Spirit Sealing: This requires a scroll to perform the technique. It allows the user to seal a soul from a human inside the scroll.
Sealing Technique: Three Directions Seal: The user, along with two shadow clones, creates a triangular seal around the opponent. Then a tetrahedral form of light traps and sends them up in the sky, leaving a large hole on the ground.
Sealing Technique: Tiger Vision Staring: After the user draws a gigantic tiger, the illustration extends from the scroll and while still connected, captures its prey with its teeth and claws, before dragging the victim back into the scroll and pinning them down within the confines of the drawing. Due to the enormity of the illustration, the user requires an extended period of time to complete the image, during which they need protection as their attention is devoted to drawing.
Sealing Technique: Vitality Seal Formati: Tsukino uses her two tantō to perform her fūinjutsu. When using this technique, she can temporarily suppress the chakra of multiple individuals in the area around her.
Sealing Trap Explosion: Tsukino prepares a sealing trap on the ground which, when stepped on by an enemy, explodes.
Seasickness Fist: Similar to the Drunken Fist, the user harnesses the queasiness caused to them by motion sickness to lend them a degree of unpredictability in combat. They can also vomit on their opponent in order to totally gross them out.
Secret Anaesthesia: Using Yomi's snakes, Kusuna has them bite a target. The bite leaves a purplish colour around the area bitten and causes the target's veins to swell up, after which they become temporarily paralysed.
Secret Ingredient: Chōji headbutts the opponent and rolls into them two times.
Secret Sword: Flowing Shadow: Hayate creates several shadow clones that attack the enemy with their swords. During this time, he himself becomes invisible, allowing him to launch a surprise attack at the right moment, even if the clones are destroyed.
Secret Sword: Moonlight: Hayate dashes to his opponent with great speed before attacking them with a quick lateral sword strike. The tremendous speed leaves a trace of an afterimage in the process.
Secret Sword: Snowstorm Beheading: While focusing their chakra into their sword while still sheathed, the user performs a Battōjutsu strike. From this, the user unleashes a powerful shockwave which becomes a massive tornado surrounding them, repelling everything in the area near the user. Powerful as the technique is, it is not without drawbacks. It takes time and focus to unleash the technique. It is also very chakra-taxing, making it only usable once in a given day. Finally, the technique is also potentially dangerous to the user, as loss of control can potentially cause as much harm to the user as all other targets around them.
Secret Taijutsu: Super Fire Release Illu: Hashirama calls on Madara, after which they together deal the enemy several punches and kicks, then Madara paralyzes them with his genjutsu while Hashirama throws giant Fūma Shuriken which spin wildly, cutting the enemy, and in the end, Madara sets them on fire along with the shuriken, burning everything to ashes.
Secret Taijutsu: Wild Stone Dance Flame: Madara calls on Hashirama, after which they begin to furiously throw rocks at the enemy, then Hashirama throws Madara into the air, where he releases a fireball at the enemy, and finally throws several kunai with explosive tags, causing a powerful explosion.
Secret Technique Stone Needles: This technique makes use of the user's chakra as a paralysing agent. The user throws kunai with strings attached at the opponent. Once the enemy is hit, chakra is ran through the string to paralyse them, which will serve to either incapacitate or allow the user to attack. However, against those who can absorb chakra, this technique could backfire as the target may simply steal chakra from the user, while exhibiting immunity to the paralysis, as Kisame demonstrated.
Secret Technique: Insect Arm: Shino sends his insects that form roots and entangle the opponent and then explode.
Secret Technique: Insect Bog: The user sends their insects to encase the opponent; the insects then lift the opponent into the air, and crush them.
Secret Technique: Insect Cocoon: This unique technique allows the user to accelerate the growth of their insects. As the user's body is already a hive of sorts for the insects, the user will encase themselves in an actual cocoon to further aid the insects. This is an extremely useful move for Aburame clan members, since their attacks mainly focus on the usage of insects. However, using this in the midst of a battle can be potentially dangerous as it leaves the user static and vulnerable. As such when this technique is being employed, the user generally finds a safe location or otherwise can be guarded by their teammate.
Secret Technique: Insect Gathering: By simply touching a surface with their palm and fingers, the user releases a small web of chakra that draws bugs to that location. Since the Aburame member can communicate with insects, it can be useful to gain information by gathering local insects.
Secret Technique: Insect Sphere: The user sends their kikaichū to spread over a wide range, and the moment they locate the target, the insects gather at once, forming a sphere around the target. They then attach themselves to the target and begin eating away at their chakra. Even if the target manages to escape, the insects will immediately follow.
Secret Technique: Insect Tornado: This technique covers the enemy's entire body with the kikaichū living inside the Aburame clan member's body. The chakra-sensing kikaichū spread over a wide range, and the moment they locate the enemy, the insects, following the user's orders, gather at once completely surrounding the target creating a fast-moving tornado that will seemingly disintegrate the target.
Secret Technique: Insect Wall: By releasing a large number of kikaichū, the user creates a massive wall out of them, which protects both himself and allies nearby. The wall is strong enough to protect against large falling objects and Fire Release techniques.
Secret Technique: Mist Rain: A technique known by Kirigakure hunter-nin. The user makes rain that absorbs any chakra it comes into contact with, as long as it's not of the same signature as the original user. The effect of this technique is powerful enough to absorb Utakata's Soap Bubble Ninjutsu and Naruto's Rasengan.
Secret Technique: Mouth Seal Technique: The user initiates the technique with a specific technique seal and apparently before asking the target a question. If the target answers, the technique is then immediately invoked causing the person to lose the use of their voice. The target will remain in this state until the technique is dispelled by the user.
Secret Technique: Sealing Release: Tsukino uses her two tantō to perform her technique. When using this technique, she can dispel seals.
Secret Technique: Summoning: Mugen Castl: A technique created by Orochimaru. Kabuto uses eight seal tags to summon the Mugen Castle. The castle can absorb the people's vitality and is also capable of destroying the land where it stands. When the castle is destroyed by removing the eight seal tags, it disappears without a trace.
Secret Technique: Tree Blood Barrier: The user manifests threads made of their own blood to encase the area around them. Anyone stained by the blood will instantly have their body and its actions controlled by the user. The threads are relatively easy to damage, but can regenerate. At the same time, there is only a certain amount of damage they can regenerate from. Their control is also not absolute, as it can be overpowered by other jutsu that control the target's actions. Alternatively, the threads can also be used to control weapons from afar.
Self-Cursing Seal: Similar to the Cursed Tongue Eradication Seal, this seal can also be applied during combat, and can secretly be placed on the opponent's body. When the user activates it, the curse seal's marks spread around the opponent's body, paralysing them. However, one can break free from the seal with a strong enough release of chakra.
Self-Healing Technique: Upon forming the necessary hand seals, either immediately before or after being struck by an attack, the user's body will regenerate to heal all recent injuries and lost anatomy in seconds, leaving no lingering traces of said wounds. This technique can also negate the effects of venom on the user's body.
Self-Repairing Barrier: The Self-Repairing Barrier is a Cooperation Ninjutsu that by linking chakra from a team of ninja, will create a barrier which if damaged, will constantly repair itself with said chakra that emanates from their bodies. The barrier also prevents those outside of it from sensing anything inside it through traditional methods.
Self-Seal Technique: This technique allows the user to turn their body into stone, allowing them to store chakra for many years. The technique also keeps the user from ageing.
Self-Taught: Instant Attack: Might Duy opens the Eight Gates and delivers a powerful punch that creates a large vacuum, propelling the enemy away.
Self-Taught: Youth Kick: Might Duy jumps and delivers a powerful drop kick to the opponent.
Senbon Shower: This technique requires special umbrellas that have been spring-loaded with hundreds of senbon. The user opens several of these umbrellas and spins them into the air. As they spin, they release the combined thousands of senbon, which the user controls with their chakra. The user directs the senbon to fall upon the target, striking them all over like rain; to control so many senbon at once requires a great deal of training. Because of how many senbon there are, evading all of them is almost impossible. Furthermore, each senbon is supposed to be able to penetrate a five millimetre-thick steel plate. The senbon can also be dipped in poison to increase their lethality. Despite all this, Gaara's Shield of Sand completely protected him from damage.
Senrigan: The is a dōjutsu awakened by some members of the Ōtsutsuki Clan, which grants vast clairvoyant abilities. Appearance-wise, it is distinguished by a bright-blue iris, a white-glowing pupil surrounded by a dark, waxing crescent shape, and a darkened sclera.
Sensing Barrier: The Sensing Barrier is a giant, dome-shaped barrier placed over a designated area. The barrier is not visible to the standard eye; when viewed with certain dōjutsu, it can be seen that there is a design of several circles which have the kanji for , and inscribed in them. When linked with a Sensing Water Sphere, all unauthorised passage in and out of the barrier can be detected and pinpointed.
Sensing Barrier Pass Technique: According to Pain, Itachi and Kisame were able to enter Konohagakure undetected after Orochimaru's failed invasion because as a former member of Konohagakure's Anbu, Itachi knew how to pass through the barrier surrounding the village undetected.
Sensing Hexagram Seal: The user places a hexagram seal on the ground that allows them to sense targets on a wide radius by transmitting waves through the seal. This technique could also identify if an individual was a medical-nin.
Sensing Sand Sphere: This sphere, made out of sand, can be used to monitor chakra signatures in a given area. The sphere itself is not a great form of detection and needs on-the-field reports to locate targets that should be kept track of. When linked with a Sensing Barrier, this imprecision is mitigated somewhat.
Sensing Technique: The Sensing Technique allows sensor type shinobi to mould chakra and change it to the sensor type. This enables them to detect and track down targets through their chakra signatures. The range of this technique varies between sensors.
Sensing Transmission: By making physical contact with another individual, the user is able to transmit what they are currently sensing directly into the target's mind. The user's perception can then be further transferred to another individual that person is connected to, be it physically or through such means as their shadow.
Sensing Water Sphere: By forming a sphere of water, the user can use it to monitor chakra signatures in a given area. Individuals or groups are represented as varying-sized bubbles within the sphere, with larger chakra signatures having larger bubbles. The sphere itself is not a great form of detection and needs on-the-field reports to locate targets that should be kept track of. When linked with a Sensing Barrier, this imprecision is mitigated somewhat.
Serial Kick: The user kicks their opponent several times in quick succession and finishes with a powerful kick that sends the opponent flying.
Seven Lightnings of the Heavenly Realm: With Susanoo, Indra forms seven bolts of lightning that rain down as a circle around his opponent before detonating.
Seven Swords of the Bloody Mist: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist gather as a thick mist surrounds the battlefield. Ameyuri heads in for an attack, delivering an electricity-enhanced horizontal slash with Kiba, followed by Kisame slashing with Samehada in the opposite direction. Jinin launches the opponent up in the air with the axe portion of Kabutowari, where they are met by Jinpachi's attack wih Shibuki, creating an explosion. From a distance, Mangetsu slashes the opponent with Hiramekarei's longsword form, and Kushimaru stabs them repeatedly, binding them in place with wire. Finally, Zabuza lands a final slash with Kubikiribōchō.
Seven-Coloured Rasengan: The Seven-Coloured Rasengan is a Rasengan, coloured by the light reflecting from the mirror generator in the Land of Snow. This colouring gave the chakra used for the Rasengan the appearance of a rainbow. Judging by how far it causes the opponent to fly, it may be that the multicoloured chakra is not just a colourful sight, but somehow increases its power as well.
Severed Inscription: Mifune quickly draws his sword, slashing everything around himself.
Severed Land: Wielding Kubikiribōchō, the user leaps in front of the opponent and slashes down at them with the sword, crushing the ground below them.
Sexy Reverse Harem Technique: A technique created by Naruto Uzumaki, and a variation of the Harem Technique.
Sexy Technique: Naruto Uzumaki created this technique in order to play pranks on men. The user transforms into a beautiful woman, with special attention given to the woman's figure, breasts, and waist. When Naruto teaches this technique to Konohamaru Sarutobi, Konohamaru initially struggles to take an attractive form; in the anime, Naruto helps him improve by having him look at naked women. With practice, Konohamaru is eventually able to use this technique effectively, though Rin no Sho describes his version as not having the same "wow" factor as Naruto's.
Sexy Technique: Pole Dance and Nice Body: Another variation of the Sexy Technique, the user and a staff are transformed into a woman with an especially attractive body (hence the "Nice Body" title) wearing a red bikini on a pole. The woman winks, blows kisses and speaks seductively to the victim to add to the effectiveness of this technique. Konohamaru showed this technique to Naruto in a failed attempt to impress him, only to find out that Naruto had already learned it while developing the New Sexy Technique.
Sexy: Boy on Boy Technique: A technique that implements the Sexy: Girl on Girl Technique. A technique that excites women sexually by changing into two naked men. Unlike when changing into girls, other things are vital besides proportions, like the selection and combination of the men one transforms into and how they pose. By being well acquainted with the person the technique is targeted to and adjusting the transformation accordingly, one can deliver an even greater impact.
Sexy: Girl on Girl Technique: Naruto's Harem Technique, as arranged by Konohamaru, it is consecutively using the Shadow Clone Technique and Transformation Technique, but by having the user himself and the shadow clone change into different people on the moment of transformation. Because several different seducing girls appear, the chances of meeting the preferences of the target are upped significantly. Konohamaru has invented an alternative form of the technique to work on females, Sexy: Boy on Boy Technique.
Shadow Arms: The Zero-Tails can create a multitude of tan coloured arms from its body that chase after the opponent. The arms can also absorb chakra from the opponent. When used by Shinnō, he could also form a wall to shield himself with these arms, enough to block Naruto's Tornado Rasengan.
Shadow Bind Combo: Shikamaru restrains the opponent with Shadow Sewing Technique and Naruto uses his clones to attack the trapped opponent.
Shadow Bind Technique: Check: Shikamaru's shadow expands into a circular shape, immobilising the opponents caught in it, as Naruto attacks them with the Super-Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan.
Shadow Bind: Crush: Shikaku extends his shadow into multiple tendrils which all wrap around the opponent into sphere that crushes them.
Shadow Cage Technique: The user projects their shadow at target. Upon which, the shadow splits into multiple lines and surrounds the target as solid beams, forming a round cage. The shadow can be maintained and launched away even after the user's personal shadow splits from the structure.
Shadow Clone Charging Bullet: Naruto creates and tosses a shadow clone at the opponent, tossing another and then creating multiple clones that are shot at the opponent.
Shadow Clone Elite Bullet: Naruto creates several shadow clones, which are thrown toward his opponent, stringing together many hits.
Shadow Clone Kick: Itachi creates a clone in midair that performs a drop kick on the opponent.
Shadow Clone Roundhouse Kick: Naruto uses his shadow clones to deliver a series of hits to his opponent, finishing it by spinning and throwing a shadow clone, that lands a roundhouse kick on the opponent.
Shadow Clone Technique: The Shadow Clone Technique is a clone technique created by Tobirama Senju.
Shadow Clone: Great Rotation: Naruto creates two shadow clones, and they form a chain with each Naruto holding the other by the ankles. Naruto then spins, hitting his opponents with the clones.
Shadow Clone: Super Tailed Beast Rasensh: Naruto sends out seven shadow clones in the air, which rain down Magnet Release Rasengans to seal any movements from the opponents, and finished with five additional shadow clones throwing Magnet Release, Lava Release, and ink covered Rasenshurikens in the surrounding area, leaving hazardous pools of substances leftover after the Rasenshuriken explosions.
Shadow Clone: Twin Lightning Cutter: Kakashi sends out a shadow clone, which attacks the opponent with a Lightning Cutter in each hand.
Shadow Clone: Upper: Naruto creates a shadow clone to throw him towards his opponent, delivering an uppercut.
Shadow Clutch Technique: The user materialises their shadow and increases its power, becoming like steel. The user then captures the target's shadow and forcibly moves them about. The techniques strength is proportionate to the chakra put into it, with enough strength even giants can be moved. When used together with the Akimichi's Human Bullet Tank, it turns it into a weapon. This simple application makes it useful in a number of emergency situations. Unlike with the Shadow Imitation Technique, though the two shadows are connected, the target is not forced to copy the user's movements, allowing them to retain their own range of motion.
Shadow Demon Binding Technique: Much like the Shadow Imitation Technique and Shadow–Neck Binding Technique, shadows dart towards the opponent, though they're much larger and have more shadow strips, all going at a fast pace. Once the opponent is caught, small shadow hands wrap their entire body, making them unable to move. Then the user sets his index finger and thumb looking like a window while concentrating chakra to the desired area to shadow crush.
Shadow Gathering Technique: This is a ninjutsu using materialised shadows, but compared to the Shadow Sewing Technique from the same line, this technique places emphasis on the minute control of the shadow's movements. It is accurate enough to even make the tentacles go through tiny holes. Basically, this technique takes the user's own shadow and transforms and stretches it into countless thin tentacles, which are then used to grab objects and pull them in. Also, one can skilfully make use of the tentacle-shaped shadow tendrils by using them to lift up and throw weapons like kunai and such. This technique has many possible applications and uses.
Shadow Hell Technique: Shikamaru uses his Shadow Imitation Technique and makes his opponent fall through the shadow to teleport them to the unknown location, and in seconds, the opponent returns dropped from a set height from a smoke cloud.
Shadow Human Bullet Tank: Chōji uses his Multi-Size Technique to do the Human Bullet Tank, then Shikamaru uses his Shadow Imitation Technique to paralyse the opponent then Chōji crushes them.
Shadow Imitation Field Technique: This technique is an advanced version of the Shadow Imitation Technique, where the user expands their shadow to cover a wide range, thereby reducing the chance of escape. Due to the technique's concept, multiple targets can be captured simultaneously.
Shadow Imitation Shadow Bind Technique: The Shadow Imitation Shadow Bind Technique is one of the hijutsu utilised by members of the Nara clan.
Shadow Imitation Shuriken Technique: The Shadow Imitation Shuriken Technique is a ninjutsu invented by Shikamaru Nara while teaching himself to use Asuma Sarutobi's chakra blades.
Shadow Imitation Technique: The Shadow Imitation Technique is the signature technique of the Nara clan.
Shadow Imitation Technique: Ryūō: Shikamaru branches out his shadow, with the tip of each branch holding an explosive tag.
Shadow Mirror Body Changing Method: A technique passed down in the Land of Demons, it was used by Taruho to alter his appearance into that of Shion.
Shadow Network Technique: Shikamaru is able to utilise his shadow to crack the ground around him, possessing nearby opponent. The shadow will spin, forming a small whirlwind, attacking possessed and approaching opponent.
Shadow Pressure Palm Technique: Shikamaru throws flash bombs behind him, to not only blind his foes but also to extend the range of his shadow indefinitely. Once those preparations are complete, Shikamaru can put any parts of his body in front of the light and it will appear as an enormous shadow. Once his shadow is ready, he can constrict any enemies easily just by closing his hand.
Shadow Rope Technique: The Magaki Group wraps their opponent with black rope, to restrict their movements.
Shadow Senbon: A simple technique using senbon, the user throws senbon with bells attached and senbon without bells at the same time. The intention is that the opponent will only react to the sound of the bells and won't notice the silent senbon, getting hit by these. However, if the opponent recognises the trick it becomes easy to evade, as they simply need to focus on how many senbon were actually thrown. Kin Tsuchi makes a more advanced use of this technique by attaching strings to the thrown bells and ringing them from unexpected positions, confusing and distracting her opponent long enough for her to attack.
Shadow Sewing Technique: This is a ninjutsu from among the Nara clan's secret techniques that uses materialised shadows to attack and bind, instead of merely immobilising and controlling like the Shadow Imitation Technique. The user changes the shape of their shadow into several sharp tendril-like needles and controls each separately. They can then attack the same or several targets simultaneously and at the same time snatch away their ability to move by sewing them stuck with the shadow threads. Because it is a physical attack, it is impossible to capture someone without harming them, but on the other hand, since the speed of invocation and the time of duration are excellent, it can be used when urgent restraint is required.
Shadow Sewing Technique: Piece Set: Shikamaru expands his shadow into the field, using the tendrils from it to fling parachutes with explosive tags.
Shadow Sewing Technique: Round Shadow: Shikamaru uses the Shadow Sewing Technique to cover all directions, piercing anyone in close proximity.
Shadow Sheep Cloud Technique: Shikamaru creates a sheep out of shadows which puts the enemy to sleep.
Shadow Shuriken Technique: The user places two shuriken together and throws them both at a target simultaneously; the larger the shuriken that are thrown, the greater the necessary skill. The goal is for targets to focus their attention on whichever of the two shuriken is on top, not noticing the second shuriken travelling below it. Ideally, targets will dodge the upper shuriken in such a way that they are left unable to dodge the second. If targets do at any point realise there's a second shuriken, the technique is rendered ineffective.
Shadow Smokescreen Technique: Shikamaru releases several smoke bombs that engulf the enemy in smoke. Shikamaru then wraps his shadow around the enemy before constricting it to a small egg-like size that he forces to implode.
Shadow Stabbing Technique: Shikamaru, while in his awakened state, forces his shadow to rise and form many different needle-like shapes and launches them at his opponent, stabbing and making them fall to the ground.
Shadow Stabbing Technique: Narigin: Shikamaru expands his shadow into five circular fields, four out of the five send out piercing tendrils from beneath the opponents.
Shadow Stroke: Isobu (or Yagura while fully transformed into Isobu) can roll into a ball and bulldoze its opponents, making full use of its many spiky protrusions in a manner similar to the Akimichi clan's Spiked Human Bullet Tank. This manoeuvre can also be used to escape attacks.
Shadow Sword: Under moonlight, the user can grab at their shadow to manifest a tangible blade to strike with. Unlike Moon Shadow Technique, once created, the blade cannot be dispersed with other sources of light.
Shadow of the Dancing Leaf: The user moves close behind a target and carefully matches their movements, following them in the same way that a leaf is followed by its shadow. Simply mimicking a target in this way does no harm to them, but it's useful as a setup for other techniques, such as the Front Lotus or the Lion Combo. The tracking technique boosts the accuracy of the follow-up move. Because of how difficult it can be to use this technique, most genin are unlikely to be talented enough to perform it.
Shadow–Neck Binding Technique: This is a variation of the Shadow Imitation Technique, designed for offensive purposes. The user extends their shadow along a target's body, which, because the shadow has physical properties, the target can feel. There, the shadow can be used for restraint, replacing or adding to the binding of the Shadow Imitation; the closer the user is to their target, the stronger this binding becomes. Like the Shadow Imitation, the Shadow–Neck Binding requires a great deal of chakra to maintain, making it weaker over extended periods of time. For this reason, it is most effective when immediately used to strangle a target, hence the name.
Shapeshifting Technique: Pain allocates a portion of an individual's chakra to a living human sacrifice. This causes the sacrifice to become the individual's identical copy, complete with perfect imitations of the original's kekkei genkai (such as the Sharingan) and unique weapons (such as Samehada). The original controls their copy remotely, thus making the copy's movements and knowledge indistinguishable as well. However, the copy is limited by how much of the original's chakra they are given, so particularly chakra-taxing jutsu cannot be used. Once the chakra from the original runs out, the sacrifice reverts to their own appearance and they die.
Sharingan: The is the dōjutsu kekkei genkai of the Uchiha clan that appears selectively among its members. It is regarded as one of the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Byakugan and the Rinnegan. While its powers originated from Kaguya Ōtsutsuki's Rinne Sharingan, its independent form was first manifested by Indra Ōtsutsuki, possibly as a manifestation of the (Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki in the anime).
Sharingan: Negative Confusion: Itachi binds the opponent with his Sharingan in confusion.
Shark-Slaying Slash: Kisame charges forward rapidly with his blade drawn, executing a swift slash that leaves a trail of light in its wake. Upon impact, he sheathes his sword as the residual light explodes causing the target to bleed rapidly. He is able to follow this technique up with Water Release: Water Shark Bullet Technique as the light explosion happens, catching a target vulnerable.
Sharp Hair Spear: Might: The user extends their hair and hardens it to be as sharp as a spear to pierce through an opponent. It is especially useful against multiple opponents, as it can be used to attack them simultaneously.
Shield of Sand: The Shield of Sand is the first part of Gaara's "Absolute Defence", his Armour of Sand being the second.
Shifting Body Technique: The user can temporarily increase the size of their body parts or their entire body at will. When using it on their belly, the user can make it spin faster and in great speed. While used on the entire body, the user can easily repel close-range enemy attacks.
Shin Uchiha's Space–Time Dōjutsu: Shin Uchiha is able to perform a space–time ninjutsu using his Sharingan.
Shining Ostrich Kick: Condor, while in the air, slams the opponent down with a powerful kick.
Shinra Tensei: Shinra Tensei is a technique used through the Deva Path of the Rinnegan, said to be its pinnacle ability.
Shock Wave Blossom: Sakura uses her super strength to punch the ground and make it shake, knocking down all the enemies around her.
Shock Wave Thrust: After delivering a series of punches to the enemy, Sakura delivers one powerful punch which sends the enemy flying followed by a second punch, which is just as powerful.
Short Range Mind's Eye of the Kagura: Karin uses her Mind's Eye of the Kagura to sense her opponents at a close range. This allows her to sense when a blow is about to connect with her, preventing her from being hit by their melee attacks.
Shrike: Itachi and a couple crow clones land a series of punches, kicks, and kunai slashes to the opponent, before stunning them with three thrown kunai, allowing a final crow clone to stab them with one.
Shrine Seal: This seal is in the Land of Swamps, and contains the body of the evil spirit Mōryō.
Shrine Seal: Release: After performing the hand seals (or rather, chant them out loud like an incantation), the user releases a dark shock wave that destroys the talismans on the Shrine Seal, and shatters the stone door, releasing Mōryō's entrapped soul. This may be a variation of the Shrine Seal, or even the counterpart, as it contains a portion of the hand seals that the sealing technique does.
Shuriken Shadow Clone Technique: This technique was invented by Hiruzen Sarutobi, demonstrating his title as the "Professor" with its conceptualisation and efficiency. After throwing a single shuriken, the user duplicates it with their chakra, in the same way that the Shadow Clone Technique makes copies of the user; creating shadow clones is already difficult on its own, but specifically duplicating inanimate objects is even more difficult. In an instant, the thousand copied shuriken spread throughout the area, surrounding the target. Because the shuriken are physically real, the target is attacked from every direction, which they have almost no chance of completely avoiding.
Shuriken: Double Knockdown Technique: Madara throws a Fūma Shuriken at his opponent, which spins, slicing through flesh, before returning to Madara's hands. He can also deliver a few kicks before throwing the shuriken, or run up and strike while it's spinning. A more powerful version of this attack is performed with two shurikens, attacking from both sides.
Sickle Mist Technique: After Hanzō summons Ibuse to toss the opponent into the air and expel poison mist, he sends his kusarigama through the mist and reels it back, slicing the opponent.
Sickle Weasel Explosion: Temari punches the opponent into the air, and Shikamaru connects with a kick. Then Shikamaru uses his Shadow Imitation Technique to paralyse the opponent. Then he throws kunai with attached explosive tags while Temari uses her Sickle Weasel Technique to put the opponent in a tornado and slash them with the kunai while they explode with the explosive tags.
Sickle Weasel Technique: Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari causes many currents of wind to collide with each other, creating vacuum pockets. On its own, the gust is powerful enough to blow away incoming attacks and knock targets off their feet. If a target should become engulfed in the winds, their body will be carved up by the countless wind blades. Temari can control the form that the winds take, such as by making them into a tornado that lifts targets into the air. She can also alter the intensity of the wind's cutting power, such as by having them cut open a samurai's armour without harming the samurai inside.
Silent Fist: The is a fighting style unique to Shira. With it he is able to render his movements completely silent by cloaking himself in chakra. Neji Hyūga likens its usage to the feathers of an owl, as the chakra cloak makes Shira's movements virtually unpredictable.
Silent Killing: As the name suggests, this technique is simply a soundless method of killing an opponent by striking their vital points, usually from behind with a blade. Additionally, because the user moves silently, the attack cannot be anticipated and defended against. The user will often slit their opponent's throat, preventing any cry that might give them away. Some shinobi also opt to use a cover such as mist or even frost to rob their opponents of their field of vision and then attack them using it as cover.
Silver Wheel Reincarnation Explosion: The Silver Wheel Reincarnation Explosion is a powerful technique utilised by Toneri Ōtsutsuki.
Single Claw Bisection: Tenma opens the claws of his fiddler crab, charging directly at his target while aiming at the head to cut if off.
Six Paths Chakra: Rebirth: Using Six Paths Chakra, Naruto heals and/or brings back to life any allies in range of him.
Six Paths Sage Mode: is a divine transformation gifted by Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki to those who have an iron faith and the will to never give up. It significantly enhances the user's powers and allows them to use a number of new techniques.
Six Paths Technique: The is the origin of the unique techniques bestowed by the Rinnegan. Those who wield the Rinnegan have access to each of these techniques. Despite its name, there are actually seven of these techniques that grant the user powerful and near god-like abilities:
Six Paths Ten-Tails Coffin Seal: The is a sealing technique used by Obito and Madara Uchiha to seal the Ten-Tails into themselves, thus becoming the beast's jinchūriki. After a Rinnegan user performs the required hand seals while in close proximity to the Ten-Tails, the beast is quickly absorbed into the user's body.
Six Paths Yang Power: The Six Paths Yang Power is a power wielded by Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki and later given to Naruto Uzumaki. It is represented by a light-coloured, sun-like on the user's right hand.
Six Paths Yin Power: The Six Paths Yin Power is a power wielded by Hamura and Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki, and later given to Sasuke Uchiha. It is represented by a dark-coloured, crescent moon-like on the user's left hand.
Six Paths of Pain: The is an Outer Path technique that allows a Rinnegan user to manipulate up to six bodies as though they are their own.
Six Paths — Chibaku Tensei: The Six Paths — Chibaku Tensei is a powerful fūinjutsu which can only be used by those who have awakened the Six Paths Senjutsu. It combines the Six Paths Yin and Yang powers.
Six Paths: Cross Lantern: The user, while using Six Paths Senjutsu, launches Truth-Seeking Balls around them into the ground, creating a dark-coloured shockwave, which induces Tenpenchii around them in the process, with the calamities including flames and purple-coloured electricity.
Six Paths: Five Balls: Asura expands his large Truth-Seeking Balls further and sends them out to the opponent, where they converge and explode.
Six Paths: Flame Extinction Hand: Obito uses chakra arms to punch the opponent multiple times, then uses one chakra arm to crush them.
Six Paths: Kunitsukami: Asura creates a gigantic chakra avatar, which is powerful enough to do battle with Indra's Complete Body — Susanoo. Asura is able to equip the avatar with Truth-Seeking Balls that can be used as a means of offence, or the avatar can serve as a defensive structure, similar to Indra's Susanoo.
Six Paths: Shinra Tenkyō: Both Naruto and Sasuke use the chakra of the nine tailed beasts to enhance their power; with the former manifesting his three-headed, six-armed Tailed Beast Mode while forming the Six Paths: Ultra-Big Ball Rasenshuriken, and the latter manifesting his enhanced Complete Body — Susanoo while forming Indra's Arrow. They fire off their techniques simultaneously at the target, resulting in a cataclysmic explosion.
Six Paths: Super Tailed Beast Rasenshuri: Naruto enters Six Paths Sage Mode and throws a Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken at the opponent, following with three shadow clones throwing lava, blue fire and magnet Rasenshuriken at them, leaving hazardous pools from the elemental Rasenshuriken.
Six Paths: Super Truth-Seeking Serial Ba: Asura merges his Truth-Seeking Balls to shoot the combined ball at the opponent.
Six Paths: True Several Rasenshuriken: Asura, Hashirama and Naruto team up together, with Naruto in Tailed Beast Mode forming a Rasenshuriken in the center of Asura's Amenomihashira, formed by both the wooden statues created by the latter and Hashirama, following Naruto throwing the large combined Rasenshuriken at the opponent.
Six Paths: Ultra-Big Ball Rasenshuriken: While in his Six Paths Sage Mode, using the Six Paths Senjutsu and fully transformed into Kurama, Naruto creates two shadow clones of the entire chakra construct. The shadow clones merge with the original, creating a three-faced, six-armed construct. In its right arms, it creates a , and in its left arms, it creates a Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken, both infused with natural energy. It is strong enough to counter Sasuke Uchiha's strongest offensive technique, being Naruto's strongest technique at the time.
Six Red Yang Formation: This is a barrier technique of the highest calibre, surpassing the Four Red Yang Formation in terms of both scale and durability. It is a barrier created by oneself that is impossible for anyone to step past, though it can only be used by those blessed with Six Paths Power. When Obito Uchiha uses this technique, the Truth-Seeking Ball floating behind his right hand is engulfed in red flame-like chakra, at which point he launches six black rods from his hand, each surrounded by the same red chakra. The rods strike the ground at six points in his surroundings, and once the necessary hand seals are performed, they serve as the origin points for a gigantic red barrier.
Six Red Yang Formation: Blazing Annihila: Obito traps his opponents in a barrier and combines his Truth-Seeking Balls into a massive flaming ball, sending it down on them.
Skewering Punishment: Hidan attacks the opponent many times with his Triple-Bladed Scythe, sending them flying. He then holds the rope connected to his scythe and throws it at his opponent.
Sky Claw Double Scratch: Yugito jumps in the air, delivering multiple clawed slashes, and finishes off with a two-handed, downwards slash.
Sky Shaking Fist: After a series of punches, the user then finishes by jumping into the air and delivering a downward punch.
Sky Spiralling Drop: Sakura twirls Naruto around in the air and then launches Naruto at the opponent with his Rasengan.
Sky-Slashing Wave: Zaku first extends both arms out to the sides, firing a small blast of air, then turns fully towards the opponent, delivering two more powerful blasts in turn and finishes with his most powerful technique.
Slashing Bandages: Hiruko flows chakra into the bandages around his arms, which not only allows him to manipulate them, but makes them strong enough to easily slice through rock.
Slashing Handling Punishment: Hidan attacks the opponent five times with his Triple-Bladed Scythe, and finishes it with a big slash of his scythe, sending the opponent flying.
Slashing Shadow: Sasuke kicks and slashes his opponent around before pulling them close with Banshō Ten'in so he can kick them up in the air where he slashes at them some more.
Sleeping Snake Blade Slash: Orochimaru summons his Sword of Kusanagi from a snake that comes out of his mouth and delivers a series of spinning slashes to the opponent.
Slicing Crimson Wave: Towa does a simple crescent-shaped slash at the opponent, expelling a red chakra wave on the process.
Slithering Snake Mode: The user turns the lower half of their body into a snake's tail, which greatly increases their speed and agility. An alternative version is Orochimaru shedding his skin, revealing a new body that already has a snake's tail.
Slug Crusher: Tsunade summons a small sized Katsuyu and throws her in the air above the opponent, where she grows to her full size to crush them, somewhat similar to Summoning: Food Cart Destroyer Technique.
Slug Great Division: Katsuyu, being a mollusk, has a body that is naturally difficult to grasp hold of, in turn granting it a natural defence. As an additional defence, it can, when it's being physically attacked, divide its body into countless smaller versions of itself, thus nullifying the attack. The smaller divisions, each one a full-functioning Katsuyu, can recombine when they wish, restoring Katsuyu to its larger size. If a Katsuyu should be attacked again, it can just divide again, repeating the process indefinitely until the attacker gives up.
Sly Mind Affect Technique: This technique causes a target or targets to, while walking in what they believe to be a straight direction, walk in circles. As is typical for genjutsu, the targets are unlikely to notice that they're doing this, causing them to waste time and energy as they wander about. Team 7 only realise that they've fallen prey to this technique when they notice the body of a centipede that Naruto killed hours earlier.
Small Package: Konan creates a localised paper storm around her opponent.
Smell Sphere: The user spits out a purple breath-sphere which forcefully explodes into a stinking cloud, covering a wide area. Anyone who comes in contact with the gas gets paralysed for a short while. Furthermore, the technique can hinder the sense of smell of their victims for a prolonged period of time, as seen with Kiba Inuzuka and Akamaru. Due to this, this technique is very effective against ninken and other groups who rely on their sense of smell. The smell is due to fermentation inside the body.
Smoke Clone: This technique allows the user to create a clone made out of smoke. When it is hit, it reverts back into smoke.
Smoke Dragon: By unleashing a continuous stream of smoke from his wrist launcher, Kihō can use his chakra to shape the smoke into the form of a dragon linked to his wrist launcher. This gives him the advantage of short range attacks, and because the dragon is completely composed of smoke, physical attacks are useless against it. He could also form several smoke dragons at once. Its primary battle ability is to envelop and suffocate the target. However, as smoke is dissolved when it comes into contact with water, this technique is weak against water-based attacks.
Snake: , also known as , are residents of the Ryūchi Cave that are the signature summons of Orochimaru, his assistant, Kabuto Yakushi, and his students: Sasuke Uchiha and Anko Mitarashi.
Snake Charmer Technique: Orochimaru opens his mouth, letting out a giant snake that slithers its way towards the opponent and rams them. When the snake stops its attack, it dissolves back into Orochimaru.
Snake Clone Technique: Using snakes as a catalyst, the user can create a clone of themselves or objects that function similarly to shadow clones. When dealt sufficient damage the clone will revert back into snakes. The snakes can also be used to enter areas that they might find difficult to access otherwise. The user can then manipulate its actions, when given the command.
Snake Mouth Bind: The user traps the opponent and himself in the mouth of a snake. The snake's stomach is very elastic-like as it could even withstand Gamabunta, a creature of similar size, being summoned within it.
Snake Mouth Poison Mist Technique: Using his snake-tail, Kabuto sprays a venomous cloud on the opponent, which causes devastating effects when inhaled by the opponent.
Snake Reconnection Technique: If Orochimaru is bisected by an opponent, snakes are able to emerge from both halves of his body and pull him back together, seemingly undoing the damage he sustained.
Snake Skin Sword Stroke: Kabuto slashes his opponent with a chakra scalpel, followed by three strikes with his navel tail. Then, two giant white snakes emerge from the ground, biting his opponent, a third one releases a venom cloud, poisoning the target, and Kabuto finishes by emerging from his stretched snake tail, delivering another chakra scalpel slash.
Snake Spying Technique: The user links with their summoned snake to access their point of view, seeing and hearing everything around them. It allows for more discreet surveillance and intel gathering.
Snake Steel Net: After using the Summoning: Dual-Headed Snakes, snakes emerge from the summoned snakes mouths in order of two's and from those ones others are summoned through the mouths in a continuous order in an attempt to capture their target. As the snakes continue to multiply, they become smaller and smaller the farther they are from the epicentre of this technique.
Snake Wild Strike: Anko rushes her target with a series of slashes with a twin-knee-leap in-between followed by another slash into a kunai reap, then finishes by releasing snakes from both wrists.
Soap Bubble Ninjutsu: Soap Bubble Ninjutsu is a branch of ninjutsu from the of the Water Release nature transformation.
Soap Bubble Slime: Utakata blows bubbles, which release a sticky slime when popped, delaying or trapping an opponent.
Soaring Bird Crusher: Sasuke hits the opponent under the chin with the hilt of his sword. Then he kicks them thrice sending them further into the air. As the opponent plummets to the ground, Sasuke appears where they are about to fall and hits them powerfully in the gut, sending them crashing into whatever's on the way.
Soaring Shine Falling Bullet: Fū blinds her opponent with scale powder, grabs them, flies them up in the air, and throws them back down at the ground.
Soaring Strings: Kagura shoots numerous knives attached to chakra strings from the ground, like a geyser.
Soaring Swallow Stepping Foot: Fū jumps up into the air, slashes her opponent with a kunai, damages her opponent while spinning, and finishes by landing on top of them with both feet.
Soft Neck Throw: Orochimaru lengthens his neck and thrusts his head towards the opponent's neck and latches on with a bite. He then throws them behind him with his mouth.
Soft Physique Modification: Before this technique can be performed, the user's body must first be modified to increase its flexibility and elasticity. Once this is done, the user can stretch and bend their body however and whenever they please, extending it to great lengths and retracting it again. This is done by dislocating their joints and then using chakra to manipulate their body's shape. The technique was originally developed for intelligence gathering so that users could squeeze into smalls spaces. In combat, users can wrap around targets to restrain or constrict them, or strike at them with their limbs, the limbs' length making them similar to whips.
Sonic Blast: Dosu grabs the opponent by the throat, releasing a small amount of sound from his device, disorienting them.
Sonic Shock: Dosu slams the ground hard, releasing sonic waves that paralyse anyone caught in the attack's range and cracking the ground.
Soul Hunting: #The first, shown in Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2, is of Hidan slashing the opponent with his Triple-Bladed Scythe in a combo.
Soulbane: A powerful genjutsu known to be forbidden among the Konohagakure ninja. It targets the mind and causes the target to believe that anyone is a foe. While under the effects of the genjutsu, anyone affected will attack those who they believe to be enemies, even their closest friends. They will act completely coherent, however, almost as if it is of their own volition, but they will not listen to reason. Once defeated, they return to normal with almost no memory of the events. A more powerful version was cast on Konoha ninja through the use of barriers set up and maintained at four points, two of which were protected by ninja who were under the effects of the genjutsu themselves. This more potent version could not be dispelled by normal means; only by killing the original caster could it be stopped.
Soul–Body Separation Technique: With the aid of a tag, the user creates a seal which affects a certain area around it removing the soul of the target from its body. The soul is sealed within the tag. If someone comes in contact with the tag or removes it from its place, the soul will be released. The soul is visible and audible to the person who touched the tag, but has no initial memory of their past life.
Sound Four's Cursed Seals: Each member of the Sound Four uses a cursed seal. Their seals, however, are not as powerful as the Heaven and Earth seals, although they have similar end results.
Sound Four: Summoning: Four Beasts Encir: The Sound Four summons each of their respective summons to barricade their opponents. While the Triple Rashōmon makes escape difficult, the Doki and Earth Prison Golem attack from the front, while Kyodaigumo attacks from above.
Sound Wave Technique: A technique that allows the user to create a burst of sound waves that upsurge from around their vicinity. This technique was strong enough to not only destroy Orochimaru's lab, but also subdue two Anbu members.
Space–Time Ninjutsu: Godspeed: Minato throws a Flying Thunder God Kunai at his opponent, hitting them, and then teleports behind them to stab them again.
Space–Time Technique Formula: Underworld: The Space–Time Technique Formula: Underworld Turnover was a technique designed by Orochimaru for the sole purpose of revenge. It was utilised by the reincarnated Sound Four releasing their hatred within their cursed seals.
Space–Time: Spiralling Serial Spheres: Minato teleports towards the opponent in a zig-zag manner, and hits them with a large Rasengan in each hand.
Spear Attack Shining Horn: Using its foremost horn, Chōmei attacks its opponent. Sending the reeling with such force that the victim is left incapacitated by the wind force, unable to react to either protect or defend themselves.
Spear of Heaven Nine-Tails Beam: After bathing in Ama no Hoko, the Nine-Tailed Naruto Clone's abilities were magnified and it could fire powerful purplish-orange chakra beams from its dragon/snake-like heads. These beams were powerful enough to cut through solid rock and even damage Naruto despite the latter being almost completely transformed into Kurama.
Special Attack Rasengan: Naruto punches the opponent to the ground and creates two clones as one forms a weaker Rasengan in the other's hand that the clone strikes the opponent with.
Spider Bind: Kidōmaru spits a web of threads from his mouth, the web's size being adjusted depending on how far away his targets are and how many he intends to trap. On contact, the web pushes targets away from Kidōmaru and wraps around them, trapping them. Because Kidōmaru's threads are made sticky with chakra, escaping from them is difficult once trapped. Kidōmaru most often uses this technique in response to frontal attacks, the webs neutralising his opponents before they can harm him.
Spider Cocoon: Kidōmaru imprisons a target in a cocoon of spider threads. Because of how tightly around the target the spider threads are stretched, they are unable to move once they've been trapped. Kidōmaru can further constrict the threads by flowing additional chakra into them, to the point of ultimately strangling the target. The threads are produced by mixing Kidōmaru's saliva with chakra, making them exceptionally sticky. As with all of Kidōmaru's webbing, targets can free themselves by injecting their own chakra into the threads, such as with the Gentle Fist.
Spider Drop: Kidōmaru spews rope made of webs, which he uses to swing around the area.
Spider Scatter Technique: Kidōmaru summons a horde of small spiders to crawl towards his opponent and attack them.
Spider Sticking Spit: Kidōmaru spits a thick rope of webbing from his mouth at a target. The rope is very sticky because of all the webs that are layered together, which Kidōmaru can further increase (or decrease) the stickiness of by altering how much chakra flows into the rope. The rope attaches firmly to targets at the point of contact, allowing Kidōmaru to fling them around into the surroundings. Alternatively, the rope itself can be used to damage targets directly as a whip.
Spider Sticky Gold: Kidōmaru produces a golden metallic substance within his body, which he can gather in his mouth like saliva or secrete from his pores like sweat. It is very malleable when first created, but once it makes contact with the air it hardens rapidly, becoming as strong as steel. For this reason, if he intends to shape the substance into a particular form, he should do so before it's left his body, such as by chewing it into sharp projectiles that he extracts from his mouth. Alternatively, he can carefully shape it as he spits it out, as he does with the Spider War Bow: Terrible Split. These golden weapons are the core of Kidōmaru's offensive tactics, typically used for long-range attacks. A property of the Spider Sticky Gold is that it is fortified against chakra, making techniques such as Gentle Fist unable to penetrate it.
Spider War Bow: Terrible Split: Kidōmaru first creates a war bow by carefully expelling Spider Sticky Gold from his mouth. With it he is able to fire arrows, using his body's eight limbs to boost the bow's tension beyond what normal people are capable of. Because of how much power is put into each arrow, they travel incredibly quickly, too fast to see. On impact, the arrows pierce cleanly through targets and obstacles alike and can crater the ground, to the point that it is described as a "one hit kill". By activating his cursed seal's second level, Kidōmaru gains a third eye which further increases his accuracy, allowing him to hit his target's vital spots from hundreds of metres away.
Spider Web Area: Kidōmaru spreads a network of "touch threads" throughout an area. Kidōmaru constantly sends his chakra along the threads, allowing him to sense anything that comes into contact with them; the threads are sensitive enough to even detect slight disturbances in the air. Because the threads appear no different than normal spiderwebs, they aren't likely to be noticed and thus are effective as an alert of approaching enemies. Kidōmaru uses this technique while he and the rest of the Sound Four are resting, ensuring they won't be ambushed. The touch threads, being stronger than wire, can also be used to reel in those who've contacted them.
Spider Web Flower: Kidōmaru spits several small nets from his mouth at a target or targets; the nets' small size means they can be produced rapidly, increasing his chances of striking his target. The nets are made sticky with chakra, causing them to cling to targets on contact and adhere them to whatever other object or surface the nets touch. The more nets a target is struck with, the stronger the binding. As with all of Kidōmaru's webbing, targets can free themselves by injecting their own chakra into the nets, such as with the Gentle Fist.
Spider Web Unrolling: Kidōmaru creates a ball of thread which he then expands into a large web using his six arms. He most often uses this while he's in the air, allowing the web to spread over a wide area. Approaching enemies are usually caught off guard by the technique and end up suspended in place by it. The webbing is made sticky with chakra, restricting victims' movements and thus leaving them at Kidōmaru's mercy. The web is elastic enough and strong enough that a kunai cannot cut it and that two elephants pulling it from opposite ends cannot break it. As with all of Kidōmaru's threads, targets can free themselves by injecting their own chakra into the webbing, such as with the Gentle Fist. The flames of Amaterasu are also strong enough to burn away the webs.
Spike Rain: The user throws several Spike Bombs at their opponents, their detonation covering a wide area.
Spiked Human Bullet Tank: This is an enhanced version of the Akimichi clan's Human Bullet Tank. The user first wraps ropes around themselves that have kunai attached to them. Once this is done, they use the Multi-Size Technique and perform the Human Bullet Tank as normal. The kunai act as spikes, increasing the Bullet Tank's rotation power and, consequently, making it a much more destructive attack.
Spindle Formation: The user has their bugs attack the target in a spiralling motion in order to stop the enemy from retaliating.
Spinning Snake Thorn: After using Summoning: Dual-Headed Snakes and merging with them by using the Chimera Technique, the user can fire spinning projectiles from the snake's mouths that have explosive impact.
Spinning Top Swing: Naruto jumps mid-air, creates a shadow clone, and each take turns delivering hits to the opponent, the momentum of their spinning keeping them in the air until the last hit is landed.
Spiral Boruto Storm: Boruto creates a shadow clone and delivers a few strikes to his opponent, putting some distance between them. The shadow clone creates a Vanishing Rasengan, and Boruto grabs the clone by the hand, spinning it to create momentum. Boruto lets go of the clone, and the clone throws the Rasengan, giving it more speed. When it connects with the target, it pushes them up in the air before expanding.
Spiral Lotus: This technique is exactly like the Front Lotus except Naruto gives it another name when he uses it.
Spiralling Absorption Sphere: Naruto uses his chakra arms while within Nine-Tails Chakra Mode to form a Big Ball Rasengan in his hand, then throws it above his back. He then uses extra chakra arms to grab and smash enemies into the sphere, simulating an "absorption" of the victims into the Rasengan.
Spiralling Bullet: The user gathers chakra with two fingers to condense it into a small Rasengan. It can be shot from a distance at the target and move a blazing speed. To which, it has immense penetrative power, throwing its target off their feet even after piercing through them.
Spiralling Combo: Momoshiki fires three small Rasengan bullets at the opponent, doing more damage than a singular bullet.
Spiralling Flash Super Round Dance Howl: This technique was devised by Minato Namikaze and employs the use of the Flying Thunder God Technique.
Spiralling Great Fire Sphere: Naruto creates a Rasengan, Sasuke breathes Fire Release: Great Fireball into it. Naruto then slams the flame-covered Rasengan into the opponent which erupts into a fiery blast.
Spiralling Ring: Menma creates a dark purple Rasengan-like orb of chakra surrounded by a series of white rings of chakra that orbit the main sphere. These rings then align into one disc-like shape around the orb, causing the rings to resemble planetary rings. It matches Naruto's Sage Mode Wind Release: Rasenshuriken in power.
Spiralling Serial Spheres: The Spiralling Serial Spheres is a double-handed version of the regular Rasengan.
Spiralling Strife Spheres: Naruto, while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, uses a chakra arm to form multiple Rasengan above his head. He then uses additional arms to hold the Rasengan and hit multiple opponents simultaneously.
Spiralling Tower Technique: This technique is devised by Kakashi Hatake as a way to reach 200 kilometres above Konohagakure. His original idea is to create an Earth-Style Wall to reach that altitude, but he doesn't believe he would have enough chakra to make it tall enough. For this reason he recruits Yamato to assist him. They practice all night to synchronise Kakashi's Earth Release with Yamato's Wood Release, finding a configuration that is structurally sound but that also will reach the intended elevation within the one hour they'll be allotted.
Spirit Foot: Shizune spins around and kicks her opponent sending them flying backwards.
Spirit Reflection Technique: Malice takes a shinobi's chakra and imbues a puppet with it, creating a perfect copy of the shinobi. These puppets are granted any weapons, techniques, and bloodline techniques they may have. Malice is able to control the puppets from very long distances and without the use of chakra threads.
Spirit Transformation Soul Killing Techn: Dan's soul leaves his body, and enters the body of his opponent. Inside, it destroys their opponent's soul before returning to Dan's body.
Spirit Transformation Technique: This highly versatile technique allows the user's spirit to leave their body. By taking possession of a target, the spirit can suppress and collapse the victim's spirit, killing them, or freely manipulate their actions. This technique can also be used to communicate information or transfer chakra. This technique will always reach the intended target, even when their whereabouts are unknown to the user. Having become a living ghost, the spirit has no substance and cannot be affected by enemy attacks.
Spontaneous Tree Summoning: A last resort technique which doesn't require hand seals. Using their own cells as a medium, the user creates an entire tree from their body at the cost of a large amount of chakra. In doing so, it can alter the trajectory of incoming attacks.
Spore Technique: White Zetsu is able to plant spore-sized parasite clones onto the bodies of others for the purpose of remotely monitoring them. As these clones parasitise their victim's chakra and have no chakra of their own, they cannot be detected by standard sensory abilities. Once activated via time-delay, the parasite clones suddenly expand, restricting their victim's movements and stealing greater amounts of chakra.
Stagnate Snake Confinement: Kabuto expels four white snakes from his mouth on the field, which is stepped on, will have numerous snakes swarm on the opponent.
Stake Chains: Obito delivers a series of strikes to the opponent with a combination of Kamui, a shuriken and Wood Release: Cutting Technique. Then he creates black receivers which rain on the opponent. Finally, Obito uses Demonic Statue Chains to pick up the stakes and smash them to the opponent.
Starch Syrup Binding Rope: After kneading chakra in the stomach and converting it to high-viscosity water, the user spits it out, in the form of ropes that restrains the target's movement. Because of the viscosity of the water, it is even more difficult for them to escape its confines.
Starch Syrup Gun: The user kneads chakra, along with natural energy and then converts it into large amount of high-viscosity water within their mouth before spitting it outward with an incredible amount of force. The projectile-like force of this technique combined with its monstrous volume gives it the capability to quickly cover a wide area.
Stealth Snake Hand: Kabuto lands a series of attacks with snakes and chakra scalpels, before burrowing underground and rising out for a snake-based uppercut.
Steam Dash: After increasing their chakra temperature to its boiling point, the user releases boiling steam from their body, after which, they dash straight at the opponent in a straight line, taking the similar approach to a locomotive and creating sounds, which are similar to the ones made by a steam whistle.
Steaming Danger Tyranny: The Steaming Danger Tyranny is Gengetsu Hōzuki's .
Steaming Danger Tyranny: Sleeve Cutter: The user uses Steaming Danger Tyranny, which is capable of forming an axe on one of its hands. The axe can be used for combat purposes.
Steaming Danger Tyranny: Steaming Danger: Gengetsu creates a Steaming Danger Tyranny that body slams the opponent, creating an explosion of steam.
Steel Blades Technique: When using this technique, steel blades begin to grow from the ground, which rush into the heights in wave-like movements, growing like tree branches, piercing everyone who gets in the way.
Steel Release: Impervious Armour: This technique allows the user to turn their body into jet-black steel. Hiruko states that blades do not affect him at all due to this ability, which is demonstrated when Sai's tantō snapped clean in half on impact.
Steel Release: Steel Projectile: The user creates a ball made out of steel. The projectile can be launched a considerable distance at the target, inflicting heavy blunt damage. When in unison with Lava Release, which can melt the steel, it changes into a spiralling-like shape.
Steel Release: Steel Shield Technique: The user raises a steel shield from the ground, in the form of a defensive wall. The shield is strong enough to ward off large amounts of sand bullets.
Sticky Bite: Transformed as Saiken, Utakata bites and chews his opponent.
Stomach Reflection: Shukaku feigns sleep while the opponent rushes to attack it, only for Shukaku's stomach to bounce the opponent back.
Stone Pillar Destruction: Based on the terrain she is in, Sakura will use her enhanced strength to break off a large column of stone and throw it at the opponent. She can also place explosive tags on the column.
Storm Release Secret Technique: Demon Dr: Hiruko uses the Storm Release kekkei genkai he acquired through his Chimera Technique to produce a massive thunder cloud capable of infinitely absorbing chakra to grow in size, strength and ferocity. The amount of chakra it receives will also increase. He can apparently channel this absorbed energy into himself, amplifying the technique to its highest limit.
Storm Release: Azure Eagle Blade: Darui generates beams of energy that strike the opponent, then jumps and delivers a sword strike with his electricity-charged blade.
Storm Release: Black Hunting: Seemingly using the manoeuvrability of his Storm Release: Laser Circus technique, but employing the use of black lightning instead of normal lightning, Darui sends out several panthers which are guided towards the opponent, slashing them as they pass. The panthers then merge into a single, giant panther behind the opponent, which bites them and then explodes.
Storm Release: Laser Circus: This technique creates several beams and shoots them at the enemy. First, a halo of bright energy spreads around the user's hands as this technique is activated, then it encircles the user's hand and from that, the beams are shot out towards the enemy. The user is able to alter the beam's direction after being shot, making it possible to strike multiple enemies with pinpoint accuracy, even bypassing hostages held in close proximity. The user can also increase the number of beams to a great amount to pin down an enemy.
Storm Release: Thunder Cloud Inner Wave: Hiruko uses Storm Release to generate a thick ring of thunderclouds and electricity around him, creating an offensive and defensive ward. He can then use these clouds to fire powerful blasts of lightning at his enemies, and as an electrified perimeter; effectively preventing his enemies from getting close.
Strange Mask Exploding Flame: By having his fire and wind masks merge, with or without him, Kakuzu has them combine their fire and wind attacks to create a powerful blast of intense fire. Kakashi remarked that water alone wasn't enough to put it out. It took the effort of a wind-enhanced water technique to fully counter it.
Strange Transmission Distant Shadow: Through an application of Sakon's kekkei genkai, Kabuto is able to use the techniques of anyone whose cells are integrated into his body, including even kekkei genkai and hiden techniques. Using Sakon's Twin Demons Technique, he makes a clone of the person's upper half form out of his own body, emerging from the base of the snake growing out of his torso. This clone is then able to perform any of the techniques used by its genetic source, all the while Kabuto himself is free to continue moving and fighting independently. Once generated, the clone is able to transform into others on the fly in order to access their techniques, and it can even use one person's abilities in conjunction with another's; for example, a clone of Tayuya is able to cast genjutsu using a bone flute created by a clone of Kimimaro. In theory, there are no techniques that Kabuto cannot use thanks to this ability.
Strength of a Hundred Seal: The Strength of a Hundred Seal is a jutsu from the Sage of Six Paths era, that requires extremely delicate chakra control. By storing a vast amounts of chakra over an extended period of time into a specific point on their body — usually the forehead — the user creates this seal, which manifests in the form of a rhombus-like marking. Once the seal is formed, the user's already impressive chakra control allows them to perform techniques without any wasted energy. When released, the seal will either spread across the user's face or wrap around their entire body. The stored chakra is then released into their body, greatly amplifying the power of their techniques. The seal will permanently remain in the centre of the user's forehead, presumably so that the user can keep on benefiting from its effects.
Strengthening Prescription: Chakra Injec: The was a dark medical ninjutsu that Yomi's clan had spent generations to perfect just for the night of releasing Mōryō's spirit in the Land of Demons.
String Bean Binding Illusion: A typical technique amongst the members of the Kurama clan. The illusion shows the user disappear before the opponent is surrounded by several bean vines that bind their body and lift them into the air. A bean pod then rises from the ground which opens to reveal the user, ready to strike.
String Light Formation: This barrier is designed to prevent anyone from leaving its confines. Once within a certain range of the target, the user erects the barrier underfoot, rendering anyone within the seal formula incapable of escaping. Despite its strength, it can be overpowered as demonstrated when Naruto Uzumaki was able to easily break the seal by entering his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode.
Strong Fist: is Guy's and Lee's characteristic fighting style, the purpose of which is to cause external damage and break bones. It is the exact opposite of Gentle Fist which is used mainly by the Hyūga Clan. This style of fighting involves smashing your opponent and is generally used only by extremely physically powerful and dominating shinobi. As shown by Sasuke's initial usage of this style, the user must be exceptionally conditioned or even a brief performance in this style will quickly exhaust and strain the body. It was only after a month of training that Sasuke later became able to use this style unhindered.
Strong Spear Tree: Hashirama will form the required hand seal and create two tendrils that emerge from the ground and shoot towards the opponent intertwining with one another before piercing through the opponent.
Strong Sword: Helmet Breaking: Hashirama further enhances his chakra enhanced sword, increasing its size. Then, he delivers a straight slash into the ground, dealing a great damage to the opponent.
Student and Teacher: Rasengan: A cooperation ninjutsu used by two Rasengan users, one of whom was the teacher of the Rasengan to the other. They each perform a Rasengan next to each other, and strike together at their opponent, causing twice the damage of what a single Rasengan would do.
Substitute Technique: The Substitute Technique is a technique unique to White Zetsu. It allows him to assume the identity of any individual for a variety of purposes: though similar in nature to the standard Transformation Technique, it boasts far greater utility.
Successive Shots Iron Sand Drizzle: Shinki uses his Iron Sand to shoot a multitude of skewer-like projectiles in rapid succession. Being that it is a widespread attack, it is especially effective against multiple opponents.
Successive Shots Sand Drizzle: Gaara rapidly fires bullet-like sand at the opponent to take them down in one swift motion.
Suicide Bombing Clone: After creating a shadow clone, it will then ingest some explosive clay and explode, creating a diversion that can be used to escape. With a "suicide bombing announcement" the enemy's wariness is heightened and this opportunity is used to switch places with a shadow clone. The explosion is said to be strong enough to destroy an entire forest. This technique requires an adept usage of verbal tricks; with this foundation of using many "arts" to trifle with the enemy, it certainly fulfils its purpose.
Sukunahikona: Sukunahikona is a Kokugan technique. It allows the caster to instantaneously shrink themselves or any nonliving matter within their field of vision (or return the same to full size) at will.
Sukunahikona: Canopy Box Drop: As Jigen, Isshiki sends the opponent to another dimension, attacks them, and pins them in stakes as he summons a large cube to slam down on them.
Sukunahikona: Chaos Bloom: Kawaki slams his hand on the grow, growing numerous stakes around him, as well as larger stakes, damaging at opponent that is near him.
Sukunahikona: God Hunter: Kawaki shrinks himself and rushes towards the opponent, returning to full size and punches them with his transformed fist.
Sukunahikona: Instant Appearance: The user shrinks themselves to evade their enemy’s sight in order to perform a sneak attack. Due to the speed at which the user shrinks and enlarge, the technique had been mistaken for teleportation.
Sukunahikona: Mighty Thrashing: Kawaki shrinks himself and appears in front of the opponent, showering down a barrage of rods on them.
Sukunahikona: Rain of Early Summer: In the air, Isshiki brings out a large bundle of rods, which he separates and showers down in the surrounding area. Isshiki can use the scattered rods to track down a target if the Byakugan's chakra sensing is impaired.
Sukunahikona: Rapid Succession: The user fires formerly shrunken black rods as projectiles towards the enemy. The speed they can be fired is so fast that even the Sharingan cannot detect them in time, only a feat that Baryon Mode had been able to accomplish.
Sukunahikona: Scale Fragment: Kawaki places shrunken fragments of his altered skin around his opponent and restores them to full size to converge on the opponent.
Summoning Rinnegan: Through the power of the Animal Path, the user is able to summon people and animals which will come to possess copies of the Rinnegan. As with the Six Paths of Pain and the King of Hell, animals summoned through this technique are visually linked to the user's own Rinnegan, offering them a greater field of view. The summons' bodies are also adorned with a number of black piercings, allowing the user to control them remotely through the use of their chakra. People summoned with the technique can also be granted a portion of the Six Paths Technique.
Summoning Technique: The Summoning Technique allows the user to transport a target, most frequently an animal familiar, to their location.
Summoning Technique — Fall: Nagato summons a giant panda, which drops directly on top of his opponent.
Summoning: Blue Snake Ring Prison: Sasuke summons Aoda, who circles around him and spins around, preventing the opponents from approaching.
Summoning: Crushing Toad Stomach: This technique bares some similarity to the Summoning: Toad Mouth Bind technique. However, instead of warping the battlefield into the digestive tracts of a giant toad, Jiraiya reverse summons himself and his opponents into the stomach of a giant toad (possibly the same species as the giant, fire-breathing toad used in his Summoning: Toad Mouth Bind technique), essentially bringing the battle to a new battlefield.
Summoning: Demonic Statue of the Outer P: Summoning: Demonic Statue of the Outer Path is a technique used through the power of the Rinnegan.
Summoning: Dual-Headed Snakes: The user summons a double-headed, snake-like creature to attack their enemies.
