Summoning: Earth Release: Tracking Fang: When, for whatever reason, the user cannot find a target, they use this technique to summon a pack of ninken underground. The ninken use their superior sense of smell to track the target, converge on their location, and then all together burst from the ground and take hold with their fangs. With the target captured in this way, the summoner can easily locate them and finish them off.
Summoning: Fan Dance Drop: After summoning Kamatari, Temari spins it with the kama. It slams the opponent into a giant rock, which splits apart and falls on the opponent like an avalanche.
Summoning: Fiddler Crab: Tenma summons scissor-like pincers from a scroll that he uses in conjunction with taijutsu. The pincers are very strong, able to cleave clean through solid metal.
Summoning: Food Cart Destroyer Technique: The user summons a toad in the air, which falls to the ground. On impact, the ground shakes, structures are destroyed, and the user's targets are pinned beneath the toad's weight, preventing them from moving. Jiraiya is skilled enough to, while summoning the toad, add force to the toad's fall, creating the effect that the toad has fallen from several hundred meters higher than it actually did and thus doing greater damage.
Summoning: Giant Clam: Boiling Break: Gengetsu summons the giant clam, which creates a mirage of two additional clams surrounding the opponent, leaving Gengetsu to shoot the trapped opponent, creating a large vortex of water.
Summoning: Ibuse: Hanzō summons Ibuse, who creates a poison cloud in the general area in front of it, poisoning his opponent in it.
Summoning: Ibuse Poisoning: Ibuse gets out of the ground under the feet of the target and swallows them, poisoning them with poisonous gas inside his body.
Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation: The Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation is a jutsu that binds the soul of a deceased person to a living vessel, restoring them as they were in the last moments of their lives in order to do their summoner's bidding. It was originally created by Tobirama Senju, some time after which he declared it a kinjutsu. Orochimaru would discover the technique decades later and improve on its use, while his subordinate Kabuto Yakushi nearly perfected it.
Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation Ho: Orochimaru summons the reincarnated Hashirama and Tobirama, having them use their elemental dragon techniques to attack the opponent.
Summoning: Iron Maiden: Ibiki summons a giant iron maneki neko, which appears beneath the opponent from underground, split down the middle. The statue clamps around the target and is then wrapped in chains, which drag it back down into the ground.
Summoning: Kamatari: Temari summons Kamatari, which swirls around her to create a whirlwind that slices any opponents in her vincinity.
Summoning: Katsuyu: The user briefly summons Katsuyu, which sprays acid at the opponent in front of it.
Summoning: Lightning Flash Blade Creatio: This is a special "ninja tool summon" that allows the user to seal ninja tools like swords or kunai into a scroll or their clothes beforehand, allowing them to be called upon when needed. The ninja tools can be summoned in an instant just by touching the sealing "marks" which can be drawn anywhere. The greatest advantage of this technique is that the time between taking out a ninja tool, taking the right stance and actually throwing it is greatly reduced. Also when a weapon such as a fūma shuriken is summoned, the time needed to throw it can be further shortened by having prepared the weapon in its fully extended form beforehand.
Summoning: Log Rolling: Rin quickly performs a few hand seals, then summons a large rolling log which slams all opponents that are within a short distance in front of her.
Summoning: Nine-Tails: The user summons Kurama, who they have under their control, to blast the opponent with the Tailed Beast Ball.
Summoning: Quick Beheading Dance: Temari uses her Giant Folding Fan to create a whirlwind that is powerful enough to travel several hundred metres. As she swings the fan, which has previously been smeared with her blood, she summons Kamatari, which travels upon the winds and rapidly cuts through everything in its path. The debris that Kamatari creates, as well as anything else in the area, is picked up by the winds and crushes whatever it is flung against. Because of how extensive this technique's damage and how wide an area it covers, it is most useful against hiding opponents or when the user is surrounded. The terrain is left flattened afterwards, which also means the user's location is exposed.
Summoning: Quintuple Rashōmon: While one is already boasted as an absolute defense, the user — without the need of hand seals — instantly summons five Rashōmon gates to neutralise incoming attacks. The user can alter the positioning of all five gates, even if it is to change the trajectory of an attack. Not only were the combination of these gates able to redirect an attack as powerful as a Tailed Beast Ball equipped with a Susanoo sword, but they remained standing upon impact.
Summoning: Rainwater Gate: A form of summoning technique, bringing forth a single gate sturdy enough to withstand a taijutsu-attack by Rock Lee. However, an explosive tag from behind is able to destroy the gate.
Summoning: Rashōmon: The user summons a large gate; Sakon and Ukon can only summon it together. The gate itself is designed to look frightening, with the gate's doors having a demonic face upon them; this is to intimidate onlookers, potentially warding them off. The gate's doors are tightly shut and solidly built, making it useful as a shield against most forms of physical attack. The stronger the attack, the more damage the attacker will do to themselves when they try and fail to break through the gate. Sakon and Ukon praise Kiba Inuzuka and Akamaru for being able to dent the gate, which they say is Orochimaru's strongest defence. Despite this, Orochimaru can also use a three gate variant, and beyond that is a five gate variant.
Summoning: Rashōmon Hell: Sakon and Ukon separate and use a combined Summoning Technique to summon the Rashōmon flat on the ground. The demonic gate then opens and swallows the opponent into another dimension.
Summoning: Ten-Tails: Obito slams his right hand to the ground, creating a summoning symbol to call Ten-Tails. The Ten-Tails' fist will then burst from under the ground a short distance in front of Obito, striking the opponent. As the rest of the incomplete Ten-Tails surfaces, Obito stands upon its head, ordering it to attack. An eruption will occur in front of the Ten-Tails, incinerating Obito's opponent.
Summoning: Toad Mouth Bind: Unlike the usual practice of summoning an entire creature, the user instead summons only the oesophagus of a giant toad from . The oesophagus is summoned around a target; if this is done inside a cave or some other structure, it's possible the target will not even notice. The walls of the oesophagus are sticky and pliable, making it difficult for opponents to keep their footing and, therefore, fight as normal. The oesophagus is ordinarily inescapable, and over time it will contract around and digest its victims.
Summoning: Toad Shop Technique: This technique summons a from Mount Myōboku. This toad has the ability to transform into a building and with their chakra, the user gives the building a design they imagined themselves. The target is then lured inside, for example, with the promise of cheap drinks. Once the target has entered the store, the toad changes back into its original small form, trapping the target inside the toad's stomach. From the moment the cancellation hand seal is performed, it takes only a few seconds for it to return to its original shape, meaning there is little chance of escape.
Summoning: Torture Chamber: This technique is used by Ibiki to summon an iron torture chamber around himself and the opponent. First, the enemy's arms and legs are captured by four chains, and then the walls of the cage appear flat on the ground, quickly folding together to box them in. Finally, a large statue falls atop the cage, which is then tightly bound in chains.
Summoning: Triple Rashōmon: The Summoning: Triple Rashōmon is an upgrade to the standard Summoning: Rashōmon, which — as its name suggests — summons not one, but three menacing Rashōmon. The technique requires two summoning seals to be completed, and these gates serve the same function as the single Rashōmon, but with triple the defence. The first gate takes the attack head-on, the second reduces the attack's power and the third disperses the pressure, causing all attacks that come in contact with it to lose their power before they can be effective. The defensive capabilities of this technique are further boosted by the lack of hand seals required to perform this technique.
Summoning: True Fire of the Flaming Moun: The user summons fire from the Flaming Mountains. Because they're naturally-occurring, physical flames, instead of being chakra-based, Kāma cannot absorb them.
Super Beast Flying Combo: Sai creates an ink hawk with Naruto riding high in the air and him and some shadow clones drop down on the opponent.
Super Beast Flying Hammer: Yamato strikes the opponent with a wooden pillar where Sai's ink hawks attack the opponent in the air and Yamato slams the opponent to the ground with another wooden pillar.
Super Beast Imitating Drawing: The Super Beast Imitating Drawing is a technique that allows the user to animate ink drawings, which act upon the user's will.
Super Beast Imitating Drawing: A Hundred: Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to create dozens of lions which shower down on the opponent. He then creates a giant dragon, finishing them off.
Super Beast Imitating Drawing: Armour Co: While flying in the air above the opponent on his ink hawk, Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to have multiple ink creatures descend upon the opponent and attack them. He then dives down himself and slashes them with his tantō.
Super Beast Imitating Drawing: Dragon: Sai enlarges and unrolls the giant scroll with an image of a dragon that he summons to carry his opponent into the air and slam them into the scroll which the dragon itself submerges in.
Super Beast Imitating Drawing: Flight: Sai creates several ink birds from his scroll to attack his opponent.
Super Beast Imitating Drawing: White Ske: Sai uses his Super Beast Imitating Drawing to create three lions and a large hawk. The lions hit the opponent rapidly and send them upward, where the hawk waits and fires a barrage of razor sharp ink feathers at the opponent, covering them in ink and sending them crashing into the ground.
Super Compression Rasengan: With Mitsuki's addition of senjutsu chakra and Sarada adding to the force of impact, Boruto's Compression Rasengan's compression and power is increased. Their combined might makes it possible to overcome the near-impervious defences, like Deepa's Carbon Armour.
Super Excellent Hyper Attack: Potcha and Mondai put on their football helmets and charge at the enemy with a high speed. The attack resembles Passing Fang, though it is unknown how much damage it causes, since it was only used once and was halted by Lee and Guy.
Super Fang Wolf Fang: Man and beast transform into a single two-headed gigantic animal by the Human Beast Combination Transformation: Double-Headed Wolf technique, and just like its parent technique, have their body spin in a violent assault against the enemy. The power is great enough to break through three Rashōmon gates without losing its power. In addition unlike its parent technique it does not first require the use of Dynamic Marking first.
Super God Imitating Drawing: The Super God Imitating Drawing is a technique usable by those who have mastered the Super Beast Imitating Drawing.
Super Inner Sakura: Sakura does a sequence of punches and then she strikes her opponent with a powerful punch that sends them flying. After this, she makes a rapid combo of punches and finishes with a strike with her knee and a powerful kick.
Super Light Foot: Minato dashes towards his opponent and kicks them on the knee. He then slides behind them and kicks the same knee again in such a way that the opponent fly into the air.
Super Mini-Tailed Beast Ball: While in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Naruto gathers and balances the necessary black and white chakra to form a condensed, miniaturised Tailed Beast Ball. Upon impact, the ball explodes resulting in a very sizeable blast radius. As with the Rasengan, he can extend the ball forward with the use of a chakra arm. Naruto can use a shadow clone to help him form the ball, while in Tailed Beast Mode he can form it on his own.
Super Multi-Size Technique: This is a heightened version of the Akimichi clan's Multi-Size Technique. It is essentially the same as the base version, though the user becomes significantly larger, on a scale comparable to a mountain. Because of their huge size, any physical attacks the user makes are by default extremely powerful and cover a wide area. Such a drastic increase in size places a great strain on the user's body. The chakra requirements to perform this technique are also quite steep; in Part I, Chōji Akimichi must take one of the Three Coloured Pills in order to have enough chakra.
Super Open Hand Slap: After using the Multi-Size Technique to increase their size, the user funnels chakra into their hands, which causes special markings to appear on them. The weight and power of the hands are greatly increased because of the larger size, the muscles are activated with concentrated chakra, and the thickness is also increased. With so much chakra that it becomes visible, the user's palms become like an iron hammer. This gives this attack the power to even cave in the earth, causing extensive crushing damage to anything that may be caught beneath them. Due to the increased size of their palms, the attack covers a wide range.
Super Pressure: While in his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto delivers a series of punches to the opponent before kicking them upwards into the air, and falling down with them via a downwards punch. With the victim face-down on the ground, Naruto pummels away at their head in a feral fashion, before ending it with a punt-away kick as he growls afterwards.
Super Revival Fist: The Super Revival Fist is the ultimate technique derived from dark chakra.
Super Tailed Beast Big Ball Rasenshurike: Naruto enters his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode's Tailed Beast form, then proceeds to create nine separate Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken within each of his tails, using the elemental properties of Magnet, Fire, Water, Lava, Boil and Wind Release, as well as Tailed Beast chakra. He then throws each Rasenshuriken towards his opponent, culminating in a multitude of explosions.
Super-Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan: The Super-Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan is an even more powerful version of the Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan. The impact of this technique can carve a huge crater on the ground. In the anime, its strength was enough to uproot trees in its near vicinity.
Super: Human Bullet Tank: Chōji jumps into the air where he performs his Super Multi-Size Technique, followed by an enormous Human Bullet Tank to slam into his opponent.
Superb Turn: Deidara creates two small birds out of clay and they fly towards the opponent and explode. These knock targets back a long distance, and can ricochet off walls.
Supercooled Water Technique: The user employs Water Release and Wind Release to create supercooled water. The user can also create weapons out of the frozen water. With enough mastery, the use of Wind Release to supercool the water can be dispensed. While working fundamentally the same, Sasuke states that this technique is inferior to the true Ice Release.
Supervibrato Lightning Release Swords: Supervibrato Lightning Release Swords is a form of chakra flow used by Killer B, often alongside his signature kenjutsu and his preferred blades.
Supreme Ultimate Rasengan: Naruto merges his Rasengan with Minato's to create a Rasengan that drills through the opponent, causing massive damage. The Supreme Ultimate Rasengan, like the Tornado Rasengan, has several streams of chakra spiralling around the centre, but it has far more streams, completely covering the users' bodies. These streams are capable of deflecting attacks. The sphere itself appears unstable, with the shape fluctuating wildly unlike the solid sphere shape of other Rasengan techniques.
Surging Fire Wild Dance: This technique is a barrage of taijutsu attacks. The user first attacks their opponent with a kick, which is immediately followed by a punch and another kick from the opposite leg.
Susanoo: Susanoo is the strongest ability available to those who have awakened the Mangekyō Sharingan in both eyes, having been passed down through the Uchiha Clan's generations. It manifests as a gigantic, humanoid avatar made of the user's chakra, which surrounds them and fights on their behalf.
Susanoo: Attack: Sasuke lands a punch, followed by a few sword slashes, a kick, and a few more sword slashes before manifesting a Susanoo arm to punch his opponent.
Susanoo: Blade of Yachihoko: While in his Susanoo, Merz uses Yachihoko to gather chakra from all those who were under the effect of the Engraved Tsukuyomi to increase the size of his sword.
Susanoo: Captive Slash: Sasuke grabs his opponent using his Susanoo's hand, and slashes them with his sword.
Susanoo: Chidori: An application of Chidori through a Complete Body — Susanoo, whereby Sasuke produces a massive Chidori with its primary left hand.
Susanoo: Crush: Sasuke grabs his opponent with one of Susanoo's fists and crushes them within it.
Susanoo: Dance of Two Swords: The user's Susanoo swipes its blades, slashing with numerous waves of chakra.
Susanoo: Dance of the Sword: Using their Susanoo, the user swipes it blade to unleash a large wave of chakra to slice the opponent.
Susanoo: Destruction: Indra in his Susanoo creates a wave by slamming down both swords.
Susanoo: Fist: The user manifests a partially transformed Susanoo arm, which when used, can destroy a wall or repel a large individual.
Susanoo: Great Fireball Technique: Using Complete Body — Susanoo as a medium, the user can fire a multitude of fireballs from the construct's mouth. The fireballs vary in size, capable of becoming as large as a Tailed Beast. As the technique doesn't explode on impact, the fireballs can be repelled with enough force. By launching the technique into the sky, it creates thunderclouds, making it possible to use Kirin.
Susanoo: Kamui Lightning Cutter: Kakashi throws Kamui-imbued shuriken at his opponent, transporting them to Kamui's dimension, before going there himself. As his opponent falls through the dimension, Kakashi manifests his Complete Body — Susanoo, channels a Kamui Lightning Cutter through its hand, and runs his opponent with it.
Susanoo: Lightning Battle Formation: Using Susanoo, Indra brings down five bolts of lightning surrounding the opponent, where streams of electricity surge towards the center, causing a large electric blast.
Susanoo: Lightning Flame Flash: With Susanoo, Indra swipes his avatar's sword, unleashing a fiery twister and leaving the field electrified.
Susanoo: Rotating Flame: Shisui ignites his Susanoo's drilled spear with fire and drills into the opponent.
Susanoo: Sever: Madara begins by elbowing his opponent, and follows with a series of six Susanoo Sword slashes and stabs, before manifesting his incomplete Susanoo to deliver a final, downward slash.
Susanoo: Slash: Sasuke has his Susanoo punch his opponent, followed by a Susanoo sword swipe, a Fire Release attack, and two further sword swipes.
Susanoo: Smash: Sasuke swats his opponent aside and punches them with a Susanoo arm.
Susanoo: Tear: Madara has his Susanoo swipe the opponent with a sword, throwing them into the air, then manifests its incomplete form to deliver a cross slash with two Susanoo swords as they fall, knocking them further back.
Susanoo: Tsukumo: After Shisui manifests his Susanoo's upper-body, it opens its ribcage to expose its chest before launching a barrage of large, green-coloured chakra needles at an incredible speed.
Susanoo: Twin Flames: In the skeletal states of their Susanoo, Itachi and Sasuke slash downwards with the Sword of Totsuka and Sword of Kagutsuchi, creating a fiery explosion.
Susanoo: Twin Gods Lightning Advent: Sasuke and Itachi activate their Complete Body — Susanoo. Itachi launches his Yasaka Magatama at the opponent while Sasuke slashes at them with his Blaze Release: Susanoo Kagutsuchi, with the resulting flames creating lightning clouds. The two then fly high up in the sky, fusing their Susanoo's sword together, which Sasuke engulfs in lightning and Itachi engulfs in black flames. They finish by flying down at the opponent sword first, the impact in which is so great, it dispels the lightning clouds, clearing up the sky.
Swarming Art: Deidara creates many clay spiders which crawl all over the opponent and detonate on them.
Swift Release: Shadowless Flight: Hiruko uses this technique to move at instantaneous speeds, rapidly striking his opponents at various angles while avoiding any opposition regardless of the opponent's speed or strength. This technique is very effective against strength-based close-combat taijutsu users.
Swift Wind Wall: The user summons a swirling stream of wind, encasing the user and repelling incoming attacks. It can also be expanded to protect others near the user.
Sword Combo: With this technique, Yūgao makes a sequence of slashes with her sword and finishes with a powerful slash that greatly injures the opponent.
Sword of Kagutsuchi: By applying shape transformation to the orb of black flames wielded by his Susanoo, Sasuke manifests a blade in its hand for the purpose of slicing and piercing targets, thus setting them ablaze with the inextinguishable flames of Amaterasu.
Sword of Kagutsuchi: Sever: Sasuke manifests the arm of his Susanoo, holding an Amaterasu sword, and delivers a single downward slash at his opponent.
Sword of Kagutsuchi: Stabbing Flame: While inside his Susanoo, Sasuke swipes his Amaterasu sword horizontally, proceeds with a downward stab at the ground that causes flame spikes to erupt, throwing his opponent up in the air, where he stabs them, and sends a final pulse of black flames through the sword.
Sword of Kagutsuchi: Violent: Sasuke attacks his opponent with a string of sword slashes, Chidori, and a black flame sword, the last swing of which sends a volley of black flame spikes.
Sword of Kusanagi: Blades from All Direc: After restraining the target with a snake, Orochimaru summons several replicas of his Sword of Kusanagi which attacks the enemy from every direction.
Sword of Kusanagi: Chidori Katana: This technique allows Sasuke to channel the Chidori through his chokutō. This makes it nearly unblockable as the radiating and chirping blade can easily cut through steel. Furthermore, if an opponent is stabbed, their body goes numb due to an electrical current which causes the muscles to contract, making it impossible for the opponent to move. However, it can be countered by other weapons that also utilise Lightning Release chakra flow, such as Killer B's flowed swords.
Sword of Kusanagi: Hawk Flash: Sasuke attacks his opponent with a series of sword slashes and a roundhouse kick, before hitting them with a forward lunging, horizontal slash.
Sword of Kusanagi: Longsword of the Sky: This technique allows Orochimaru to control the Sword of Kusanagi. As he moves his fingers, the Sword of Kusanagi makes the same movements, even to the point of moving in the air. This allows him to continue using the sword even if he's been disarmed of it, wielding it against opponents and, because of the sword's natural sharpness, easily cutting through them. The sword moves quickly while airborne, allowing Orochimaru to direct it at opponents from behind before it can be defended against. In the anime, the sword's blade emits a bright blue light when controlled in this way.
Sword of Kusanagi: One-Stab Death: Orochimaru summons a giant snake, which slams the ground with its tail, throwing the target into the air. Then, Orochimaru commands the Sword of Kusanagi to stab the target.
Sword of Nunoboko: Mow: Hagoromo shapes his shakujō into the Sword of Nunoboko, coated in dark, flaming chakra, and slashes the opponent.
Sword of Totsuka: Serial Slashes: Itachi uses the Sword of Totsuka for two horizontal slashes, followed by a stab, and finishes it with a fireball.
Sword of Totsuka: Slashing Rise: Itachi uses the Sword of Totsuka to deliver a diagonal slash, followed by three horizontal slashes, the last of which throws his opponent up in the air, where Itachi hits him with a fireball, sending them further back.
Sōshūga: is the name of a fighting style employing a pair of by Might Guy. Guy wields these with great dexterity, utilising all of his limbs at times, making use of them particularly during situations where direct physical contact must be avoided. Making use of his own impressive strength, he can even crush large boulders using this technique.
Tail Chasing Fang Fang Rotating Fang: After the user transforms into a single, three-headed, gigantic wolf with their shadow clone and ninken, the user curls into a ball and rolls at a ferocious speed towards the enemy, as if chasing after their own tail. The ultra-violent rotation created can tear through multiple enemies, rending them apart with ease.
Tail Path Foolishness: Sasori, while inside his puppet Hiruko, extends the puppet's iron tail to circle around his opponent like a cocoon and then suddenly constricts it, crushing them.
Tail Releasing Method: This fūinjutsu employs the use of formulae to bind a jinchūriki before extracting the tailed beast from within them. When extracted, the beast initially takes the form of pure chakra, also causing the host to go into a near Version 1-like state. After being extracted, the beast takes a corporeal form. Obito Uchiha waited until Kushina Uzumaki's seal was weak enough to use this technique to extract Kurama.
Tail Sweep: Releasing six tails, Kinkaku extends one of them and attacks opponents like a whip.
Tailed Beast Ball: The Tailed Beast Ball is the ultimate technique of a tailed beast, which can also be used by a jinchūriki while transformed, considered the strongest technique they can use.
Tailed Beast Ball Rasenshuriken: With help from Kurama, Naruto converts his Truth-Seeking Ball into a Tailed Beast Ball, and adds wind-natured chakra to create the shuriken-like blades around it before hurling it at the target. The resulting explosion dwarfs that of a regular Tailed Beast Ball and can destroy multiple planetoid-like objects in one blast.
Tailed Beast Chakra Arms: This is an ability a jinchūriki is able to perform when in a tailed form. The jinchūriki will use the raw chakra of their Tailed Beast to form arms, which they can freely manipulate to attack their foes, able to strike an opponent faster than even a Sharingan user can react to. The chakra arms' hands are clawed while the rest of the arm seems to lack any kind of joint, thus allowing them to have flexible movements that will generally be impossible for normal arms. The user can create any number of arms that they desire and they can also serve other purposes such as grappling hooks, to either grab onto objects or enemies from great distances, for offensive means, as merely touching one of these can cause fatal burns, due to the Nine-Tails' seething hatred within its chakra (though this is not always the case). Due to having chakra attached to his body, the chakra arms can grow in size and from the fourth tail up, Naruto, the arms, or any part of his body can divide into two or more fully operational appendages. Killer B has also been shown to use this technique though instead of arms, he can form horns which he uses for his Lightning Release: Lariat technique.
Tailed Beast Combo: Naruto, in his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, and Minato combine their Rasengans and strike the opponent with it. Minato then throws his Flying Thunder God Kunai at the opponent. The two ninja then bump fists, with Minato entering his Nine-Tails Chakra Mode. Father and son then use Flying Thunder God Technique to teleport to the thrown kunai, delivering a series of strikes to the opponent, forming a yellow and orange rasengan-shaped chakra silhouette, which creates a massive explosion, dealing great damage in the process.
Tailed Beast Eight Twists: After assuming his full Eight-Tails transformation, Killer B tightly coils the beast's tails around himself, before extending them with an enormous amount of physical strength. This causes him to spin rapidly, resulting in the generation of tremendous gusts of wind that buffets everything in the surrounding area. This technique was powerful enough to level the terrain within a large range of the Eight-Tails.
Tailed Beast Flash Bullet: Naruto, while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, delivers a fast combo of punches and kicks to the opponent.
Tailed Beast Full Charge: All the Tailed Beasts gather together, after which they all head in to attack the opponent in the following order: Shukaku blasts the opponent with a powerful sandstorm (in the game, Shukaku simply punches them), Matatabi slashes them with its claws, Isobu bulldozes them towards Son Gokū, who kicks them, allowing Kokuō to thrust their body towards Saiken who then sprays them with acid, which leads to Chōmei knocking the opponent towards Gyūki, whose punch allows Kurama to ram them into the ground.
Tailed Beast Heavy Cannon: The tailed beast or their jinchūriki forms a Tailed Beast Ball which they ignite in the tailed beast's mouth to shoot a massive beam of chakra.
Tailed Beast Lariat: The is a taijutsu technique, available to the Eight-Tails jinchūriki. After manifesting their Version 2 form, without bones, or while in their Tailed Beast Mode, the user charges at the opponent, striking them with a Lariat. It is unknown if this technique contains Lightning Release nature transformation, like the original version.
Tailed Beast Planetary Rasenshuriken: Naruto starts with a wind punch, sending the opponent into the air. He then transforms into his Kurama Mode and prepares a giant-sized Rasenshuriken and a Tailed Beast Ball. He throws the Rasenshuriken, then fires four satellite Tailed Beast Balls, circling around the shuriken. As the attack hits the opponent, it explodes, resulting in an enormous dome of blue chakra.
Tailed Beast Rasengan: The Tailed Beast Rasengan is an incomplete technique of Naruto Uzumaki. It attempts to use the Rasengan's form to create a substitute for the Tailed Beast Ball.
Tailed Beast Removal Technique: After setting up an area, the user can attempt to extract a tailed beast from its jinchūriki. The jinchūriki is bound to a rock table surrounded by a large circular sealing formula with several ceremonial rocks surrounding it. During the extraction process, the jinchuriki experiences extreme pain as the beast is ripped from their body.
Tailed Beast Replication: Gensui creates a special sealing tag which, if placed on human beings, transforms them into false replications of one of the tailed beasts. Not only does the seal shape the victim into the desired tailed beast, but it also grants them the original's abilities. The tag can also replicate the tailed beast's jinchūriki as well.
Tailed Beast Sealing: Whenever Naruto Uzumaki entered into a tailed form, the First Hokage's Necklace activated this technique to restrain him. It is unknown if the technique just restrains Naruto until Yamato is able to suppress the Nine-Tails' influence or if it suppresses the influence by itself as the Nine-Tails cancelled the technique by crushing the necklace.
Tailed Beast Seventeen Whirlwinds Attack: Killer B and Naruto, in their Tailed Beast Modes, twist their tails to form two twisters with the opponent caught in between them, and finish by shooting Tailed Beast Balls at them.
Tailed Beast Spiralling Double: Style On: In Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Minato forms two Rasengan from his hands and two Tailed Beast Balls from his chakra arms, attacking the enemies in front of him and the enemies further out.
Tailed Beast Tail: Yugito claws her opponent and then slaps them with one of Matatabi's tails.
Tailed Beast Telepathy: An innate skill possessed by all the tailed beasts, which allows them to communicate with one another on a deeper plain of their subconscious minds known as the . This kind of communication differs from the one used by jinchūriki and their tailed beasts, since there are no seals or other restrictions and it is accessible for all tailed beasts and their respective jinchūriki. However, it requires a jinchūriki and their tailed beast to be fully linked to gain access to this world. Furthermore, it is impossible for influences from the outside to reach this plane, even if the tailed beasts are being controlled.
Tailed Beast Transfer Technique: This technique allows one person to transfer the complete chakra of a sealed tailed beast within a jinchūriki into a different person.
Taisa's Transformation Technique: Taisa activates this technique by forming the needed hand seal. Once activated, Taisa transforms into an armoured beetle similar to a kabutomushi. He then gains six legs which are mostly bandaged up, five horns, and orange and violet markings all over his back body. In this form, Taisa is able to make powerful charge attacks with his horns and can release a Poison Mist from his body. He is also able to leap high into the air and land down on the enemy with great force. The only vulnerable part of this form is his underbelly, and he has to somehow be tipped over for an attack to reach it.
Takamimusubinokami: After absorbing his enemies' ninjutsu with the Rinnegan in his right hand, Momoshiki can release those same techniques from the Rinnegan in his left hand, using the chakra he obtains from his pills to amplify their power as many times as he wishes. In the anime after absorbing Kinshiki, Momoshiki's golden Rinnegan turn red when he uses this technique.
Takemikazuchi: Sasuke pierces his opponent with Amaterasu flames while simultaneously capturing them inside a Chibaku Tensei which is enveloped by the black flames. Sasuke then jumps high in the air and activates his Complete Body Susanoo and proceeds to fly towards the Chibaku Tensei. He creates a Chidori through his Susanoo and covers it in Amaterasu flames as well before charging towards the opponent still caught inside the Chibaku Tensei. The impact results in a massive explosion which blows the Chibaku Tensei into smithereens.
Takigakure Style: Watercutting Sword: A secret technique of Takigakure that allows the user to manipulate water into the form of a sword. While usually used for close quarters, this technique can, as demonstrated by Shibuki, be used for ranged assaults as well. This sword is also shown to be very resilient as it is able to withstand and cut through most Fire Release techniques.
Takigakure Whirlwind: While in midair, the user will come down with a whirlwind-like force flowing around them, punching the target.
Tatami Return: Mifune slashes at his opponent a couple times, jumps up, and upon landing, the impact makes the ground in front of him rise up, with a slab of rock sending his opponent up in the air.
Team-work is Outstanding: Naruto, Sakura, and Sasuke kick the opponent in a combined attack. Naruto and Sasuke then rush ahead, delivering a series of hits to the target. Then, Sakura reveals a rope that she had hid under the ground and furiously uses it to tie the opponent to a log, while also tying Naruto with them, while Sasuke escapes using the Body Replacement Technique.
Tearing Air Heavenly Light Slashing Flas: In Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Minato scatters Flying Thunder God Kunai around the opponent, slashing them each time he warps.
Tearing Blade: Orochimaru jumps up high and then comes falling down onto the opponent, stabbing them and then slashing them with his Sword of Kusanagi in the process.
Tearing Fang: Akamaru attacks the opponent by jumping and kicking them, finishing them with a weaker Passing Fang.
Telegram Flash: With his team lending him chakra, Akaboshi can slam his hand onto the ground and cause lightning to spread from his hand to underneath the opponent.
Teleportation Seal: The user creates a seal that can teleport anything within its confines to a predetermined location, dispersing into balls of light. Hamura used this technique to travel to the moon he and Hagoromo created.
Telescope Technique: By peering into a crystal ball, the user can see the current activities of anyone whose chakra signature they know. Users can view subjects from any location, regardless of distance or potential obstructions, making it ideal for intelligence gathering. The Third Hokage uses this technique to monitor the villagers of Konohagakure and thus maintain public order.
Temple of Nirvana Technique: Everybody within an area is subjected to the same illusion: many white feathers fluttering down from the sky. If a given target sees enough of these feathers fall, they will fall into a deep sleep. Because it's a genjutsu, victims cannot be woken in conventional ways, meaning they will continue to sleep even if extensive combat is going on around them. Only by dispelling the genjutsu, such as with the Genjutsu Cancel, can victims regain consciousness. If targets are attentive enough, they can similarly dispel the genjutsu themselves before the feathers have lulled them to sleep.
Temporal Rewind: In preparation of being struck, the user activates their Rinnegan as glowing blue. This technique allows them to warp several seconds into the past. While normally defensive, essentially allowing the user to seemingly teleport away from danger, repeated usage of this technique grants a pseudo-form of clairvoyance. With the acquired knowledge of how the near-future will happen, a perfect counter-strategy can be formed from being able to accurately tell how the enemy will act. However, due to the effects of the technique, the user experiences more time than those around them, putting the user at risk of prolonged exposure to hazardous conditions.
Temporary Paralysis Technique: Using this technique causes a target or targets to be physically immobilised, as though they've been tied down with invisible steel ropes. Because it's a relatively simple technique, even genin should be able to perform it. However, the strength of the binding varies significantly from one skill level to the next, so a mere genin could not hope to restrain the same targets that an Anbu could, for instance. The Temporary Paralysis Technique is a useful way to stop an opponent from attacking or, alternatively, make an opponent easier to attack.
Ten-Finger Drilling Bullets: Kimimaro parts his fingertips, creating holes that expose hardened finger bones. In volleys (five per hand), he shoots these bone bullets at a target by swinging his hand, causing a loud sound as they're fired. The bullets travel incredibly quickly through the air and take a spinning motion. Upon impact, the bullets tear through skin, flesh, and bone. The bullets aren't able to penetrate the Shield of Sand, but in the anime, they can pierce samurai armour. Kimimaro relies on this technique for his long-range attacks.
Tengai Shinsei: The user weaves three hand seals simultaneously between themselves and their Susanoo, in order to draw massive meteorites from the upper atmosphere down towards a specific location on the ground. As they descend in succession along the same trajectory, if one of these meteorites is stopped, the user can summon another one to then collide with the first, ensuring that they crash into their intended destination.
Tengai Shinsei: Pierce: A smaller scale version of the larger variant, Madara calls forth a shower of small meteors.
Tenhōjimetsu: Indra, Madara and Sasuke enter their completed Susanoo states. Sasuke traps the opponent in a giant meteorite, but Madara tries one-upping him by summoning a larger meteorite above Sasuke's technique to crash into it, declaring that he alone is sufficient for the job. He is interrupted when Indra shatters both meteorites with a lightning bolt, and retorts that both of their jutsu are the same to him. Refusing to be outdone, Sasuke flies into the air and calls them both pathetic before calling a Kirin coated in black flames down upon the battlefield, finishing the opponent in a huge explosion.
Tenketsu Blocking Strikes: A taijutsu technique that allows the user to disable an opponent by performing a two-fingered thrust at the opponent's tenketsu. By doing so, the user can manipulate the flow of chakra within their opponent, similar the the Gentle Fist fighting style. Shira can unblock his opponents' tenketsu, with a single impact with his fist.
Tenpenchii: By interfering with the natural energy using its immeasurable amount of chakra, the Ten-Tails is able to simultaneously create a variety of natural disasters that devastate the surrounding area, with itself acting as their epicentre. The phenomena involved in this technique include: earthquakes, floods, thunderstorms, and tornadoes. These concurrent events result in a blast akin to a nuclear explosion, even forming a vast mushroom cloud.
Tenrō-Style Ninjutsu: Beast-Human Transf: The user transforms themselves into a wolf-like creature that enhances their strength and speed. The transformation wears off if the user is defeated. This technique is known only by the members of the Tenrō clan.
Tenseigan: The is a dōjutsu introduced in The Last: Naruto the Movie. The movie's novelisation explains that the Tenseigan can be acquired when an Ōtsutsuki is implanted with the Byakugan of a Hyūga: this combination of the two clans' chakra transforms the Byakugan into Tenseigan. When Toneri Ōtsutsuki implants himself with Hanabi Hyūga's Byakugan, the transformation takes several days to complete. As the transformation advances, Toneri experiences increasingly painful pulsations in his eyes that subside with rest.
Tenseigan Chakra Mode: The Tenseigan Chakra Mode is a heightened transformation unique to those who possess the Tenseigan.
The Great Sakura: Sakura traps her opponent in a genjutsu in which the giant form of Inner Sakura raises up from beneath the opponent. Inner Sakura takes the opponent into the air and crushes the opponent with both her hands, and the genjutsu promptly ends with the opponent on the ground.
The Immortals Rushing Madly Ahead: Taking advantage of Hidan's immortality, Kakuzu uses the Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work and Wind Release: Pressure Damage techniques to engulf Hidan in flames, propelling him towards the opponent, while Hidan slashes them continuously with his Triple-Bladed Scythe.
The Inheritance of the Will of Fire: Hashirama, Tobirama and Hiruzen use a combination of wood, water and fire to push away the opponent. Hashirama uses Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity of a World of Trees to create a forest in which Tobirama and Hiruzen strike the opponent using a fire and water combination. The three Hokage then strike the opponent, with Hashirama using Chakra Enhanced Strength, Tobirama kicking the opponent and Hiruzen summoning Monkey King: Enma and striking the opponent with the adamantine staff. The force of the attacks explodes the forest in the process.
The Red-Hot Habanero: Kushina, while in her awakening state, delivers a series of powerful punches to the opponent.
Thick Steam Flow Technique: This is a cooperation ninjutsu where one Fire Release user attacks the enemy from one side and a Water Release user attacks them from the other. The collision of these two naturally opposing natures create a devastating attack as well as a great deal of water vapour.
Third Eye: Gaara creates an eye out of sand that hovers in the air wherever it's created. Gaara connects the eye with his optic nerve using chakra, allowing him to see whatever is in the Third Eye's field of vision. The eye gives Gaara a useful method of performing surveillance without being noticed; in Sakura Hiden, Gaara manipulates the Third Eye's sand to allow it to double as a listening device. Gaara also uses the Third Eye when fully surrounding himself with the Shield of Sand, allowing him to be protected without sacrificing seeing what opponents are doing. In Gaara Hiden, Gaara is capable of creating several Third Eyes and connect each eye to his optical nerve at once, allowing him to observe things from multiple angles simultaneously.
Thistle: Kimimaro slices upward with a sword made of bone and then extends his bones from his back to throw the opponent into the air violently.
Thorn: Kimimaro delivers a series of slashes to the opponent with two bone swords until he sends them flying into the air, where he delivers a series of slashes at lightning speed.
Thorn Explosion: The user punches the opponent and follows up with impaling them with their modified flesh.
Thousand Bee Stings Technique: The user summons bees that shoot their poisonous stingers at their target.
Thousand Flashes Beheading Dance: The user slashes at the opponent with very sharp senbon exactly a thousand times in multiple different directions, leaving the opponent with plenty of slashes and senbon pierced into their body.
Thousand Flying Water Needles of Death: The user creates a thousand long needles from the nearby water, which surround the target. The user carefully aims the needles at the target and fires them at rapid speeds. Targets who are struck by the needles suffer significant injury. When Haku uses this technique against Sasuke Uchiha, Sasuke is able to escape harm by leaping directly upwards.
Thousand Hands Manipulation Force: The Thousand Hands Manipulation Force is a technique which is used through the puppet of the Third Kazekage.
Thousand Hands Manipulation Force: Thrus: Sasori attacks his opponent using his Third Kazekage puppet, causing multiple arms to erupt from seals in its left arm, reaching for a mid-air opponent.
Thousand Needles of Death: Kin Tsuchi controls a vast amount of needles at once using strings, and attacks the enemy. When shown in the game, this technique resembles a white version of Haku's Thousand Flying Water Needles of Death.
Threaded Tree: Hashirama creates two rising wood pillars that intertwine with each other from the ground and lift the opponent into the air. He then creates two more pillars of intertwining wood, striking the opponent further into the air.
Three Colouring: Kurenai Yūhi releases a pillar of cherry petals at the opponent sending them flying.
Three Demon Gods: Momoshiki grabs his opponent, throws them up in the air, and consumes a chakra edible, changing his appearance. Transformed, he sends five dog avatars which converge at his opponent, biting at them, before a fire pheasant crashes through them. Finally, Momoshiki punches his opponent back at the ground with a giant rock monkey.
Three Jewels Suction Crushing: This technique is a performance by puppets 6, 7, and 8 of the Chikamatsu Collection. The three puppets get into a triangular formation and by opening the mechanisms marked with "Buddha", "Dharma", and "Sangha", respectively, they invoke this technique. A terrifying tornado breaks out and sucks the targets into the centre of the formation. Everything that is sucked into the centre is completely crushed with tremendous force and shot out from the back. However, the vacuum can be overloaded, leaving the three puppets vulnerable to attacks.
Three-Seal Barrier: Similar to the Five-Seal Barrier technique, instead the user places three sealing tags around their location. If any one manages to enter through a secret entrance of the protected hideout, a deep mist is created and the only way to get rid of it is remove the tags around the protected area.
Three-Tailed Rasengan: While in his three-tailed form, Naruto creates a shadow clone that charges a Nine-Tails-enhanced Rasengan that implodes in on the enemy who is attacked by it.
Three-Tails Chakra: Release: Due to his mysterious connection to the Three-Tails, Yūkimaru is able to at least partially control the Three-Tails. At first, Yūkimaru can only make an apparition of the beast appear, after taking some of Kabuto's pills. Later, after taking a larger dosage of the pills (combined with Guren's Crystal Release technique) he is able to make the beast fully appear, but couldn't control it. Later, when Guren is in danger of being harmed by the Three-Tailed Beast, he is able to halt it completely without Kabuto's pills. When Guren seemingly sacrificed her life to save him, Yūkimaru lost control of himself and used his powers to the fullest which enhanced the Three-Tails strength and rampage enabling it to break through the Four-Corner Sealing Barrier. This could mean that, like Naruto's jinchūriki forms, this ability is tied to his emotions.
Three-Tails Mini Clone: When the Three-Tails devours anything, its body produces thousands of smaller clones of itself with its gut. These antibody-like clones attack and devour the invading organism, presumably to aid in digestion and destroy any potential hazards.
Three-Tails' Rampage: Isobu takes over Rin Nohara, causing her to manifest a chakra cloak, and slam the opponent with a chakra tail. Isobu fully manifests itself, slams the opponent underwater, and sends a Tailed Beast Ball their way. Rin manages to suppress Isobu with memories of her team, as a slight shower from the explosion rains down on her.
Thrusting Shark: While merged with Samehada, Kisame forms a water shark around him and charges at the opponent, with the shark biting down on them.
Thunder Laser Scan: While in flight mode, Mecha-Naruto scans the area with a special blue laser, identifying its target.
Thunder Sabre: is a technique utilised by Ranke by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel.
Thunder of the Dead: Orochimaru summons snakes, with Sasuke using Chidori Current on them, that spiral around them both hitting anyone nearby.
Thunderclap Drill: Sarada delivers a Lightning Release-enhanced, super strong punch on her opponent.
Thunderswords Technique: Remote Control: This technique allows the user to manipulate Kiba independently from afar. This allows the user to keep their hands free for combat and also attack from multiple angles at once. The user can also manipulate the blades to strike in a variety of manners.
Thunderswords Technique: Thunderbolt: Holding the Kiba swords over their head like birch rods, the user summons a bolt of lightning from the sky to shock anyone in their immediate vicinity.
Tiger Lily: Kimimaro, when in his cursed seal level two form, attacks the opponent repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes them off with a powerful strike from his backbones.
Tight Binding Golden Chain Technique: These chains formed by a member of the Uzumaki clan are used offensively rather than the ones used for sealing purposes.
Time Reservoir: A member of the Ōtsutsuki clan can manipulate the mental space of an individual to send their conscience to a certain point back in time. The user creates a doorway which will enable an indictable to travel to the past. The individual sent back in time can only observe past events, they can not interfere or make changes. However, under three conditions, the individual can be sent back in time, both mentally and physically:
Time Reversal Technique: This technique is used by the Anbu to pull out forgotten memories. After forming the appropriate hand seals, the Anbu will put the target into a state of reverse hypnosis, allowing them to remember details that they otherwise would not. The target will comply with interrogation, but seems to retain his or her personality while under hypnosis. For example, when the Anbu used this technique to bring back Naruto's memories about his conversations with Gennō, Naruto was more specific about the ramen he shared with the old man rather than their conversations, which the Anbu were asking about.
Time-Release Technique: By placing a mark on a person in a ritualistic method, this technique will activate as timed even if the person is tortured or put under a trance. This is meant to catch an enemy when their guard is down. Sai mentions that this is used as a last resort technique by the Anbu, and as such, is rare; Sakura likens it to a living time bomb. When Kakashi Hatake requested Tsunade to use it on him, the technique would activate Kakashi's Mangekyō Sharingan technique, the Kamui, upon Hiruko's attempt to assimilate him.
Toad Flatness — Shadow Manipulation Tech: The user first infuses a target's shadow with their own chakra. The user then flattens themselves to paper-like thinness and merges with the target's shadow, giving them complete control over the target's mind and body. The user must hold their breath in order to maintain this control. Jiraiya uses this technique on Ryūsui with the intention of exploring Amegakure and gathering intel, but he is quickly spotted by Konan speaking to a toad. Although Konan immediately knows that it's Jiraiya because of what she overhears, she focuses her attacks on Ryūsui's body, evidently believing him to be Jiraiya in disguise despite her prior knowledge of this technique. In this way, the controlled body is useful as a shield, and while it's taking attacks meant for the user, the user is able to prepare their own attacks unnoticed.
Toad Oil Bullet: The user converts their chakra into an extremely sticky oil and spits it out as a huge mass or as a barrage of small bullets. Those caught by it will find it difficult to move, and simply washing the oil away with regular water won't be easy. Furthermore, if a Fire Release technique is launched at the target after this technique is used, they will be enveloped in flames in an instant.
Toad Smoke Technique: The user produces a burst of a smoke from their body, forming a thick smokescreen to mask their movements. It can also produce a denser smoke within shaped like the user for an additional distraction.
Toad Spying Technique: Koji links with his artificial toad to access their point of view, seeing and hearing everything around the toad. This can be done via special software or through Koji directly, in which the latter case his pupils will become toad-like. It allows for more discreet surveillance and intel gathering. He can also use two toads to communicate with others if one is left with the person they are in contact with. The connection can even be maintained between separate dimensions.
Toad Sword Beheading: A toad, using its naturally strong hips and legs, leaps precisely at a target. Toads can cover a great distance by doing this, shifting from a remote location to close range suddenly in order to catch targets off guard. The toad then just as quickly swings with their sword, before the target can react, shifting the power of their leap into the strike. When used by Gamabunta, the slash is powerful enough to sever the arm of Shukaku's Tailed Beast Mode.
Toad Three Slashes: The user coats their weapon with chakra and swings it at the target, releasing three sharp crescent-like waves.
Tongue Tooth Sticky Acid: Katsuyu releases an acidic paste from the mouth that, because of Katsuyu's size and height, is spread over a wide area. The acid's concentration and density is great enough to melt stone. Katsuyu requires no preparation to perform this technique, allowing it to be used instantly, which in turn means that targets have no opportunity to dodge.
Tonton Combo: Shizune transforms Tonton into a copy of herself who uses chakra scalpels to stun their opponent. Tonton changes back and jumps up as Shizune slices though the opponent, side-to-side with two chakra scalpels herself. However, she caught the tip of Tonton's tail while the pig was doing a flip; the opponent collapses. Shizune then notices Tonton's tail is burning and begins healing her as an angry Tonton repeatedly hits her.
Top Transformed Buddha: After creating a gigantic wooden statue that possesses hundreds or thousands of hands, the user utilises all of these hands simultaneously to deliver powerful blows to the target. Due to the sheer volume of the punches involved, defending against the entirety of them is nearly impossible. This can be used as a one-shot technique, increasing its destructive power but also resulting in the hands behind the statue's back being destroyed. Afterwards, Hashirama discards the back of the statue to increase the mobility of the True Several Thousand Hands statue. It can also be used more conservatively as seen in Tobi's usage, preventing the hands from being destroyed and enabling another usage of the technique, but results in less destructive power.
Torii Seal: When Naruto first obtained Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, his previous seal's outward appearance had changed into a shape of a magatama, along with a swirl design that resembled Uzushiogakure's symbol.
Torn Castle: Zabuza kicks his opponent, delivers some side slashes with Kubikiribōchō, kicks them once more, and finishes with a forward stab, knocking his opponent far back.
Tornado High: Boruto and a shadow clone string a series of attacks at an opponent, finishing by creating a small tornado that lifts the shadow clone as it performs an upper kick.
Tornado Rasengan: The Tornado Rasengan is a Rasengan formed from the released chakra of Kurama. The Rasengan formed is red similar to the Demon Fox Rasengan from Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel, but with several streams of red chakra spiralling around the sphere. The Rasengan can then be further compressed giving the sphere more power.
Tornado of Water: This is a technique that utilises water to create a spinning water vortex around the user. The water vortex acts both as a barrier and an attack mechanism. The power of the vortex is enough to knock an opponent unconscious.
Tornado of Water Technique: Magnum: Gengetsu forms and sends out a vortex of water, then shooting a bullet of water to massively increase the size of the vortex, swirling around the area.
Torpedo Nails: The user throws nails into the air. Upon impact on the ground, they dig themselves into the earth. When the opponent walks over the ground where the nails dug themselves in, nails pin their feet stopping their movement. Then, the user forms a hand seal and hundreds of nails shoot out of the ground at the opponent.
Torrent: Hydrification Technique: Suigetsu transforms into a wave of water which crashes into the opponent. He then rushes behind the opponent with the lower half of his body still being waves and slashes them in half with the Kubikiribōchō.
Torsion Flower: Kimimaro (when in his cursed seal level two form) attacks the enemy repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes off with a powerful strike from his bone drill, knocking the enemy backwards.
Towards the Setting Sun: Lee opens several chakra gates and dives into the opponent. He carries them through several mountains before focusing his remaining chakra to brutally drive them through a valley wall.
Tracking Technique: Upon activation, the user's pupils glow yellow. This allows them to see the lingering energy traces left from a person's footsteps.
Transcription Seal: Amaterasu: This is a technique that seals the technique Amaterasu within the Sharingan of another person. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated (indicated by the person's Sharingan taking the form of the sealer's Mangekyō Sharingan) when the eye sees its target, which is predetermined by the user.
Transcription Seal: Izanagi: This is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique that seals the technique Izanagi within the Sharingan of the target. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated when certain requirements, which are predetermined by the user, are met. Madara Uchiha used this on his own right eye, to trigger after he dies in order to rewrite his death into a mere dream.
Transformation Technique: The Transformation Technique allows the user to take the appearance of whatever they choose.
Transformation: Adamantine Staff: The user transforms into a staff for their summoner to use as a weapon; Enma's staff form was the preferred weapon of Hiruzen Sarutobi, whose heavy use of it through decades of warfare contributed to his reputation as a "God of Shinobi". The staff is as hard as diamond, making it very destructive. This also renders it largely impervious to damage, making it useful as a defence; despite this, Enma still feels pain from clashing with the Sword of Kusanagi. The staff dimensions can be altered, becoming wider or extending to great lengths, enough that, in the anime, it could push the Nine-Tails beyond the borders of Konohagakure. The user can produce any part of his regular body from the staff, such as his claws or fangs, to surprise opponents.
Transmission Wood: After turning a wood clone into a seed, the seed can be used to track a target by either planting it on them or having them ingest it. Only the user of this technique can detect the seed's transmissions.
Transparent Escape Technique: This technique has never actually been seen in the manga, but it allows the user to spy on others without being noticed. It was invented by Jiraiya during his youth to allow him to spy on girls bathing without the risk of being caught.
Trinity: Obito uses Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique and Minato throws Flying Thunder God Kunai at the opponent. Kakashi then forms a Chidori and Obito activates his Sharingan and Minato teleports them to the opponent using Flying Thunder God Technique. Kakashi strikes the opponent with Chidori and Obito kicks the opponent, with Kakashi rushing and striking the opponent with Chidori yet again. Minato then teleports to the opponent. The three then strike the opponent, with Obito stabbing the opponent with a kunai, Minato slashing with a kunai and Kakashi slashing with a White Light Chakra Sabre.
Triple Strike: Breaking Through the Clou: Asuma delivers three powerful blows to the enemy with his chakra blades, after which he releases a cloud of ash that explodes and burns the enemy.
True Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms: Neji leaps forward and strikes the opponent several times in the back before dashing in front of them. He strikes several more times until using an Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven-like strike to launch the opponent into the air. There, Neji strikes the opponent before several more times hitting them once more at light speed, blasting them into the air in a beam of chakra.
True Fire of Samadhi: This Fire Release technique appears to be initiated remotely upon placing the target in contact with a physical object such as a kunai or even a small toad, and can cause the target to spontaneously burst into flames. Regarded as the , they are said to be inextinguishable by wind or rain, and burn so quickly that regenerative techniques cannot keep up with them, leaving the victim's body completely charred in mere moments. The flames can, however, be absorbed and sealed away.
True Rasengan: An enhanced version of the Rasengan, where the user draws more power that lasts for a longer period of time. The Rasengan increases in size to a bigger larger version. When used, the user slowly moves around the area dealing damage to any target in his path. In addition, it absorbs chakra from the user.
True Reverse Lotus: After unlocking the sixth of the Eight Gates, Lee pummels his opponent.
True Sand Waterfall Funeral: Gaara encases himself in a huge amount of sand, thus creating a giant clone of himself out of sand that will do everything that the engulfed Gaara does. The giant Gaara holds the opponent down and implodes, crushing them. The implosion is so great that it sends a shock wave through the battlefield.
True Several Thousand Hands: Spiralling: Using a massive wooden statue, Asura generates several Amenomihashira on its many hands and unleashes them upon his opponent.
True Shadow Seizing Technique: Sending his shadow towards his opponent, it will then crawl up the opponent's body until a shadow-hand reaches the opponent's neck, and breaks it.
True Sickle Weasel Technique: Temari summons Kamatari, who then creates a stronger and larger version of her Sickle Weasel Technique. The wind vortex can reach opponents farther away from her than her original technique.
True: Chibaku Tensei: The user claps both hands together, forming a black sphere between them, and launches it. The black sphere will then expand and encase a large area. Upon which, it draws in a large quantity of the earth around, effectively creating a "moon" that hovers high in the sky with the consumed area inside. Slowly after, the structure will begin compressing itself, crushing everything within. The structure is very powerful as even an Eight Gates-enhanced attack could barely scathe its surfaces. By performing a Snake handseal, the technique can be released, safely returning the entrapped area back to its proper location.
True: Supreme Ultimate Rasengan: Naruto hits the opponent with a Rasengan, with Minato and Kushina adding their chakra to Naruto's palm to enhance the strength of his Rasengan which pushes the opponent far away, resulting in an explosion.
True: Tailed Beast Rasenshuriken: Naruto punches his opponent with a tailed beast chakra arm, sending them up in the air and putting some distance between them. He fully manifests Kurama, and creates nine shadow clones, each creating a different Rasenshuriken. The shadow clones throw the Rasenshuriken, while the real Naruto sends a Tailed Beast Ball, all attacks converging on the opponent.
Trump Card of Pair: Naruto creates several shadow clones to charge towards and beat the opponent before kicking the opponent into the air. Naruto and Sasuke each form a Rasengan and Chidori that they both use on the falling opponent.
Truth-Seeking Ball: Truth-Seeking Balls are orbs of malleable black chakra, which can alter their form and characteristics in various ways. Though only the size of a fist, each hides within it the power to obliterate an entire forest.
Truth-Seeking Ball: Cycle: The user encases themselves in a Truth-Seeking Ball shell to protect them from any incoming attack. They can also control the shell to ram enemies around them.
Truth-Seeking Body Flicker: Obito forms one or two blades from his Truth-Seeking Balls attached to his hands and instantly passes through the opponent.
Truth-Seeking Chaos Bullets: Hagoromo uses his Truth-Seeking Balls to shoot bright blue bullets of chakra at the opponent.
Truth-Seeking Kick: Naruto combines his Truth-Seeking Balls and kicks the single large ball towards the opponent with great force.
Truth-Seeking Ruined Earth: Madara sends out three Truth-Seeking Balls in front of him to shoot beams of chakra at the opponent.
Truth-Seeking Scorched Earth: Obito merges his Truth-Seeking Balls into a single sphere in front of himself, and unleashes a beam at his opponent.
Truth-Seeking Umbrella: Obito uses a Truth-Seeking Ball to shape it into a spear-like weapon, impaling any far off opponents.
Truth-Seeking: Pure Shadow: Obito encases himself in a Truth-Seeking Ball shelling, which he uses to hit the opponent numerous times.
Truth-Seeking: Saving Light: Obito fires a Truth-Seeking Ball at the opponent, which lights up and expands, releasing a large explosion. Once released, the ball returns to him.
Truth-Seeking: Sever: Obito forms two scythe-like weapons from the Truth-Seeking Balls to swipe at the opponent.
Truth-Seeking: Shining Deity: Obito forms four large interconnected arms that spin around shooting beams of chakra.
Tsuchigumo Style: Forbidden Life Techniq: This technique releases the seal on the Fury technique and then accumulates natural energy from the earth and atmosphere to be used for the technique. The bearer of the seal acts as a passive vessel, continuously gathering natural energy, which makes it possible to use Fury without their cooperation.
Tsukuyomi: Tsukuyomi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu and one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. Said to represent the , it is the antipode to Amaterasu.
Tsukuyomi Mode: This technique is a variation of Tsukuyomi, a high-level genjutsu. The user transforms the Tsukuyomi into a barrier that slows the opponent down. This does not happen physically but rather mentally. It makes the opponent think they are being held back by a barrier. While using this technique, Itachi's health and chakra slowly drain.
Turbulent Four Seasons: Itachi and Shisui both attack their opponent with Fire Release: Great Dragon Fire Technique. Through the blazing fire, Itachi launches a barrage of kunai at them. Afterwards, Shisui appears behind the opponent, grabbing one of the kunai and in unison with Itachi launch a flurry of attacks with a kunai each in hand.
Turning into a Frog Technique: By touching the forehead of a target and then, according to a mental image the user forms, the target changes into a tree frog. This is mainly used for interrogating several prisoners of war. Seeing their comrades changed into a frog before their eyes, the prisoners of war will cave in, becoming what could be described as a "frog chorus", sonorously chanting information. This terrifying technique will, without a doubt, make an "information leak" open up.
Twin Fangs Slash: Using their Kunai Blades, Izumo and Kotetsu attack the enemy from two sides and pierce them through.
Twin Metal Rods Shootdown: Tenten summons a twin-ended Wolf Teeth Mace that is the size of a human.
Twin Pole Heavely Drop: After separating, Sakon and Ukon place themselves so that their opponent is in between them. They both lunge at the opponent, switching places and knocking them into the air. While the opponent is airborne, they jump into the air, and both grab an opponent's arm. They then both spin rapidly until the opponent's head makes contact with the ground.
Twin Rising Dragons: The Twin Rising Dragons is a technique created by Tenten that takes advantage of her pinpoint accuracy.
Twin Rising Dragons: Second Scroll: Tenten jumps in the air and opens her giant scroll, releasing a smoke dragon hiding a large number of weapons that she rains down on her opponent.
Twin Snakes Mutual Death Technique: This technique was taught to Anko Mitarashi by Orochimaru. The user grabs one of their intended victim's hands and forces it to assist in performing the necessary hand seals. Once this is done, the user and the victim die, which Rin no Sho likens to a lovers' double-suicide. It's not actually clear how death occurs because the technique has never been seen performed successfully: when Anko uses it on Orochimaru, she stabs his hand to hers to prevent him from escaping as she performs the hand seals. When she realises he's merely a shadow clone, the technique is aborted. Naruto: One Decade, One Hundred Ninja illustrates this technique as two snakes coiling around Anko and Orochimaru.
Twin Swallow Cut: Tenten repeatedly hits her opponent with a pair of tonfa, then strikes them into the air with a three-section staff which she separates to deliver a final blow to the falling opponent.
Twin Swift Rasengan: Firstly, Jiraiya performs a single Rasengan, deforming the ground. After a moment, while the first one is still in contact with the opponent, he creates a larger Rasengan and combines both of them. Due to the massive power, the slightly deformed ground gets destroyed.
Twinkling Maiden's Heart: Sakura smiles at her opponent before glaring and summoning her giant inner self. Inner Sakura yells "I'm speaking from the heart!" as she punches her opponent. The screen shatters, revealing it all to have been a genjutsu and Sakura herself punched her opponent. The foe flies off into the distance. Sakura smiles and says "You should be nice to girls."
Twinsword Technique: Crushing Hammer: Chōjūrō unleashes his Hiramekarei, forming a hammer, with which he attacks his opponent.
Twinsword Technique: Cut to Pieces: Chōjūrō unleashes his Hiramekarei, forming a long-sword, with which he slices his opponent.
Twisted Truth-Seeking: The user gathers their Truth-Seeking Balls to shape them into a drill to drill the opponent.
Two Calm Kusanagi: Sasuke first hits the opponent into the air. Orochimaru spits his Kusanagi to Sasuke, and it slashes the opponent on the way. Sasuke grabs the Kusanagi with his free hand and jumps towards the opponent, slicing them repeatedly with his and Orochimaru's swords.
Two Lights Beams of Kumogakure: Entering the first stage of the Jinchūriki form, Kinkaku and Ginkaku deliver several powerful blows to the enemy with increased strength and speed, after which they begin to spin like tops and, pinning the enemy from both sides, destroy them.
Two Rays of Light Among the Clouds: Ginkaku and Kinkaku stand on the front and back sides of the opponent, the former starting by releasing a fire ball with Bashōsen, following with the latter using the suction of Benihisago to kick the opponent and then finishing them by raising the opponent with earth through Bashōsen and channeling electricity through Shichiseiken, releasing an electric surge by slamming down on them.
Two-Tailed Cat Flame Incineration Slash: Matatabi begins to build up a Tailed Beast Ball while Yugito attacks the enemy with quick slashes from her long claws, after which the Tailed Beast Ball hits the enemy, and in the finale, Yugito, having coated her sword in Matatabi's blue chakra, delivers a double strike, leaving a trail of chakra behind.
Two-Tails Exploding Orbs: Matatabi creates large orbs of flame-like chakra, similar to the flame covering its body. It then manipulates these orbs in order to chase the enemy before they explode. Enemies hit by the explosions of one of these orbs will have their offensive capabilities lowered for a time. This has only been shown used by a false Two-Tails.
Typhoon Flame Formation: Hagoromo surrounds himself in raging winds, which he promptly ignites.
Typhoon Impact: Asura expels a gust of slashing wind that swirls towards the opponent.
Typhoon Release: Consecutive Bursting St: A Typhoon Release technique used by Nowaki through his kekkei genkai.
Typhoon Release: Great Consecutive Burst: Nowaki summons a massive tornado, intense enough to not only dwarf Sasuke Uchiha's Complete Body — Susanoo, but to also be capable of forcing it to the defensive. Despite its power, the technique has an exploitable flaw. The user is left defenseless at the eye of the storm. Should the enemy reach it, they can easily counter with a surprise attack.
Typhoon Rotating: The user gathers wind to create a large tornado that swirls towards the opponent. The user can also form the tornado beneath the opponent.
Typhoon Water Vortex Technique: This cooperation ninjutsu uses the wild rotation of the thrown Wind Release: Rasengan to swallow up the water current created by the Water Release: Tearing Torrent, creating a large quantity of water vapour. Once invoked, a strong wind whirls around inside the highly concentrated mist, turning it into a solid barrier. The mist created by the violent rotation of the Rasengan also has the effect of taking away the enemy's field of vision. Of course, the mist can be used as a smokescreen when escaping, but the confusion it creates can also be used, for instance, to launch a surprise attack. If one can use multiple natures, it is possible to perform this technique alone.
Uchiha Blaze Sword: Fire Possession: The user breathes a fireball and then slices through the opponent with their sword.
Uchiha Cherry Blossom Thunderclap: Sasuke manifests his Complete Body Susanoo, striking the opponent with its sword, which launches several portions of the floor in the air. Sakura jumps between these floor portions to close the distance with the target, punching them back towards the ground. Sarada finishes it by landing a Chidori.
Uchiha Family: Trinity Technique: Sasuke and Sarada expel two fireballs, following with Sakura jumping down on the opponent with a powerful punch.
Uchiha Flame Formation: After manifesting small chakra flames on each finger of one hand, the user then slams their palm on the ground, resulting in the creation of a cylindrical barrier of flames enveloping a location of their choosing. Should the enemy come into contact with the barrier's exterior, they will be quickly set ablaze.
Uchiha Imprisonment Sealing: During the Warring States Period, the Uchiha clan would place seal tags surrounding where they are imprisoning their captives. If the prisoners were to touch the bars in their prison, they would catch fire. Any attempts at using ninjutsu would drain the prisoner's chakra.
Uchiha Return: By utilising the Gunbai Uchiwa to block an incoming attack, the user nullifies the effects of the attack by converting the incoming chakra into Wind nature transformation, which is then reflected. As this reflection of an attack occurs both suddenly and unexpectedly, the reflected attack can prove difficult for opponents to evade.
Uchiha Shuriken Formation: Spring Lightn: Sarada attacks her opponent with a Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique. She jumps out of the smoke, and with her Sharingan, she throws out several shuriken, which ricochet from one another, hitting her target. She finishes them off with a Thunderclap Drill.
Uchiha Shurikenjutsu: Spring Storm: Sarada jumps high and throws an explosive tag laden Fūma Shuriken at her opponents, while also throwing healing seal laden kunai at her allies.
Uchiha Style Blade Technique: Hagoromo: By continuously flowing chakra into it, this technique increases the blade's sharpness and durability, preventing it from chipping. At the same time, it is a delicate technique, requiring constant focus to keep active.
Uchiha Style Kenjutsu: The is a unique style of kenjutsu developed and mastered by Sasuke Uchiha, who passed on the skill to his student Boruto.
Uchiha Style Shurikenjutsu: \"Lightning\: The user throws three shuriken, infused with Lightning Release chakra, at the opponent. The addition of lightning-natured chakra increases the lethality and cutting power of the weapons.
Uchiha Style Shurikenjutsu: Hazy Wheel: Shisui plants a closed Fūma Shuriken into the ground, connected to him by a string. When he pulls on it, the shuriken flies back to him while spinning, fanned out and hitting any opponents on the way back.
Uchiha Style: Dance of the Sun Halo: Shisui coats his tantō in fire and with a quick gesture unleashes a wave of flame towards the opponent.
Uchiha Style: Dance of the Sun Halo – Fl: Itachi slashes the opponent with his sword coated in flames, following with putting them under a genjutsu where they are hit with flame twisters.
Uchiha Style: Four Directions Slash: Shisui powers up his tantō with Fire Release and, using the Body Flicker Technique, attacks the enemy from four sides, burning them with a fiery blade.
Ukon's Mad Dance: Ukon separates from Sakon, kicking the opponent and then finishing them by slicing them with his claws.
Ultimate Art (game): While riding his C2 Dragon, Deidara creates a clay clone and the clone strikes down on the opponent from the sky, Deidara sets off the clone causing a huge explosion.
Ultimate Death Beyond Terror: After riding on one of Kakuzu's masked beasts towards the enemy, Hidan slashes the opponent with his scythe and curses them with his Curse Technique: Death Controlling Possessed Blood. Kakuzu then uses Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work, Lightning Release: False Darkness and Wind Release: Pressure Damage on Hidan, creating a great explosion.
