Because of Hidan's curse, the opponent takes the same damage as he did.
Ultimate Poison Scattering: While transformed as Saiken, Utakata releases poisonous gas around himself, poisoning any opponent in close proximity.
Ultimate Reverse Lotus: This technique is almost identical to True Reverse Lotus, but Guy slams the opponent down and then tosses them into the air, instead of just kicking them into the air. The light beams are also larger and the punch used at the end is much more intense.
Ultimate Summoning Beast's Genjutsu: This genjutsu, which is emitted from the beast's eyes, sends rainbow-coloured rays to the targets which immobilises them.
Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Sand Wa: Gaara claps his hands together, causing a giant mound of sand to rise up from below the opponent, trapping and restraining every part of their body except for the head. He then summons a large amount of sand in the form of Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Spear of Shukaku, which he then sends towards the giant mound of sand at intense speed, aimed at the opponent. Due to the size of the spear, it rips the enemy apart, killing them and causing the mound to explode.
Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Spear o: The Spear of Shukaku is the attack counterpart of the Shield of Shukaku. Like the shield, Gaara crushes the hardest materials from the ground using sand, this time in the form of a halberd, in the shape of the Shukaku's hand. Just like the shield which has yet to find anything that could break its defence, the halberd has yet to find a defence that it can't break through.
Ultimately Hard Absolute Defence: Shield: Using his chakra, Gaara gathers the densest minerals in the soil, compresses their size, and then mixes them together. The resulting sand is formed into a protective shield in front of Gaara, shaped to resemble a miniature Shukaku, the . The Shukaku shield, because of how meticulously it's constructed, is incredibly strong, to the point that not even the Dance of the Clematis: Flower can penetrate it.
Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan: The Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan is a more powerful version of the Big Ball Rasengan.
Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan: Heaven Destruct: While possessing Boruto's body, Momoshiki creates three shadow clones to fire Spiralling Bullets at the opponent. The clones then pin them down while Momoshiki creates a large Rasengan to slam down on them.
Ultra-Fast Regeneration Technique: The user gathers a large quantity of chakra to rapidly regenerate any damage done to the body.
Ultra-Many Spiralling Serial Spheres: After creating a multitude of shadow clones, Naruto and his clones each create a Rasengan to bombard their target with devastating effects.
Ultra-Viscous Slime Battering Ram: Hiruko used strange viscous liquid in his surrounding during the eclipse immortality ritual. He's able to manipulate the viscosity of the liquid, so he can control it. The movement of the liquid is similar to a metal spring. These chunks of liquid can hit an enemy with enough force to temporarily knock them out.
Umbrella Shock Wave: After swinging his umbrella, Aoi produces a torrent of water large enough to attack a group of targets. The pressure generated is strong enough to ground his target and crack stone.
Uncontrollable Power: After entering his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto creates a giant claw out of Kurama's chakra, and slashes the opponent. Afterwards, he enters his Version 2 state.
Unite: Mecha-Naruto attaches his mechanical body to Naruto, who wears him as sort of a mechanised suit. Doing this gives the wearer added strength and a few added abilities.
Unknown Ability: Tobi teleports behind the opponent and prepares to throw a bomb, only to accidentally drop it at his feet. As he quickly makes a run for it, the bomb detonates, creating a huge explosion.
Unsealing Technique: A technique used by shinobi to unseal what was sealed within a scroll, or in the anime, a sheet of paper.
Unsealing Technique: Paper Snowstorm: Using a piece of paper with a sealing formula on it, the user generates thousands of tiny pieces of paper to engulf the target, robbing them of their sight and enabling the user to hide in their presence.
Unsealing Technique: Segmented Iron Dome: Tenten summons a large segmented iron dome from one of her scrolls to shield herself or allies from incoming attacks. The dome resembles the shell of an armadillo.
Unsealing Technique: Shuriken: Using the sealing formula contained on a sheet of paper or a scroll, the user summons multiple shuriken from it, which are launched directly at the target.
Unstoppable Blade Shuriken: The user throws the Kubikiribōchō at the opponent like a shuriken.
Uzumaki Formation: Naruto creates twelve shadow clones, each armed with a kunai, forming a defensive circle, with Naruto in the middle, all prepared for the enemy to strike. The Naruto clones will throw the kunai at the enemy.
Uzumaki Sealing Technique: After forming the necessary hand seals, the user slams their hand on the ground after which a sealing formula, that originates from the user's hand, forming underneath the target. When the seal activates, anything above the inscription is sealed within the formula itself.
Uzumaki Twin Striking Palms: Boruto, Naruto, and Hinata charge at their opponent. Boruto accidentally drops his Extreme: Shinobi Picture Scrolls cards, rushing to recover a specific card, while Naruto helps him. Hinata spots a Santa version of her card by the opponent, and embarrassed by it, pushes her husband and son towards them with the Gentle Fist to keep them from seeing it. She is still embarrassed when Naruto recovers the card.
Vacuum Sword: The user swings their sword and a gust of wind is released in the arc that it was swung in. The technique is strong enough to stop projectiles that are thrown at the user.
Vanishing Facial Copy Technique: The user applies their hand to a target's face, allowing them to take the face and use it as their own. Because it's the actual face that they're using and not a disguise, the user runs no risk of being discovered due to imperfections or minor flaws. The bodies of those whose faces have been stolen are, as a consequence, quite ghastly to look upon. After Orochimaru uses this technique to take the face of a Kusagakure-nin, his voice changes as well, though it's not clear if that's part of this technique. As he takes damage in combat, the stolen face gradually wrinkles before finally tearing away, revealing Orochimaru's face underneath. Orochimaru can also remove the face himself when he no longer needs it.
Vanishing Many Spiralling Serial Spheres: Boruto creates four shadow clones that form Vanishing Rasengans that are thrown at the opponent.
Vanishing Rasengan: The Vanishing Rasengan is a Lightning Release version of the Rasengan, that was created by Boruto Uzumaki, and named by Sasuke Uchiha.
Vanishing Rasengan: Waxing and Waning: The user forms a medium sized Vanishing Rasengan and fires it at the opponent, vanishing and then reappearing upon hit. Targets close to it will be drawn into the jutsu. Charging it further will increase its size, damage, and drawing radius.
Very Hiden: Venomous Insect Venom: Torune lands a series of hits on the opponent, poisoning them with his rinkaichū.
Veteran Taijutsu: When in front of the opponent, Chiyo kicks them and finishes with a spinning upward kick.
Violent Arm: The user enlarges their fist and stretches their arm out, swinging in a punch.
Violent Headspinner: Karin gets up close to her opponent and does a combo of violent slaps.
Violent Heavenly Earth Needle: After using the Earth Release: Earth Flow Wave technique to shape and form the earth, the user creates a large needle out of it to impale the opponent.
Violent Stabbing Face Slap: Karin charges and slaps her opponent with a explosive tag. The force of the slap knocks the opponent across the field, and the explosive tag detonates after the opponent hits the ground.
Violent Whirlwind: The user produces a powerful stream of wind from their mouth. This technique was powerful enough to dispel several shadow clones in an instant.
Violent — Leaf Adamantine-Strength Whirl: Guy deals a severe roundhouse kick to his opponent after entering his Eight Gates state.
Viscous Water Mass: Nurari is able to manipulate the strange liquid from his special suit. He is able to contort his body in various ways and even summon extra limbs. Nurari is able to shed layers of his suit, making him immune to techniques like Parasitic Destruction Insect Technique and also seems to be able to manipulate the liquid's viscosity and stickiness. He can extract this liquid in the form of projectiles to throw at his opponents in order to trap them, incapacitate them, or to pin them down. He can also form the membrane into barriers in order to nullify incoming projectile attacks.
Watch Your Steps!: Kushina creates a barrier seal on the ground. If the opponent steps on the barrier seal, two frying pans appear in the sky and fall on the opponent, knocking them unconscious.
Watchful Eye's Torrent: Kakuzu uses his Earth Grudge Fear to lift his opponent into the air with his threads. He then use his masks to attack the opponent with a triple elemental blast of lightning, fire and wind.
Water Attacking Gorgon: This technique will summon a large amount of water that will then be used to strike at the opponent in several versatile ways. Shizuku has been known to transform it into a dragon with a gaping mouth to attack. The water used will be stationary till it is sent offensively toward the opponent.
Water Balloon Technique: Gengetsu creates a puddle of water mixed with oil, which he uses to produce bubbles that float up into the air. On his command, the bubbles launch themselves toward Gengetsu's enemy with such speed and force, they can cause great blunt-force trauma upon bursting.
Water Characters: This technique allows one to send messages through water. By throwing water on a surface, even a vertical one, the water will rearrange itself into a readable message, which will fade after a while.
Water Clone Combo: Attacking the opponent with a series of punches and kicks to force them backwards, Tobirama then creates a small pool of water from which a clone of himself emerges. The clone, alongside Tobirama then buffets the target with a series of more kicks and punches before delivering a final kick and the clone then dissipates back into water.
Water Clone Technique: This technique originates from Kirigakure. Using water from the surroundings, the user creates one or more copies of themselves. Unlike the standard Clone Technique, these water clones are physically real, allowing them to interact with others and even perform the same jutsu as the user. Although a single water clone can be quite challenging to a standard genin, water clones only have about a tenth of their user's strength. When a water clone is sufficiently damaged, it will revert back into water. In the anime, the clones can alternatively disperse into a mist that act as a smokescreen to briefly cover the area.
Water Droplet Reflection Sight: By dilating her pupils, Yome is able to track down enemies via the reflection on tiny water droplets. According to Sen, once Yome has fixated her sight, her visual range reaches several dozen kilometres. Yome can also use this ability to augment her evasion-skills during combat.
Water Flow Sensing Technique: The user is able to create a stream of water that enables them to sense the surroundings of the flow of water. The technique presumably causes great strain to the user, as prolonged usage caused sweating and a bloody nose.
Water Gun Technique: The Water Gun Technique is a technique used by the Hōzuki clan.
Water Gun Technique: One-Hand Magnum: Gengetsu jumps and creates a few water bullets, shooting the opponent with them in quick succession.
Water Gun Technique: Two-Handed Magnum: Gengetsu creates a barrage of water bullets and sends them at the opponent. Then he forms one big water bullet and shoots the opponent with it.
Water Gun: Quick Shot: Gengetsu jumps up in midair and fires several water bullets at his opponent.
Water Gun: Two Guns: A more lethal version of the Water Gun Technique, where, instead of using one hand, the user uses both hands and fires two powerful shots of water simultaneously as if dual-wielding. This technique was powerful enough to destroy part of Tobi's face.
Water Mirror Colliding Bullets: Hagoromo forms a mirror of water, which breaks up into small projectiles of water that are shot at the opponent.
Water Needle: Using the chakra control granted by the Gentle Fist, Hinata concentrates her chakra until water vortexes are created around her. Those vortexes shoot water blasts which turn to needle-like water. By using Byakugan, this technique can be used with great precision to hit very small targets such as bees.
Water Palm Blade: Tobirama attacks the opponent with a combination of taijutsu and Water Release. He begins with a simple punch followed by three kicks and then lifting the opponent into the air where with his mastery of the Water Release, Tobirama materialises from his palm, a blade of water that he uses to blast the opponent through the air.
Water Pillar Thrust: Tobirama uses his mastery of the Water Release to materialise a small body of water to rise up beneath the opponent and thrusting them into the air.
Water Prison Bead Binding Technique: After thrusting their palm out, the user creates a large bubble in front of them, which then disperse into smaller Water Prison Technique traps when targets are near enough to it.
Water Prison Shark Dance Technique: After using the Water Release: Great Exploding Water Colliding Wave, Kisame forms the water into a gigantic prison. Because he acts as the centre of the dome of water, the dome alters its position in order to reflect the direction of his movements, making it difficult for his target to escape as long as he continues his pursuit.
Water Prison Technique: This technique traps a target in a sphere of water; the water can either be drawn from the surroundings or expelled from the user's mouth. The water that the sphere is made from is noticeably heavy, which restricts the target's movements and can make breathing difficult. As such, those trapped within the water prison cannot ordinarily escape on their own. Neji Hyūga was able to free himself by simultaneously releasing chakra from all of his tenketsu, destroying the prison. In Akatsuki Hiden, Kisame Hoshigaki escaped by increasing the volume of water within the prison beyond what it could contain, causing it to burst.
Water Release Bullet: Orca: The user sends a huge surge of water crashing down onto the enemy, which restricts their movements, given the intensity and pressure of the waves produced.
Water Release Genjutsu: Demonic Phantom: After Kandachi performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King opens its shell and releases a mist that puts the opponent under a genjutsu. In the genjutsu, the Conch King licks the opponent until they're frozen, which results in the opponent being overcome with fear and going into a mental breakdown in a matter of time. The power of the genjutsu was greatly increased by the magnetic forces of the trees surrounding the swamp they were in.
Water Release: A Thousand Feeding Sharks: A much more powerful version of the Water Release: Five Feeding Sharks, where the user creates one thousand sharks out of water that replicates a giant wave to swarm down and attack the opponent.
Water Release: Angry Bitter Rain: After water has been shot into the air, such as with the Water Release: Water Bullet Technique, this jutsu turns the water black. When the black water falls on a target it clings to their body and covers their eyes, blocking their vision. Because of the name ("doku" meaning "poison"), victims are intended to believe the water is poisonous. In truth the water is harmless, and the name is only meant to distract victims long enough for the user to follow up with another attack and/or escape.
Water Release: Archerfish: The user simply creates a jet of water that can be used to extinguish fire.
Water Release: Azure Dragon Palm: Ao dashes towards his opponent pushing his hands forward and when his hands come in contact with them, he unleashes a spiralling torrent of water.
Water Release: Black Rain Technique: This technique creates a flammable black mist that forms a small cloud. The user can then move the cloud above their target and disperse it, covering the target in flammable oil. This technique was first used to burn down Idate Morino's boat, after it was lit with fire.
Water Release: Blood Conversion Techniqu: The user extracts all the blood in their target to convert into pure water, causing the victims to shrivel into dry husks which results in their immediate death. This technique is useful if there are no nearby sources of water to perform ninjutsu. If the user's body is in a weakened state resulted in a severe lack of water, they can use this technique to revitalise themselves.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique: After blowing dozens of bubbles, the user manipulates them to surround the enemy in all directions. Only the slightest amount of physical contact with an opponent is required to make these bubbles burst, resulting in a small but powerful explosion when they do. The user can then make them detonate simultaneously with a snap of their fingers.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Broad: Utakata uses his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu to create a dome around himself and his allies. This dome is shown to be strong enough to resist large explosions.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Combo: Utakata jumps up in the air and blows six bubbles, four miniature and two large ones. The first five merely stun his opponent, and the last one knocks them far back.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Drift: Utakata creates a single, particularly large bubble with his bubble pipe and quickly jumps inside. Under his command, the bubble will take him wherever he wishes. It's seemingly very capable of both travelling very long distances and floating rather high into the air with no apparent risk of popping. Utakata can also make the bubble camouflage to hide from anyone who's after him. Utakata is also able to take people with him via this technique. Smaller bubbles were seen floating casually alongside it, whereas the first time it was shown, it was just the one bubble. Upon bursting the bubble to get out of it, Utakata can use it do damage nearby opponents.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Galax: Utakata transforms into Saiken and spews popping bubbles at the opponent, finishing with a Tailed Beast Ball.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Great: Transformed as Saiken, Utakata swipes one of his tails at his opponent, followed by two shots of corrosive alkali, and finishes it with a volley of bubbles.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Ink: Using his bubble-blower, Utakata sends a rush of bubbles toward his enemies, who are subsequently encased in a large bubble, which then appears to fill up with a black liquid. The bubble then pops in a black inky splash, obliterating them and leaving no sign of a corpse behind.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Mount: Utakata blows several bubbles at his opponent, stunning them, ending it with a single great bubble. Upon the great bubble bursting, it turns into several smaller bubbles, which coalesce into an even great bubble on top of his opponent, and floors them.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Rippl: Utakata strikes his opponent using his bubble pipe, followed by two empty-handed swipes, and finishes it with a volley of bubbles.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Rise: Utakata blows a series of bubbles at his opponent, each stunning them, ending it with a downwards cluster of bubbles, which multiply at their feet, throwing them up in the air.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Twist: Utakata blows a series of bubbles at his opponent, each one leaving his opponent stunned, ending it with a great cluster of rotating bubbles, which knocks his opponent back.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Wrap: Utakata blows a great bubble near his opponent, trapping them inside it. He then snaps his fingers, bursting the bubble and damaging his opponent.
Water Release: Clear Mirror Still Water: Kagura creates a clear mirror out of water to serve as a shield for incoming attacks.
Water Release: Cold Sky Water Attack: The user shoots numerous amount of extremely large jets of water from their mouth at high speeds which can easily shatter rock.
Water Release: Drizzle: The user condenses the water vapour in the air to fire multiple blasts of water at the target.
Water Release: Droplet Spear: Mei attacks her opponents with several water orbs, which converge on top of them and come crashing down in the form of spears.
Water Release: Exploding Water Colliding: The user spits out a great volume of water from their mouth, swallowing up and crushing the enemy with the advancing surge. The user can ride the wave, allowing them to move at high speed, and attack the enemy, now swept off their feet. The amount of water created is proportional to the amount of chakra used; when used with Kisame's enormous chakra, even a dry wasteland can become a small ocean. Afterwards, the excess water can be used for additional Water Release techniques.
Water Release: Falling Rain Needles: By using the existing rain around them, the user infuses their chakra into the individual raindrops, sharpening them into ultra-thin needles to fall down and skew their targets. Because of its minuscule nature and how they blend in with the rest of the rain, it is hard for a person to discern the true nature of this technique without prior knowledge.
Water Release: Five Feeding Sharks: The user puts their hand on the surface of a body of water and from the tips of five fingers, chakra is released into the water, changing it into the form of five ferocious sharks. The sharks circle the target with high speed, creating a raging stream that takes away their prey's freedom of movement and their sharp teeth tear into the enemy with each consecutive attack. In the anime, these sharks can regenerate from surrounding water, making them difficult to destroy.
Water Release: Five Gluttonous Sharks: Kisame slashes a body of water, creating a pillar of water that launches the opponent into the air. He then releases five water sharks that attack the opponent until one devours them before imploding, launching the opponent into the air. The remaining water sharks surround the opponent and force them under water where they implode in on them.
Water Release: Four Sharks Rain: Kisame slams his palm onto a nearby water surface, sending a large surge of water into the air. This water then forms into a group of four water sharks, which then rush towards the target from above. Should these sharks be attacked, the water that composes them simply reforms into countless droplet-sized sharks, which continue to rain down upon the target and inflict damage whenever they come into contact with them.
Water Release: Furious Roaring Tornado: The user draws on nearby water sources to create a large waterspout, capable of tearing through an area with ease. The user must be inside the waterspout in order to control it.
Water Release: Great Exploding Water Col: This technique is a larger version of the Water Release: Exploding Water Colliding Wave. With it, the user spews out a massive amount of water, covering an entire area with a ferocious tsunami. The produced ocean of water can be used for further techniques, and even gathered into a gigantic water prison, allowing Kisame to use his Water Prison Shark Dance Technique.
Water Release: Great Gunshot: The user spits out a giant pressurised bullet of water from their mouth that goes through and damages the opponent as it hits them.
Water Release: Great Shark Bullet Techni: The Water Release: Great Shark Bullet Technique is a stronger version of the Water Release: Water Shark Bullet Technique.
Water Release: Great Water Arm Technique: By putting the Hydrification Technique into practical use, the muscles of the arm are temporarily enlarged and strengthened. Moisture is gathered from the whole body and compressed into the entire arm, like an instant pump-up. However, because it is essential to properly control the moisture balance inside the body, this technique's degree of difficulty is very high. The technique gives the user superhuman strength, capable of breaking through both rock walls and steel doors with ease.

Suigetsu enlarges his arm muscles by using the Water Release: Great Water Arm Technique, then proceeds to use Kubikiribōchō to deliver a straight cut to the opponent, followed up by a moonslice that causes water to erupt from the ground.
Water Release: Great Water Drill: Kisame coats Samehada in water, and forms it into the shape of a drill. After drilling the opponent into the ground the water spreads out into a tsunami that drenches the battlefield.
Water Release: Great Water Leg Technique: By isolating the application of the Hydrification Technique, the user's legs can expand and increase in muscle mass. This proportionately increases the user's range and raw strength in their leg attacks as well as accelerated movement in linear paths.
Water Release: Great Water Mass Bullet: Isobu, or Yagura while taking on its form, releases water balls of varying size. These large water projectiles are also powerful enough to destroy an entire cliff side.
Water Release: Great Waterfall Flow Tech: By mixing a source of water with chakra, the user can create a whirlpool of differentiating sizes in order to drown their opponent.
Water Release: Great Waterfall Technique: A large volume of water is directed from a preexisting source or expelled from the mouth dozens of metres high into the air; to manipulate so much water at once requires a great deal of chakra. Once high enough, it cascades down onto the targeted area, resembling a giant waterfall. The force of this waterfall is great enough to hollow out the ground, washing away everything in the area. In the aftermath, whatever remains will appear devastated, as though some sort of natural disaster has just occurred.
Water Release: Great Whirlpool Enfolding: Kisame uses a nearby water supply to create a giant water vortex around his Samehada. Kisame wields the vortex as a weapon and then jumps above his opponent and uses his sword to smash the vortex into his targets causing massive damage.
Water Release: Gunshot: The user creates water in their body using chakra. The user then spits the water from their mouth as orb-shaped projectiles, whose destructive potential are determined by how much chakra is placed in them. The orbs travel quickly towards the target, dealing extensive damage upon impact. When Gamabunta uses this technique, the water orbs are not only especially large, but are made more lethal because they're shot while he's airborne, thereby adding the force of gravity to their power.
Water Release: Hail: Chino gathers water into large clumps in the shape of massive orb-like formations and then drops them from the sky on to her opponents. The attack covers a large range, making it difficult to dodge.
Water Release: Hail Barrage: This technique freezes water into twelve jagged chunks of hail.
Water Release: Hard Whirlpool Water Blad: The user makes the water under their opponent explode, launching them into the air. They then jump above them, creating a large whirlpool around their arm that gets concentrated into a water lance, that strikes their opponent. This technique has a long attack range and tremendous piercing power that is said to be able to pierce through nearly anything.
Water Release: Hiding in Drizzle Techniq: The user generates drizzle to hide themselves and/or their comrades in it. However, the technique is useless in areas with little moisture, as it prevents it from taking effect.
Water Release: Hiding in Rain Technique: The user blends in with the rain to be near by the enemy. When used by Tsurugi, he can summon rain around him at will.
Water Release: Hiding in Water Technique: A technique that allows the user to fuse with water, even in water as shallow as a puddle. By doing so, the user can take advantage of their hidden presence and launch a surprise attack on their target.
Water Release: Hydrification Exploding F: The user dissolves into a big pool of water, engulfing the opponent, then emerges from beneath the opponent's feet and explodes. As the user is able to turn their entire body into water, they do not sustain damage and are able to re-assemble after detonation.
Water Release: Imminent Danger: The user generates a powerful stream of water that becomes a vortex, able to overwhelm several targets at once. It is able to move with such sudden change in direction as to leave opponents disoriented as they struggle to anticipate it. Alternatively, the user is able to ride the technique, holding their sword and spinning with the vortex's rotation to launch a more lethal assault.
Water Release: Infinite Sharks: Kisame creates an orb of water that releases countless water sharks that rapidly assault the opponent. If the orb is released underwater, the strength of the sharks is greatly enhanced and all of them colliding with the target will result in an enormous implosion.
Water Release: Jadeite: The user holds their arm out with their palms flat at target, launching a powerful stream of water to push them back.
Water Release: Large Projectile: When in Kaima Form, the user is able to attack with a giant blast of water by spitting it as a strong stream from their mouth.
Water Release: Lotus Light Rupture: The user creates drops of water from an outside source, which are then shaped into razor-sharp lotus petals. As the petals expand in size and spin around, emitting explosive energy in every direction, they are launched at the opponent. The petals can be controlled and are able to kill a man with a single petal. Hisen noted it to be his strongest technique.
Water Release: Mouth Shot: A technique where the user spits out a single senbon-shaped droplet of water with high velocity which is hard to avoid. Once the droplet hits anything, it forcefully bursts and injures the target. While the technique lacks the force to seriously endanger somebody, it can be used to weaken enemies while they are distracted.
Water Release: Multiple Water Spirit Wav: An upgraded version of the single-shot technique, the user cups their hands together while points bother their index fingers at the target, mimicking a gun with their fingers. Within a few seconds, they will generate a large ball of water from the fingertips that can launch several water bullets at the opponent in rapid succession, as if from a machine gun.
Water Release: Pillar Encirclement: The user creates four large water pillars which then circle around the user as a protective barrier.
Water Release: Raging Jellyfish: Funamushi creates a giant water jellyfish, which he rides and controls. With its tentacles, it can cause widespread destruction and attack multiple targets at once. Funamushi only employed it in combat when he had access to a significant amount of water provided by rainfall. Despite his Water Release being vulnerable to Lightning Release, especially when absorbing water to use jutsu, once it was used, it appeared to suffer no effect from three simultaneous Lightning Release attacks.
Water Release: Rampaging Water: Gamabunta shoots a stream of water from his mouth. This technique appears to tire him.
Water Release: Rapid Thunder Whip Techni: The user dips their first two fingers into a source of water making a long rope of water rise out from said source. The whip is as sharp as a sword being able to cleanly slice through trees and wrap opponents up. Lightning chakra is also channeled through the whip.
Water Release: Rising Water Slicer: The user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds to its target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.
Water Release: Running Water Spear: After attacking the opponent with multiple water attacks, Mei shapes the remaining water into a spear that strikes them upwards.
Water Release: Running Water Whip: After kneading chakra in her mouth, Mei converts it into water before expelling from her mouth in the form a whip, which she uses to lash at her opponent, sending them flying back.
Water Release: Scattering Bullets Techni: Gengetsu sends a wide volley of water bullets at his opponent, delivering several sequential hits.
Water Release: Snake's Mouth: The user generates a spinning column of water which takes the form of a snake with a gaping jaw. This snake can twist and follow its targets and swallow them. After it has swallowed them, it turns into a river that carries the targets away.
Water Release: Starch Syrup Capturing Fi: The user expels high viscosity water to cover the ground. This stream of sticky liquid can be used to form an adhesive trap that will inhibit a person's mobility. One can effectively reduce their enemy's area of activity with this technique, giving the user an advantage on the battlefield. The normal scope of this technique is normally just a few metres, but it is possible to make an entire pond of starch syrup. The syrup can be manipulated to move after it is created, being able to stick and travel up surfaces.
Water Release: Stormy Blockade: This technique allows the user to summon a massive amount of water from the sky, crashing it onto the opponent. If needed, the user can cancel the technique in an instant.
Water Release: Submerged Shark Scraping: Kisame spits a lake of water near the opponent from which water sharks come out and force them up. Kisame then jumps up and slashes the opponent back into the lake, where they are devoured by the sharks.
Water Release: Surfing Strike: The user creates water underneath their feet in the form of a wave and then proceeds to ride it directly towards the opponent, sending the crashing waves to attack them.
Water Release: Surging Sea: After kneading chakra in their stomach and converting it, the user expels a large surge of water from their mouth.
Water Release: Tate Eboshi: After using his Hydrification Technique to merge with a water source, Suigetsu can form a giant wave that resembles a demon-like fish. Suigetsu can use this form to battle larger opponents, or he can use it to shield allies from attack. Though it was strong enough to physically push back Killer B in his Tailed Beast Mode, it was not strong enough to withstand a point-blank range Tailed Beast Ball, and rendered Suigetsu unconscious soon afterwards, causing him to fall into a jelly-like state.
Water Release: Tearing Torrent: This technique creates water that spirals in the user's hand which fires at a high speed towards the enemy. In the anime, it was also shown to be able to be conjured from the surrounding area in the form of a torrential wave. It can also be combined with the Wind Release: Rasengan to create the Typhoon Water Vortex Technique.
Water Release: Torrent Bullet: The user creates a powerful vortex of water and unleashes it on the target.
Water Release: Transform-at-Will: Suien has a durable, jelly-like substance flow onto his enemy. This substance binds, blinds and suffocates the victim.
Water Release: Water Armour: Suien covers the entirety of his body with chakra-infused water, making it like a sturdy suit of armour. It can withstand most physical attacks suffered.
Water Release: Water Army Water Demon Te: This technique gathers a large amount of water to form a large spiralling stream of water. It can be guided to strike a target in a number of angles.
Water Release: Water Beast: The user manipulates water and transforms it into a giant wolf-like beast. The beast can launch powerful streams of water from its mouth, or sweep the area with its claws to let a powerful torrent of water to wash the enemies away.
Water Release: Water Binding: The user produces large tendrils from behind. They are highly malleable, able to twist and constrict as needed. They are also very strong, able to easily lift and subdue a grown man, potentially able to crush their victims.
Water Release: Water Blade Technique: The user forms a hand seal and raises a column of underground water from beneath their feet, which takes the shape of a high-pressured water blade. If one were to take a direct hit from the blade, it would cut clean through flesh and bone. This technique is perfect for digging through bedrock without creating igniting sparks. Using hydrated calcium and volcanic rock from the underground water, the shape of this technique can also take the form of a javelin, which is capable of piercing though the Shield of Sand. This technique was noted to have been created by Rasa, the Fourth Kazekage.
Water Release: Water Body: This technique transforms the user's entire form into water and back at will, granting the user free control of their shape, including slipping through small cracks. This technique allows for high-level infiltration and stealth. By travelling down a target's mouth, even a recently deceased one, the user is also able to possess them, controlling the body's full range movements and actions as if their own personal body, even talking. Due to this form's fluid and malleable nature, physical attacks will harmlessly pass through them. However, this technique is very vulnerable to Lightning Release and still vulnerable to chakra disruption by an opponent.
Water Release: Water Bowl: The user emits a continuous jet of water from their hand to strike the enemy and disrupt their attack. Due to the nature of water, this technique works especially well against smoke-based attacks.
Water Release: Water Buckshot: The user spits several blade-like projectiles, strong enough to penetrate protective armor.
Water Release: Water Bullet Technique: The Water Release: Water Bullet Technique is a highly versatile Water Release technique with many variations. After kneading chakra in their stomach, the user expels a large quantity of water in the form of a powerful torrent aimed towards their intended target.
Water Release: Water Colliding Wave: The user creates a massive vortex of water that protects the user from attacks. It explodes from the top of it in the form of a wave that travels at high velocity, covering the entire battlefield. The impact of the technique is similar to a huge tsunami. By using hand gestures, the user can manipulate the water to move in any direction. Having changed the battlefield in this way enables the user to follow up with additional Water Release techniques. The user can also evaporate the water at will.
Water Release: Water Current Bridge: The user slams their hands on the ground, causing a torrent of water to erupt. It sturdy enough for grown men to run across.
Water Release: Water Dragon Biting Explo: Tobirama creates a large pool of water that, after firing the enemy into the air, shoots numerous water bullets at them and then finishes by forming the water bullets into a water dragon which attacks the target, sending them crashing into the ground.
Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Techn: The user moulds water into the shape of a dragon, which they then direct at a target. The water crashes upon the target, dealing significant physical damage. Ideally, users will use pre-existing bodies of water for this technique, but sufficiently skilled users can instead create the water themselves, spitting the dragon from their mouths. The more talented the user, the greater the amount of water that the dragon can be made from.
Water Release: Water Dragon Shot: The user creates a small reservoir from which three water dragons are formed, attacking several opponents at once in different directions.
Water Release: Water Dragon Triple Step: An advanced version of the Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique, where the user launches three water dragons at the target instead of one.
Water Release: Water Dragon Whip: This technique creates an orb of water from which many sharp whips of water emerge that can be directed towards and impale a target or multiple targets. The whips can also change direction in mid-trajectory, bending to seek out the targets.
Water Release: Water Dragon Whirlpool Te: Gengetsu creates a barrage of water bullets and shoots the opponent in successive hits. Then he creates a whirlpool and sends it to the opponent.
Water Release: Water Fang Bullet: The user forms projectiles underwater; the water that the projectiles are made of is highly pressurised because of how compact they are. The projectiles are then shot from the water at high speeds at the user's target, which can be made more lethal by adding a spinning motion. This technique is especially useful during fights taking place on top of water, as the projectiles can be shot at the target from any direction, ideally blind-spots. Users will often try to distract targets before using this technique against them, or even use this technique itself as a distraction. In the anime, multiple users can work together to create larger, stronger projectiles, or a single user can create several smaller projectiles in a scattershot manner.
Water Release: Water Forge Technique: By gathering water around the user's sword, it generates a rapidly swirling stream. Once striking with it, it unleashes a strong surge of water to launch a target.
Water Release: Water Formation Pillar: A defensive technique where chakra kneaded inside the body is converted into water and then expelled from the mouth in a dense, curved torrent, near-instantaneously creating a circular barricade that can be used to intercept incoming attacks.
Water Release: Water Formation Wall: The user spits a stream of water from their mouth at the ground, which circles around them and rises upward to create a wall. If the user is standing on a body of water, they can instead create the wall from the surroundings. The water wall defends anyone within its perimeter from attack, with the wall's strength being determined by how much of the user's chakra is put into it. Users control how long the wall lasts as well as how much water it's made with. Because the water is clear, the wall doesn't obstruct the user's vision, allowing them to make their next move uninhibited. The wall's initial formation, if timed correctly, can be used to fend off opponents, flinging them away as the wall rises. In the anime, the water can also be gathered midair, and dispersed in all directions as a form of fire-fighting, or shot from one's hand.
Water Release: Water Gun: This technique is demonstrated as being both a technique on its own and as a two-way cooperation ninjutsu between Gamariki and Jiraiya. Using this technique, Gamariki can blast off a wave of high speed water from his mouth with extreme precision and force. When combined with another person's chakra, this technique becomes a two-way collaboration water technique that can slice the target into multiple fine-carved pieces. After he learns this technique, Gamatatsu is able to combine it with Naruto's wind-natured chakra to create the Wind Release: Toad Gun technique.
Water Release: Water Hail: The user cups their hands together and stretches their arms outward at the target. They will then unleash a large barrage of water bullets. The bullets are very potent, able to effortlessly demolish large and sturdy trees.
Water Release: Water Lock Technique: Tobirama lands a water punch to his opponent, causing a whirlpool to hold them in place. He then jumps up in the air, and comes down at the opponent with a water drill.
Water Release: Water Mass Crumbling Bull: Yagura creates a giant ball of water above his opponent before crashing it down on them.
Water Release: Water Mirror Technique: The user creates a large, flat, circular pool of water in front of their opponent. Its surface acts like a mirror, perfectly reflecting the attacking targets. By then hooking onto and rotating the "mirror" 90° with their staff, the reflections emerge and materialise from the mirror, where they collide with the mirrored targets. As these reflections use the exact same technique as their counterpart — regardless of its type — they counter the attack completely, while repelling them in the process. However, upon impact, the reflections disperse into water.
Water Release: Water Palm Wave: Yagura jumps up in the air, delivers a couple hits with his staff, and finishes with a water blast that knocks his opponent down in the ground.
Water Release: Water Pillar: The user creates a pillar of water, allowing them to dodge attacks by raising the pillar above their level, or to level themselves with an opponent if they're higher, for example, on a rock.
Water Release: Water Pillar Method Attac: Yagura hooks his opponent with his staff, throwing them up in the air, and hits them with four water pillars.
Water Release: Water Quaking Pillar: The user jumps into the air and stabs down towards the ground. This causes water to burst up around the user, and creates a pillar of water to rise into the air and repel the enemy.
Water Release: Water Scales: Tenma creates a myriad of fish scales out of water and blasts them at his opponents through his fiddler crab.
Water Release: Water Severing Slash: After jumping in the air, Mei kneads chakra in her stomach and converts it into water before expelling it from her mouth as a high-pressured stream to strike the opponent down into the ground.
Water Release: Water Severing Wave: After kneading chakra in the stomach and converting it into water, the user spews it out as a high pressure stream that is powerful enough to cut cleanly through the roots of the God Tree with ease.
Water Release: Water Shark Blade: Kisame points Samehada towards his opponent and then envelops it with water, which is then manipulated into the form of a shark. Kisame then thrust Samehada forward, releasing the shark as a projectile that flies towards the opponent and explodes into a burst of water on contact.
Water Release: Water Shark Breakthrough: Kisame summons a water shark to jump into the air and bolt towards the opponent, striking them.
Water Release: Water Shark Bullet Techni: The user manipulates a volume of water with their hand; by thrusting their hand in a direction, the manipulated water is sent in that direction. As it moves, the body of water takes the shape of a shark, with additional water following in its wake for as long as the user keeps their hand thrust out. Because of how quickly the shark moves and because of how much water there is, it does extensive damage when it impacts something. Users can also ride within the water shark as it moves, allowing them to travel faster than they're able to swim.
Water Release: Water Shark Shot Techniqu: Kisame releases several fast-moving water sharks through the ground, one after the other. The sharks rush towards the opponent and falls on top of them.
Water Release: Water Shark Wild Sphere T: Merged with Samehada, Kisame surrounds himself with water and summons sharks to attack the trapped opponent.
Water Release: Water Shield: The user launches a ball of water that turns into a shield capable of pushing back the opponent and blocking their attacks.
Water Release: Water Shuriken: The user creates a large amount of shuriken, made out of water, and throws them at the opponent in quick succession.
Water Release: Water Snake Threads: The user produces a stream of water from their palms which spreads out into thin threads. The threads can hold a substantial amount of tension, but will throw their user back should they give out under great strain.
Water Release: Water Spikes: The user produces large spikes capable of impaling clean through a target. This technique can be performed from afar through any existing water source, even mist, to rain down on its foe or erupt from the ground. The user can also produce a spike to act as a makeshift sword for the wielder to strike with at hand.
Water Release: Water Spirit Wave: The user points their hand at a target, mimicking a gun with their fingers. They then generate a ball of water at their fingertip, shooting it at the opponent. The user can also cup both hands together while making the gesture to produce a larger, more powerful ball to launch.
Water Release: Water Spring Rush: Izumo spews a large stream of water from his mouth, which slithers towards the opponent in waves before exploding beneath their feet, sending them flying into the air.
Water Release: Water Suicide Bomb: The user performs a suicide bomb on themselves, emitting steam from their body and then self-destructing. This technique is primarily used to keep intel obtained secret from the enemies.
Water Release: Water Trumpet: The user launches a large jet of water from their mouth through their cupped hand. This gives the appearance of playing a trumpet, hence the name.
Water Release: Water Weapons: By cupping their hands, the user can gather up water and shape it into various weapons. These weapons can be used both in short or long range combat.
Water Release: Water Whip: The user creates a whip made of water that can wrap around the opponent. The user can also channel lightning chakra to shock anyone wrapped in it. This technique seems to be known by the Kirigakure hunter-nin. It's also strong enough to completely counter Yamato's Wood Release.
Water Release: Waterfall Basin Technique: This is a technique which creates a waterfall by developing spring water in a place without water veins and manipulating the resulting water current to form a wave. This is a very convenient technique as it can be used for training or relaxation. On the other hand, because it changes the environment on a large scale, it also has the effect of hiding one's location from the enemy by confusing them. The width of the water source, waterfall, and basin can be expanded as long as the user continues to send chakra in.
Water Release: Waterfall Prison: While infused with Samehada, Kisame creates a large vortex of water around himself, which defends him from enemy attacks, as well as harms anyone in close proximity.
Water Release: Water–Heavens Convergence: This technique enables the user to manipulate water and moisture around oneself. In this way, the user can quickly extract and utilise groundwater or water from vegetation, should no other source be available.
Water Release: Wild Bubble Wave: The user spits out a large volume of foam-like bubbles which covers the ground and reduces its friction, considerably limiting the opponents' movements. The bubbles are spit out with violent force that is capable of washing away most attacks, such as oil and fire. This technique can also be used as an effective smokescreen.
Water Release: Wild Water Wave: The user spews water from their mouth in a waterfall-like fashion to wash away the target. One can freely control the power of this technique by the amount of chakra kneaded and then released. While considered to be a basic Water Release technique, it has many variations.
Water Replacement: When the user is hit by an attack, this technique will transform the user into water to avoid taking direct damage from any physical attacks.
Water Retain: Tobirama punches his opponent then following up with a spinning kick that lifts them into the air, where he follows through with a further three kicks before appearing above the opponent and releasing a blast of water from his hand, pushing the opponent into the ground.
Water Vortex Thunderclap: Hagoromo sends a vortex of water to the opponent and adds four balls of electricity to it, shaping the twister in an electrified sphere of water.
Waterfall Binding Sand: Gaara creates a giant hand out of his sand to grab the opponent and throw them a great distance away.
Wave Break: Kisame creates a small wave of water underneath him that he manipulates to carry himself fowards towards the opponent and using Samehada he drills through the opponent.
Wave Transmission Technique: With this technique, the user is capable of creating a wave, by touching a solid substance, like a wall, that lets them communicate with their allies. When in use, the wave seems to creates a howling wind-like sound.
Waving Pursuit Sand: Gaara has his sand barrage the opponent three times and then he finishes it with a slash from a giant sand rope.
Waving Sand Waterfall Spread: Gaara traps his opponent in a swirling sand vortex, sinking them deep into it. When the sand at the border of the vortex reaches the middle of the vortex, Gaara crushes the opponent with the sand the vortex sucked in.
Weapon Reverse Control Technique: With this ability, the user throws their weapon, be it a sword, axe or fūma shuriken, at their opponent, controlling it with chakra so that it inflicts damage by spinning wildly and slicing through flesh, after which it inevitably returns to the user's hands. The weapon can be further enhanced by a chakra flow (and in Madara's case, setting fire using Fire Release techniques).
Weather Manipulation: A special ability known by his clan, Yota can to freely manipulate the weather around him. Regardless of the natural atmosphere around him, he could manifest many different weather effects, effectively turning them into powerful attacks or defences. It should be noted that his area of effect is not limited to outside, as he is able to isolate his abilities to relatively closed off areas, while within them. Yota has shown to have a great level of control over the range and direction of his ability, and could use them simultaneously if need be.
Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murde: This is the ultimate technique of the Fire Temple that is taught only to its ninja monks, and requires the special Gift of the Hermit Group chakra. The technique is activated when the user takes a specific stance with their left hand making a half-ram and then extending their right hand down with his palm parallel to the ground. Once the stance is taken, the spirit of the Thousand-Armed Kannon is summoned to defend the user, or attack their enemies. The spirit is normally calm, angelic and looks peaceful. However, whenever the user gets angry, the spirit turns red and transforms into a demonic-looking creature. Kannon then attacks the user's target with its 1000 spirit fists. The size and power of the spirit is dependent upon the skill of the user.
Whac-A-Mole Technique: By using this technique to move around the battlefield, the user pops up out of the ground in front of their opponent before whacking them with a stick. Unlike its parent technique, this technique is used to quickly attack multiple opponents in succession.
Whip of Love: The user stretches its tongue out with an incredible speed and force, delivering a powerful blow to the opponent. The toad may also use its tongue to wrap around the enemy and smash them into the ground.
Whirling Snake Tail: Kabuto lands a series of attacks with snakes, kicks, chakra scalpels, and his own navel snake, before grabbing his opponent with the navel snake, and flinging them over his head to the ground.
Whirlwind Drop: Temari sends out a gust of wind towards an enemy, trapping them within a powerful tornado. Controling the tornado's movement, she lifts the opponent up into the air and then sends them crashing down into the ground.
Whirlwind Gun: Chiriku empowers the spear with golden chakra, similar to that emitted by Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder, and attacks the opponent several times before piercing them with a spear throw.
Whirlwind Pinching Wall: Temari creates two localised tornadoes by flapping her Giant Folding Fan. The first tornado ensnares the opponent and the second one combines with the first to create a giant tornado that slashes the opponent with razor sharp wind pinions.
Whirlwind Sweep: Transformed as Kokuō, Han tramples his opponents twice, by his left and right, rams into them with his horns, and finishes by spinning and swatting at them with his tails.
Whirlwind Wild Strike: User quickly spins while holding Jō in his hands and attacks the opponent in this manner. The enhanced version uses Earth Release: Rock Brick Cane.
Whirlwind of Feet: The user swings his legs very quickly, creating a kind of vortex around him that repels attacks. With his help, Kajika easily destroyed several of Naruto's clones.
White Haze Heavenly Dance: Hinata's hands turn white, with chakra coating and flowing through them. She takes several swipes at the opponent, and finishes by bringing together both her hands. This creates a large explosion that damages and knocks back the opponent.
White Light Blade: Using his father's White Light Chakra Sabre, a young Kakashi delivers a series of slashes, finishing with a downward cut.
White Secret Technique Secret Art: Colle: After taking control of several bodies at once, Chiyo lets them attack an entire battlefield, resulting in constant and devastating impacts.
White Secret Technique: The Chikamatsu C: The White Secret Technique: The Chikamatsu Collection of Ten Puppets is a ninjutsu which was invented by Monzaemon Chikamatsu.
Using Monzaemon's puppets, Chiyo uses the number four's cable arm and puppet number three's spinning chakra blade, and finishes with puppet number five's hidden head cables impaling the opponent.

This technique utilizes the unique mechanism of fifth puppet of the Chikamatsu Collection. Ramming it into the target headfirst, five metallic tendrils release from holes in its scalp and pierce the target, as well as anything else behind it.
White Snake: Orochimaru leaves his body in the White Snake form, launching at the opponent damaging them and entering the ground, and then attacks the opponent from behind again before entering his body again.
White Snake Charmer Technique: Orochimaru uses the Snake Charmer Technique, but instead of sending a regular snake, he sends his true form, dealing more damage as well as poisoning the target.
White Snake Possession: Orochimaru transfers his consciousness into a white snake and then slithers into his target's body, enabling him to gain control of their body as well as their mind. This technique is similar in concept to the Yamanaka clan's Mind Body Switch Technique, where the user's original body is left defenceless after taking control of someone else's. Orochimaru used this technique to control Kajika and so test the extent of Sasuke Uchiha's power.
White Spirit Release: Neji performs a series of high-speed strikes before charging his chakra into his hands and releasing it in a burst.
White: Assimilation: Poison Mist: After taking on the properties of the unique, red soil situated at the Seventh Front, the White Zetsu Army gains poisonous properties. Whenever they exhale or are cut apart and killed, they expel a red poisonous gas capable of leaving their opponents unconscious.
Whole Body One Shot: Naruto while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, uses his Body Flicker Technique to jump into the air, then lands on the opponent and punches them at blinding speed.
Wicked Gong Mouth: After being summoned by Orochimaru, Manda slithers towards the opponent then dives and runs through them.
Wicked Tongue Combo: Tayuya sweeps the opponent off of their feet, then kicks them up into the air, where she then dashes behind them. She then activates the first level of her cursed seal, and delivers a bone-breaking punch to the face.
Wide Healing: The user is able to heal three characters at a time, or only the fourth, substitute character. It is a basic healing move and is known by almost all medical-nin and others.
Wide Range Bombing: Deidara has his C2 dragon shoot clay bombs from its mouth while in the air.
Wild Boar Spin: Obito lunges forth at the opponent, stabbing them with a kunai and finishing with a spinning kick, sending the opponent into the air.
Wild Body Strike: The user concentrates their chakra into one point in their body. They use that point of their body to strike their opponent, causing severe damage. A chance of confusion also might be effected on their opponent because of the damage they have taken.
Wild Dance: Kankurō manipulates Karasu to bolt towards the enemy and begins spinning, striking the enemy, and throws kunai around him.
Wild Lion's Mane Technique: This technique uses chakra to temporarily enhance the head's metabolism and manipulate the hair that grows longer as a result of it. There is also chakra flowing through the lengthened hair, making its hardness comparable to that of steel wire. By thickly bundling the hair, its strength is further increased, also increasing its destructive power. Its name may come from the fact that, as seen just before striking Pain, it takes the shape of what resembles a lion's mouth.
Wild Serpent: Mitsuki stretches his arm, causing it to go into and out of the ground many times before finally grabbing his opponent's leg. He pulls his opponent through the tunnels created by his arm and throws them high up in the air, still holding onto them, and spins his arm rapidly, to the point of creating a hurricane, before smashing the opponent against the ground.
Wild Shuriken Dance: Sakura releases a barrage of shuriken at the enemy.
Will Materialisation: This ability allows a user to materialise their itself into a physical form.
Will of Fire: Traditions: Kosuke first throws his opponent into the air, creating a water wall under his feet, after which he attacks them with a water dragon, and finishes off with a huge number of shuriken slashing through the water column.
Willow: Kimimaro jumps into the air, lands two spinning kicks, followed by two bone sword swipes, and then finishes by growing several bone spikes from his arm and chest and sending them towards his opponent.
Wind Cutter Technique: This technique requires the Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, and allows the user to divide and neutralise a Wind Release technique, making it harmless. The user can even redirect the opponent's attacks to them.
Wind Cyclone of Lightning: Kakuzu's masks use Wind Release: Pressure Damage and Lightning Release: False Darkness and shoot them at the opponent which trap them in a lightning cyclone that explodes after some hits.
Wind Demon Rotating Special Attack Bulle: The user delivers a barrage of punches before finishing them with a Rasengan.
Wind Demon Special Attack Bullet: Naruto creates a shadow clone which he grabs and transforms into a fūma shuriken that he throws at his enemy. After it hits the enemy the shuriken turns back to a shadow clone and punches the enemy in the face. This can also be done to escape attacks.
Wind Demon Special Attack Transformation: Naruto creates a clone to uppercut the opponent into the air where it and the real Naruto merge into a Fūma Shuriken that tears through them.
Wind Dust Violent Wave: Orochimaru upon connecting with an initiating blow, performs a Wind Release technique from his mouth, which manages to generate a large wind from behind himself, making his victim forced to stand their ground before being blasted away.
Wind God and Thunder God Technique: A cooperation ninjutsu used by a Wind Release and a Lightning Release user. The Wind Release user creates a giant tornado which spins towards the opponent, after which the Lightning Release user run an electrical current through the tornado. This has devastating effects on the opponent.
Wind Release Trap: Rin throws a special tag down at her opponent's feet, which unleashes a tornado of wind, launching them up into the air.
Wind Release: Air Bullets: This technique shoots multiple bullets of air at the victim with intense speed. The bullets also have great power, enough to subdue a whole group of shinobi.
Wind Release: Air Current Wild Dance: The user creates and controls air currents from the palms of their hands. The technique is able to easily whip up loose dust in the area. It is also performed to create a controllable dust storm.
Wind Release: Breakthrough: After gathering chakra in their stomach, the user expels it as a gust of wind. They can also release it as a burst of wind from their hands. This technique is powerful enough to blow away everything within the user's immediate vicinity. This technique can also be used for supplementary purposes, such as creating a vortex of wind to save a falling ally.
Wind Release: Bursting Compressed Air: A reversed version of Wind Release: Vacuum Blade, where the user compresses air inside their weapon, which, in the case of it getting destroyed, would cause its fragments to burst apart and take down the opponent.
Wind Release: Cast Net: Using their Giant Folding Fan, the user launches sharp wind currents in the form of a net to slice their target apart. When collaborated with other tessenjutsu users, it was powerful enough to inflict wounds on the Third Raikage — a shinobi renown for his tremendous durability.
Wind Release: Divine Mountain Wind: This technique creates a vortex of wind to blast at a target. It can be used in a combo with the Fire Release: Running Fire and the Earth Release: Earth Corridor to release a massive inferno at the opponents while they are trapped within the confined space of the earth.
Wind Release: Divine Wind: The user releases a gust of wind that forms several small tornadoes. Combined with Fire Release: Running Fire that forms a circle on ground level, this creates a massive flaming hurricane.
Wind Release: Dragon Blade Rasengan: Naruto uses Wind Release: Rasengan, which, when used in tandem with his holding the Dragon Blade, enhances the technique, causing a dragon of wind to swirl around Naruto, damaging the surroundings around him.
Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet: Shukaku pounds on its stomach with its arm, producing a loud sound. The external pressure from the pound forces a ball of wind from Shukaku's large mouth, firing it like a bullet. The wind, highly compressed and imbued with chakra, travels in a straight line. It moves quickly across the landscape, tearing up trees and hollowing out the ground. When it finally impacts with its target, it explodes, dealing enough damage that even Gamabunta couldn't withstand more than a few. By hitting its stomach rapidly, Shukaku can produce multiple Air Bullets in order to overwhelm its opponents.
Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet Pellet: A weaker version of Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet, in which after fully possessing Gaara, Shukaku exhales two smaller shots of compressed air mixed with chakra. He has the ability merge two shots to make a larger and more powerful shot.
Wind Release: Dust Cloud Technique: This technique creates a stream of high-velocity wind containing dust particles, capable of decimating anything caught in it in only a matter of moments. The completed technique is directed through horizontally overlapped hands that are placed in front of the user's mouth after forming the necessary hand seals.
Wind Release: Flag Current: By swinging their flag, the user can change the flow and shape of the surrounding air currents and use them for various offensive purposes against the opposing threat, like breaking through various defences or cutting through clothing.
Wind Release: Flashing Fireworks: The user throws a handful of shuriken into the air like one would throw flowers. With a swing of their Giant Folding Fan, the user then encloses the shuriken in wind, making them hit the floor and spring back up in several sequences.
Wind Release: Flower Scattering Dance: This technique allows the user to summon a cyclone of petals to attack their opponent. The user can remain in one spot for the use of the technique, because they can direct it anywhere they desire. Therefore, the user can increase the direction and power of the technique to the maximum as a last resort.
Wind Release: Flower Storm: Hana creates a petal filled wind vortex around her target to confuse and distract it.
Wind Release: Flying Locust Wind: The user conjures a powerful gust of wind in the surrounding area. They could use the powerful wind to boost themselves to a higher location. The wind is strong enough to damage unsound structures.
Wind Release: Gale Palm: A Wind Release technique where the user either increases their velocity, or by the user clasping their hands together, wind is compressed and transformed into a powerful gale, which has enough force to knock over a person. When used in conjunction with shuriken or kunai, the tools become more lethal as their speed is increased.
Wind Release: Great Balloon: The user gathers an enormous amount of wind and creates a massive twister. Its power can easily repel two men a considerable distance away. The hand seals for the technique differ depending on which direction the user gathers wind.
Wind Release: Great Breakthrough: The user breathes wind from their mouth, blowing away whatever is in front of them. The technique itself is quite simple, but its power varies significantly depending on the user's skill and how strong they make the winds; Rin no Sho compares Orochimaru's use of this technique against Team 7 to a hurricane, as his is able to uproot trees.
Wind Release: Great Cast Net: The Wind Release: Great Cast Net technique works similar to its parent technique whereby the user utilises their Giant Folding Fan to create a multitude of extremely sharp blades of wind to attack their opponent with. These blades of wind overlap with one another forming a figurative net which cuts the target from all angles.
Wind Release: Great Explosion Flame: Kakashi shoots a blast of wind on a flame-covered opponent, which intensifies the fire and causes it to blow up.
Wind Release: Great Sickle Weasel Techni: Temari uses her giant fan to create a more powerful and larger-scale version of her Great Sickle Weasel Technique, releasing heavy air currents that collide together to create many vacuum pockets to slash her targets.
Wind Release: Great Slashing Tornado: Temari, flapping her Giant Folding Fan, creates a minor tornado, which ensnares the opponent, damaging and cutting the opponent, leaving them crashing into the ground after the tornado subsides.
Wind Release: Great Task of the Dragon: The user swings their fan to the sky, causing a giant tornado to descend upon a target. This technique can be set up as a feint as it has a delayed activation. The technique alters weather conditions temporarily and attacks from the sky rather than from the person. The storm clouds that create the attack dissipate immediately after the tornado begins while the tornado continues in a highly concentrated state.
Wind Release: Great Wind Mask: Kakuzu, while in his long-range form, releases a wind bullet that can repel a multitude of things and damage multiple enemies all at once.
Wind Release: Great Wind Protective Wall: Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari creates a wind wall that pushes her opponents away.
Wind Release: Heaven and Earth Net: Reto condenses chakra and throws several wind blades forward continuously, which form a huge net to cut the enemy and the terrain together.
Wind Release: Infinite Sand Cloud — Grea: While preparing to enter Tailed Beast Mode, Gaara covers his body with sand. With this sand, he is able to form mouths all over his body. Gaara inhales with these and his regular mouth, causing his body to swell up. He then exhales this wind, mixing it with sand that's been coated with his chakra. The resulting sandstorm covers a wide area in front of Gaara and is very powerful, enough to knock down trees and deal extensive physical damage. For these reasons, it is a useful attack against multiple opponents.
Wind Release: Multi-Layered Gale: The user creates a wall of multiple layers of vacuum that are stacked on top of each other like a mille-feuille. This technique can be used to provide additional support to other defensive techniques.
Wind Release: Obscuring Paper: The user manifests countless dark papers to surround and envelop the area, forming a dome barrier to trap targets inside. Within it, the user can unleash their other techniques to attack from any angle. The user can also project their voice to further confuse the enemy. If the dome barrier is damaged, the user can reinforce it with new paper. It is a chakra taxing technique which can't be maintained for long.
Wind Release: Passing Typhoon: The user creates a gust of wind that blows away all weather conditions. It is powerful enough to dispel even the Hiding in Mist Technique.
Wind Release: Pressure Damage: A powerful wind technique released by Kakuzu's wind-element mask. This tornado-like mass is compressed until it has a very high density before being released. The blast can hit a vast range, inflicting massive damage on both the target and their close surroundings. This technique can also be combined with the Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work, to increase the flame's potency in a great scale, causing a massive fire-storm.
Wind Release: Rasengan: The Wind Release: Rasengan is an original technique created by Naruto Uzumaki.
Wind Release: Rasenshuriken: The Wind Release: Rasenshuriken is a shuriken-shaped variant of the Wind Release: Rasengan.
Wind Release: Repeated Rasenshuriken: The Wind Release: Repeated Rasenshuriken is a ninjutsu created and utilised by Naruto Uzumaki.
Wind Release: Rotating Shuriken: By infusing wind-natured chakra into shuriken, the user can make them spin, as well as control them in the air.
Wind Release: Sand Buckshot: After Gaara scatters and compresses numerous sand particles into bullet-like projectiles, Shukaku expels a giant gust of wind from its stomach, with the impact of a bomb to increase the force of the bullets, creating a large-scale sandstorm. This attack is powerful enough to pierce through flesh with ease, and is difficult to dodge, due to the technique's speed and range.
Wind Release: Sand Cloud Breakthrough: The user unleashes a powerful burst of wind blades from their palm. It is strong enough to repel a large assault of Iron Sand.
Wind Release: Sand Cloud Whirlwind: The user creates a dome-shaped sandstorm which surrounds the opponent and prevents them from escaping. During the technique's execution, the used sand particles collide against each other, thus creating electromagnetic waves which place the trapped person under never-ending genjutsu in the form of featureless beings attacking with kunai. While the target is busy fending these illusions off, they are vulnerable to attacks from the outside.
Wind Release: Scattering Blossoms: Hana attacks her target with a petal filled wind vortex. However, per chakra nature relationships, this jutsu faltered when used against a fire-breathing flame bear.
Wind Release: Shakujō Twister: By spinning their shakujō above their head, the user is able to produce a very large twister around himself before launching it out. It is powerful enough to easily repel demonic wind blasts.
Wind Release: Shield of the Wind Count: A self-proclaimed invincible barrier; using hand gestures, the user is able to create a protective barrier of wind capable of repelling any incoming attack they perceive, back on the original user with equal or greater force. In the anime, even if an attack proves too powerful to repel, the barrier will cushion enough of the attack to save the user from an otherwise deadly assault.
Wind Release: Spiralling Barrier: Using a Rasengan, Konohamaru can counter an enemy attack by dispersing the Rasengan with wind chakra, creating a strong wind barrier. This technique proved to be powerful enough to block a Chidori.
Wind Release: Spiralling Wind Ball: This technique allows the user to breathe wind-infused chakra into the palm of their hand, shaping it into a small, whirlwind-like ball. Then the user will shoot it at their opponent. This technique seems to be very fast and powerful, as it is capable of smashing through thick rock. They can be launched in rapid succession.
Wind Release: Sword of the Wind Count: Through a mere hand motion, the user releases a sharp wave of compressed wind from their hand. This was powerful enough to effortlessly slash through a shadow clone.
Wind Release: Toad Gun: The Wind Release: Toad Gun is a two-way cooperation ninjutsu between Naruto and Gamatatsu. It is a wind-infused version of the Water Release: Water Gun technique.
Wind Release: Toad Oil Bullet: This technique is the wind-natured upgrade of the Toad Oil Bullet technique, similar in principle to the Water Release: Water Gun. It was ad-libbed from Naruto's and Gamatatsu's Wind Release: Toad Gun technique, using toad oil instead of water. Naruto moulds his wind-natured chakra, while Gamatatsu moulds his own chakra into the oil in his mouth. On command Gamatatsu will expel the oil from his mouth, and combine it with the wind chakra that Naruto channels into Gamatatsu's body, creating a powerful and fast stream of toad oil, which spreads to cover a much larger area but maintaining a powerful striking force due to the wind-natured chakra.
Wind Release: Toad Oil Flame Bullet: This is a three-way synchronised cooperation ninjutsu between Naruto, Gamatatsu, and Gamakichi. It is an expansion of the Wind Release: Toad Oil Bullet technique. After Naruto enhances Gamatatsu's Toad Oil Bullet with his wind-natured chakra, Gamakichi steps in and uses his Fire Release: Flame Bullet technique to ignite the oil. The wind not only improves the oil's coverage and distance, but also adds power to the flame. Using this technique they were able to knock out the Three-Tails.
Wind Release: Ultra-Big Ball Rasenshurik: The Wind Release: Ultra-Big Ball Rasenshuriken is a more advanced version of Wind Release: Rasenshuriken.
Wind Release: Vacuum Blade: The user exhales wind-infused chakra onto a weapon in order to increase its sharpness, range and lethality. For example, the user can infuse a kunai to resemble a makeshift scimitar or infuse shuriken to increase their range and cutting power. In the case of the kunai, wind-natured chakra, which envelopes the weapon, has a distinctive light green colouring.
Wind Release: Vacuum Gale: Single: Danzō jumps back, firing a vacuum sphere, and while his opponent is stunned, he follows with a vacuum wave.
Wind Release: Vacuum Great Sphere: A stronger version of the Wind Release: Vacuum Sphere technique, where the user instead chooses to compress the entirety of the previously inhaled breath into a single large, crushing sphere of wind chakra that they then proceed to expel from their mouth.
Wind Release: Vacuum Serial Waves: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several blades of wind at different angles, by rapidly moving their head in various directions. The power of this technique can be dramatically enhanced when utilised in conjunction with the effects of extreme suction, such as that generated by Baku, where the augmented attack proved effective enough to even slice through the defences of Sasuke's humanoid Susanoo.
Wind Release: Vacuum Sphere: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, making it very difficult for one to avoid without injury. Due to the properties of this technique, the expelled blasts are capable of piercing into and potentially through an opponent's flesh. In the anime, Danzō could also compress the air to create a spherical-like blast that is powerful enough to break through a wood dome.
Wind Release: Vacuum Wave: The user takes a deep breath and spins while exhaling, compressing the released air into a solitary blade of wind that covers a substantial area around the user, due to their circular motion.
