The resulting sharpened blast is large enough to slice through multiple targets located at a significant distance from the user, causing grievous injuries to those hit.
Wind Release: Verdant Mountain Gale: By using wind-based chakra, the user can infuse their bladed weapons with it from a distance and manipulate them.
Wind Release: Whirlwind Fist: A technique where the user clads their fist with Wind Release to form somewhat of a typhoon that is a revolving blade of wind. Upon impact against an individual, the technique pierces their body and blows them away with a shock wave.
Wind Release: Wind Cutter Technique: Using their chakra or a ninja tool such as a war fan to manipulate or create an external source of wind, the user can create one to several blades of wind, which are capable of slicing through their target with ease. Temari and a group of tessenjutsu users from Sunagakure also used this technique as a means of countering a powerful, incoming torrent of wind.
Wind Return: Using the Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, the user of this technique can easily cancel another Wind Release technique and redirect it to its user in the form of a hurricane.
Wind Spider Technique: Jigumo can summon his wind spiders, enabling him to spin trails, which can be used to shoot his opponent with webs at high speeds (as shown in Casualty Puppet), trap opponents inside a room crawling with spiders and webs, or to make a windmill of webs. This technique was used to track down team Jiraiya by spinning a silver trail. This can be useful with a ventriloquism technique.
Wind Water Wild Wave Technique: In this cooperation ninjutsu, the Water Release user unleashes a wave of water which torrents towards the opponent while the Wind Release user enhances the wave's destructive capability with wind.
Wind Waves: The user waves their hand and creates a large blade of wind that can be launched at the opponent. This technique was powerful enough to briefly stop the movements of Sasuke Uchiha's Susanoo.
Wind and Lightning Release: Typhoon Ligh: Naruto forms a wind-natured Rasengan and Sasuke adds his Chidori to the sphere, after which the two thrust the technique into the opponent.
Winding Smoke Technique: After revealing a special tag, the user executes a hand seal, releasing a green sort of smoke to disable the sight of all enemies involved in it. This gives the user the opportunity to escape or attack their opponents, depending on their will.
Windmill: Kimimaro teleports above the opponent, extending his bones and then spins downwards like a giant drill to rip through the opponent's body.
Windmill (Hanabi): An imperfect version of the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven. After countering the opponent's attacks, Hanabi spins while a protective shield surrounds her. Unfortunately for her, she falls down after use.
Windmill Throw: Sakura grabs her opponent by the torso, jumps up with them and comes back down, hitting the ground with them, and still holding them, throws them behind her back sideways.
Wing Beheading: Using two of Chōmei's wings, Fū spins and unleashes two large blades of wind on the opponent.
Wing Rotation: Transformed as Chōmei, Fū swirls Chōmei's non-winged tail, creating and directing a small tornado towards her opponent.
Wire Bind: After performing the necessary hand seals, the user launches several strands of wire to ensnare an enemy. Once captured, the user can tighten the wire at will, to inflict injury or maim the victim.
Wire Cage: This technique uses wire strings to form a powerful protective dome. This dome can repel most basic taijutsu attacks. The user can reshape the wire within the dome as needed, changing it from a defensive structure to a binding string with ease.
Wisdom Wolf Decay: The Wisdom Wolf Decay is a ninjutsu unique to Saiken.
Wolf Fang Punishing Drill: Asuma delivers two slashes across the opponent's chest and delivers another slash upwards to launch the opponent into the air. Asuma quickly jumps into the air himself, delivers two slashes in the opponent's face and one final slash to send the opponent back into the ground.
Wolf Fang Rising Fist: The user hits the opponent with a series of punches and slashes, finishing with a rising uppercut that lifts the opponent into the air.
Wolf River: After transforming into a two headed wolf, Kiba and Akamaru leap forward and bite the opponent with both heads sending them flying.
Wood Clone Technique: A clone that is created by using chakra to alter the user's own cells into vegetation. The clones can be as simple in function as a wooden dummy for use in the Body Replacement Technique or completely mobile and able to perform jutsu. They have the ability to travel far from the user and are able to communicate with the original. Moreover, since the wood clone has the ability to merge with plants and trees, it is also great for reconnaissance missions. By directly touching the wood clone with his hand, the user can change the shape of the clone.
Wood Clone: Kick: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground and hit the opponent, knocking them backwards. A clone then flips over the pillar and slams his leg into the opponent when they are on the ground.
Wood Pillar Climb: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground and hit the opponent, knocking them backwards.
Wood Pillar Sky Kick: Yamato attacks his opponent with a series of punches and kicks before turning their left arm into a pillar of wood that is extended into the ground and lifting him into the air towards the opponent, and kicking them backwards.
Wood Pillar Spin Kick: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground, takes hold of the pillar and then begins spinning around with his leg hanging out to kick the opponent multiple times.
Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity: Hashirama Senju creates a dense growth of trees, controlling how it grows using his chakra. The trees' life force is immense enough to split the earth as they sprout and further pierce through any other obstructions they encounter. This growth is also fast enough that it can capture targets before they have a chance to escape. Hashirama used this technique to serve as a foundation for Konohagakure; none other than Hashirama have been capable of such a feat.
Wood Release: Adamantine Beckoning Tree: Hashirama uses this technique to make some thick tendrils of wood surround him. This can be used to defend against close range attacks or to strike an opponent when they are near.
Wood Release: Adamantine Fist: Hashirama enhances the physical strength of Wood Release: Wood Human Technique, which jumps and smashes the opponent with its fist, dealing great damage.
Wood Release: Advent of a World of Flowe: Taking advantage of the innate properties of Wood Release which allows the user to force trees to grow on any surface at a rapid pace, the user creates a dense forest of flowering trees. During the forest's formation, the user can have the branch restrain any target(s) that tries to attack the user before the formation of the forest is complete. The pollen produced by these flowers is then released into the atmosphere and when inhaled, renders any afflicted target unconscious. The user can also control where the pollen spreads so it does not affect them nor their comrades. The pollen is also capable of penetrating Susanoo's defences.
Wood Release: All Creation: Hashirama causes multiple wood tendrils to rise up from the ground, weaving into a wooden wall around the opponent's limbs binding them in place. He then concentrates his chakra into his fist and then strikes the opponent, breaking them free of the woven wooden wall.
Wood Release: Beams: Yamato causes several wood beams to erupt from the ground and reach high into the sky. They spread out and turn back down, crashing down at the opponent. They end up looking like a willow.
Wood Release: Circular Pillar Prison Tec: Yamato creates wooden pillars in a circular formation to trap and crush the opponent.
Wood Release: Complete Capture: Yamato traps his opponent in a wooden dome, and sends several wood beams crashing at it, destroying the dome and hitting his opponent.
Wood Release: Cutting Technique: A versatile technique where the user can produce sharp wooden spikes from their body to either fashion short-range weapons akin to a makeshift sword, or use them as projectiles, where the branches' growth can be triggered remotely, skewering the enemy as a result which will usually see the target dying.
Wood Release: Cypress Nail: Yamato impales the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and hammers the wood with a giant wooden mallet that crushes the opponent to bits.
Wood Release: Firmament Splinter: Hashirama slams the ground with his fist, releasing large trees from which rise from underground and capture the opponent, allowing him to finish them off by punching them down through the trees, and into the ground.
Wood Release: Foo Dog Heads: A technique designed to be used to absorb a tailed beast's chakra. The user produces the kanji on their palm and creates a series of wooden pillars, which are engraved with what resemble foo dog faces and have lit wicks on top of them. When the user slams their palm on the ground, the wooden statues rush towards the target and absorb its chakra.
Wood Release: Four-Pillar House Techniqu: By sending chakra into the ground, the roots of the plants are converted into raw materials. This technique allows for a building to be constructed, by forcing accelerated growth. Just like with the Four-Pillar Prison Technique, the size and shape of the building are taken from the user's imagination or memories. By placing tags around the house, the user creates a barrier, making it impossible for the enemy to detect it and allowing the user to "camp" in peace.
Wood Release: Four-Pillar Prison Techniq: The user converts chakra into timber under the ground and lets it grow rapidly while forming it into a wooden prison. The size of the prison is based on the user's imagination. From an insect cage to a great prison, one can make it into whatever they want by regulating the amount of chakra used. The timber itself is treated with a chakra coating, making its destruction extremely difficult. During war, it has the great ability to detain prisoners, but it can also be used as a disciplinary measure for quarrelling subordinates.
Wood Release: Great Forest Crumbling: The user makes trees grow rapidly under the opponent, stabbing them and throwing them quite distantly.
Wood Release: Great Forest Technique: A technique that changes one's own arm into big trees. Using chakra, the tissues are transformed into trees at the cellular level. Then, by activating the trees, stimulating them to grow rapidly, they lengthen at high speed and fork into many branches. It is possible to capture the enemy with these branches and at the same time, if one changes the ends into sharp stakes, turn them into countless, sharp, spear-like piercing weapons.
Wood Release: Great Spear Tree: Obito brings up several thick roots from the ground, and uses them to crush his opponents.
Wood Release: Great Tree Crumbling Attac: Hashirama attacks the opponent with thick tree branches growing out towards the opponent.
Wood Release: Great Tree Roaring Nativit: Hashirama summons tree branches to lift himself up in the air towards the opponent and punches the ground beneath them, causing trees to grow underneath and strike them away.
Wood Release: Great Wooden Mallet: Yamato creates a wood clone with a giant wooden hammer as a hand, which jumps at the opponent and clobbers them with it.
Wood Release: Hand Tool Manipulation: Using Wood Release, Yamato manipulates his hand to form into a tool, such as a key or a shield.
Wood Release: Hotei Technique: The user creates a number of gigantic wooden hands that erupt upward from beneath the ground, which then encircle and attempt to restrain a chosen enemy. The size of each of these hands is around the size of a tailed beast. Hashirama is shown to be able to manifest two hands with sheer will alone, without the use of hand seals.
Wood Release: Hōbi Technique: Quickly creating a dome-like structure in the form of a dragon's face, the user is completely surrounded. Taking advantage of the nature of Wood Release, this fūinjutsu substantially weakens incoming attacks whilst protecting the user inside.
Wood Release: Kakashi: Yamato traps the opponent in a wooden vice, after which he uses carpentry tools to carve a giant head of Kakashi Hatake out of the resulting vice.
Wood Release: Nativity of Trees: Yamato strikes the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and makes the wood that struck the opponent form into a tree.
Wood Release: Nativity of a Sea of Trees: After forming the necessary seals, Yamato is able to turn an area into a vast forest in a matter of mere moments complete with trees and grass growing out of any terrain he is on. This technique is very similar to Hashirama's signature technique, albeit on a somewhat smaller scale.
Wood Release: Pillar Crush: Yamato traps the opponent in a wooden prison and turns his wood clone into a giant pillar that ultimately crushes the opponent.
Wood Release: Revolt of Hell: Obito skewers his opponent with wood tendrils, punches and kicks them upwards, followed by a knee to the face. He then phases through them on the way down, and brings up several roots to impale them.
Wood Release: Ruptured Earth: Hashirama launches an attack across the surface of the ground, causing roots to sprout underground, destroying the battlefield.
Wood Release: Serial Pillar Houses Techn: A larger scaled version of the Wood Release: Four-Pillar House Technique where instead of creating a single house, Yamato creates multiple houses at once. Because of the sheer volume of structures created with this technique, it appears to exhaust him rather quickly.
Wood Release: Smothering Binding Techniq: By transforming their arm into a tree, the user can then create multiple branches which will rapidly grow around the target, immobilising them. This technique is strong enough to restrain a giant squid.
Wood Release: Stocks: Yamato creates wooden stocks to restrain a target. These stocks also have the added effect of suppressing the target's chakra, rendering most captives unable to retaliate.
Wood Release: Thousand Core Piercing Tec: Using the giant statue as a medium, Tobi smashes the opponent with a giant wooden hand, and while the enemy is trapped under its giant hand he impales them with wooden spikes.
Wood Release: Transformation: Yamato performs the necessary hand seals, then wood emerges and covers his entire body with a puff of smoke or chakra, covering up the transformation. Once the technique is done, the transformation is complete. It acts more like a costume than a transformation, as he is able to leave it behind if necessary. He also demonstrates the ability to adjust his voice while using this technique.
Wood Release: Tree Bind Flourishing Buri: This technique lets the user summon a tree around their opponent to bind them. This technique is relatively powerful and holds opponents much more gracefully, with less of a strain on the user, because the user sinks them into the ground. Afterwards, the user can enclose the opponent so that their body is crushed.
Wood Release: Tree of Flight: Yamato kicks the opponent into the air before summoning a bridge of wood that carries the opponent away. Yamato then jumps behind them and uses a beam of wood to run them through the wood bridge and force them to the ground.
Wood Release: Wild Picket Technique: Yamato places his hands on the ground to bring forth three cylinder shaped branches to attack the opponent.
Wood Release: Wood Dragon Technique: The user creates a gigantic wooden dragon, which they can use for a multitude of purposes including restraining a target, or for offensive purposes. The dragon that the user creates can vary in terms of appearance. While both instances created a serpentine dragon, Chinese dragon, though the first had a short trunk-like nose, while the other two later created did not. It also has the ability to absorb chakra from its target, slowly rendering them unable to use techniques by biting into the target and draining them almost in a vampiric fashion. In the anime, Hashirama was able to cause the dragon to detonate on his target, resulting in a large explosion.
Wood Release: Wood Fetters Technique: Yamato creates a spiralling pillar of wood rise up from the ground beneath the intended target causing them damage whist throwing them several feet.
Wood Release: Wood Human Technique: After forming the required hand seals, the user creates an enormous statue-like creature out of wood. This humanoid creature with a full body and an oni-like face is usually created with a wooden dragon wrapped around its torso, and is generally used in battle as an avatar. The wooden dragon can be multiplied and be used to attack its enemies directly as well. This creature is stated to be as powerful as the Nine-Tails, and could catch an uncompressed, uncharged, standard Tailed Beast Ball fired by the latter. If the user doesn't have enough time to manifest the entire body, they can manifest a limb or two first to buy enough time for the full body to form. It could even clash against the likes of Madara Uchiha's Complete Body — Susanoo, which was stated by Madara himself to have destructive powers rivalling even the tailed beasts.
Wood Release: Wood Locking Wall: An extremely versatile move, this technique uses chakra to activate the roots in the ground and, using the user of the technique as a reference point, makes wooden pillars appear from left and right. The wooden pillars join together in a dome-shape with the user at the centre. In the case that the user confronts the enemy at a short distance, the enemy can be locked up inside the dome, catching the enemy in a double sided attack. Furthermore, it can function as an easy shelter against an enemy's long-distance attacks, like the shockwave created from Naruto Uzumaki in his Version 2 state.
Wood Release: Wood Spikes Ring: The user creates a semi-circle of wood around a captured target, and then form spikes within the ring, pointing at the target, preventing them from making any sudden movements.
Wood Release: Wooden Mallet: Yamato creates several pieces of wood from the ground that shoot out and pierce the opponent.
Wood Release: Wooden Spear Heavenly Tear: After a taijutsu combo, Hashirama summons a large tree branch to send the opponent flying in the air, jumps at them and punches them down.
Wood Release: World of Trees Wall: The user creates countless wooden branches that grow at high speed from the ground. The branches interlace to form a wide, net-like wall with an impressive defensive power.
Wood Stab Palm: Yamato strikes the opponent with a series of punches and kicks leading to him jumping into the air and releasing a wooden spear from his palm that is directed into the opponent and used to drive them into the ground.
Wooden Men Possession Turnover Manipulat: This technique forces two opponents to fight each other through wooden training dummies, with the intent of tricking them into fighting each other until all but one of them is defeated. The only way to break the technique is to have fast and strong taijutsu, by utilising speed so extreme that the wooden training dummies are unable to keep up and thus break apart, effectively breaking the technique. If the victims are familiar enough with one another they will be able to tell who their opponent is. They can also communicate through non-verbal means such as Morse code.
Wooden Puppet Manipulation Technique: By placing a charm onto the puppet beforehand, this technique allows the user to control its movements through will alone. Alternatively, the puppets can attack the opponent on their own, though the ability to react to their opponent's movements is limited. If the tag is removed, then the technique can then be disabled.
Wrapping Flame Cat Fire: Transforming into Matatabi, Yugito runs towards the opponent in a fiery tackle.
Yachihoko: Yachihoko is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu.
Yachihoko no Kami: Kaguya opens numerous small portals to shoot hazards from her dimensions at the opponent.
Yachihoko: Dazzling Flames of Rebellion: Using Yachihoko to boost her abilities, Hikari dashes around slicing the opponent with her kunai, kicks them up in the air, spews a a fireball and Amaterasu, causing it to burst into towering pillars of blazing fire and black flames.
Yakusaikazuchinokami: Momoshiki first calls forth several lightning bolts to strike the ground before him, then releases a powerful tidal wave of water over the area, forming a large, electrified whirlpool.
Yasaka Magatama: Yasaka Magatama is a technique that Susanoo users can use from any of its hands. Due to its structure, it acts in a similar manner to that of a shuriken when thrown by Susanoo — rapidly spinning towards the intended target — and results in an explosion upon impact. The size of these projectiles are dependent on the user, with smaller variations often used when fighting in close quarters or confined spaces.
Yasaka Magatama: Tailed Beast Noka: This Cooperation Ninjutsu is a collaboration technique using the user's strongest long ranged techniques including Naruto's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken, Itachi's Yasaka Magatama, and Killer B's Tailed Beast Ball. The combination was only used once against Nagato, during which the users took advantage at not needing to aim their jutsu towards the target due to its gravitation pull. On impact, the collaboration technique was strong enough to destroy Nagato's Chibaku Tensei.
Yellow Flash (Naruto): Channelling Kurama's chakra, Naruto performs an enhanced Body Flicker Technique to instantly cross vast distances.
Yellow Flash (jutsu): Minato blasts the opponent into the air with a Rasengan and then proceeds to throw one of his Flying Thunder God Kunai behind them. As he teleports behind them, he strikes them in the back with another Rasengan that expands to a larger size before exploding and sending the opponent back to the ground.
Yellow Flash Rasengan: Minato kicks the opponent in the air, throws his Flying Thunder God Kunai, teleports to them, and kicks them again, ending the combo with a Rasengan while on the ground as the opponent falls down on the attack.
Yin Healing Wound Destruction: Kabuto analyses an opponent's facial expression, movements, and the properties of their jutsu to anticipate where and how he will be attacked. He then gathers chakra to the area of his body where the attack will strike, preemptively starting medical treatment in order to minimise the damage he'll receive. The more extensive the damage, the more chakra it takes to heal; the damage from Rasengan is so great that Kabuto lacks enough chakra to fully recover. In addition to needing to correctly read the opponent and react in time, users require great resilience in order to perform the jutsu, traits that only Kabuto possesses.
Yin Seal: Release: The Strength of a Hundred Seal - which takes the form of a diamond on the user's forehead - is used to gradually build up and store the user's chakra over time. Yin Seal: Release opens that seal, giving the user access to the accumulated chakra. Upon release, a pattern starts to appear from the diamond shape, spreading out across their forehead and potentially the rest of their body; by spreading the seal's pattern to another, the user can transfer the seal's chakra to them instead. The stored chakra amounts to far more than what the user has on their own, allowing them to perform chakra-demanding jutsu that they wouldn't be able to use otherwise, such as Creation Rebirth. If not all of the chakra ends up being used, it can be stored in a new Strength of a Hundred Seal.
Yin–Yang Release (jutsu): Obito uses Truth-Seeking Balls to block an opponent's attacks, shaping the Truth-Seeking Balls into a different defensive shield each time. After blocking several attacks in this way, he forms a spike from one of the shields to pierce the opponent, creating an opening for him to attack the opponent with chakra arms and his staff.
Yomito's Transformation Technique: Yomito activates this technique by placing the mask he keeps strapped to his right arm on his face. Once activated Yomito transforms into an oni-like creature. His body greatly grows in size and becomes very muscular, his skin becomes grey and his hair becomes crimson. The only clothes that remain are his pants. He also gains a necklace of large, dark green beads and a crimson marking on the back of each arm, right above his elbows. In this form Yomito makes use of the enormous fists it grants him, using them to smash the ground or chuck rocks out of it to attack from a distance. The only vulnerable spot seems to be his head and he has to somehow be knocked down for it to be reached.
Yomotsu Hirasaka: Yomotsu Hirasaka is a kekkei mōra technique used by members of the Ōtsutsuki clan, which is said to be the progenitor of all space–time ninjutsu.
Yosaku Cut: Using his giant axe, Sabu strikes the opponent with a low, lateral blow.
You Won't Get Away!: Kushina jumps and delivers a series of strikes with her frying pan, chasing the opponent. Then, she hits her opponent with a pan, knocking them into the ground.
Young Lightning: Kakashi whilst in the air will drop down on his opponent with a lightning-charged hand strike.
Young Spirited Embrace of Youth: Guy punches the opponent aside, only to apologise and embrace them, fracturing the opponent's back and doing liberal damage.
Youth Full Power: The user begins with kicking the opponent into the air. Once airborne, the user will then kick the opponent in the face before finishing with a powerful drop kick that will send the opponent back down to the ground, emitting a light of "youthful" energy.
Youth Leaf Lotus Attack: Lee activates the Eight Gates, delivers a barrage of punches and kicks, and delivers one final kick on the opponent.
Youth Roar: Guy lets out a loud shout, made to intimidate opponents and invigorate teammates.
Zelkova: Kimimaro knocks the opponent into the air and then appears above them before extending a large number of spikes from his arm to stab the opponent.
Zero-Tails Sealing Technique: This technique is a unique form of sealing which was passed down in the Land of the Sky and used to restrain the Zero-Tails.
Zeus: The technique consists of striking the opponent into the air with a Lightning Release-infused uppercut palm attack.
Ōdachi Mow Down: Kinshiki manifests a giant axe, flies at his opponent, and delivers a sweeping slash at them.
Ōhirume: Ōhirume is a dōjutsu that can be used with Sarada Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan.
Ōtsutsuki Teleportation: This technique is a Space–Time Ninjutsu used by the Ōtsutsuki clan. The user creates a rift, which allows anyone enveloped to transfer to a chosen location including foreign dimensions. The rift's formation is fast enough to catch targets off guard and transport them alongside the user, as well as to evade attacks from enemies at the last moment.
